articles.abstract_zh: MnPtGa 在中心对称的 P63/mmc 结构中具有铁磁、倾斜反铁磁和自旋密度波等竞争磁态，而相关的破缺反演对称结构则支持手性斯格明子。研究制备了生长于石墨烯/Ge(111)上的单晶 MnPtGa 薄膜，并通过机械剥离释放薄膜；衍射结果证实其具有较高晶体质量。磁化率和时间分辨反射率测量表明约 140 K 的异常与可能的自旋密度波能隙有关，而人为引入褶皱能够抑制该异常，显示出机械调控低温磁态的能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: MnPtGa 在中心对称的 P63/mmc 结构中具有相互竞争的磁性态，包括铁磁序、倾斜反铁磁序和自旋密度波（SDW）序，而一种相关的破缺反演对称结构则支持手性斯格明子。对这种竞争进行调控，需要能够实现可调应变和对称性破缺的材料平台，同时还需要适用于超薄样品的 SDW 序探测手段。在这里，我们展示了通过分子束外延在石墨烯/Ge(111)上生长、并通过机械剥离释放的单晶 MnPtGa 薄膜。X 射线和电子衍射证实了其较高的晶体质量。SQUID 磁强计测量显示，在零场冷却条件下，dM/dT 中位于 140 K 的异常在剥离后仍然存在，而时间分辨反射率测量显示，电子弛豫时间在同一温度处出现峰值，这与可能由假定的 SDW 能隙引起的准粒子—声子瓶颈相一致。人为引入褶皱会抑制约 140 K 的磁性异常，证明机械作用能够控制低温态。这些结果确立了 MnPtGa 薄膜作为探测和通过应变调控竞争磁序的平台。

articles.title: Chirality in Condensed Matter: Symmetry, Waves, and Quasiparticles
articles.title_zh: 凝聚态物质中的手性：对称性、波与准粒子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chirality has become a recurring concept throughout condensed-matter physics, appearing in contexts ranging from optical activity and chiral phonons to magnetic excitations and hybrid quasiparticles. As its use has expanded, however, the concept has often become intertwined with related notions such as angular momentum, polarization, helicity, and nonreciprocity, obscuring its precise symmetry-based meaning. Although chirality is universally associated with broken spatial-inversion (P) symmetry and preserved time-reversal (T) symmetry, its physical manifestation and quantitative characterization strongly depend on the system and phenomenon under consideration. In this review, we examine chirality across photons, phonons, magnons, and hybrid excitations. We show that, while no universal measure of chirality exists, different physical systems admit different P-odd and T-even quantities that characterize specific chiral phenomena. We further argue that chirality is often best understood through chirality-selective interactions between waves, matter, and quasiparticles rather than as an intrinsic property of isolated excitations. From this perspective, hybridization provides a particularly promising setting for the emergence, transfer, and control of chirality in condensed-matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性广泛存在于凝聚态物理的光学活性、手性声子、磁激发和混合准粒子等现象中，但其含义常与角动量、偏振、螺旋度和非互易性相混淆。本文从光子、声子、磁振子及混合激发的角度综述手性，指出不存在普适的手性度量，不同体系需采用特定的宇称奇、时间反演偶物理量进行刻画。作者认为，手性往往应通过波、物质与准粒子之间的手性选择性相互作用来理解，而非视为孤立激发的内禀性质；混成则为手性的产生、传递与调控提供了重要平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性已经成为贯穿凝聚态物理的一个反复出现的概念，涉及从光学活性和手性声子到磁激发与混合准粒子等一系列领域。然而，随着其应用范围不断扩大，这一概念常常与角动量、偏振、螺旋度和非互易性等相关概念交织在一起，从而模糊了其基于对称性的确切含义。尽管手性普遍与空间反演对称性破缺，即宇称对称性P破缺，以及时间反演对称性T保持联系在一起，但其物理表现和定量表征在很大程度上取决于所考察的体系和现象。在这篇综述中，我们考察了光子、声子、磁振子和混合激发中的手性。我们表明，虽然不存在统一的手性度量，但不同物理体系可以采用不同的宇称奇且时间反演偶的物理量，来表征特定的手性现象。我们进一步认为，与其把手性视为孤立激发的内禀性质，不如通过波、物质和准粒子之间的手性选择性相互作用来理解它。从这一角度看，混成是凝聚态体系中手性产生、传递和调控的一个尤其有前景的场景。

articles.title: Enhanced anomalous Nernst effect in Pr-doped kagome and honeycomb magnet LaCo₅
articles.title_zh: Pr掺杂Kagome与蜂窝磁体LaCo₅中的增强反常能斯特效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we report the successful synthesis of La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅ (x = 0.09, 0.21, 0.45) single crystals. Magnetic field-dependent magnetization measurements reveal that Pr substitution induces negligible changes in the magnetic properties of LaCo₅, with the ferromagnetic ordering predominantly governed by the Co sublattices. Remarkably, the doped systems exhibit significant enhancements in the anomalous Nernst effect. At 300~K, the anomalous Nernst thermopower S^Ayₓ reaches 6.5~μ V/K in La₀.₅₅Pr₀.₄₅Co₅, corresponding to a sim 40 % enhancement compared to the parent compound. This significant improvement can be predominantly attributed to Pr-doping-induced Fermi level modification, which directly leads to a redistribution of Berry curvature across the Fermi surface. This work highlights the effectiveness of Pr doping in boosting the anomalous Nernst effect of La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅, offering a practical strategy to design advanced materials for room-temperature energy-harvesting technologies and high-efficiency thermal sensing devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文成功制备了La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅（x = 0.09、0.21、0.45）单晶。磁场依赖的磁化测量表明，Pr替代对LaCo₅磁性的影响很小，铁磁有序主要由Co子晶格决定。掺杂体系的反常能斯特效应显著增强，在300 K时La₀.₅₅Pr₀.₄₅Co₅的反常能斯特热电势达到6.5 μV/K，较母体材料提高约40%。这种增强主要归因于Pr掺杂引起的费米能级调节及费米面上贝里曲率的重新分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本工作中，我们成功制备了La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅（x = 0.09、0.21、0.45）单晶。磁场依赖的磁化测量显示，Pr替代对LaCo₅磁性性质的影响可以忽略，铁磁有序主要由Co子晶格控制。值得注意的是，掺杂体系表现出显著增强的反常能斯特效应。在300 K时，La₀.₅₅Pr₀.₄₅Co₅中的反常能斯特热电势S^A_yx达到6.5 μV/K，相比母体化合物提高了约40%。这种显著改善主要可归因于Pr掺杂诱导的费米能级调节，该调节直接导致费米面上贝里曲率的重新分布。本工作凸显了Pr掺杂在增强La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅反常能斯特效应方面的有效性，并为设计用于室温能量收集技术和高效热传感器件的先进材料提供了实用策略。

articles.title: Tensor-network Monte Carlo approach based on time-evolving block decimation
articles.title_zh: 基于时间演化块解耦的张量网络蒙特卡洛方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a tensor-network Monte Carlo (TNMC) approach for unitary evolution following the compression sequence of the time-evolving block decimation (TEBD) algorithm. In the TNMC approach, the obtained results contain evaluable statistical errors rather than truncation errors, unlike ordinary singular-value-decomposition-based methods such as the TEBD algorithm. Consequently, one can estimate unbiased expectation values within statistical errors even with a finite bond dimension. Since the sampling scheme is introduced in the simulations of unitary evolution, the proposed Monte Carlo scheme may suffer from a sign problem. We observe that the sign problem can be mitigated by increasing the bond dimension. We apply the proposed TNMC approach to the Hamiltonian and the Floquet dynamics. Numerical experiments show that the TNMC approach can estimate accurate expectation values of observables even when the TEBD method with the same bond dimension cannot. The proposed approach can be a new direction for improving the classical simulatability of unitary evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种张量网络蒙特卡洛方法，用于按照时间演化块解耦算法的压缩序列进行幺正演化。与基于奇异值分解的常规方法不同，该方法产生的是可评估的统计误差而非截断误差，因此即使键维数有限，也能在统计误差范围内估计无偏期望值。数值结果表明，在相同键维数下，该方法能够在时间演化块解耦方法失效时仍准确估计观测量，并可应用于哈密顿量动力学和Floquet动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种张量网络蒙特卡洛方法，用于按照时间演化块解耦算法的压缩序列进行幺正演化。在张量网络蒙特卡洛方法中，所得结果包含可评估的统计误差，而不是像时间演化块解耦算法等基于奇异值分解的常规方法那样包含截断误差。因此，即使在有限键维数下，也可以在统计误差范围内估计无偏的期望值。由于采样方案被引入幺正演化的模拟中，所提出的蒙特卡洛方案可能遭遇符号问题。我们观察到，增大键维数可以减弱符号问题。我们将所提出的张量网络蒙特卡洛方法应用于哈密顿量动力学和Floquet动力学。数值实验表明，即使相同键维数下的时间演化块解耦方法无法做到这一点，张量网络蒙特卡洛方法仍能准确估计观测量的期望值。所提出的方法可以成为提高幺正演化经典可模拟性的新方向。

articles.title: Spin-polarized Superconductivity and High-Chern Insulators in Twisted Rhombohedral Graphene Family
articles.title_zh: 扭转菱方石墨烯家族中的自旋极化超导与高陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene has emerged as a remarkably versatile platform for exploring strong correlation driven quantum states arising from low-energy topological flat bands. When reconstructed by the moire superlattice, these bands host a wide range of emergent novel states, including integer and fractional Chern insulators and unconventional superconductivity. Here, we firstly report the simultaneous emergence of widespread spin polarized SC and high Chern insulators in twisted bilayer multilayer RMG system 2+n where n=4,5,6. The SC states in 2+n system exhibit different responses to the in plane magnetic field, with SC being suppressed, enhanced and induced by in plane magnetic field . The latter two are consistent with spin-triplet pairing. Along with SC, angle and layer dependent HCIs with tunable Chern numbers emerge. Moreover, the fractional high Chern insulator in the system survives under high in plane magnetic field which can induce SC in the same device. Our work not only establishs twisted bilayer multilayer rhombohedral graphene as a unified platform for studying SC and high Chern insulators, but also opens a pathway towards multiple copropagating chiral Majorana channels by coupling spin-polarized SC to high Chern insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 菱方多层石墨烯为研究低能拓扑平带中强关联驱动的量子态提供了多功能平台。本文首次报道了扭转双层-多层菱方石墨烯2+n体系（n = 4、5、6）中广泛出现的自旋极化超导和高陈绝缘体。超导态对面内磁场表现出抑制、增强和诱导等不同响应，其中后两种现象与自旋三重态配对相一致；同时还出现了角度和层依赖、陈数可调的高陈绝缘体。该体系中的分数高陈绝缘体可在较强面内磁场下保持稳定，为通过自旋极化超导与高陈绝缘体耦合实现多条共传播手性马约拉纳通道提供了可能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 菱方多层石墨烯已经成为探索低能拓扑平带中强关联驱动量子态的极其多功能的平台。当这些能带被莫尔超晶格重构后，它们可以承载一系列新兴的新颖态，包括整数和分数陈绝缘体以及非常规超导态。在这里，我们首次报道了扭转双层-多层菱方石墨烯2+n体系（其中n = 4、5、6）中广泛出现的自旋极化超导和高陈绝缘体。2+n体系中的超导态对面内磁场表现出不同响应，包括被面内磁场抑制、增强以及由面内磁场诱导产生，其中后两种现象与自旋三重态配对相一致。与超导态同时出现的还有依赖于扭转角和层数、且陈数可调的高陈绝缘体。此外，该体系中的分数高陈绝缘体能够在较强面内磁场下保持稳定，而该磁场又可以在同一器件中诱导超导态。我们的工作不仅确立了扭转双层-多层菱方石墨烯作为研究超导与高陈绝缘体的统一平台，也为通过将自旋极化超导与高陈绝缘体耦合来实现多条共传播手性马约拉纳通道开辟了路径。

articles.title: Critical current anisotropy pf practical superconductors: analysis methods and application cases
articles.title_zh: 实用超导体的临界电流各向异性：分析方法与应用案例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The analysis of critical current anisotropy is important for improving superconductor-based devices. This article critically evaluates contemporary techniques for analyzing the angular dependence of critical current in practical superconductors, focusing on second-generation high-temperature superconducting tapes (coated conductors). These techniques are based on the scaling model, vortex path model, or anisotropic pinning model. We present empirical findings on critical current angular dependencies in coated conductors of different chemical compositions. Distinctive features are highlighted: the complex effect of rare-earth substitution in the HTS composition on the pinning landscape, peak asymmetry, and the dependence of critical current on Lorentz force direction at fixed magnetic field direction. The described techniques are then applied to the experimental dataset. A refined anisotropic pinning model is introduced to accurately describe certain observed phenomena. Approximation accuracy of the models is assessed using the coefficient of determination adjusted for the number of fitting variables. The fundamental disparity in interpreting angular dependencies with different models is emphasized. No universal methodology yet comprehensively explains all features or links them to the defective structure of the HTS material. This is a critical gap in understanding superconductor behavior under varying conditions and highlights the need for further research.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统评估了实用超导体，尤其是第二代高温超导带材临界电流角度依赖性的现代分析方法，包括标度模型、涡旋路径模型和各向异性钉扎模型。作者分析了不同化学成分涂层导体中的实验结果，讨论了稀土替代对钉扎景观、峰值不对称性以及洛伦兹力方向依赖性的复杂影响。研究还提出了改进的各向异性钉扎模型，并使用校正决定系数比较不同模型的拟合精度，指出目前尚无一种统一方法能够解释全部角度依赖特征及其与高温超导体缺陷结构的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分析临界电流各向异性对于改进基于超导体的器件具有重要意义。本文批判性地评估了分析实用超导体中临界电流角度依赖性的当代技术，重点关注第二代高温超导带材，即涂层导体。这些技术建立在标度模型、涡旋路径模型或各向异性钉扎模型的基础上。我们给出了不同化学成分涂层导体中临界电流角度依赖性的经验结果。研究突出了若干特征，包括高温超导成分中的稀土替代对钉扎景观的复杂影响、峰值不对称性，以及在磁场方向固定时临界电流对洛伦兹力方向的依赖性。随后，我们将所述技术应用于实验数据集。我们引入了一种改进的各向异性钉扎模型，以准确描述某些观测到的现象。我们使用根据拟合变量数量进行调整的决定系数来评估各模型的近似精度。本文强调，不同模型对角度依赖性的解释存在根本差异。目前还没有一种通用方法能够全面解释所有特征，或将这些特征与高温超导材料的缺陷结构联系起来。这是理解超导体在变化条件下行为时的一个关键缺口，也凸显了进一步研究的必要性。

articles.title: Universal transverse diode effects in superconducting unconventional magnet hybrids
articles.title_zh: 非常规超导磁体杂化体系中的普适横向二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that superconducting unconventional magnet junctions harbor transverse spin and charge diode effects with perfect rectification efficiencies. This nonreciprocal transverse transport is governed by the interplay of mirror reflections and spin rotation with respect to the Néel vector, a mechanism that is universally applicable to all unconventional magnets. Interestingly, the transverse spin diode features pure spin currents, while the charge diode yields spin-polarized charge currents, both exhibiting highly controllable rectification functionalities at vanishing net magnetization. Our results position superconducting unconventional magnets at the forefront of orthogonal engineering in next-generation transverse superconducting spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，超导非常规磁体结能够产生具有完美整流效率的横向自旋和电荷二极管效应。这种非互易横向输运由镜面对称反射与相对于 Néel 矢量的自旋旋转共同决定，并适用于所有非常规磁体。有趣的是，横向自旋二极管产生纯自旋流，而电荷二极管产生自旋极化电荷流；二者均可在净磁化为零时实现高度可控的整流功能。该结果表明，超导非常规磁体是下一代横向超导自旋电子学中正交工程的重要平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，超导非常规磁体结具有横向自旋和电荷二极管效应，并且能够实现完美的整流效率。这种非互易横向输运由镜面反射以及相对于Néel矢量的自旋旋转之间的协同作用控制，这一机制对所有非常规磁体都具有普适适用性。有趣的是，横向自旋二极管表现出纯自旋流，而电荷二极管产生自旋极化的电荷流；二者都能在净磁化为零的情况下表现出高度可控的整流功能。我们的结果使超导非常规磁体成为下一代横向超导自旋电子学正交工程的前沿体系。

articles.title: Efficient non-volatile electric control of magnetosensing in CrSBr
articles.title_zh: CrSBr中磁传感的高效非易失电控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In two-dimensional crystals, electrostatic gating can modulate the charge carrier density, thereby tuning their electrical properties. In magnetic materials such as CrSBr, this approach can also enable direct electrical control of magnetoresistance. Non-volatile gating is particularly attractive since it allows the carrier density to be maintained at a desired level without the need for a continuous gate bias, offering significant advantages for technological applications. Here, we demonstrate a simple device architecture in which a solution-processed ferroelectric P(VDF-TrFE) layer is integrated directly onto a CrSBr channel, enabling non-volatile control of its magnetoresistance. We investigate the magnetotransport response over a broad temperature range and demonstrate a reproducible and robust gate dependence. Notably, the ferroelectric gate achieves a gating efficiency approximately one order of magnitude higher than that of a conventional SiO₂ dielectric, highlighting the potential of ferroelectric gating for electrical control of 2D magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 在二维晶体中，静电栅控能够调节载流子密度，从而改变材料的电学性质；在CrSBr等磁性材料中，这一方法还可直接控制磁阻。本文将溶液法加工的铁电P(VDF-TrFE)层直接集成到CrSBr沟道上，实现了磁阻的非易失调控。宽温区磁输运测量显示出可重复且稳健的栅极依赖性，铁电栅控效率约为传统SiO₂介电层的一个数量级，体现了其用于二维磁性材料电控的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在二维晶体中，静电栅控可以调节载流子密度，从而调控其电学性质。在CrSBr等磁性材料中，这种方法还能够实现对磁阻的直接电控制。非易失栅控尤其具有吸引力，因为它能够在不需要持续施加栅极偏压的情况下，将载流子密度保持在所需水平，从而为技术应用带来显著优势。在这里，我们展示了一种简单的器件结构，其中通过溶液加工制备的铁电P(VDF-TrFE)层被直接集成到CrSBr沟道上，从而能够非易失地控制其磁阻。我们在较宽的温度范围内研究了磁输运响应，并证明了可重复且稳健的栅极依赖性。值得注意的是，与传统的SiO₂介电层相比，铁电栅极实现的栅控效率约高一个数量级，凸显了铁电栅控在二维磁性材料电控制方面的潜力。

articles.title: Persistence of BKT phase transition in the 2D nonanalytic XY model
articles.title_zh: 二维非解析XY模型中BKT相变的持续存在
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12560v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the two-dimensional XY model with the nonanalytic pair potential 2[(1-cosδ)/2]p, whose small-angle law propto|δ|²p carries a cusp for p<1 and a flat bottom for p>1, invalidating the harmonic spin-wave expansion. Two questions arise: the nature of the low-temperature (T) phase and of the phase transition. A naive energetic argument would predict genuine long-range order and an enhanced transition temperature for p<1, and no transition at all for p>1. Large-scale Monte Carlo simulations contradict both: for every p>0 the dengrevxxilow-T phase is quasi-long-range ordered, with anomalous dimension η(T)propto T¹/p, and terminates at a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless transition. Using a vortex-free noncompact lattice-field description and utilizing a duality transformation, we show that coarse-graining drives the height-difference distribution onto a single Gaussian fixed point, renormalizing the cusp and flatness into a finite harmonic stiffness that restores the spin-wave description and the BKT scenario for all p>0.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有非解析成对势的二维XY模型，其小角度行为在p<1时具有尖 cusp，在p>1时具有平坦底部，因此常规谐自旋波展开失效。大规模蒙特卡洛模拟表明，对所有p>0，低温相均为准长程有序相，并在Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless相变处终止，而非简单能量论所预言的长程有序或无相变。通过无涡旋非紧致晶格场论和对偶变换，作者说明粗粒化会将高度差分布驱动到单一高斯固定点，从而把尖 cusp和平坦底部重整化为有限的谐刚度，恢复所有p>0情况下的自旋波描述与BKT情景。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有非解析成对势的二维XY模型，其形式为2[(1-cosδ)/2]^p；该势的小角度规律与|δ|⁽²p⁾成正比，在p<1时带有尖 cusp，在p>1时具有平坦底部，从而使谐自旋波展开失效。由此产生了两个问题：低温相的性质以及相变的性质是什么？一种朴素的能量论论证会预言，在p<1时存在真正的长程有序和增强的转变温度，而在p>1时根本不存在相变。大规模蒙特卡洛模拟与这两种预言都不一致：对于每个p>0，低温相都是准长程有序的，其反常维数满足η(T)与T⁽¹/p⁾成正比，并在Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless相变处终止。通过使用无涡旋的非紧致晶格场论描述并结合对偶变换，我们表明粗粒化会将高度差分布驱动到单一的高斯固定点，将尖 cusp和平坦性重整化为有限的谐刚度，从而在所有p>0情况下恢复自旋波描述和BKT情景。

articles.title: Certifying Hidden Dissipation from Observed Current Fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 从观测到的电流涨落认证隐藏耗散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A single-molecule experiment on a driven enzyme or motor resolves only a few of the transitions the machine makes, yet one would like to know how much free energy it dissipates in total, including on the steps that stay hidden. The mean and the fluctuations of the currents on the watched transitions are shown to certify this hidden dissipation, with no knowledge of the transition rates and no access to the hidden transitions: when the watched transitions span the cycles of the network, the observed-current covariance recovers the full density-contracted quadratic current geometry, including the contribution of transitions that are never seen. The mechanism is that fluctuations are set by the dynamical activity, or traffic, the symmetric partner of the current. Contracting the large-deviation cost of empirical currents over density fluctuations identifies the observed-current covariance with a traffic-weighted metric, and turns partial observation into a minimum-energy completion problem over the unseen cycles, whose solution is the certified hidden cost. Existing current-fluctuation uncertainty relations bound dissipation from chosen currents but do not say when partial observation fixes the hidden contribution; the cycle-observability condition derived here does. The statements concern long-time means and fluctuations; finite-time estimates require separate error control.
articles.abstract_zh: 单分子实验通常只能分辨受驱动酶或分子马达经历的少数跃迁，但观测电流的均值和涨落可以在无需转移速率或隐藏跃迁信息的情况下认证总自由能耗散。当被观测跃迁能够覆盖网络中的循环时，观测电流协方差可以恢复包含不可见跃迁贡献的完整流几何。该机制源于涨落由动力学活性或交通量决定；对密度涨落进行大偏差收缩后，部分观测可转化为隐藏循环上的最小能量补全问题，从而得到经过认证的隐藏耗散成本。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单分子实验只能分辨受驱动的酶或分子马达所经历的少数跃迁，但人们希望知道它总共耗散了多少自由能，包括那些保持隐藏状态的步骤所产生的耗散。研究表明，在不了解转移速率且无法接触隐藏跃迁的情况下，被观测跃迁上的电流均值和涨落仍可认证这种隐藏耗散：当被观测跃迁覆盖网络中的各个循环时，观测电流协方差能够恢复完整的、经密度收缩的二次电流几何，其中包括从未被观测到的跃迁所作的贡献。其机制在于，涨落由动力学活性或交通量决定，而交通量是电流的对称对应量。对经验电流在密度涨落上的大偏差代价进行收缩，可以将观测电流协方差识别为一个由交通量加权的度量，并将部分观测转化为在不可见循环上的最小能量补全问题；该问题的解就是经过认证的隐藏代价。现有的电流涨落不确定关系可以对选定电流的耗散给出界限，但并不能说明部分观测何时能够确定隐藏贡献；本文推导的循环可观测性条件解决了这一问题。上述结论针对长时间均值和涨落，有限时间估计则需要单独进行误差控制。

articles.title: Magnetically activated optical visibility of many-body excitons in NiPS₃
articles.title_zh: NiPS₃中多体激子的磁激活光学可见性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12613v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NiPS₃ is a layered van der Waals magnet that provides a unique platform for exploring the interplay between excitons and magnetic order. In its antiferromagnetic phase, strong many-body interactions give rise to a many-body exciton, which manifests itself as an exceptionally sharp resonance near 1.47 , eV in optical absorption spectra and photoluminescence. Previous theoretical studies have assigned the local ground state and the many-body exciton to spin-triplet and spin-singlet states, respectively, both with even parity. This picture, however, cannot account for the observed optical visibility of the many-body exciton because one-photon transitions between these states are forbidden by spin and parity selection rules. Here, using group-theoretical analysis and exact diagonalization of single- and two-cluster models, we show that zigzag antiferromagnetic order breaks the relevant symmetries and activates the otherwise forbidden transition. We further find that trigonal distortion of the local ligand environment and the inter-cluster exchange interaction relax additional spatial and spin constraints on the transition, producing an exciton signal in the optical conductivity that is distinguishable from the spectral background. These results provide a microscopic explanation for the optical visibility of the many-body exciton and its connection to antiferromagnetic order in NiPS₃.
articles.abstract_zh: NiPS₃是一种层状范德华磁体，为研究激子与磁有序之间的相互作用提供了独特平台。在反铁磁相中，多体相互作用产生了约1.47 eV处的多体激子，其在光学吸收和光致发光谱中表现为异常尖锐的共振。本文通过群论分析以及单团簇和双团簇模型的精确对角化表明，锯齿形反铁磁有序破坏了相关对称性，从而激活原本受自旋和宇称选择定则禁止的跃迁；局域配体环境的三方畸变和团簇间交换作用还会进一步放宽空间与自旋限制，解释了可从谱背景中区分的激子光学信号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: NiPS₃是一种层状范德华磁体，为探索激子与磁有序之间的相互作用提供了独特平台。在其反铁磁相中，强多体相互作用产生了一个多体激子，该激子在光学吸收光谱和光致发光光谱中表现为约1.47 eV处异常尖锐的共振。此前的理论研究将局域基态和多体激子分别归属于自旋三重态和自旋单重态，并且二者都具有偶宇称。然而，这一图像无法解释多体激子的实验光学可见性，因为这两个态之间的单光子跃迁受到自旋和宇称选择定则的禁止。在这里，我们利用群论分析以及单团簇和双团簇模型的精确对角化表明，锯齿形反铁磁有序破坏了相关对称性，并激活了原本被禁止的跃迁。我们进一步发现，局域配体环境的三方畸变和团簇间交换相互作用会放宽跃迁所受到的额外空间和自旋限制，从而在光学电导中产生一个能够与光谱背景区分的激子信号。这些结果为多体激子的光学可见性及其与NiPS₃中反铁磁有序之间的联系提供了微观解释。

articles.title: Nonequilibrium Broken-Symmetry States from Retained Observables
articles.title_zh: 由保留观测量产生的非平衡破缺对称态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12661v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In equilibrium, broken-symmetry states are selected by the competition between energy and entropy. Out of equilibrium, slowly relaxing observables retain information about the preparation and may reshape this competition, allowing orders that are not thermally favored. Identifying such states ordinarily requires following slow, protocol-dependent dynamics. Here we recast this dynamical selection as a static constrained variational problem. A small set of experimentally measurable or numerically accessible quantities-particle number, energy, and slow observables-defines a constraint space. The underlying dynamics determines where the system lies in this space, while entropy maximization over both quasiparticle occupations and a prescribed class of candidate orders determines which order is selected. Restricting the variational states to the Gaussian manifold yields a computationally inexpensive constrained Hartree-Fock implementation. For photoexcited Hubbard models, the approach reproduces the long-time TDHF suppression of square-lattice antiferromagnetism and identifies incommensurate spiral order in place of the equilibrium 120^circ state on the triangular lattice. For a continuously driven ferromagnetic double-exchange model, evaluating the constrained order map at the stationary NESS energy reveals a restricted region in which Neel order is favored. The framework therefore turns the search for nonequilibrium broken-symmetry states into a practical static screening problem, without requiring simulations of every preparation protocol.
articles.abstract_zh: 在平衡态中，破缺对称态由能量与熵之间的竞争选定；而在非平衡条件下，缓慢弛豫的观测量会保留制备信息，并可能使热力学上不利的有序态得到选择。本文将这种动力学选择重写为静态约束变分问题，用粒子数、能量和慢变量构成约束空间，并通过熵最大化确定候选有序态。基于高斯流形的受限Hartree-Fock实现可高效应用于光激发Hubbard模型和持续驱动的双交换模型，重现已知的反铁磁抑制并预测特定条件下的螺旋序或Neel序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在平衡态中，破缺对称态是由能量与熵之间的竞争选定的。在非平衡条件下，缓慢弛豫的观测量会保留制备过程的信息，并可能重塑这种竞争关系，从而使热力学上不受偏好的有序态得以形成。识别这类态通常需要跟踪缓慢且依赖于具体过程的动力学。在这里，我们将这种动力学选择重新表述为一个静态约束变分问题。一小组实验可测量或数值可获得的量，包括粒子数、能量和慢观测量，定义了一个约束空间。底层动力学决定系统在该空间中的位置，而对准粒子占据和预先规定的一类候选有序态同时进行熵最大化，则决定了被选择的有序态。将变分态限制在高斯流形上，可以得到计算成本较低的受限Hartree-Fock实现。对于光激发的Hubbard模型，该方法重现了长时间TDHF动力学对方格反铁磁性的抑制，并在三角晶格上识别出非公度螺旋序，以取代平衡态的120度态。对于持续驱动的铁磁双交换模型，在稳态非平衡态能量处评估受限有序图后，发现存在一个有限区域，其中Neel序更受偏好。因此，该框架将非平衡破缺对称态的搜索转化为一种实用的静态筛选问题，而不需要模拟每一种制备过程。

articles.title: On non-phononic modes and glassy dynamics
articles.title_zh: 关于非声子模与玻璃态动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The relationship between vibrational modes and glassy dynamics has been an important and controversial topic of study for many decades. We introduce a family of glass-forming model potentials that have identical molecular and swap dynamics but different low-frequency vibrational modes. In sufficiently small systems low frequency modes do not hybridize with phonons, and this enables us to study their statistical properties independently. We investigate i) the role of the optimization algorithm used to find a minimum; ii) that of the finite-size effects; iii) that of the truncation of the interaction potential; and, iv) that of the parent temperature. We find that models with identical supercooled liquid structure and dynamics can have dramatically different non-phononic vibrational modes at low frequency, based on how the potential is truncated. These findings challenge ideas relating the low-frequency non-phononic vibrational modes with the slow supercooled liquid relaxation.
articles.abstract_zh: 振动模与玻璃态动力学之间的关系长期以来一直是重要且存在争议的研究主题。本文引入了一族玻璃形成模型势，它们具有相同的分子动力学和交换动力学，但低频振动模不同；在足够小的体系中，低频模不会与声子杂化，因此可以被独立研究。结果表明，仅仅改变相互作用势的截断方式，就能使具有相同过冷液体结构与动力学的模型产生显著不同的低频非声子振动模，从而对将低频非声子模与过冷液体慢弛豫联系起来的观点提出挑战。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 振动模与玻璃态动力学之间的关系数十年来一直是一个重要且具有争议的研究主题。我们引入了一族玻璃形成模型势，它们具有相同的分子动力学和交换动力学，但具有不同的低频振动模。在足够小的体系中，低频模不会与声子发生杂化，这使我们能够独立研究它们的统计性质。我们考察了以下因素的作用：一是用于寻找极小值的优化算法；二是有限尺寸效应；三是相互作用势的截断；四是母体温度。我们发现，具有相同过冷液体结构和动力学的模型，可以根据势函数的截断方式，在低频处表现出显著不同的非声子振动模。这些发现对将低频非声子振动模与过冷液体的缓慢弛豫联系起来的相关观点提出了挑战。

articles.title: Chirality enhances diffusion in disordered environments
articles.title_zh: 手性增强无序环境中的扩散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chirality, a systematic rotational bias in the motion of a particle, arises in a wide range of physical and biological systems, from charged colloids in magnetic fields to swimming bacteria near surfaces. While its effects in homogeneous environments are well understood, the interplay between chirality and structural disorder has remained largely unexplored. Here we investigate the chiral random walk on two-dimensional percolation clusters above the percolation threshold, combining numerical simulations with an analytically tractable annealed-disorder approximation. We find that the long-time diffusion coefficient depends non-monotonically on both the chirality parameter and the obstacle density: for every obstacle density above the percolation threshold, there exists an optimal chirality that enhances diffusion relative to the achiral walk. We show that the optimal chirality is set by an edge-adhering mechanism: maximum diffusion is achieved when the persistence length of the wall-adhering motion matches half the typical obstacle cluster perimeter. This yields a closed-form prediction for the optimal chirality in terms of geometric properties of the medium alone, which we verify across the full range of obstacle densities studied. The enhancement extends to first-passage statistics, where chirality shortens typical search times at strong disorder while lengthening them at weak disorder, with direct implications for biological navigation in disordered environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察二维逾渗簇中的手性随机游走，结合数值模拟与可解析的退火无序近似。结果表明，长时扩散系数随手性参数和障碍密度呈非单调变化，并且在每个高于逾渗阈值的障碍密度下都存在可增强扩散的最优手性。作者将这一最优值归因于沿边附着运动的持久长度与典型障碍簇周长一半相匹配，并指出手性还会影响首达时间统计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性，即粒子运动中的系统性旋转偏置，出现在广泛的物理和生物系统中，从磁场中的带电胶体到靠近表面的游动细菌皆是如此。虽然它在均匀环境中的效应已得到充分理解，但手性与结构无序之间的相互作用仍基本未被探索。本文研究高于逾渗阈值的二维逾渗簇上的手性随机游走，结合数值模拟和一种解析上可处理的退火无序近似。我们发现，长时扩散系数对手性参数和障碍物密度都呈非单调依赖：对于每一个高于逾渗阈值的障碍物密度，都存在一个相对于非手性游走增强扩散的最优手性。我们表明，最优手性由一种贴边机制决定：当沿壁附着运动的持久长度与典型障碍簇周长的一半相匹配时，扩散达到最大。这给出了仅由介质几何性质决定的最优手性的闭式预测，并且我们在所研究的整个障碍物密度范围内验证了该预测。这种增强还延伸到首达统计，其中在强无序下手性缩短典型搜索时间，而在弱无序下延长典型搜索时间，这对无序环境中的生物导航具有直接意义。

articles.title: In-plane anomalous and third-harmonic Hall response in an easy-plane trigonal magnet
articles.title_zh: 易平面三角磁体中的面内反常霍尔响应与三次谐波霍尔响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12738v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the emergence of an in-plane anomalous Hall effect (IPAHE) and a pronounced third-harmonic Hall response in an easy-plane trigonal magnetic system achieved via tuning of magnetic anisotropy. Angle-dependent Hall measurements reveal a clear departure from conventional sinusoidal behavior, revealing a strong sin(3θ) component at elevated fields, which increases as the magnetic anisotropy is reduced, accompanied by a finite in-plane Hall signal. Consistently, the observed nonlinear Hall signal exhibits a cubic field dependence, indicative of a leading third-order contribution to the transverse conductivity. The enhancement of the third harmonic reflects the evolution toward coherent in-plane magnetization and symmetry-governed nonlinear transport. These observations support an intrinsic, symmetry-controlled transport mechanism enabled by reduced magnetic anisotropy and establish a direct link between anisotropy, crystal symmetry, and higher-order Hall response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报告了通过调控磁各向异性在易平面三角磁性系统中出现的面内反常霍尔效应和显著三次谐波霍尔响应。角度依赖霍尔测量显示，在较高磁场下传统正弦行为明显偏离，并出现随磁各向异性降低而增强的 sin(3θ) 分量。作者认为这些结果支持一种由降低的磁各向异性所促成、受对称性控制的内禀输运机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了通过调节磁各向异性，在易平面三角磁性系统中实现的面内反常霍尔效应（IPAHE）和显著的三次谐波霍尔响应的出现。角度依赖霍尔测量揭示出对常规正弦行为的清晰偏离，显示在较高磁场下存在强的 sin(3θ) 分量，该分量随着磁各向异性的降低而增加，并伴随有限的面内霍尔信号。与此一致，所观测到的非线性霍尔信号表现出三次方的磁场依赖，表明横向电导中存在主导的三阶贡献。三次谐波的增强反映了体系向相干面内磁化以及受对称性支配的非线性输运的演化。这些观测支持一种由降低磁各向异性所开启的、内禀且受对称性控制的输运机制，并建立了各向异性、晶体对称性与高阶霍尔响应之间的直接联系。

articles.title: Agent-authored deposition recipes for X-ray multilayer mirrors: schema-bound LLM control of a magnetron sputtering system with reflectivity-verified outcomes
articles.title_zh: 由智能体编写的 X 射线多层镜沉积配方：通过模式约束的大语言模型控制磁控溅射系统并以反射率验证结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12796v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic multilayer mirrors for X-rays require a layer period held to about 0.02 nm, set by deposition rates held in the laboratory's own notebook. A large language model agent was given a target multilayer specification and read access to a laboratory archive. Deposition recipes were authored in the native recipe language of a magnetron sputtering system and submitted through a Model Context Protocol bridge of 17 tools in three tiers, with enforcement held in the control application. The target was a 30-bilayer Ru/C multilayer with a period of 6.85 nm, a pair chosen because each period is fitted as two layers. The agent could write only inside a working project of its own, so it could alter neither the calibration it read nor the measurements that scored it. Mirrors were scored against a human-authored reference by X-ray reflectivity, and the 3% acceptance threshold on relative period difference was fixed before deposition. Across four scored agent-authored depositions the relative period difference fell from 20% on the calibration as given to 2.26% after one measured-feedback iteration and 0.79% after a second. Sixteen failure modes of the agent-facing interface were identified. The result is bounded to the period, pair and chamber observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作测试了大语言模型智能体在受控接口下为 X 射线周期多层镜编写磁控溅射沉积配方的能力。目标为 30 个双层的 Ru/C 多层膜，周期为 6.85 nm，并以 X 射线反射率相对人类参考样品进行评分。四次评分沉积中，相对周期差从初始校准条件下的 20% 降至两轮测量反馈后的 0.79%，同时识别出 16 种面向智能体接口的失效模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用于 X 射线的周期多层镜要求层周期保持在约 0.02 nm 的精度内，而这由保存在实验室自身记录本中的沉积速率决定。一个大语言模型智能体获得了目标多层膜规格，并拥有对实验室档案的读取权限。沉积配方以磁控溅射系统的原生配方语言编写，并通过一个包含三层共 17 个工具的模型上下文协议桥提交，执行约束保留在控制应用程序中。目标是一个 30 个双层的 Ru/C 多层膜，周期为 6.85 nm，选择这一材料对是因为每个周期被拟合为两层。该智能体只能在其自己的工作项目内写入，因此既不能修改它所读取的校准，也不能修改用于评分的测量结果。多层镜通过 X 射线反射率相对于人类编写的参考配方进行评分，并且相对周期差 3% 的接受阈值在沉积前即已固定。在四次评分的智能体编写沉积中，相对周期差从给定校准条件下的 20% 降至一次测量反馈迭代后的 2.26%，并在第二次迭代后降至 0.79%。研究识别出 16 种面向智能体接口的失效模式。该结果的适用范围限定于所观察的周期、材料对和腔室。

articles.title: Ultrastrong Au-Te bonding drives disorder in monolayer ZrTe₅ on gold
articles.title_zh: 超强 Au-Te 成键驱动金基底上单层 ZrTe₅ 的无序化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monolayer ZrTe₅ is predicted to host a large-gap quantum spin Hall phase, motivating efforts to isolate single layers of the material. Gold-assisted exfoliation produces clean monolayers of many chalcogen-terminated van der Waals crystals, but the strong Te-Au bond may compete with the bonding network of the ZrTe₅ layer itself. Across tens of samples, low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy on gold-exfoliated flakes shows a disordered monolayer surface in the overwhelming majority of cases, while thicker flakes preserve the characteristic quasi-one-dimensional chain structure. emphAb initio calculations of the ZrTe₅/Au(111) interface reproduce this asymmetry and resolve its mechanism: the Te atoms facing the gold chemisorb, rupturing the weak zigzag Te-Te bonds that cross-link the ZrTe₃ chains, turning the discrete bond-length spectrum of the crystal into a continuous one, while the chains persist as distorted units. Charge analysis shows the signature of covalent Te-Au bonding with a modest transfer that hole-dopes the monolayer; in the bilayer, the distortion and the doping stay confined to the layer contacting the gold, and the chemisorption and disorder each preclude the predicted quantum spin Hall phase. The same quasi-covalent Te-Au bond may perturb the contact layer of other gold-exfoliated Te-terminated crystals, particularly those with weakly connected intralayer networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨金辅助剥离单层 ZrTe₅ 时强 Te-Au 键对材料结构和量子自旋霍尔相的影响。低温扫描隧道显微镜显示，金剥离薄片中的单层表面大多无序，而较厚薄片保留准一维链结构。第一性原理计算表明，面向金的 Te 原子化学吸附并破坏弱的锯齿状 Te-Te 键，导致单层无序并阻碍预期的量子自旋霍尔相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单层 ZrTe₅ 被预测可承载大能隙量子自旋霍尔相，这推动了分离该材料单层的努力。金辅助剥离能够产生许多硫族元素封端范德华晶体的洁净单层，但强 Te-Au 键可能与 ZrTe₅ 层本身的成键网络竞争。在数十个样品中，对金剥离薄片进行的低温扫描隧道显微镜研究表明，绝大多数情况下单层表面呈无序状态，而较厚薄片则保留了特征性的准一维链结构。ZrTe₅/Au(111) 界面的从头算计算再现了这种不对称性，并阐明了其机制：面向金的 Te 原子发生化学吸附，断裂了交联 ZrTe₃ 链的弱锯齿状 Te-Te 键，将晶体离散的键长谱转变为连续谱，而链仍作为扭曲的单元存在。电荷分析显示了共价 Te-Au 成键的特征，并伴随适度的电荷转移，使单层发生空穴掺杂；在双层中，畸变和掺杂都局限于与金接触的那一层，而化学吸附和无序都会排除所预测的量子自旋霍尔相。同样的准共价 Te-Au 键可能扰动其他金剥离 Te 封端晶体的接触层，尤其是那些具有弱连接层内网络的晶体。

articles.title: Diversifying time evolution of matrix product states using BUGs
articles.title_zh: 使用 BUG 积分器拓展矩阵乘积态的时间演化方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time evolution of tensor-network states is a central tool for studying nonequilibrium dynamics in strongly correlated quantum systems. In the past decade, using the time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) discretized by projector-splitting has become the gold standard for evolving matrix product states (MPS) with long-range Hamiltonians. More recently, a conceptually different class of discretizations of the TDVP, the class of Basis Update and Galerkin (BUG) integrators, has been developed within the framework of dynamical low-rank approximation, offering an alternative, more flexible approach. In this work, we formulate two BUG integrators explicitly for MPS. The BUG integrators result in "single-site" MPS integrators that are robust with respect to small singular values, avoid backward-in-time substeps, and naturally allow for the adaptive choice of bond dimensions. We consider the augmented BUG integrator of first order and the midpoint BUG integrator of second order and clarify their relation to the projector-splitting discretization of the TDVP. Using representative models of strongly correlated quantum systems, like the XY spin model with long-range interaction and two-dimensional lattice models of fermions and spins of various lengths, we perform a systematic numerical comparison between BUG and projector-splitting time discretizations of the continuous-time TDVP, focusing on scalability, numerical complexity, and accuracy. We find that BUG integrators, due to their reduced numerical cost and the flexibility of the concept, provide a competitive and, in certain regimes, advantageous alternative to the well-established time-stepping by projector-splitting in TDVP, especially in models with large local dimensions, and in cases where observables are extracted with high temporal resolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将基更新与 Galerkin（BUG）积分器明确表述为矩阵乘积态时间演化方法，并与 TDVP 的投影分裂离散化进行比较。BUG 方法形成单站点 MPS 积分器，对小奇异值稳健，避免反向时间子步，并自然支持键维数自适应选择。数值结果显示，BUG 积分器在大局域维数模型和需要高时间分辨率提取观测量的情形中具有竞争力甚至优势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 张量网络态的时间演化是研究强关联量子系统非平衡动力学的核心工具。在过去十年中，使用由投影分裂离散化的含时变分原理（TDVP）已成为演化具有长程哈密顿量的矩阵乘积态（MPS）的黄金标准。近年来，在动力学低秩近似框架内发展出一类概念上不同的 TDVP 离散化方法，即基更新与 Galerkin（BUG）积分器，为此提供了一种替代的、更灵活的方法。在本文中，我们明确地为 MPS 构造了两种 BUG 积分器。BUG 积分器产生“单站点”MPS 积分器，它们对小奇异值具有稳健性，避免反向时间子步，并自然允许自适应选择键维数。我们考虑一阶的增广 BUG 积分器和二阶的中点 BUG 积分器，并阐明它们与 TDVP 的投影分裂离散化之间的关系。利用强关联量子系统的代表性模型，如具有长程相互作用的 XY 自旋模型以及不同长度的费米子和自旋二维晶格模型，我们对连续时间 TDVP 的 BUG 与投影分裂时间离散化进行了系统数值比较，重点关注可扩展性、数值复杂度和精度。我们发现，由于数值成本较低以及概念上的灵活性，BUG 积分器为 TDVP 中成熟的投影分裂时间推进方法提供了一种具有竞争力、并且在某些区域具有优势的替代方案，尤其是在具有大局域维数的模型中，以及在以高时间分辨率提取观测量的情形中。

articles.title: Chiral Valence-Bond Solid and Chiral Triplons
articles.title_zh: 手性价键固体与手性三重激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a chiral valence-bond solid (VBS) state that spontaneously breaks inversion and mirror symmetries. It is characterized by a finite electric toroidal (ET) monopole, whose sign distinguishes the two enantiomorphic states. Using a spin-lattice model with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, we show that the chiral VBS produces spin-split triplon bands with enantiomer-dependent spin textures governed by its ET monopole. Under a temperature gradient, these spin textures generate a net spin response whose sign is tied to the handedness of the VBS. More importantly, we show that the imaginary off-diagonal components of the dynamical spin structure factor change sign between the two enantiomers, providing a direct neutron-scattering probe of the selected handedness. These results establish a route to spontaneous chirality in a valence-bond system and to its direct detection through magnetic excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种自发破缺反演和镜面对称性的手性价键固体态，其特征是有限的电环极单极矩。作者利用含 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的自旋-晶格模型表明，该手性 VBS 会产生自旋劈裂的三重激发能带和依赖对映体的自旋纹理。研究还指出，动力学自旋结构因子的虚非对角分量会在两个对映体之间变号，可作为中子散射探测手性的直接信号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种自发破缺反演和镜面对称性的手性价键固体（VBS）态。其特征是具有有限的电环极（ET）单极矩，该单极矩的符号区分两个对映异构态。利用具有 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的自旋-晶格模型，我们表明手性 VBS 会产生自旋劈裂的三重激发能带，其依赖对映体的自旋纹理由其 ET 单极矩支配。在温度梯度下，这些自旋纹理产生净自旋响应，其符号与 VBS 的手性相联系。更重要的是，我们表明动力学自旋结构因子的虚非对角分量在两个对映体之间变号，从而为所选择的手性提供了直接的中子散射探针。这些结果建立了一条在价键体系中实现自发手性以及通过磁激发直接探测该手性的途径。

articles.title: Slow activity decay in excitable models with discontinuous phase transitions
articles.title_zh: 具有不连续相变的可激发模型中的慢活动衰减
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As a simple model of interacting systems of excitable degrees of freedom, we consider a threshold contact process on various lattices and networks, in which a successful activation event requires the presence of more than one active neighbors. We show by combining numerical simulations and a phenomenological theory that, in the two-phase coexistence region and for a sufficiently low initial activity, a slower-than-exponential temporal decay of the global density emerges, caused by the spontaneous formation of slowly vanishing and non-communicating clusters of activity. This slow-decay phenomenon is found to appear generally for regular lattices and also for finite-dimensional random lattices such as the Voronoi-Delaunay network. However, the slow-decay is impeded by small-world property, as demonstrated by simulations on random-regular networks. In the case of a power-law decay of the order parameter, which is valid among others on two-dimensional regular lattices, our phenomenological theory points out that the decaying state is stable against unbounded nucleation only if the decay exponent exceeds 1/2. Besides the well-known Griffiths effects of quenched random systems, this slow-decay phenomenon rooted in the threshold condition provides an alternative mechanism of off-critical but scale-free dynamics, occurring also in the absence of disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察阈值接触过程这一可激发自由度相互作用系统的简单模型，其中成功激活需要多个活跃邻居。数值模拟和现象学理论表明，在两相共存区且初始活动足够低时，整体密度会出现慢于指数的时间衰减，这是由缓慢消失且彼此不通信的活动簇自发形成造成的。作者指出该现象可出现在规则晶格和有限维随机晶格中，但会受到小世界性质抑制，并为非临界尺度自由动力学提供一种不同于 Griffiths 效应的机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作为可激发自由度相互作用系统的一个简单模型，我们考虑各种晶格和网络上的阈值接触过程，其中一次成功的激活事件要求存在不止一个活跃邻居。我们通过结合数值模拟和现象学理论表明，在两相共存区域内并且初始活动足够低时，整体密度会出现慢于指数的时间衰减，这是由缓慢消失且彼此不通信的活动簇自发形成所导致的。我们发现，这种慢衰减现象通常出现在规则晶格上，也出现在有限维随机晶格上，例如 Voronoi-Delaunay 网络。然而，小世界性质会阻碍慢衰减，这一点由随机正则网络上的模拟所证明。在序参量呈幂律衰减的情形中，这种情形也适用于二维规则晶格等系统，我们的现象学理论指出，只有当衰减指数超过 1/2 时，衰减态才对无界成核保持稳定。除了淬火随机系统中众所周知的 Griffiths 效应之外，这种源于阈值条件的慢衰减现象为非临界但尺度自由的动力学提供了一种替代机制，并且也可在没有无序的情况下发生。

articles.title: NEMO: A Framework for Nematic and Morphological Analysis of Curved and Multi-layered Biological Surfaces
articles.title_zh: NEMO：用于弯曲和多层生物表面的向列与形态分析框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Across biological scales, from cytoskeletal networks to whole tissues, orientational order and topological defects arise within complex three-dimensional geometries. However, quantifying nematic order orientational order with head-to-tail symmetry remains challenging: 2D projections introduce geometric distortions, while current 3D methods often struggle to resolve distinct nematic fields within curved or multilayer structures. Here, we introduce NEMO, a modular Python framework for the depth-resolved quantification of tangential nematic order and surface morphology. By reconstructing biological surfaces as triangulated meshes, NEMO projects curved intensity layers, extracts local nematic directors, and computes locally averaged nematic tensors within the tangent plane. The pipeline identifies topological defects and computes their topological charge by accounting for the Gaussian curvature of the underlying surface. Furthermore, NEMO quantifies tissue morphology through inter-surface distance and surface-fitted estimates of Gaussian and mean curvatures. We show the capacities of this framework using a synthetic nematic film on a vesicle and experimental actin organisation in Hydra. By combining customisable projections with surface-constrained analysis, NEMO provides a unified framework for quantifying the interplay between orientational order and geometry across scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 NEMO，一个用于深度分辨量化切向向列有序和表面形态的模块化 Python 框架。NEMO 将生物表面重构为三角网格，投影弯曲强度层，提取局域向列指向矢，并在切平面内计算局域平均向列张量。该框架还可识别拓扑缺陷、计算拓扑荷，并量化表面间距离及曲率，作者通过合成囊泡向列膜和 Hydra 中的肌动蛋白组织展示了其能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在从细胞骨架网络到完整组织的生物尺度上，取向有序和拓扑缺陷会出现在复杂的三维几何中。然而，量化具有头尾对称性的向列取向有序仍然具有挑战性：二维投影会引入几何畸变，而当前三维方法往往难以分辨弯曲或多层结构中的不同向列场。在这里，我们介绍 NEMO，这是一个模块化 Python 框架，用于对切向向列有序和表面形态进行深度分辨量化。通过将生物表面重构为三角网格，NEMO 投影弯曲的强度层，提取局域向列指向矢，并在切平面内计算局域平均向列张量。该流程通过考虑底层表面的高斯曲率来识别拓扑缺陷并计算其拓扑荷。此外，NEMO 通过表面间距离以及表面拟合的高斯曲率和平均曲率估计来量化组织形态。我们使用囊泡上的合成向列膜和 Hydra 中实验观测到的肌动蛋白组织展示了该框架的能力。通过结合可定制投影与受表面约束的分析，NEMO 为跨尺度量化取向有序与几何之间的相互作用提供了一个统一框架。

articles.title: Intrinsic excitations and a proposed ground state in an Ammann-Beenker artificial spin ice
articles.title_zh: Ammann-Beenker 人工自旋冰中的内禀激发与一种拟议基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12930v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial spin ices built on quasiperiodic geometries remain under-explored. Here we investigate an ASI based on the octagonal Ammann-Beenker tiling, whose six vertex types present local environments inaccessible in periodic lattices. Combining Monte Carlo simulations of dipolar-coupled macrospins with micromagnetic calculations of individual vertex energies, we find that vertex types freeze in an order set not by coordination number, but by quasi-degenerate levels at five-island vertices and their local environment. Excitations in the low energy state are correspondingly localised to specific, geometrically determined sites. Using twice-inflated substitution rules as an energetic backbone, we propose an analytical ground state combining a long-range ordered fixed spin network with a sparse set of degenerate regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察基于八角 Ammann-Beenker 拼砌的准周期人工自旋冰，其六种顶点类型提供了周期晶格中不存在的局域环境。作者结合偶极耦合宏自旋的 Monte Carlo 模拟和单个顶点能量的微磁计算，发现顶点冻结顺序并非由配位数决定，而由五岛顶点处的准简并能级及其局域环境决定。研究还提出一种解析基态，由长程有序的固定自旋网络与稀疏简并区域共同构成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 建立在准周期几何上的人工自旋冰仍然研究不足。本文研究一种基于八角 Ammann-Beenker 拼砌的人工自旋冰，其六种顶点类型呈现出周期晶格中无法获得的局域环境。通过结合偶极耦合宏自旋的 Monte Carlo 模拟与单个顶点能量的微磁计算，我们发现顶点类型的冻结顺序并不由配位数决定，而是由五岛顶点处的准简并能级及其局域环境决定。低能态中的激发相应地局域在特定的、由几何决定的位置。利用二次膨胀替换规则作为能量骨架，我们提出了一种解析基态，它结合了长程有序的固定自旋网络和一组稀疏的简并区域。

articles.title: Spin splitting without symmetry: a nearly compensated ferrimagnet and the origin of altermagnetism
articles.title_zh: 无对称性的自旋劈裂：近补偿亚铁磁体与交替磁性的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12931v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin splitting of collinear altermagnets is usually attributed to the crystal symmetry relating the opposite-spin sublattices --- a rotation or mirror in place of the translation or inversion of a conventional antiferromagnet. We show that this symmetry organizes the splitting but does not produce it; its origin is the anisotropic arrangement of the magnetic orbitals and their ligands, which also fixes the symmetry itself. Two results establish this. A triclinic (P1) ceMn oxide, a fully compensated ferrimagnet whose two inequivalent sublattices are related by no symmetry, is spin split throughout the Brillouin zone; repositioning the same ligands, atom for atom, to restore an inversion centre relating the two metal sites collapses the splitting to a residual two orders of magnitude smaller, so the splitting follows from the arrangement rather than the symmetry. Symmetry, we show formally, can only ever reverse or forbid a splitting that already exists: it cannot create one between sublattices an arrangement has left electronically identical, nor where the underlying orbitals carry no anisotropy to arrange in the first place. Organizing the analysis through an operation-resolved symmetry hierarchy and reading the crystal classes as a single axis, the enforced nodal planes fall from two to one to zero across the orthorhombic, monoclinic, and triclinic classes while the arrangement-generated splitting persists to the base. The altermagnet and the fully compensated ferrimagnet are thus the two ends of one axis --- the same splitting, organized by symmetry at one end and unorganized at the other --- and the search for compensated spin-split magnets is a search over orbital arrangements rather than symmetry labels.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究挑战了将共线交替磁体自旋劈裂归因于连接相反自旋子晶格的晶体对称性的常见看法。作者认为，对称性组织劈裂但并不产生劈裂，其根源在于磁性轨道及其配体的各向异性排列。通过三斜 P1 补偿亚铁磁体以及恢复反演中心后的对比，研究指出寻找补偿自旋劈裂磁体应聚焦于轨道排列，而非仅依赖对称性标签。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 共线交替磁体的自旋劈裂通常被归因于连接相反自旋子晶格的晶体对称性，即以旋转或镜面取代传统反铁磁体中的平移或反演。我们表明，这种对称性组织了劈裂，但并不产生劈裂；其起源是磁性轨道及其配体的各向异性排列，而这种排列也固定了对称性本身。两个结果证明了这一点。一个三斜（P1）ceMn 氧化物，即一个完全补偿的亚铁磁体，其两个不等价子晶格之间不存在任何对称性关系，却在整个布里渊区内发生自旋劈裂；将相同配体逐个原子重新定位，以恢复连接两个金属位点的反演中心，会使劈裂坍缩到小两个数量级的残余值，因此劈裂来自排列而非对称性。我们形式上表明，对称性永远只能反转或禁止一个已经存在的劈裂：它不能在某种排列已使其电子上相同的子晶格之间产生劈裂，也不能在底层轨道本身没有可供排列的各向异性时产生劈裂。通过一种按操作分辨的对称性层级组织分析，并将晶体类别解读为单一轴线，强制节点平面从正交、单斜到三斜类别依次由两个降为一个再到零，而由排列产生的劈裂持续存在到底层。交替磁体和完全补偿亚铁磁体因此是同一轴线的两端，即同一种劈裂在一端由对称性组织而在另一端未被组织；寻找补偿自旋劈裂磁体就是在轨道排列中搜索，而不是在对称性标签中搜索。

articles.title: Density-matrix quantum kinetics of spin-mode crossover and ac Edelstein response in spin--orbit-coupled chiral metals
articles.title_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合手性金属中自旋模交叉与交流 Edelstein 响应的密度矩阵量子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To establish a reference for angular-momentum dynamics driven by spin--orbit coupling (SOC) in chiral conductors, we formulate a density-matrix quantum kinetic theory for a three-dimensional isotropic chiral metal with hedgehog SOC and nonmagnetic impurity scattering. The formulation retains interband coherence, and its collision integral conserves charge, energy, and spin during impurity scattering. We identify three spin modes that evolve continuously from a long-lived D'yakonov--Perel' relaxation mode and two strongly damped precessional modes at weak SOC to one relaxational and two coherent precessional modes at strong SOC. Comparison with a band-diagonal Boltzmann equation shows that interband coherence is essential for both the weak-SOC relaxation mode and the strong-SOC precessional modes. We further derive the ac Edelstein susceptibility and the reciprocal current response to a time-dependent Zeeman field, show that their poles coincide with the spin modes, and verify Onsager reciprocity. The theory thus provides a unified analytic description of spin relaxation, precession, and spin--charge conversion across the weak-to-strong SOC crossover.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了三维各向同性手性金属的密度矩阵量子动力学理论，用于描述由自旋-轨道耦合驱动的角动量动力学。理论保留带间相干性，并构造了在杂质散射中守恒电荷、能量和自旋的碰撞积分。作者识别出随 SOC 强度从弱到强连续演化的三种自旋模，并推导交流 Edelstein 磁化率及其倒易电流响应，验证了 Onsager 倒易性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为了为手性导体中由自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）驱动的角动量动力学建立一个参考，我们为具有刺猬型 SOC 和非磁性杂质散射的三维各向同性手性金属构建了密度矩阵量子动力学理论。该形式保留了带间相干性，并且其碰撞积分在杂质散射过程中守恒电荷、能量和自旋。我们识别出三种自旋模，它们从弱 SOC 下的一个长寿命 D'yakonov-Perel' 弛豫模和两个强阻尼进动模，连续演化为强 SOC 下的一个弛豫模和两个相干进动模。与带对角 Boltzmann 方程的比较表明，带间相干性对于弱 SOC 弛豫模和强 SOC 进动模都是必不可少的。我们进一步推导了交流 Edelstein 磁化率以及对含时 Zeeman 场的倒易电流响应，表明它们的极点与自旋模一致，并验证了 Onsager 倒易性。因此，该理论为跨越弱到强 SOC 交叉的自旋弛豫、进动和自旋-电荷转换提供了统一的解析描述。

articles.title: Orbital Hall effect and orbital altermagnetism in even- and odd-parity-wave magnetic Lieb lattices
articles.title_zh: 偶宇称波与奇宇称波磁性 Lieb 晶格中的轨道霍尔效应和轨道交替磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12956v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated antiferromagnetic order with ferromagnet-like signatures such as spin-polarized bands and, under appropriate conditions, an anomalous Hall response. Their characteristic momentum-dependent spin splitting originates from the interplay of magnetic order and crystal structure and therefore does not require spin-orbit coupling (SOC), whereas the anomalous Hall effect relies on SOC. This raises the question whether the ferromagnet-like transport character of altermagnets can manifest already in the nonrelativistic limit. Here, we investigate the transport of orbital angular momentum in magnetic Lieb lattices. We show that a collinear antiferromagnetic texture realizes a d-wave altermagnetic state and simultaneously generates an orbital Hall effect, both in the complete absence of SOC. In this nonrelativistic limit, the orbital Hall response closely resembles that of the corresponding ferromagnet. When SOC is included, the orbital Hall effect is accompanied by a spin Hall response, while the altermagnetic spin texture acquires a corresponding orbital texture, realizing orbital altermagnetism. In contrast, an anomalous, or crystal, Hall effect requires SOC and is additionally subject to crystal-symmetry constraints. We extend the analysis from d-wave altermagnetism to odd-parity p-wave magnetism, where the orbital Hall effect becomes anisotropic and the orbital conductivity tensor develops a symmetric transverse component analogous to the planar Hall response in charge transport. Our results establish the orbital Hall effect as a nonrelativistic transport manifestation of the close relation between altermagnets and ferromagnets and extend this connection to unconventional magnetic orders beyond altermagnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨磁性 Lieb 晶格中轨道角动量输运与交替磁性之间的关系。作者表明，共线反铁磁织构在无自旋-轨道耦合的非相对论极限下即可实现 d 波交替磁态并产生轨道霍尔效应，其响应类似相应铁磁体。加入 SOC 后，轨道霍尔效应伴随自旋霍尔响应，交替磁性自旋纹理获得相应轨道纹理；研究还将分析扩展到奇宇称 p 波磁性，揭示各向异性轨道霍尔响应和对称横向分量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体将补偿反铁磁有序与类似铁磁体的特征结合起来，例如自旋极化能带，并在适当条件下具有反常霍尔响应。其特征性的动量依赖自旋劈裂源自磁有序与晶体结构之间的相互作用，因此不需要自旋-轨道耦合（SOC），而反常霍尔效应依赖 SOC。这提出了一个问题：交替磁体的类铁磁输运特征是否已经能在非相对论极限中显现。本文研究磁性 Lieb 晶格中的轨道角动量输运。我们表明，共线反铁磁织构在完全没有 SOC 的情况下实现了一种 d 波交替磁态，并同时产生轨道霍尔效应。在这一非相对论极限中，轨道霍尔响应与相应铁磁体的轨道霍尔响应非常相似。当纳入 SOC 时，轨道霍尔效应伴随自旋霍尔响应，而交替磁性自旋纹理获得相应的轨道纹理，从而实现轨道交替磁性。相比之下，反常霍尔效应或晶体霍尔效应需要 SOC，并且还受到晶体对称性约束。我们将分析从 d 波交替磁性扩展到奇宇称 p 波磁性，在该情形中轨道霍尔效应变得各向异性，并且轨道电导张量发展出一个对称横向分量，类似于电荷输运中的平面霍尔响应。我们的结果确立了轨道霍尔效应作为交替磁体与铁磁体之间密切关系的一种非相对论输运表现，并将这种联系扩展到交替磁性之外的非常规磁有序。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文研究偶宇称和奇宇称波磁性 Lieb 晶格中的轨道霍尔效应与轨道交替磁性。作者表明在无自旋轨道耦合的非相对论极限下，特定共线反铁磁织构即可产生 d 波交替磁态和轨道霍尔响应，加入自旋轨道耦合后还会伴随自旋霍尔响应和轨道纹理。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在交替磁性、自旋输运、磁性拓扑性质、Wannier 模型和自旋轨道耦合方向相关。其模型晶格研究可为理解交替磁体中非相对论输运响应和轨道自由度作用提供理论参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议关注其对称性分析、轨道霍尔电导计算和 SOC 前后响应变化。后续可在真实二维磁性材料或候选交替磁体中构建 Wannier 紧束缚模型，检验类似轨道霍尔和自旋霍尔响应是否可实现。

articles.title: Assessing the magnetic states and the accuracy of first-principles Hubbard corrections for the battery cathode LiₓCoO₂ (x=0,1)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LiₓCoO₂ is a prototypical layered cathode material for Li-ion batteries, yet its accurate description from first principles remains challenging because of self-interaction errors, weak interlayer interactions, and a complex magnetic energy landscape. Here, we present a systematic investigation of the structural, electronic, magnetic, and electrochemical properties of LiₓCoO₂ (x=0,1) using density-functional theory augmented with self-consistent Hubbard corrections and long-range van der Waals interactions, together with a systematic exploration of possible magnetic states. The on-site interactions on Co-3d and O-2p states, as well as inter-site Co-O interactions, are determined from first principles using linear-response theory in the framework of density-functional perturbation theory, with Löwdin-orthogonalized atomic orbitals employed as Hubbard projectors. For LiCoO₂, the inclusion of Hubbard corrections provides an accurate description of the structural properties, while the electronic structure is very sensitive to the choice of Hubbard projectors. In particular, frontier Wannier-function projectors substantially improve the description of the occupied electronic states compared with localized atomic orbitals. For CoO₂, we demonstrate that a systematic exploration of the magnetic energy landscape is essential to identify the lowest-energy low-spin ground state. However, the resulting Hubbard-corrected electronic structure is insulating, consistent with the prediction of the HSE06 hybrid functional, but in contrast to the experimentally observed metallic behavior. Structural relaxation further drives the system toward a different metallic solution with an electronic configuration inconsistent with low-spin Co⁴⁺ character. Despite these limitations, the calculated intercalation voltages agree well with experiment, with deviations as small as 2%.

articles.title: Reliable training of neural hyperelastic models via full-field data
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic investigation of the robustness and limitations of equilibrium gap-based calibrations for hyperelastic physics-augmented neural networks (PANNs), where we consider the special case of isotropic and polyconvex PANNs. In full-field parameterizations, it is commonly assumed that the displacement field is captured with sufficient spatial resolution for an accurate evaluation of the deformation field, and that the specimen is thin enough for plane stress to hold to a good approximation. Since these assumptions are never ideally satisfied in real experiments, we investigate, using synthetically generated data, how severely an under-resolved surface measurement and a non-negligible specimen thickness can affect the model parameterization. Furthermore, we perform calibration on real experimental data for a set of inhomogeneous specimen geometries. We show that the coverage of the admissible deformation states during calibration governs the ability of a model to generalize to unseen geometries and load cases; this ability can be improved further by appropriate combinations of specimens. Accurately depicting the material behavior underlying this rich data, however, requires a sufficiently flexible constitutive model, for which PANNs are well suited. Yet a rich coverage of deformation states alone is not sufficient: unless the calibration data comprise biaxial-tension-like states, models that include the second deformation invariant extrapolate unphysically towards equi-biaxial tension, whereas restricting the PANN to the first invariant remains reliable.

articles.title: Mesoscale Crystallographic Helicity in Confined Tellurium Quantum Wires
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Helical order can facilitate symmetry breaking and emergent physical responses in crystalline materials, yet how intrinsic chirality manifests beyond atomic length scales remains poorly understood. Here, the direct observation and quantitative characterization of long-range crystallographic helicity in template-grown tellurium (Te) quantum wires on amorphous substrates are reported. Four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) enables quantitative mapping of crystallographic orientation with nanometer-scale spatial resolution. The resulting orientation maps establish continuous mesoscale lattice twisting, providing direct evidence of long-range crystallographic helicity. Correlated orientation and strain mapping reveal pronounced lateral strain heterogeneity, with compressive strain concentrated within the wire interior. Systematic analysis across multiple wires suggests that higher twist rates are generally associated with weaker lateral compressive strain, narrower wires, and better atomic chain - template axis alignment. Complementary first-principles calculations on finite Te nanorods further suggest that twisting is intrinsically accessible in nucleus-scale Te clusters and strain can bias the preferred torsional state. Together, these results support a growth-incorporated, strain-biased picture in which nanoscale confinement and anisotropic strain facilitate torsional relaxation and stabilize mesoscale helicity in Te nanostructures highlighting strain and confinement as potential routes for engineering chiral lattice states in van der Waals nanostructures.

articles.title: 2D Weak Localization in Trilayer Ruddelsden-Popper Nickelates
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates superconduct when pressure suppresses intertwined charge- and spin-density waves. Here, we employ measurements of quantum corrections to magnetoconductivity as a probe of the dimensionality, phase coherence, and scattering mechanisms of the underlying single crystal trilayer RP nickelate Pr4Ni3O10 and La4Ni3O10. We observe signatures of 2D Weak Localization (WL), implying that the in-plane electron transport is in the quantum diffusive regime, while the out-of-plane transport is incoherent, and the electronic ground state is a quasi-2D disordered Fermi liquid. Application of pressure up to 3 GPa continuously suppresses signatures of WL, potentially signaling a 2D/3D dimensional crossover and an eventual pressure-driven transition into a superconductor.

articles.title: Visualizing Chiral Edge Modes in Twisted Cuprate Superconductors via Scanning-Probe Quantum Sensing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, unconventional superconductivity hosted by twisted van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures has received immense interest due to the exotic pairing symmetry, electronic interactions and nontrivial topological nature that are naturally relevant to the fast-advancing quantum technologies. Here, we report scanning-probe quantum sensing of nanoscale electromagnetic behaviors of twisted vdW cuprate superconductors. Using single-spin relaxometry, we directly visualize edge modes spontaneously formed in twisted Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x (BSCCO). By investigating temperature dependent variations of edge-state-induced quantum spin relaxation, we experimentally evaluate the magnitude of nontrivial topological band gap opened at nodal points in twisted BSCCO and its critical temperature behaviors under different twist angles. We further observe alternating chiral domains defined by edge modes, exploring experimental signatures of in-plane magnetic field-induced topology in 45deg twisted BSCCO. Our results advance the current understanding of twisted vdW nodal superconductors, presenting an appealing high-temperature topological superconducting material platform for cutting-edge quantum innovation.

articles.title: An on-lattice model for two-dimensional melting
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce an on-lattice minimal model of two-dimensional melting, a clock model with vacancies with control parameters temperature, chemical potential and external field. We study the full phase diagram using cluster Monte Carlo, Tensor Network Renormalisation Group and selfconsistent mean field methods. A non-universal ensemble of melting scenarios is observed including the KTHNY scenario of two Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless phase transitions delimiting a quasilong-range ordered phase. The upper transition evolves into first-order transition in analogy with simulations on hard and soft discs and at low chemical potential there is a single transition between ordered high density and disordered low density phases. The evolution is via a special tricritical point that is accessed in detail. This work therefore provides a framework for understanding the crossover between 2D melting scenarios and offers insights into the behavior of realistic systems.

articles.title: Laser-induced metastable (anti-)skyrmion states with higher-order topological charge
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast creation and manipulation of topologically non-trivial spin objects promises significant potential for spintronic applications. Here, we demonstrate laser-induced nucleation of skyrmions and antiskyrmions with topological charge up to |Q|=3 from the saturated magnetization state of a Co/Ni-multilayer which does not intrinsically host a skyrmionic ground state. The resulting configuration of spin objects thus constitutes a metastable, thermodynamically hidden magnetic state. We control the number and type of spin objects by the excitation fluence and the external out-of-plane magnetic field.

articles.title: Magnon-induced hybridization brightens excitons in ferromagnetic semiconductors
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons in magnetic semiconductors have energies and spin structures that are sensitive to the underlying magnetic order. We study this coupling in a minimal one-dimensional lattice model of a conduction electron and a valence hole moving in a ferromagnetic background of localized quantum spins, treating the electron, the hole, and the magnon(s) as explicitly resolved degrees of freedom. At zero temperature, spin conservation closes the relevant Hilbert subspaces at the one- or two-magnon level, so the model can be solved essentially exactly with a real-space Green's function method. Comparison against a frozen-spin approximation in which the local moments are replaced by their ordered values identifies which effects are due to emission and absorption of quantum magnons. A frozen background already lifts the spin degeneracy of the exciton and, if the two carriers couple with different strengths to the local moments, it mixes the singlet with the spin-zero triplet exciton. The emission and absorption of quantum magnons goes qualitatively further: it splits and shifts the exciton energies nonlinearly in the exchange coupling even when all frozen-spin effects vanish; for carriers with unequal hopping integrals, it hybridizes the singlet and spin-zero triplet excitons, thereby brightening the dark triplet; and it increases the exciton radius, which in turn enhances the magnon dressing by removing an on-site cancellation. These quantum effects are therefore strongest for extended, Wannier-like excitons, which is precisely the regime that is commonly modeled assuming a static (frozen-spin) magnetic order.

articles.title: RS-CIDER: A non-local machine learning model for approximating screened hybrid functionals
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Screened hybrid functionals such as HSE06 improve the description of band gaps, charge localization, and redox energetics relative to semilocal approximations, but their explicit Hartree-Fock exchange term is computationally costly for large, periodic systems, especially in plane-wave basis set calculations. Here we present RS-CIDER, a machine-learned non-local exchange functional that approximates the short-range Hartree-Fock exchange term in HSE06 by explicitly fitting both ground-state energies and single-particle energy levels. RS-CIDER combines scale-invariant semilocal and non-local density descriptors and can be evaluated self-consistently without explicitly applying the short-range Hartree-Fock exchange operator. RS-CIDER shows close agreement with HSE06 for molecular reaction energies and solid-state band gaps. Further tests across distinct materials show agreement between RS-CIDER and HSE06 for local magnetism, Cu-O phase competition, polaron localization, and neutral-defect energetics. For an Fe olivine, chemistry-specific fine-tuning recovers the HSE06 Li intercalation voltage. A timing benchmark shows that RS-CIDER reduces the measured per-SCF-step wall time by more than an order of magnitude relative to HSE06. Together, these molecular and solid-state results establish RS-CIDER as an efficient self-consistent machine-learned surrogate for HSE06.
articles.focus_summary: 该论文提出RS-CIDER非局域机器学习交换泛函，用于近似HSE06中的短程Hartree-Fock交换，并能自洽地计算分子和周期性固体。结果表明其可较好复现HSE06的带隙、局域磁性、极化子局域化和中性缺陷能，并有望显著降低计算成本。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量、电子结构计算、机器学习泛函、磁性、极化子和半导体缺陷研究高度相关。其非局域密度描述符与能级联合拟合策略，可借鉴用于构建适用于缺陷、磁性和复杂材料的高精度机器学习电子结构模型。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其非局域描述符、自洽实现和跨化学体系泛化方法，并测试其在HfO2铁电体、卤化物钙钛矿缺陷及二维磁性材料中的适用性。进一步可结合主动学习和自旋分辨哈密顿量预测，发展能够处理带电缺陷、非共线磁性与长程库仑相互作用的模型。

articles.title: Mined from Scientific Literature: Process Schemas for Atomic Layer Deposition and Etching in Materials Science
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12139v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Atomic layer deposition (ALD) and atomic layer etching (ALE) are reported heterogeneously across experimental and simulation literature in materials science, hindering comparison and machine-actionable reuse. We present four domain-expert-reviewed JSON Schemas for ALD and ALE experimental and simulation processes. Curated with schema-miner and grounded in QUDT using schema-miner pro, the schemas structure materials, process conditions, configurations , and measured or predicted results. We compare their scope, structure, and semantic grounding, and demonstrate their use for schema-guided literature extraction and publication of structured records through ORKG templates.

articles.title: Physics as the label for measuring and correcting materials reasoning in multimodal models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12181v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language and language models increasingly interpret materials data, yet benchmarks report that they hallucinate invalid properties and violate physical law. Evaluation matches final answers to scarce human labels, while discovery agents verify final proposals or density functional theory (DFT) execution. Neither measures the physical consistency of a model's reasoning chain. Materials data carries its own physics, making a large class of materials reasoning verifiable without annotation. We introduce MatPCR, a label-free benchmark whose programmatic oracles check diffraction geometry through Bragg's law, scale bars, spectral peaks, and Materials Project-grounded checks of near-hull stability, computed band-gap class, and net magnetization. We define the Physical-Consistency Rate over image and structure inputs; introduce Constraint-Grounded Self-Verification, an agentic loop whose gain survives self-refinement and equal-compute re-prompting controls; release an open verifier useful in distribution but near chance on all six held-out constraint types; and derive an exact identity for how oracle error displaces the reported rate.

articles.title: Design and Finite-Element Analysis of a New Inclined Blade-Electrode Architecture for Trapped-Ion Quantum Information Processing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12662v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The development of scalable quantum technologies requires ion-trap architectures that provide strong and stable confinement while minimizing motional heating caused by electric-field noise. Trapped-ion systems offer long coherence times and high-fidelity quantum control; however, anomalous motional heating from electrode surfaces can limit their performance. This study presents a finite-element analysis of a novel inclined ion-trap architecture, focusing on the effects of electrode geometry and blade separation on confinement strength, secular frequencies, motional heating, thermal response, and RF stability. Five trap inclinations were investigated using three-dimensional electrostatic simulations for blade separations of 5 to 35 um. The RF electric-field distribution was used to determine the effective pseudopotential, trap depth, secular frequencies, and normal modes. An empirical electric-field-noise model was then used to estimate the motional heating rate for frequency-noise exponents alpha = 3, 3.5, and 4. The results reveal a trade-off between confinement strength and ion-electrode distance. Blade separations of approximately 25 to 35 um provide a favorable design regime. At 25 um, the predicted heating rate is approximately 127 to 135 quanta per second for alpha = 3, but the RF stability margin is lower (qmax approximately 1.9). At 35 um, the stability is substantially improved (qmax approximately 0.52), while the heating rate increases to approximately 1570 to 1820 quanta per second. These results provide design guidelines for optimizing inclined ion traps for future trapped-ion quantum-information architectures.

articles.title: Geometry of Urban Order
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13029v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Urban street networks are modeled as spatial graphs whose geometry reflects planning, history, and physical constraints. Global orientation measures describe the overall order of a city but do not reveal how street directions form coherent neighborhoods. Here we introduce bearings communities---spatially connected domains whose streets share a common orientation---and analyze them using concepts from the physics of polycrystalline materials. Across 1025 large cities worldwide, these domains are almost perfectly ordered: their mean coherence is 0.964 and varies by only 1.4% from one city to the next, far above the value expected for randomly oriented streets. Every city is therefore a mosaic of well-ordered orientational grains, differing only in their number, size, and mutual alignment. Because the grains are equally regular everywhere, a city's global order is set mainly by how many of them it averages over: a city appears ordered because it is built from a few large grains, not because its fabric is locally more regular. A null model in which grain orientations are randomized confirms this grain-counting mechanism. Finally, the interface fraction γ measures how strongly domains interlock, yielding a morphology diagram that organizes cities continuously between grid-like, polycrystalline, and fragmented limits.

articles.title: Non-Abelian Quantum Turbulence in Spinor Bose-Einstein Condensates
articles.abstract: arXiv:1606.07190v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We numerically investigate statistically steady quantum turbulence in the cyclic phase of a spin-2 spinor Bose--Einstein condensate (BEC) driven by large-scale energy injection via a divergence-free external velocity field. In the full non-Abelian cyclic system, the mass-current spectrum exhibits an anomalous k⁻⁷/³ scaling, whereas the spin-current spectrum approximately follows a k⁻⁵/³ power law. To isolate the role of non-Abelian vortex dynamics, we compare this system with an Abelian-restricted cyclic system sharing the same Hamiltonian parameters and driving conditions. Strikingly, the Abelian restriction collapses both the mass- and spin-current spectra into a k⁻⁵/³ scaling, identical to that of a scalar BEC, despite the three distinct turbulent states maintaining nearly identical vortex-line densities. A Helmholtz decomposition reveals that the mass- and spin-current spectra are predominantly incompressible and transverse, respectively, thereby confirming that the anomalous scaling cannot be attributed simply to compressible fluctuations or to the transverse nature of the energy injection. Local spectral exponents further quantify these distinct scaling regimes. The disappearance of the mass-spin spectral separation under the Abelian restriction, alongside the formation of a large-scale web of rung-connected non-Abelian vortices, provides compelling evidence that non-Abelian vortex dynamics fundamentally govern the organization of turbulent mass flow.

articles.title: Statistical Mechanics of Semantic Compression
articles.title_zh: 语义压缩的统计力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.00612v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The basic problem of semantic compression is to minimize the length of a message while preserving its meaning. This differs from classical notions of compression in that the distortion is not measured directly at the level of bits, but rather in an abstract semantic space. In order to make this precise, we take inspiration from cognitive neuroscience and machine learning and model semantic space as a continuous Euclidean vector space. In such a space, stimuli like speech, images, or even ideas, are mapped to high-dimensional real vectors, and the location of these embeddings determines their meaning relative to other embeddings. This suggests that a natural metric for semantic similarity is just the Euclidean distance, which is what we use in this work. We map the optimization problem of determining the minimal-length, meaning-preserving message to a spin glass Hamiltonian and solve the resulting statistical mechanics problem using replica theory. We map out the replica symmetric phase diagram, identifying distinct phases of semantic compression: a first-order transition occurs between phases marked by the emergence of paraphrases, whereas a continuous crossover is seen from extractive to abstractive compression. We speculate on which features of the phase diagram are captured by replica symmetry, and which features change under replica symmetry breaking. We conclude by showing numerical simulations of compressions obtained by simulated annealing and greedy algorithms, and argue that while the problem of finding a meaning-preserving compression is computationally hard in the worst case, there exist efficient algorithms which achieve near optimal performance in the typical case.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究如何在保留意义的同时最小化消息长度，并将语义空间建模为连续欧几里得向量空间。作者把最短保义消息的优化问题映射为自旋玻璃哈密顿量，并用副本理论求解相应统计力学问题。研究给出副本对称相图，识别出释义涌现相关的一阶转变，以及从抽取式到抽象式压缩的连续交叉。数值模拟表明，尽管最坏情况下寻找保义压缩在计算上很难，典型情况下仍存在接近最优的高效算法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 语义压缩的基本问题是在保留消息意义的同时最小化消息长度。这不同于经典压缩概念，因为失真不是直接在比特层面度量的，而是在抽象的语义空间中度量的。为了使这一点精确化，我们从认知神经科学和机器学习中汲取启发，将语义空间建模为连续的欧几里得向量空间。在这样的空间中，语音、图像甚至思想等刺激被映射为高维实向量，而这些嵌入的位置决定了它们相对于其他嵌入的意义。这表明，语义相似性的一个自然度量就是欧几里得距离，这也是我们在本工作中采用的度量。我们将确定最短长度、保留意义消息的优化问题映射到自旋玻璃哈密顿量，并使用副本理论求解所得的统计力学问题。我们绘制了副本对称相图，识别出语义压缩的不同相：在以释义涌现为标志的相之间发生一阶转变，而从抽取式压缩到抽象式压缩则表现为连续交叉。我们推测相图中的哪些特征可由副本对称性捕捉，以及哪些特征会在副本对称性破缺下发生改变。最后，我们展示了通过模拟退火和贪婪算法获得压缩结果的数值模拟，并指出，尽管寻找保留意义压缩的问题在最坏情况下计算上很困难，但在典型情况下存在能够达到近最优性能的高效算法。

articles.title: On the theory of supermodulation of the superconducting order parameter created by structural supermodulation of apex distance in optimally doped Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊ₓ
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.15726v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recently using Scanning Josephson Tunneling Microscopy (SJTM) in the group of Séamus Davis a super-modulation of the superconducting order parameter induced by super-modulation of the distance δ between planar Cu and apical O was observed in [O'Mahony et. al., PNAS Vol. 119(37), e2207449119 (2022)]. The authors conclude that: "concurrence of prediction from strong correlation theory ... with these observations indicates that ... super-exchange is the electron pairing mechanism of Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊ₓ". In our current theoretical study we use the LCAO approximation, Hilbert space spanned on 5 atomic orbitals: Cu4s, Cu3dₓ^₂₋y^₂, O2pₓ, O2p_y, O2p_z. For the only super-exchange amplitude Jₛd we use the Kondo double electron exchange between Cu4s and Cu3dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbitals and its anti-ferromagnetic sign is determined by adjacent to the Cu ion in-plane O orbitals. Within this approximations we have calculated: "Measured dependence of dots electron-pair density nₚ on the displacement δ of the apical O atoms from the planar Cu atoms" depicted in Fig. 5(C) of O'Mahony et. al. and obtained an acceptable accuracy. As a whole, the analyzed SJTM experiment is one of the best confirmations of J. Röhler [J. Röhler, Physica B: Cond. Matter Vol. 284-288, 104 (2000)] idea that hybridization of Cu4s with conduction band leads to increasing of T_c. The lack of an alternative explanations for SJTM data nₚ versus δ and shape-Tc,ₘₐₓ correlations for the description of the critical temperature of optimally doped cuprates for several decades on the background of a simple view gives a hint that the long sought pairing mechanism has possibly been found and the Kondo exchange interaction as a property of strongly correlated quantum matter deserves further attention in the physics of layered cuprates.

articles.title: Quantitative and bond-traceable resonant X-ray optical tensors of organic molecules
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.01734v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Local molecular orientation and conformation within nanostructures is central to their behavior in devices, emergent quantum states, and biological processes. X-ray microscopy and scattering at the carbon absorption edge is uniquely sensitive to these phenomena, through transition dipole moments encoded with photon energy and polarization. However, quantitative analysis is precluded due to the lack of accurate optical models with bond and orientation specificity. We generate such a model through an unsupervised machine learning algorithm that clusters density functional theory calculations into principle electronic transitions, quantitatively refined with angle-resolved absorbance measurements. The resulting optical tensor reproduces data from samples with domains of different orientation and crystalline packing. This refinement method connects spectral features to chemical moieties and resolves measurement-inaccessible dipole moments, establishing a new paradigm for label-free orientation analyses of bonds within molecular nanostructures.

articles.title: Altermagnetism and Superconductivity: A Short Historical Review
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.09170v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This review is organized into three parts. In the first part, we explore the deep interconnections among three seemingly unrelated concepts in condensed matter physics: electronic liquid crystal phases, multipole expansions, and altermagnetism. At the heart of these phenomena lies a shared foundation: spin-momentum locking in the nonrelativistic regime. Originally proposed in the context of electronic liquid crystal phases, nonrelativistic spin-momentum locking was later elegantly incorporated into the formalism of multipole expansions. This framework can be further extended across multiple atomic sites, making it particularly effective for describing altermagnets, which host localized magnetic moments with anisotropic magnetization densities distributed over sublattices. In the second part, we examine superconducting phenomena associated with altermagnetism from three complementary perspectives. First, we investigate superconductivity associated with nonrelativistic spin-momentum locked Fermi surfaces, the unifying theme of the first part, highlighting a rich variety of unconventional superconducting states. These include finite-momentum pairing, d-wave and spin-triplet superconductivity, and topological Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, among others. We then review superconductivity emerging from either static altermagnetic order or altermagnetic fluctuations. Finally, we discuss the possible competition and intertwining between altermagnetic order and superconductivity, illustrated using the repulsive Hubbard model. Additional related topics are addressed in the concluding part. Overall, this work offers both an accessible introduction to the newly identified magnetic order known as altermagnetism and a conceptual guide for researchers aiming to harness the ensuing unconventional superconductivity in the development of future quantum technologies.
articles.focus_summary: 该综述梳理交替磁性与超导之间的历史联系，讨论电子液晶相、多极展开、非相对论自旋-动量锁定和交替磁体之间的统一框架。文章进一步总结交替磁性背景下可能出现的非常规超导态和相关费米面物理。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在交替磁性、磁性材料、强关联和超导量子材料方向相关，但该文为综述且偏概念与历史梳理，方法上与计算材料模拟的直接交集较弱。可作为理解交替磁性电子结构和超导耦合机制的背景材料。
