Water vapor isotopes provide a novel metric differentiating top-heavy from bottom-heavy evaporation profiles. Over the 15-year record, weakening evaporation partly masks declines in cloud-base rain in weak-rain regimes, whereas strengthening evaporation damps increasing cloud-base rain in intense-rain regimes. These effects obscure dry-gets-drier and wet-gets-wetter signals. Our analyses distinguish two regimes: one where sub-cloud evaporation efficiently reduces surface rainfall and water availability, and another where evaporation is energetically important for atmospheric circulation. Constraining both is critical for evaluating whether models reproduce water-cycle changes in a warming climate.

articles.title: Upstream Breakthrough Harvesting: A New Process Architecture for Helium Recovery Emerging from the Convergence of Mature Adsorption Paradigms
articles.abstract: Helium recovery from dilute natural gas streams remains challenging because conventional adsorption processes are typically employed only as the final purification stage after substantial upstream concentration. This work proposes Upstream Breakthrough Harvesting (UBH), a new adsorption process architecture that reassigns adsorption to an upstream cryogenic pre-enrichment step, where the transient helium-rich effluent generated before nitrogen breakthrough is intentionally harvested. Rather than treating breakthrough as the operational limit of the adsorption cycle, UBH exploits it as the productive separation mechanism.  A comprehensive review of mature adsorption literature demonstrates that the physical principles required for this architecture—including cryogenic helium adsorption, transient breakthrough operation, and electrically assisted adsorption—already exist but have evolved independently toward different engineering objectives. Their integration reveals a previously unexplored process opportunity rather than a new adsorption mechanism.  A representative industrial-scale packed-bed design is developed to evaluate engineering feasibility under conditions compatible with LNG nitrogen-rejection units. The analysis indicates that UBH can substantially reduce the flow rate, adsorbent inventory, equipment size, and energy demand of downstream polishing stages while relying exclusively on conventional adsorption technology.  The study also introduces Weak-Ionization Cryogenic Adsorption (WICA) as an optional and experimentally falsifiable process-intensification hypothesis that could further extend the productive breakthrough interval through weak dielectric-barrier-discharge excitation. Beyond helium recovery, the proposed framework illustrates how integrating mature adsorption paradigms can reveal previously unrecognized opportunities for process innovation.

articles.title: Evaluating Seismic Refraction for Shallow Saturated-Zone Delineation across Contrasting Lithological Settings
articles.abstract: Accurate characterization of shallow groundwater systems is essential for hydrogeological assessment, groundwater management, and geotechnical planning. Seismic refraction is a commonly used non-invasive method for subsurface characterization. However, its effectiveness is strongly dependent on lithological conditions and the associated P-wave velocity contrast. This study evaluates the capability of seismic refraction to delineate shallow saturated zones in three contrasting geological environments in Romania: an alluvial setting (Câmpul cu Maci), a loess-clay-dominated setting (Seismologilor), and a siliciclastic and evaporitic environment (Năruja). Seismic data were acquired using 24- and 48-channel systems and processed through first-arrival traveltime tomography. The results show that at Câmpul cu Maci and Năruja, a clear velocity increase from approximately 400–600 m/s to over 900–1300 m/s allows delineation of the top of the saturated zone at depths of approximately 4.5-6 m. In contrast, in clay-rich deposits, no significant velocity contrast is observed, and the top of the saturated zone remains undetectable. To complement the seismic refraction tomography results, MASW-derived shear-wave velocity profiles were analyzed along two profiles, providing additional constraints on near-surface stiffness and lithological variability. The comparison of the three sites shows that detectability of the shallow saturated zone using seismic refraction is primarily controlled by lithology rather than by water-table depth. These results highlight the importance of integrating geological information into the interpretation of seismic refraction data.

articles.title: From subsurface damage to surface instability: Integrating InSAR, UAV and microseismic observations of deep longwall mining beneath thick loess
articles.abstract: Mining-induced ground instability involves coupled deformation and damage processes across surface and subsurface domains, which are difficult to characterize using a single Earth observation technique. This study integrates time-series Sentinel-1 InSAR, UAV photogrammetry, and continuous microseismic observations to investigate progressive ground instability associated with deep longwall mining beneath a thick loess cover in northwestern China. InSAR observations reveal the spatial and temporal evolution of mining-induced deformation, while UAV surveys characterize surface fissures and localized geomorphological failure within zones of concentrated deformation. Microseismic observations provide complementary information on subsurface damage accumulation and episodic high-energy failure. Cross-correlation analysis indicates that cumulative Benioff strain precedes accelerated surface deformation by approximately 17 days (R = 0.47), providing an observational link between subsurface damage accumulation and subsequent surface deformation acceleration. The two largest microseismic events produce nearly synchronous responses in subsurface seismicity and surface deformation, indicating distinct temporal responses associated with progressive damage accumulation and major structural failure. Integrating the three observation sources reveals a four-stage progression from damage initiation and interaction to deformation localization and surface failure. The results demonstrate the value of multi-source Earth observations for resolving the spatiotemporal evolution of mining-induced ground instability and provide an integrated observational framework for geohazard monitoring in deeply mined, loess-covered regions.

articles.title: GPU-Accelerated Graph-Colored Simulated Annealing for Integer Factorization
articles.abstract: The security of RSA rests on the hardness of factoring a semiprime N = PQ. We present an end-to-end pipeline that turns this into an optimization problem: factorization is mapped to a sparse Ising model whose lowest-energy spin configuration encodes the bits of P and Q. We solve this model on a single NVIDIA GH200 GPU using a graph-colored simulated annealer designed around the sparsity of the underlying coupling matrix. To maximize efficiency, we use graph coloring to let multiple spins update in parallel without breaking the energy bookkeeping along with optimal assignment of per spin energy calculation on the threads in the GPU to maximize efficiency. The annealer rarely lands exactly on the ground state but consistently gets close, and a guided post-processing search: wheel-sieve brute force, or Coppersmith’s lattice method closes the residual distance. The full pipeline reliably factors 128-bit semiprimes on a single GPU host.

articles.title: Infants younger than one year retain episodic memories across a nap
articles.abstract: Infantile amnesia was long attributed to an immature hippocampus that cannot store unique events. Functional brain imaging in infants has triggered a reassessment of early memory abilities, but direct evidence of episodic memory before the age of one is still lacking. Here, we analysed event-related brain activity in infants and tracked memory formation for episodic events comprising unknown objects and unfamiliar words. We show that, like one-year-olds, infants younger than one year rapidly form detailed relational memories, with consolidation linked to the phase coupling of sleep spindles and slow oscillations during naps. Results suggest that hippocampal mechanisms of pattern separation and rapid relational binding as well as a core mechanism of memory consolidation during sleep are functional from around 9 months of age. Our findings imply that infantile amnesia is not caused by an inability to rapidly encode or consolidate episodic events, but by processes that influence memory later on.

articles.title: Scalable Synthesis of Er-Yb Co-doped Monolayer WS2 on Sapphire via Halide-Assisted CVD for Advanced Optoelectronics
articles.abstract: Rare-earth (RE) doping offers a powerful route to engineer the optoelectronic properties of 2D transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs). However, achieving uniform, large-area RE-doped WS2 with high crystallinity remains challenging. In this work, we report a scalable halide-assisted chemical vapor deposition (CVD) strategy to synthesize centimeter-scale, high-quality Er-Yb co-doped monolayer WS2 on sapphire substrates. The successful substitution of W sites by Er3+ and Yb3+ ions is confirmed by comprehensive characterization. Mechanistically, the RE doping induces a significant 10.8 nm redshift in photoluminescence (PL), attributed to lattice strain and the introduction of shallow impurity levels near the band edges. Crucially, the incorporation of RE ions via a vacancy-filling mechanism effectively passivates intrinsic non-radiative recombination centers, resulting in a remarkable 2-fold enhancement in PL intensity. Consequently, the fabricated WS2(Er-Yb) photodetectors exhibit a 3.4-fold improvement in responsivity (9.99 A/W) and an external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 1959.5%, outperforming pristine WS2 and many state-of-the-art 2D photodetectors. This work demonstrates that synergistic RE co-doping is a robust approach to tailor the optoelectronic performance of 2D semiconductors for industrial applications.

articles.title: Role of viscous fluid in FLRW model with observational constraints
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study, we investigate the role of bulk viscosity in the evolution of a spatially flat Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker (FLRW) universe dominated by dust. We parameterize the bulk viscosity as p_tilde = -3[l + m(H'(t) + H²) + nH²]H, derive the modified Einstein field equations, and reformulate them in terms of redshift z. Using 46 Hubble parameter measurements and the Pantheon+ compilation of 1701 supernovae, we estimate the model parameters (H0, l, m, n) through chi2 minimization and refine them using Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulations. The analysis gives a transition redshift zₜ = 0.585 and a present deceleration parameter q0 = -0.705, consistent with Lambda CDM. The present age of the universe is estimated as t0 = 14.5734 Gyr. We obtain H0 = 68 km/s/Mpc from the Hubble datasets and approximately 73 km/s/Mpc from Pantheon+. These results illustrate the Hubble tension between late- and early-universe determinations of H0. We further investigate the evolution of the equation-of-state parameter omega(z), energy density rho(z), and pressure p(z). Statefinder diagnostics (r,s) demonstrate deviations from and convergence toward Lambda CDM at different epochs. The results highlight the potential role of bulk viscosity in describing the accelerated expansion of the universe and provide a useful framework for studying cosmological models.

articles.title: Distinguishing the mixed conduction interphase: a machine learning molecular dynamics study on the Na3PS4/Na battery interface
articles.abstract: The interphase formed between solid electrolytes and alkali metal anodes determines whether decomposition is self-passivating, solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) or continuously propagating, mixed conducting interphase (MCI). We employ machine learning interatomic potential molecular dynamics to simulate the Na PS /Na interface at scales of 500 000 atoms and 10 ns. Three features distinguish this system from the passivating /Li interface: (1) P–P transport correlations enabling cooperative phosphorus migration toward the anode, (2) amorphous Na S domains lacking nanocrystalline order, and (3) persistent Na–P connectivity pathways spanning the interphase from the onset of decomposition. These characteristics are consistent with mixed ionic-electronic conducting behavior and inconsistent with self-limiting SEI character. While definitive classification requires direct electronic conductivity measurements of the amorphous interphase, this work establishes atomistic mechanistic criteria for interphase classification and demonstrates that MLIP simulations can access the length and time scales necessary to resolve transport mechanisms at solid electrolyte interfaces.

articles.title: From microscopic fluctuations to susceptibility spectra: Single-molecule relaxation in glassy media
articles.abstract: Single-molecule (SM) rotational dynamics of fluorescent probes in polystyrene near the glass transition temperature (Tg) are investigated over long times to reconstruct susceptibility spectra. The loss spectrum, commonly recorded using external field-driven (frequency-domain) spectroscopy, such as dielectric spectroscopy, is reconstructed from purely thermal SM rotational fluctuations. The results reproduce time-temperature superposition in the temperature range explored and show that the ensemble spectrum is comprised of individual molecular responses to distinct environments.

articles.title: Synergistic Dual-Reinforcement of Carbon Fiber/Polycarbonate Thermoplastic Composites via Molecularly Designed Interfacial Modification and Interlaminar Nano-Bridging
articles.abstract: Carbon fiber-reinforced thermoplastic (CFRTP) composites present a recyclable alternative to traditional thermosets, yet fully realizing their structural potential remains constrained by the chemical incompatibility between commercial epoxy-based sizing on the surface of carbon fibers and high-viscosity thermoplastic matrices such as polycarbonate (PC). To overcome this bottleneck, this study introduces a multiscale synergistic dual-reinforcement strategy that couples molecularly designed interfacial modification with strategic interlaminar nano-bridging. First, a sol-gel surface modifier was molecularly designed to replace conventional sizing. This specific design constructs a reactive polysiloxane network on the carbon fiber surface, promoting robust secondary bonding and molecular chain entanglement with the PC matrix while compensating for viscosity limitations during impregnation. Concurrently, a highly dispersed multi-walled carbon nanotube (MWCNT)/PC nanofilm was interleaved at the theoretical neutral plane, establishing a localized nano-bridging and crack-deflection defense network without altering bulk melt rheology. Integrated with automated fiber placement (AFP) prepreg manufacturing, the dual-reinforced composites (MWCNTs/MCF/PC) were systematically evaluated across varying matrix melt flow indices. Compared to unmodified CFRTP baselines, the dual-reinforced laminates demonstrated significant concurrent enhancements in ultimate tensile strength (+ 23.01%), flexural strength (+ 25.10%), and interlaminar shear strength (+ 27.18%). Fractographic morphology verified a fundamental shift in the failure mechanism from interfacial adhesive debonding to energy-dissipating cohesive matrix failure. Furthermore, thermogravimetric analysis revealed a 20.01°C elevation in the maximum degradation temperature (Tmax) due to a tortuous nano-labyrinth barrier effect that restricts volatile gas diffusion. Overall, this study establishes a comprehensive framework bridging interfacial chemistry, failure physics, and automated processing to realize high-performance, fully recyclable thermoplastic composites for advanced industrial applications.

articles.title: Initial Conformation Governs Amyloid-β42 Dynamics and Association at a POPC Membrane-Water Interface
articles.abstract: The conformational heterogeneity of amyloid-β42 (Aβ42) may influence its early interactions with lipid membranes, yet the extent to which different initial structures determine subsequent membrane association remains unclear. Here, three nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) derived Aβ42 monomer structures (1IYT, 1Z0Q, and 6SZF) were examined at a 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-phosphocholine (POPC) membrane-water interface. Despite an identical environment, the monomers followed different trajectories during comparative 200-ns all-atom molecular dynamics simulations using the CHARMM36m force field. The predominantly α-helical 1IYT structure underwent substantial relaxation, with α-helical content decreasing from 78.57% to 44.77%. The 1Z0Q monomer exhibited extensive rearrangement, developing 18.45% π-helical structure. In contrast, the fibril-derived 6SZF structure remodeled toward an α-helical state, increasing from 11.90% to 41.59%. Structural evolution and membrane association were evaluated using root-mean-square deviation (RMSD), fluctuation (RMSF), radius of gyration, peptide-membrane distance, interfacial contacts, hydrogen bonding, and secondary-structure analysis. These findings demonstrate that the initial conformational state of Aβ42 strongly influences its structural response to a common lipid-water environment and emphasize the importance of starting-structure selection when modeling early amyloid-membrane interactions.

articles.title: Dominant Role of Solid Matrix and Persistent Free Radicals in Cr(VI) Reduction by Biochar
articles.abstract: Biochar has emerged as a promising material for remediating toxic hexavalent chromium (Cr(VI)), yet the distinct roles of its soluble components and solid matrix remain poorly understood. This study systematically investigated the mechanisms of Cr(VI) immobilization by rice husk biochar produced at different pyrolysis temperatures (200–600°C). The biochar pyrolyzed at 400°C (RH400) exhibits the highest Cr(VI) reduction efficiency, effectively converting Cr(VI) to less toxic Cr(III). Through comparative experiments with biochar leachate and the residual solid matrix, we demonstrate that the soluble leachate does not contribute to Cr(VI) reduction, but instead antagonizes total chromium immobilization by competing for sorption sites. In contrast, the washed solid residue (WRH400) serves as the primary active component, achieving a 2.4-fold higher total Cr immobilization capacity than pristine RH400. Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) analysis identifies carbon-centered persistent free radicals (PFRs) as the key electron donors for Cr(VI) reduction. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) further reveals that this reduction process is accompanied by oxidation of the biochar matrix, with a shift of PFRs from carbon-centered to carbon/oxygen-centered species. This work conclusively identifies the biochar solid matrix and its associated PFRs as the dominant drivers for Cr(VI) reductive immobilization and suggests that pre-washing biochar can optimize its performance in environmental remediation.

articles.title: Disproportionate Contributions of Baseflow to Nitrogen and Phosphorus Export in an Agricultural Watershed of Southwest China
articles.abstract: Baseflow is a stable runoff component fed by groundwater, yet its contribution to nutrient export from agricultural watersheds in the Erhai Lake region remains poorly quantified. We addressed this gap by analyzing daily discharge and monthly water quality data from 2015 to 2024 in the Miju River catchment, using Eckhardt digital filtering, LOADEST load estimation, and XGBoost attribution to separate baseflow, estimate nitrogen and phosphorus fluxes, and rank their driving factors. Baseflow accounted for only 40.9% of total runoff but delivered 44.3% of total nitrogen and 55.9% of total phosphorus, revealing a disproportionate role especially for phosphorus. The importance hierarchies for both nutrients converged strikingly: total runoff ranked first as the physical carrier, followed by dryness index and cumulative water deficit as shared source-sink switches, while energy factors played secondary roles. This convergence indicates that baseflow transforms phosphorus from particulate to dissolved form, coupling its transport with nitrogen. Our findings challenge the classical view that nitrogen and phosphorus behave differently, and provide direct support for joint management of subsurface nutrient pollution in intensively farmed lake basins.

articles.title: Carbon fraction-specific microbial–mineral regulation outweighs direct calcium control in carbonate karst soils
articles.abstract: Purpose Carbon accumulation and persistence in karst soils is governed by interacting biological and mineral processes, yet the relative roles of microbial regulation, mineral protection, and calcium-mediated stabilization remain poorly constrained. Here, we investigated SOC pools and their fraction-specific controls across contrasting limestone and dolomite soils in southwest China.Methods We combined SOC fractionation with measurements of microbial biomass and community characteristics, calcium geochemistry, and mineral-associated properties. Boosted regression trees (BRT) and partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) were used to assess the relative importance and interconnected associations of these properties with SOC, mineral-associated organic carbon (MAOC), and particulate organic carbon (POC).Results SOC pools differed among carbonate lithologies and sites, with Puding dolomite soils exhibiting the highest SOC, MAOC, and POC concentrations alongside enhanced microbial biomass and mineral surface capacity. Microbial properties were the dominant predictors of carbon fractions, accounting for 79.1%, 62.1%, and 92.5% of BRT importance for SOC, MAOC, and POC respectively, strongest for POC. MAOC was jointly regulated by microbial and mineral properties, particularly cation exchange capacity and reactive Fe–Al phases. In contrast, calcium fractions showed no significant direct effects on carbon pools and contributed 3% or less BRT importance across all fractions.Conclusion SOC storage in carbonate karst soils is more strongly associated with fraction-specific microbial and mineral-associated pathways than with direct calcium effects. These findings highlight the value of representing POC and MAOC separately and distinguishing microbial, mineral-associated, and calcium-related pathways when conceptualizing soil C cycling in karst soils.

articles.title: Fourier-Guided Multi-Scale Vision Transformer for Object-Independent Detection and Severity Grading of Rain-Induced Cracking in Sweet Cherry
articles.abstract: Rain-induced cracking is among the most damaging preharvest disorders of sweet cherry because even narrow cuticular fractures reduce fresh-market value and create entry sites for water loss and fungal infection. Conventional inspection is subjective and is least reliable for low-contrast microcracks near the pedicel cavity. This study developed a Fourier-guided multi-scale Vision Transformer (FGM-ViT) for joint fruit-level severity grading and pixel-level crack segmentation. The dataset comprised 960 individual fruit from four commercial cultivars and eight orchard blocks, imaged from four rotational views after natural rainfall exposure or controlled water-immersion challenge. Crack severity was assigned as intact, microcrack, moderate, or severe using stereomicroscopic measurements of cumulative crack length, maximum width, affected surface area, and crack location. All views of an individual fruit and all observations from the same orchard block were constrained to the same fold in a nested five-fold grouped evaluation. FGM-ViT combined a multi-scale spatial encoder with luminance-normalised Fourier residual tokens and frequency-guided cross-scale attention. The complete model achieved 93.8 ± 0.9% fruit-level accuracy, 93.7 ± 1.0% macro-F1, and 0.842 ± 0.018 Dice coefficient for crack segmentation. It exceeded the spatial-only transformer by 2.2 percentage points in accuracy and 2.2 points in macro-F1, with the largest gain observed for microcracks. Classification errors were restricted almost entirely to adjacent severity categories. Under pedicel overlap, glare, brightness shifts, and motion blur, FGM-ViT retained a 2.7–3.5-point advantage over the spatial-only model. Frequency-band occlusion indicated that mid-to-high spatial frequencies carried complementary evidence for narrow fractures, whereas spatial features remained essential for crack location and marketability interpretation. The dual-output framework provides an auditable, low-cost RGB approach for sweet-cherry sorting, cultivar screening, and rain-cracking phenotyping.

articles.title: When accuracy does not improve decisions: a decision-outcome validation framework for cross-regional box office forecasting
articles.abstract: Cross-regional box office forecasting is routinely evaluated with predictive accuracy on randomly split samples, yet the models that minimize root mean squared error are not necessarily the models that produce better market selection decisions. This paper develops a decision-outcome validation framework in which forecast models are compared through a budget-constrained market selection problem, using temporal walk-forward holdouts, region-out and film-out generalization protocols, and top-k payoff, regret and hit rate as the evaluation criteria. The framework is applied to a web-sourced panel of 14 Chinese films released between 2023 and 2025, covering 76 film market pairs and 18 overseas territories with weekly gross data. Five models are compared, including a panel model with market fixed effects, regularized regression, gradient boosting and a decision-aware ranking model. The accuracy-optimal and decision-optimal models diverge in 22 of 30 validation folds. In the temporal fold covering the 2025 releases, the decision-optimal model captures 89.3 percent of the achievable revenue share, against 88.7 percent for the accuracy-optimal model and 78.9 percent for the boosting model that the weekly accuracy rankings favored, and the payoff gap between decision-based and accuracy-based selection is 152,746. Accuracy differences between models are statistically significant in three of the four temporal folds, and the decision ranking is robust to regularization strength, tree depth and the outcome window, while stronger regularization improves accuracy but lowers decision payoff. Paired bootstrap intervals for the payoff difference between decision-based and accuracy-based selection are positive across random and film-out folds, although the small number of folds limits statistical power. A Monte Carlo study with heteroscedastic market errors shows that divergence between accuracy and decision rankings is systematic when overall accuracy is balanced, and disappears only when one model dominates on both criteria. The results imply that accuracy-oriented validation with random splits is not a neutral protocol for cross-regional forecasting, and that decision outcomes should be reported alongside conventional error metrics.

articles.title: Cold-Alkaline Processed Enset (Ensete Ventricosum) Starch: Optimization of Gel Formation, Neutralization, and Formulation for Cosmetic and Adhesive Applications
articles.abstract: Background Enset (Ensete ventricosum) is a staple food crop in Ethiopia, traditionally processed into kocho and bulla (purified starch). While enset starch possesses favorable physicochemical properties including high purity (99.24%), 29% amylose content, and B-type crystallinity, its industrial applications remain largely unexplored. Conventional starch processing requires heating, which limits community-scale production. Cold-alkaline treatment offers an energy-efficient alternative, but systematic optimization for enset starch has not been documented.Objective This study aimed to optimize cold-alkaline processing parameters for enset starch gel formation, establish precise neutralization protocols, and develop formulations for adhesive and cosmetic applications suitable for community-scale production.Methods Enset starch (bulla) was mixed with water at varying ratios (1:33 to 1:8.3 w/v) and treated with 20% sodium hydroxide solution (2–6 mL per 5 g starch) at room temperature. Gel formation time, appearance, and pH were recorded. Neutralization was performed using 4M hydrochloric acid, with pH monitored after each addition. For adhesive applications, 5% borax solution (20–50 mL/L) was added, and time-dependent adhesion was evaluated over 48 hours. For cosmetic applications, 20% salt solution (0–2 mL/100 mL) was added to modify viscosity. For hair care applications, enset gel was combined with traditionally-prepared linseed (flaxseed) gel at ratios ranging from 20:80 to 80:20 (enset:linseed). All experiments were performed in triplicate.Results Optimal gel formation occurred at 5 g starch per 100 mL water with 4 mL of 20% NaOH (0.8 mL/g starch), producing a translucent, oil-like gel within 2–5 minutes at room temperature (pH 11.98 ± 0.05). Neutralization with 4M HCl followed a precise stoichiometric ratio of 0.060 mL HCl per mL of gel (R² = 0.9998). A dramatic pH breakthrough from 11.40 to 7.02 occurred during the final 0.5 mL of acid addition per 50 mL of gel. For adhesives, 5% borax at 30–40 mL per liter produced strong, time-dependent adhesion that reached optimal strength after 24 hours. For cosmetics, 20% salt solution unexpectedly reduced viscosity in a concentration-dependent manner (0.2–0.4% salt reduced flow time by 30–65%). All optimized parameters were successfully verified at scales up to 1 liter.Conclusion Cold-alkaline processing of enset starch is a reproducible, energy-efficient method requiring no heating. The optimized parameters 1:20 starch-to-water ratio, 0.8 mL 20% NaOH per gram starch, and 0.060 mL 4M HCl per mL gel for neutralization, provide a foundation for community-scale production. These findings contribute to the valorization of enset beyond its traditional role as a food crop.

articles.title: Experimental Correlation of Electrical and Optical Noise in a DFB Laser: Implications for Quantum Key Distribution and Quantum Random Number Generation
articles.abstract: We present an experimental and analytical study of the electrical-optical noise correlation in a distributed-feedback (DFB) laser diode operating at 1550 nm. Using dual-channel fast Fourier transform (FFT) measurements, we extract the power spectral densities of the injection current noise, the relative intensity noise (RIN) and their cross-spectrum. From these, the spectral coherence CI−P (f ) is computed, revealing a strong correlation at low frequencies ( 0.82). We quantify the impact of this correlation on two quantum communication technologies. For quantum key distribution (QKD), we evaluate the information leakage and show that with standard low-noise electronics it remains negligible. For quantum random number generation (QRNG), the correlated noise can be decorrelated and exploited to increase the total entropy rate by up to 20% compared to using optical noise alone. Our methodology bridges standard noise measurements with quantum performance, providing a practical solution for certifying laser sources in secure communication.

articles.title: Rethinking Surface-Layer Parameterization: A Turbulence-Based Framework Without Using Similarity Functions and Its Impacts on Surface–Atmosphere Coupling
articles.abstract: This study introduces and evaluates a new surface-layer formulation implemented in the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model in which turbulent exchange is represented using a 3D turbulence velocity scale, (:e*), thereby avoiding the explicit use of Monin–Obukhov similarity functions that have formed the basis of atmospheric surface-layer parameterizations for more than five decades. In this framework, stability dependence is embedded within the turbulence velocity scale itself, allowing surface–atmosphere exchange to emerge dynamically from the evolving turbulent and thermodynamic state of the boundary-layer. Five-day simulations over the contiguous United States during representative winter and summer periods are used to evaluate the new formulation (ESTAR) relative to a standard similarity-function-based scheme (BASE). ESTAR modifies surface–atmosphere coupling by altering turbulent transport and surface energy partitioning, producing a clear regime-dependent response. Under stable or weakly turbulent conditions, ESTAR reduces near-surface wind-speed bias by approximately 0.5–1 m s− 1 and weakens the diurnal amplitude of the wind-speed bias. During convective summer conditions, ESTAR can modify daytime sensible and latent heat fluxes by approximately 50–150 W m− 2, influencing boundary-layer growth and near-surface thermodynamic structure. Vertical profile responses are more conditional and depend on site, season, and atmospheric regime, and ESTAR–BASE differences remain small, concentrated within the lower boundary-layer. These process-level modifications propagate into moist convection, reducing excessive precipitation intensity by approximately 20–40 mm day− 1 in several regions while producing more spatially distributed rainfall patterns. Overall, the results demonstrate that surface-layer exchange can be represented without explicit similarity functions while still producing physically realistic and regime-aware turbulent exchange behavior.

articles.title: LAMP: LLM-Augmented Multi-Task Spectral Prediction for Au-GaN Metasurfaces
articles.abstract: Accurate multi-response spectral prediction is essential for metasurface performance evaluation, design-space exploration, and structural optimization. However, the underlying structure-to-spectrum mapping is highly nonlinear and requires the joint modeling of multiple optical responses over a broad wavelength range. Conventional neural predictors are effective at learning quantitative structure-to-spectrum relationships, whereas large language models (LLMs) can provide contextual representations of structural configurations. These two modeling paradigms, however, have largely been investigated independently. To bridge this gap, we propose LLM-augmented multi-task spectral prediction (LAMP), a dual-branch framework that integrates a spectral sequence encoder with a frozen LLM-based prompt encoder. An Align-then-Fuse (ATF) module is introduced to establish wavelength-aware interactions between the spectral and prompt representations through interactive alignment, followed by learnable residual fusion. The resulting representation is used for joint prediction of transmission amplitude, transmission phase, reflection amplitude, reflection phase, transmittance, and reflectance. Experiments on an Au-GaN metasurface dataset containing 56,576 structural configurations show that LAMP consistently reduces prediction errors across the six optical responses compared with conventional sequence-based predictors and direct LLM predictors. The framework also remains effective across different sequence backbones and language encoders. Ablation studies further verify the contributions of interactive alignment and residual fusion. These results demonstrate that LLM-derived contextual representations can provide complementary information for conventional neural predictors in multi-response metasurface spectral modeling.

articles.title: RL-Assisted A-Teams for Adaptive Algorithm Selection in UGV-UAV Route Optimization
articles.abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are capable of monitoring large areas but are constrained by limited battery life. Collaborating with Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) can greatly extend the endurance of UAVs by utilizing UGVs as mobile charging platforms. Integrating Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) enables effective long-duration surveillance over large areas, especially where real-time adaptability is essential. However, this also increases the complexity of routing these heterogeneous vehicles. Therefore, developing an efficient UGV-UAV routing framework is essential to ensure real-time adaptability, enabling them to respond effectively to dynamic changes. In this paper, we introduce a novel learning-based hyper-heuristic approach using Reinforcement Learning (RL) within a multi-agent optimization framework (A-Teams) to deliver computationally efficient, realtime UGV-UAV routing solutions. Hyper-heuristics are high-level optimization methods that select heuristic or meta-heuristic algorithms to solve complex computational problems more efficiently across different problem domains. The RL-assisted optimization framework is validated through various scenarios and tested for generalizability across different numbers of UAVs by comparing its performance with three alternative methods: (1) Genetic Algorithm, (2) conventional A-Teams, and (3) A-Teams variant. The proposed framework produces near-optimal solutions that are computed around 30-70% faster than the other methods while maintaining the solution quality and providing better solutions in some cases than its counterparts. Finally, the proposed method is evaluated on a real-world civilian application through a case study involving collaborative UAV-UGV routing for bridge inspection under dynamically changing conditions. Results demonstrate that the method efficiently adapts to changes, generating solutions with re-optimization times as low as 3 minutes for scenarios whose planning horizon is over 90 minutes for 50 task points.

articles.title: Lyapunov Integrability Test (LIT): a systematic procedure for exploring integrability in continuous dynamical systems
articles.abstract: We introduce the Lyapunov Integrability Test (LIT), a systematic Lyapunov-spectrum-based procedure for exploring integrability in continuous dynamical systems. Rather than using Lyapunov exponents primarily to detect chaotic dynamics, the proposed approach exploits the structure of the complete Lyapunov spectrum over parameter space to identify signatures of additional first integrals and candidate integrable regimes. Conceptually inspired by the role of the Mandelbrot set in complex dynamics, the LIT systematically scans parameter space to reveal structures associated with complete and partial integrability. The applicability of the method is demonstrated on several benchmark systems, including the ABC flow, the heavy top, quantum dots, a helically symmetric Hamiltonian system with three degrees of freedom, and the classical double pendulum. In particular, the use of the complete Lyapunov spectrum enables the detection of partially integrable regimes that remain chaotic, demonstrating that the proposed approach provides information beyond the largest Lyapunov exponent alone. Across these examples, the LIT recovers known integrable and partially integrable parameter regimes and effectively guides the search for additional first integrals. It can therefore serve as a preliminary numerical screening tool for selecting promising parameter regions for subsequent analytical investigations of integrability.

articles.title: Quantum Federated Digital Twin Framework with Explainable Multi-Agent Intelligence for Autonomous Engineering Management
articles.abstract: Autonomous engineering management increasingly depends on distributed digital twins that must learn, coordinate, and justify decisions across geographically separated industrial sites without exposing proprietary operating data. Existing solutions address these needs only in isolation: federated learning preserves data locality but offers no formal guarantee against gradient-based information leakage; multi-agent reinforcement learning coordinates distributed controllers but rarely explains its own decisions; and digital twins provide high-fidelity virtual representations but are seldom coupled to a decision layer that can act autonomously while remaining auditable by human engineers. This paper proposes the Quantum Federated Digital Twin framework with eXplainable Multi-Agent Intelligence (QFDT-XMAI), a five-layer architecture that couples asset-level digital twins to a quantum-enhanced federated learning layer, a graph-attention multi-agent decision layer, and a dedicated explainability layer. The core methodological contribution is a quantum-fidelity-weighted aggregation rule (QFA-FW) that combines classical federated averaging with a quantum state-overlap weighting term computed from variational quantum circuits trained locally at each site, together with an explainable multi-agent proximal policy optimisation procedure (XMAPPO) that couples agent coordination with Shapley-based attribution and counterfactual validity scoring. The framework is evaluated on a simulated multi-site digital-twin testbed spanning predictive maintenance, dynamic scheduling, and energy-aware operation, and is benchmarked against classical federated averaging with single- and multi-agent deep reinforcement learning, and against quantum federated learning without multi-agent coordination. Simulation results indicate that QFDT-XMAI improves normalised policy return by 6 to 15 percentage points over the strongest baseline, reduces communication rounds required for convergence by approximately 22 percent, and raises the proposed Explainability Fidelity Index from 0.40–0.55 to 0.90 while maintaining comparable decision latency. The findings suggest that jointly engineering quantum-assisted federation, multi-agent coordination, and explainability, rather than treating them as separate add-ons, yields measurable gains for autonomous engineering management under data-locality and auditability constraints

articles.title: Hydrochemical gradients and seasonal compartmentalization of legacy organochlorine pesticides in tropical estuarine water and sediments
articles.abstract: Organochlorine pesticides (OCPs) remain mobile in tropical estuaries through runoff, particle transport and sediment remobilization. Paired surface-water and surface-sediment samples were collected for one year at twelve stations in five river–estuary systems on the South Coast of Kenya. The study generated 144 paired station–month observations for each matrix. Fifteen identified OCPs and one unresolved chromatographic signal (HCN*) were retained for mixture analysis; HCN* was excluded from compound-specific interpretation and from the Σ15OCP. Mean concentrations ranged from 0.661 to 0.819 µg L− 1 in water and 1.614 to 1.731 µg kg− 1 dry weight in sediment. Centered-log-ratio principal component analysis showed multidimensional mixtures, with the first two axes explaining 33.8% of water and 29.0% of sediment variation. PERMANOVA detected seasonal and estuary-by-season structure in water profiles, whereas sediments showed estuarine and interaction effects. Crossed mixed-effects models estimated approximately 8.18-fold and 13.47-fold higher Σ15OCP burdens during the long rains than short rains in water and sediment, respectively. Dissolved oxygen was negatively associated with water burden. Partial redundancy analysis attributed 9.1% of residual water-mixture variation to hydrochemistry, with dissolved oxygen and pH contributing significant unique fractions. Paired total burdens were strongly correlated (Spearman ρ = 0.856), but complete mixture configurations were moderately concordant. The findings indicate that seasonal hydrological forcing regulates contaminant loading, whereas local estuarine conditions influence mixture composition, environmental partitioning and water–sediment coupling. There is need to integrate monitoring of water and sediment compartments for understanding the transport, retention and ecological exposure potential of legacy OCPs in tropical estuarine ecosystems.

articles.title: Adsorption and photo-Fenton catalytic degradation of Orange II dye over cobalt ferrite nanoparticles and almond shell biochar
articles.abstract: The purpose of this work is to synthesize and characterize new materials based on magnetic nanoparticles and almond shell biochar, and to evaluate their ability to remove Orange II dye from water sources. For this purpose, different systems were prepared: magnetic cobalt ferrite nanoparticles (MNP), MNP synthesized on almond shell biochar (BMNP) and a mechanical mixture of MNP and biochar (MM). These systems were characterized by X-ray diffraction, scanning electron microscopy, magnetic measurements and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy, revealing different structural properties for the three samples. The adsorption kinetic was studied and the equilibrium time tested in this study was 50 minutes. The photo-Fenton catalytic degradation of Orange II was studied. For MNP system, tests were performed under different conditions: varying concentration of catalyst and peroxide, and pH. The concentration of peroxide of 600 ppm, the catalyst concentration of 75 mg/l and pH 3 were the conditions that allowed obtaining higher degradation percentages (> 90%). Under these optimal operation conditions, the dye removal capacity was evaluated for the three systems. BMNP system showed a higher degradation capacity (> 97%) in less time and more than 95% of the sorption capacity remained after 5 successive sorption-washing cycles, suggesting an excellent reusability. These cobalt ferrite nanoparticles synthesized on biochar are presented as an efficient and reusable catalyst to remove dyes like Orange II from wastewater from the textile and food industries using solar energy.

articles.title: Petrography and Palynology of Carbonate Concretions From the Lower Cretaceous Romualdo Formation Lagerstätte, Brazi
articles.abstract: Carbonate concretions are among the most effective taphonomic capsules in the sedimentary record, isolating organic material from diagenetic alteration and enabling the preservation of three-dimensional skeletal structures, soft tissues, and associated microbial communities. The concretions of the Romualdo Formation (Aptian–Albian, Araripe Basin, Northeast Brazil) exemplify this preservational potential as part of one of the world's foremost Konservat-Lagerstätten, yielding vertebrate, invertebrate, and plant material. Despite the wealth of systematic research on these concretions, their diagenesis and internal palynological content remain poorly characterized relative to the broader palynological literature on the enclosing shales. Here we present integrated petrographic and palynological analyses of eight carbonate concretions nucleated around distinct organic substrates (fish remains, coprolites, and phytodetritus) collected from two shale horizons. Scanning electron microscopy with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDS) and polarized-light petrographic microscopy, together with palynological slides analyzed under transmitted-light optical microscopy, revealed that concretion formation was syngenetic to early diagenetic, and proceeded through three stages: (i) fluorapatite nucleation on organic substrates at or near the sediment–water interface; (ii) carbonate precipitation during the first centimeters to meters of burial; and (iii) pyrite precipitation under progressively reducing conditions. Microfossils within the concretion matrix, including ostracodes (e.g., Pattersoncypris) and miliolid foraminifera, mirror those of the host shales, corroborating early cementation of ambient sediment. The palynological assemblage is dominated by Classopollis and Uesuguipollenites, with subordinate lycophyte spores, monilophyte spores, green algae (Botryococcus), and dinoflagellates (Batiacasphaera), collectively indicative of a warm, arid-to-semi-arid coastal–estuarine setting under strong marine influence during the late Early Cretaceous.

articles.title: Physicists turn classical light into a quantum machine for information processing
articles.title_zh: 物理学家将经典光转化为用于信息处理的量子机器
articles.abstract: Quantum computers promise to tackle problems that are extraordinarily difficult for today's computers. But there is a major obstacle: quantum systems are notoriously fragile. Noise, loss and even tiny disturbances can destroy the delicate behavior that gives them their power. Building systems with many quantum particles is also extremely challenging.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算机有望解决当今计算机难以处理的问题，但量子系统极其脆弱，噪声、损耗甚至微小扰动都可能破坏其脆弱的量子行为。与此同时，构建包含大量量子粒子的系统也极具挑战性。该报道介绍了一种将经典光转化为量子信息处理机器的研究方向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算机有望解决当今计算机难以处理的极其复杂的问题。但这也面临一个重大障碍：量子系统出了名地脆弱。噪声、损耗，甚至微小的扰动，都可能破坏赋予量子系统强大能力的精细行为。构建包含大量量子粒子的系统同样极具挑战性。

articles.title: Grounding Agent Memory: Environment-Probing Curation for Enterprise Agents
articles.title_zh: 使智能体记忆扎根于环境：面向企业智能体的环境探测式记忆整理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Persistent memory is entering production-oriented agent platforms to help long-horizon agents accumulate experience across sessions. Yet a post-task curator agent restricted to completed trajectories can preserve errors, overgeneralize partial evidence, or retain stale knowledge. We introduce environment-probing curation, a deployment-compatible extension that gives an existing asynchronous curator agent least-privilege, read-only world tools to check, scope, and refresh candidate memories. It requires no model retraining and leaves the task agent, retriever, memory representation, and production write authority unchanged. In a production-like GitHub Copilot (GHCP) harness built on its SDK, we compare stateless execution, full in-context learning, GHCP + Mem, and GHCP + Mem (w/ Env Probing) on CLBench database exploration and 90 adapted APEX management-consulting tasks. On CLBench, probing raises pass rate from 39% to 73% and pass-discounted reward from 8.60 to 22.60 while reducing queries from 8.8 to 4.7 per question and task-agent cost from 3.38 to 1.68. Across six APEX worlds, all 18 memory-versus-baseline mean reward comparisons are positive and task-agent tool calls fall by 16--75%; probing gives the best task-agent reward gain per dollar in five worlds. Probing also attains higher mean reward than GHCP + Mem on both Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.7 without schema drift. Environment probing therefore turns existing agent-memory curation into an environment-informed, auditable process while preserving a compact task-time interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 持久化记忆正在进入面向生产环境的智能体平台，以帮助长时程智能体跨会话积累经验。然而，如果任务结束后的整理智能体只能访问已完成的轨迹，就可能保留错误、过度概括不完整证据或保存过时知识。本文提出环境探测式整理：在不重新训练模型的情况下，为现有异步整理智能体提供遵循最小权限原则的只读环境工具，以核验、限定范围并更新候选记忆。在基于GitHub Copilot SDK的生产式测试框架中，该方法在数据库探索和管理咨询任务上提高了成功率与奖励，同时减少了查询次数和任务智能体成本，并在多个环境中取得了更好的单位成本奖励增益。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 持久化记忆正在进入面向生产环境的智能体平台，以帮助长时程智能体跨会话积累经验。然而，仅受限于已完成轨迹的任务后整理智能体可能保留错误、过度概括不完整证据，或保留过时知识。我们提出环境探测式整理，这是一种与部署兼容的扩展：它为现有异步整理智能体提供遵循最小权限原则的只读世界工具，用于核验、限定范围并刷新候选记忆。该方法无需重新训练模型，并且不改变任务智能体、检索器、记忆表示或生产环境中的写入权限。在基于GitHub Copilot（GHCP）SDK构建的生产式测试框架中，我们在CLBench数据库探索任务和90个改编的APEX管理咨询任务上比较了无状态执行、完整上下文学习、GHCP + Mem以及GHCP + Mem（带环境探测）。在CLBench上，环境探测将通过率从39%提高到73%，将按通过率折算的奖励从8.60提高到22.60，同时将每个问题的查询次数从8.8次降至4.7次，并将任务智能体成本从3.38降至1.68。在六个APEX环境中，18个记忆方法相对于基线的平均奖励比较全部为正，任务智能体工具调用次数下降了16%至75%；在其中五个环境中，环境探测带来了单位成本最高的任务智能体奖励增益。在Sonnet 4.6和Opus 4.7上，与GHCP + Mem相比，环境探测均取得了更高的平均奖励，且没有出现模式漂移。因此，环境探测将现有的智能体记忆整理转变为一种以环境信息为依据、可审计的过程，同时保留紧凑的任务时接口。

articles.title: Portable Semantics, Private Dialects: Reuse and Negative Transfer in Latent Communication Between Language-Model Cells
articles.title_zh: 可迁移语义与私有方言：语言模型单元潜在通信中的复用与负迁移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In shared-genome language-model societies, restricted evidence visibility favors reusable, value-indexed latent packet interfaces, whereas the sole high-performing globally visible model in the parent study learned an episode-entangled code. This companion study asks whether independently trained societies share one packet language, where strict zero-shot transfer fails, and whether inherited interface state helps or harms later learning. First, a leakage-controlled causal interoperability audit over all 30 ordered pairs of six independently trained restricted societies -- under sealed held-out structure and a preregistered raw/orthogonal/linear/nonlinear alignment ladder -- shows the six semantically similar interfaces do not form one raw language: one same-initialization pair is exactly interoperable in both directions, a second shows asymmetric partial compatibility, and all 26 cross-initialization directions fail every frozen alignment rung. Second, within the tested decomposition and a single sealed source formulation, a source-span control localizes strict zero-shot failure to interpretation and execution of the new operator instructions. Third, in a matched adaptation factorial, the globally trained communication interface acts as a severe negative-transfer prior: reinitializing only the packet reader, writer, and mouth raises final depth-three accuracy from 0.169 to 0.857. Fourth, across two restricted checkpoints and two independently frozen target streams each, inherited interfaces never exceeded fresh-interface controls by the preregistered 0.10 margin. All primary conclusions are bounded to a near-transfer 17-state setting; the negative-transfer factorial concerns one globally visible parent-cohort checkpoint, while an appendix adds a post hoc tagged-global twin case study.
articles.abstract_zh: 在共享基因组的语言模型社会中，受限的证据可见性有利于形成可复用、按价值索引的潜在数据包接口，而全局可见性最高的模型却学会了与具体情节纠缠的编码。本文研究独立训练的社会是否共享同一种数据包语言、严格零样本迁移为何失败，以及继承的接口状态会促进还是阻碍后续学习。对六个独立训练的受限社会进行互操作性审计后发现，它们并不共享一种原始语言；在适配实验中，仅重新初始化数据包读写器和输出模块，就使最终三层深度准确率从0.169提高到0.857，表明继承接口可能造成严重负迁移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在共享基因组的语言模型社会中，受限的证据可见性有利于形成可复用、按价值索引的潜在数据包接口，而先前研究中唯一具有高性能且全局可见的模型学会的是一种与具体情节纠缠的编码。本配套研究考察以下问题：独立训练的社会是否共享一种数据包语言；严格零样本迁移在何处失败；以及继承的接口状态是否有助于或妨碍后续学习。首先，在预注册的原始、正交、线性和非线性对齐阶梯下，我们对六个独立训练的受限社会的全部30个有序配对开展了控制信息泄漏的因果互操作性审计，并使用封闭的留出结构进行评估。结果表明，这六种语义相近的接口并不构成一种统一的原始语言：其中一个具有相同初始化的配对在两个方向上都完全互操作，另一个配对表现出非对称的部分兼容性，而所有26个跨初始化方向均未通过任何一级冻结对齐测试。其次，在所测试的分解方式和一个封闭的源端表述下，源跨度控制实验将严格零样本失败定位到对新算子指令的解释和执行环节。第三，在匹配的适配析因实验中，全局训练的通信接口成为一种严重的负迁移先验：仅重新初始化数据包读取器、写入器和输出模块，就使最终三层深度准确率从0.169提高到0.857。第四，在两个受限检查点和每个检查点对应的两个独立冻结目标流上，继承的接口从未以预注册的0.10幅度超过新接口对照组。所有主要结论均限于一个近迁移的17状态设置；负迁移析因实验涉及一个全局可见的父代群体检查点，附录则补充了一个事后标记的全局孪生案例研究。

articles.title: From Queries to Narratives: Cultural Heritage Data Stories for Knowledge Graph Exploration and Quality Assessment
articles.title_zh: 从查询到叙事：用于知识图谱探索与质量评估的文化遗产数据故事
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cultural-heritage KGs such as the NFDI4Culture-KG contain millions of triples about artworks, music, inscriptions, historical events, and the people and places connected to them. For many users, however, discovering this knowledge can be difficult. While SPARQL can be learned, writing meaningful queries first requires an in-depth understanding of the graph's data model, an investment many domain researchers and practitioners are unwilling to make. Even with existing user interfaces, a starting point and some guidance are usually needed, because the data contained in the graph is highly specialized, heterogeneous, and constantly growing, making it challenging to know what it contains or which questions it can answer. In this paper, we present data stories as a way not only to lower this barrier, but also to turn exploration into data-quality assessment, and thus combine accessible querying with the discovery of issues that remain hidden in aggregate statistics. In this contribution, a data story is understood as a narrative document that integrates explanatory text and images with executable SPARQL queries and their visualized results. It is described how they are authored against the graph and how they serve several purposes: guiding users through an unfamiliar graph, creating reproducible narratives, and surfacing data-quality issues previously hidden in aggregate statistics. The authoring platform LODEON including its Sparnatural and AI-supported authoring assistants is introduced as a proof-of-concept. Within the authoring environment, every claim made about the data can be backed by an explicit query, making these narratives transparent and reproducible. This paper also reflects on lessons learned from hands-on seminars and workshops. Early experience suggests that such data stories make cultural-heritage knowledge graphs more accessible for both exploration and quality assessment.
articles.abstract_zh: 文化遗产知识图谱包含关于艺术品、音乐、铭文、历史事件以及相关人物和地点的大量三元组，但许多用户难以发现和利用这些知识。本文提出将数据故事作为一种探索方式：通过叙事文本和图像结合可执行的SPARQL查询及其可视化结果，降低知识图谱使用门槛，并将探索过程转化为数据质量评估。作者介绍了包含Sparnatural和人工智能辅助创作工具的LODEON平台作为概念验证，并指出每个数据主张都可以由明确查询支撑，从而实现透明且可复现的知识探索。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 诸如NFDI4Culture-KG这样的文化遗产知识图谱包含数百万个三元组，涉及艺术品、音乐、铭文、历史事件，以及与它们相关的人物和地点。然而，对许多用户而言，发现这些知识可能十分困难。虽然SPARQL可以学习，但要编写有意义的查询，首先需要深入理解图谱的数据模型，而许多领域研究人员和从业者并不愿意投入这样的时间。即使已有用户界面，通常也仍然需要一个起点和一定指导，因为图谱中的数据高度专业化、异质且持续增长，用户很难了解其中包含什么内容，或它能够回答哪些问题。在本文中，我们提出将数据故事作为一种方式，不仅降低这一门槛，还将探索转化为数据质量评估，从而把易于访问的查询与发现聚合统计中隐藏的问题结合起来。在本文中，数据故事被理解为一种叙事性文档，它将解释性文字和图像与可执行的SPARQL查询及其可视化结果结合起来。本文介绍了如何针对图谱创作数据故事，以及数据故事如何发挥多种作用：引导用户了解陌生图谱，创建可复现的叙事，并揭示此前隐藏在聚合统计中的数据质量问题。作者还介绍了创作平台LODEON及其Sparnatural和人工智能辅助创作工具，将其作为概念验证。在创作环境中，对数据作出的每一项陈述都可以由一个明确查询作为依据，使这些叙事具有透明性和可复现性。本文还总结了实践研讨会和工作坊中的经验教训。早期经验表明，这类数据故事能够提高文化遗产知识图谱在探索和质量评估方面的可访问性。

articles.title: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
articles.title_zh: MindTopo：基础模型能够在拓扑空间中进行推理吗？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial reasoning depends not only on metric properties such as distance, angle, and shape, but also on topological relations that remain invariant under continuous deformation. Cognitive science identifies these relations as foundational to spatial understanding, yet foundation-model evaluations largely focus on metric or viewpoint-dependent relations. We introduce MindTopo, a benchmark of topological intuition across five properties grounded in cognitive science and formal topology: continuity, separation, order, enclosure, and knots. MindTopo evaluates each property at two cognitive levels. Reasoning asks a model to identify topological relations or infer how they change. Planning instantiates a foundation model as a closed-loop agent whose policy selects environment actions. MindTopo contains 11,030 instances across 13 procedurally generated task types with controllable difficulty. We benchmark 14 MLLMs and study agent configurations augmented with image and video generation, including 3 video generative models in planning settings. Every MLLM performs better on reasoning than on planning, and the best-performing model remains far below observed human performance. On Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning improve reasoning more than planning. Generated observations retain local cues and reach plausible endpoints, but audited rollouts do not reliably follow environment dynamics or preserve topology across transitions. Our website is at https://mind-topo.github.io/
articles.abstract_zh: 空间推理不仅依赖距离、角度和形状等度量性质，也依赖在连续变形下保持不变的拓扑关系。本文提出MindTopo基准，基于认知科学和形式拓扑学，从连续性、分离性、顺序、包围和纽结五种性质评估基础模型的拓扑直觉，并分别考察推理和规划两个认知层次。实验包含11030个实例和13类可控制难度的程序生成任务，结果显示所有多模态大语言模型的推理表现均优于规划表现，最佳模型仍远低于人类水平；图像和视频生成增强的智能体也无法可靠地遵循环境动力学或在状态转换中保持拓扑结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空间推理不仅取决于距离、角度和形状等度量性质，还取决于在连续变形下保持不变的拓扑关系。认知科学将这些关系视为空间理解的基础，但对基础模型的评估主要集中于度量关系或依赖观察视角的关系。我们提出MindTopo，这是一个评估拓扑直觉的基准，涵盖五种基于认知科学和形式拓扑学的性质：连续性、分离性、顺序、包围和纽结。MindTopo在两个认知层次上评估每种性质。推理任务要求模型识别拓扑关系，或推断这些关系如何变化。规划任务则将基础模型实例化为闭环智能体，由其策略选择环境动作。MindTopo包含11030个实例，覆盖13类可程序生成且难度可控的任务。我们对14个多模态大语言模型进行基准测试，并研究了加入图像和视频生成能力的智能体配置，其中包括在规划设置中使用的3个视频生成模型。所有多模态大语言模型在推理任务上的表现都优于规划任务，表现最好的模型仍远低于观察到的人类表现。在Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct上，监督微调和强化学习对推理能力的提升大于对规划能力的提升。生成的观测结果保留了局部线索并到达看似合理的终点，但经过审计的运行轨迹无法可靠地遵循环境动力学，也无法在状态转换过程中保持拓扑结构。

articles.title: 2AM: Grounding Agent-Side Memory as Guidance for Steerable Action Models in Long-Horizon Manipulation
articles.title_zh: 2AM：将智能体侧记忆作为长时程操作中可操控动作模型的引导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11308v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires memory, but not necessarily inside the action policy. To address such tasks, current agentic systems often combine VLAs with planners and geometric tools, sometimes using additional depth or calibrated geometry. These systems confound attribution: gains may come from richer observations or alternative motor tools, while failures may stem from either the policy or an under-specified language interface. We isolate this question through a deliberately constrained design: less tool breadth, but greater interface bandwidth. 2AM makes a multimodal Agent the sole holder of task memory and a single RGB-based, episodically stateless Action Model the sole executor of task-relevant motion. The Agent compiles interaction history into subtask language and optional 2D grasp, place, and move hints that bind its physical intention at different time scales. To teach this steerability to the VLA, we augment demonstrations with structured hint labels and train under condition dropout, spatial noise, and temporal jitter to tolerate imperfect Agent outputs. On LIBERO-Mem, without depth, online geometry, or planner-based object motion, 2AM reaches 76.3% average completion, a 61.5-point improvement over the strongest reported baseline of 14.8%, together with 63.0% relaxed and 11.8% strict success. These results show that task memory can remain Agent-side. They further show that Action Model capability depends not only on what the policy has learned, but on how precisely the Agent can steer it.
articles.abstract_zh: 长时程机器人操作需要记忆，但记忆不一定要位于动作策略内部。2AM采用受约束的设计：多模态智能体独自持有任务记忆，而一个基于单目RGB、在每个情节中无状态的动作模型独自执行与任务相关的运动。智能体将交互历史编译为子任务语言，并可提供二维抓取、放置和移动提示；动作模型则通过结构化提示标签、条件丢弃、空间噪声和时间抖动训练来适应这些提示。在不使用深度、在线几何或基于规划器的物体运动的情况下，2AM在LIBERO-Mem上达到76.3%的平均完成率，较最强已报告基线提高61.5个百分点，说明任务记忆可以保留在智能体侧，而动作模型能力也取决于智能体引导的精确程度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长时程机器人操作需要记忆，但记忆并不一定要位于动作策略内部。为处理这类任务，当前的智能体系统通常将视觉语言动作模型与规划器和几何工具结合起来，有时还使用额外的深度信息或标定几何。这些系统使性能提升难以归因：收益可能来自更丰富的观测或替代性的运动工具，而失败可能源自动作策略本身，也可能源于定义不充分的语言接口。我们通过一种有意受限的设计来隔离这一问题：减少工具范围，但提高接口带宽。2AM让一个多模态智能体成为任务记忆的唯一持有者，让一个仅基于RGB、在每个情节中无状态的动作模型成为与任务相关运动的唯一执行者。智能体将交互历史编译成子任务语言，并可提供可选的二维抓取、放置和移动提示，这些提示在不同时间尺度上约束其物理意图。为了教会视觉语言动作模型具备这种可操控性，我们使用结构化提示标签增强示范数据，并在条件丢弃、空间噪声和时间抖动下进行训练，使模型能够容忍智能体输出的不完美。在LIBERO-Mem上，在不使用深度、在线几何或基于规划器的物体运动的情况下，2AM达到76.3%的平均完成率，相比已报告的最强基线14.8%提高61.5个百分点，同时达到63.0%的宽松成功率和11.8%的严格成功率。这些结果表明，任务记忆可以保留在智能体侧。结果还表明，动作模型的能力不仅取决于策略学到了什么，也取决于智能体能够以多高的精度对其进行引导。

articles.title: Language-Augmented Semantic Priors for B-Spline Surface Fitting
articles.title_zh: 用于B样条曲面拟合的语言增强语义先验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11708v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The use of B-splines and Non-Uniform Rational B-Splines surfaces constitutes the mathematical foundation of contemporary computer-aided design (CAD) systems. Despite long-term progress, geometric kernels in traditional CAD still rely heavily on predetermined heuristic initialization for surface fitting and parameterization. Meanwhile, the procedural semantics and design intent encoded in modeling histories are largely ignored during geometry generation. This disconnect creates a gap between high-level design intent and solver-executable geometric configuration, often leading to suboptimal and semantically inconsistent fitting results. To bridge this gap, we introduce LASP, a Language-Augmented Semantic Priors framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to infer structured, solver-usable B-spline priors from procedural modeling histories. Rather than modifying the geometric kernel itself, LASP operates as a semantic reasoning layer above existing solvers. It first translates modeling histories into rich textual descriptions that capture design intent, geometric context, and functional relationships, and then uses a fine-tuned LLM to predict structured B-spline prior parameters. LASP is trained through a two-stage scheme that combines local geometric regularities with long-range contextual dependencies, producing priors that are both interpretable and semantically coherent. This approach furnishes inductive signals that direct the conventional B-spline fitting process toward solutions that more accurately encapsulate the intended design objectives and demonstrate heightened semantic coherence. Compared to traditional machine learning schemes, the experiments demonstrate that language-driven reasoning can serve as a powerful inductive bias for geometric solving, establishing a new paradigm of language-guided geometric optimization in modern CAD systems.
articles.abstract_zh: B样条和非均匀有理B样条曲面构成现代计算机辅助设计系统的数学基础，但传统CAD几何内核在曲面拟合和参数化中仍高度依赖预设的启发式初始化，并且通常忽略建模历史中蕴含的程序语义和设计意图。本文提出LASP框架，将建模历史转化为描述设计意图、几何背景和功能关系的文本，再利用微调大语言模型预测可供求解器使用的结构化B样条先验参数。LASP作为现有求解器之上的语义推理层，通过结合局部几何规律与长程上下文依赖进行训练，引导传统B样条拟合得到更符合设计目标且语义一致性更高的结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: B样条和非均匀有理B样条曲面的使用构成了当代计算机辅助设计系统的数学基础。尽管相关技术已取得长期进展，传统CAD中的几何内核在曲面拟合和参数化方面仍然高度依赖预先设定的启发式初始化。同时，建模历史中编码的程序语义和设计意图在很大程度上被忽略。二者之间的不一致造成了高层设计意图与求解器可执行几何配置之间的鸿沟，常常导致次优且在语义上不一致的拟合结果。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出LASP，即语言增强语义先验框架，利用大语言模型从程序化建模历史中推断结构化且可供求解器使用的B样条先验。LASP不修改几何内核本身，而是作为现有求解器之上的语义推理层运行。它首先将建模历史转换为丰富的文本描述，捕捉设计意图、几何背景和功能关系；随后利用经过微调的大语言模型预测结构化的B样条先验参数。LASP通过结合局部几何规律与长程上下文依赖的两阶段方案进行训练，从而生成既可解释又具有语义连贯性的先验。这种方法提供了归纳信号，引导传统B样条拟合过程走向更准确体现预期设计目标、并表现出更高语义一致性的解。实验表明，与传统机器学习方案相比，语言驱动的推理可以作为几何求解的强大归纳偏置，从而为现代CAD系统中的语言引导几何优化确立一种新范式。

articles.title: A Density-Matrix Framework for Electronic-Structure Analysis of Electrolytes for Lithium Batteries
articles.title_zh: 用于锂电池电解质电子结构分析的密度矩阵框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25597v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electrolyte reactivity in lithium batteries is shaped by molecular functional groups, Li⁺ solvation and salt-anion participation. Conventional quantum chemistry is too computationally expensive for systematic analysis of diverse electrolyte molecules and their local solvation environments. Here we present EMolStudio, a density-matrix-centered AI platform for electronic-structure prediction and analysis. Its workflow integrates molecular functionalization, explicit Li⁺ first-shell assembly, density-matrix prediction, and electronic-structure parsing. Applied to 163,655 functionalized molecules and 22,500 first-shell clusters across four lithium salts, we find that 1) functionalization separates CO₂Me, CN, F/CF₃, and sulfonyl groups by distinct shifts in frontier levels, electrostatic potential, and Li⁺-donor contact; 2) anion identity reshapes frontier-orbital localization, with LiTDI anchoring the highest occupied orbital on the anion across the library. By carrying a unified density-matrix representation from molecular functionalization to salt-resolved solvation shells, EMolStudio provides a general platform for understanding and designing battery electrolytes.
articles.abstract_zh: 锂电池中电解质的反应性受到分子官能团、Li⁺溶剂化以及盐阴离子参与的共同影响，而传统量子化学方法难以系统分析多样化电解质分子及其局部溶剂化环境。本文提出以密度矩阵为核心的人工智能平台EMolStudio，整合分子官能化、显式Li⁺第一溶剂化层组装、密度矩阵预测和电子结构解析。对163655个官能化分子和22500个第一溶剂化层团簇的研究显示，不同官能团会引起前线能级、静电势和Li⁺-供体接触的特征性变化，阴离子种类则会重塑前线轨道局域化。该平台通过统一的密度矩阵表示连接分子官能化与盐分辨溶剂化壳层，为理解和设计电池电解质提供了通用工具。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 锂电池中电解质的反应性受到分子官能团、Li⁺溶剂化和盐阴离子参与的共同影响。传统量子化学方法的计算成本过高，难以对多样化的电解质分子及其局部溶剂化环境进行系统分析。在此，我们提出EMolStudio，这是一个以密度矩阵为核心的电子结构预测与分析人工智能平台。其工作流程整合了分子官能化、显式Li⁺第一溶剂化层组装、密度矩阵预测和电子结构解析。我们将其应用于163655个官能化分子和四种锂盐对应的22500个第一溶剂化层团簇，并发现：第一，官能化会通过前线能级、静电势和Li⁺-供体接触的不同变化，将CO₂Me、CN、F/CF₃和磺酰基区分开来；第二，阴离子种类会重新塑造前线轨道的局域化，其中LiTDI使整个分子库中的最高占据轨道定位在阴离子上。EMolStudio通过将统一的密度矩阵表示从分子官能化贯穿到盐分辨的溶剂化壳层，为理解和设计电池电解质提供了一个通用平台。

articles.title: Competitive Displacement Fluorescence Biosensor Based on Aptamer-Peptide Conjugates for Simultaneous Detection of Pb 2+ and Cd 2+ in Rice
articles.title_zh: 基于适配体-肽偶联物竞争置换荧光生物传感器同时检测大米中的Pb²⁺和Cd²⁺
articles.abstract: Lead (Pb2+) and cadmium (Cd2+) frequently co-occur in agricultural products, making rapid methods for their sensitive and simultaneous detection highly necessary. Current fluorescence methods often rely on signal amplification, which increases assay time and complexity. To achieve rapid and amplification-free detection, we developed a fast and sensitive fluorescence biosensor by anchoring high affinity aptamer-peptide conjugates (APCs) onto tetrahedral DNA nanostructures (TDNs) functionalized Fe3O4/Au magnetic nanoparticles. In the presence of targets, Pb2+ and Cd2+ competitively displace the corresponding fluorescently labeled APCs from the magnetic nanoparticles into the supernatant. After magnetic separation, the released probes were quantified by measuring the fluorescence of the supernatant, enabling simultaneous determination of both metal ions within 30 min while minimizing matrix interference. This biosensor showed linear ranges of 0.3–10 nM for both ions, with detection limits of 0.103 nM Pb2+ and 0.081 nM Cd2+. When tested in rice samples, the sensor showed good accuracy, matching the validation results from standard ICP-MS. This work successfully integrates APCs into a TDN-modified magnetic DNA nanostructure interface to enable a simple displacement assay that can achieve reliable simultaneous determination of trace heavy metals in complex samples.
articles.abstract_zh: 铅和镉常在农产品中共存，因此亟需快速、灵敏且可同时检测二者的方法。本文开发了一种无需信号扩增的快速荧光生物传感器：将高亲和力适配体-肽偶联物固定在四面体DNA纳米结构修饰的Fe3O4/Au磁性纳米颗粒上，目标离子通过竞争置换使荧光标记探针释放到上清液中。磁分离后，通过测量上清液荧光即可在30分钟内同时测定两种金属离子。该传感器对两种离子的线性范围均为0.3至10 nM，检测限分别为Pb²⁺ 0.103 nM和Cd²⁺ 0.081 nM，并在大米样品中获得了与标准ICP-MS验证结果一致的良好准确度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铅（Pb²⁺）和镉（Cd²⁺）经常在农产品中共同出现，因此非常需要能够快速、灵敏且同时检测二者的方法。现有荧光方法通常依赖信号扩增，这会增加检测时间和复杂性。为实现快速且无需扩增的检测，我们开发了一种快速、灵敏的荧光生物传感器：将高亲和力适配体-肽偶联物（APC）固定在由四面体DNA纳米结构（TDN）功能化的Fe3O4/Au磁性纳米颗粒上。在目标物存在时，Pb²⁺和Cd²⁺会竞争性地将相应的荧光标记APC从磁性纳米颗粒上置换到上清液中。磁分离后，通过测量上清液的荧光对释放的探针进行定量，从而能够在30分钟内同时测定两种金属离子，并尽量降低基质干扰。该生物传感器对两种离子均表现出0.3至10 nM的线性范围，Pb²⁺和Cd²⁺的检测限分别为0.103 nM和0.081 nM。在大米样品中的测试表明，该传感器具有良好的准确度，与标准ICP-MS的验证结果一致。本研究成功地将APC整合到TDN修饰的磁性DNA纳米结构界面中，构建了一种简单的置换检测方法，可在复杂样品中可靠地同时测定痕量重金属。

articles.title: Run-out hazard assessment and drainage anti-sliding pile control of a rainfall-induced loess landslide
articles.title_zh: 降雨诱发黄土滑坡的远程运移危险性评估与排水抗滑桩控制
articles.abstract: Rainfall-induced loess landslides in irrigated terrace areas can evolve from infiltration and pore-pressure buildup to rapid run-out toward river channels. Taking the Jiaojiaya No. 13 slope in the Heifangtai platform, Gansu Province, China, as a case study, this study first assessed untreated run-out hazard using Massflow and then evaluated the stabilization effects of conventional anti-sliding piles (CAP) and drainage anti-sliding piles (DASP) using SEEP/W and SLOPE/W in GeoStudio. Under natural conditions (NC), the calibrated Massflow model showed that about 12.0×104 m3 of unstable loess could travel 504.4 m and enter the adjacent river channel, indicating significant run-out and river-intrusion hazards. GeoStudio results showed that rainfall infiltration and post-rainfall moisture redistribution reduced the time-series factor of safety under NC to 0.701, while representative stability maps gave Fs values of 0.931, 1.057 and 1.638 for NC, CAP and DASP, respectively. CAP intercepted the main through-going slip surface but provided limited pore-pressure relief. In contrast, DASP combined mechanical resistance with drainage-pressure reduction, suppressed the through-going failure surface and shifted the reinforced slope to an overall stable state with a higher safety reserve. The potential low-reserve source zone decreased to about 0.86×104 m3, 92.8% lower than the untreated source volume. These results indicate that DASP mitigates landslide hazard mainly through source control by lowering pore-water pressure and preventing large-scale source formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 灌溉梯田区的降雨诱发黄土滑坡可能经历入渗、孔隙水压力累积，并快速远程运移至河道。以中国甘肃省黑方台焦家崖13号斜坡为案例，研究利用Massflow评估未治理滑坡的远程运移危险性，并通过GeoStudio中的SEEP/W和SLOPE/W评价常规抗滑桩与排水抗滑桩的加固效果。结果表明，排水抗滑桩通过降低孔隙水压力、抑制大规模滑源形成，主要依靠源头控制减缓滑坡危险性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 灌溉梯田区的降雨诱发黄土滑坡可能从入渗和孔隙水压力累积演化为朝向河道的快速远程运移。以中国甘肃省黑方台平台焦家崖13号斜坡为案例，本研究首先利用Massflow评估未经治理条件下的远程运移危险性，随后利用GeoStudio中的SEEP/W和SLOPE/W评价常规抗滑桩（CAP）和排水抗滑桩（DASP）的稳定效果。在自然条件（NC）下，经校准的Massflow模型显示，约12.0×10⁴ m3的不稳定黄土可运移504.4 m并进入邻近河道，表明其具有显著的远程运移和侵入河道危险。GeoStudio结果显示，降雨入渗及降雨后的水分再分配使NC条件下的时序安全系数降至0.701，而代表性稳定性图中的Fs值在NC、CAP和DASP条件下分别为0.931、1.057和1.638。CAP能够截断主要贯通滑面，但对孔隙水压力的消减作用有限。相比之下，DASP将机械抗力与排水降压作用相结合，抑制了贯通破坏面，并使加固后的边坡转变为整体稳定状态，同时具有更高的安全储备。潜在低储备滑源区体积降至约0.86×10⁴ m3，较未经治理的滑源体积降低92.8%。这些结果表明，DASP主要通过降低孔隙水压力并防止大规模滑源形成，从源头控制角度减缓滑坡危险性。
