articles.title: Physics-guided explainable machine learning and uncertainty quantification for predicting unconfined compressive strength of nano shale–quicklime stabilized kaolin clay
articles.title_zh: 用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土无侧限抗压强度的物理引导可解释机器学习与不确定性量化
articles.abstract: Data-driven prediction of stabilized-soil strength is often constrained by small experimental datasets, leakage between related specimens, and limited physical interpretability. This study develops an explainable, uncertainty-aware framework to predict the unconfined compressive strength (UCS) of nano shale–quicklime stabilized kaolin. A specimen-level database of 180 measurements from 36 mixture–curing conditions was analyzed using multiple linear regression (MLR), support vector regression (SVR), random forest (RF), XGBoost, CatBoost, and backpropagation artificial neural network (BP-ANN), with nonlinear models optimized by particle swarm optimization and evaluated through nested GroupKFold cross-validation. Mechanism-inspired features represented binder dosage, binder–curing interactions, nonlinear curing behavior, relative plasticity, and compaction state. Sequential feature ablation identified a compact CatBoost model with six physics-guided descriptors, achieving R2 = 0.841 ± 0.123 and RMSE = 151.11 ± 34.94 kPa. SHAP analysis, sensitivity assessment, and two-dimensional partial dependence mapping identified plasticity, curing duration, and binder–curing interactions as dominant controls and revealed nonlinear stabilizer effects and favorable binder combinations. Monte Carlo input perturbation and group-bootstrap resampling quantified input-driven and model-related uncertainty, with the highest 95% prediction-interval coverage reaching 0.894. The framework provides a physically interpretable, reliability-aware approach for preliminary stabilized-soil screening while retaining confirmatory laboratory testing.
articles.abstract_zh: 稳定土强度的数据驱动预测通常受到实验数据集较小、相关试样之间存在数据泄漏以及物理可解释性有限等因素的制约。本研究建立了一个具有可解释性和不确定性感知能力的框架，用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土的无侧限抗压强度，并比较了多种回归与机器学习模型。研究通过物理机制启发的特征、嵌套分组交叉验证、SHAP分析及不确定性量化，确定塑性、养护龄期和胶结料-养护相互作用是主要控制因素；最终得到的紧凑型CatBoost模型在可靠性意识下为稳定土初步筛选提供了具有物理解释的工具，但仍需实验室试验进行确认。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稳定土强度的数据驱动预测通常受到实验数据集较小、相关试样之间存在数据泄漏以及物理可解释性有限等因素的制约。本研究建立了一个具有可解释性和不确定性感知能力的框架，用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土的无侧限抗压强度（UCS）。研究分析了一个试样层面的数据库，其中包含来自36种混合物-养护条件的180次测量，并采用多元线性回归（MLR）、支持向量回归（SVR）、随机森林（RF）、XGBoost、CatBoost和反向传播人工神经网络（BP-ANN）进行建模；其中，非线性模型通过粒子群优化进行优化，并通过嵌套式GroupKFold交叉验证进行评估。受机理启发构建的特征表示了胶结料掺量、胶结料-养护相互作用、非线性养护行为、相对塑性和压实状态。顺序特征消融识别出一个包含六个物理引导描述符的紧凑型CatBoost模型，其表现达到R2 = 0.841 ± 0.123，RMSE = 151.11 ± 34.94 kPa。SHAP分析、敏感性评估和二维部分依赖关系映射表明，塑性、养护时间以及胶结料-养护相互作用是主要控制因素，并揭示了非线性稳定剂效应和有利的胶结料组合。研究通过蒙特卡罗输入扰动和分组自助法重采样，分别量化了由输入引起的不确定性和与模型相关的不确定性；其中，最高的95%预测区间覆盖率达到0.894。该框架在保留实验室确认试验必要性的同时，为稳定土初步筛选提供了一种具有物理可解释性并关注可靠性的途径。

articles.title: Halide Perovskite Trilayer Metasurfaces for Ultrabright and Wide-Gamut Structural Color
articles.title_zh: 用于超高亮度和宽色域结构色的卤化物钙钛矿三层超表面
articles.abstract: We present an all-perovskite, gradient-index trilayer metasurface for reflective structural color based on a truncated-cone meta-atom comprising a black-phase α-CsPbI₃ core between two MAPbCl₃ cladding layers. The design translates the multilayer gradient-index concept previously demonstrated with GaP/TiO₂ into a chemically related halide-perovskite platform. Finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations show that, with the three-layer heights fixed at 90/100/80 nm, the palette can be generated primarily by scaling the lateral radii and lattice period. Seven representative colors are obtained with peak reflectance near unity in the reported simulations and resonance peaks spanning 470–630 nm. The calculated linewidth decreases from 63 nm for the shortest-wavelength design to approximately 19 nm for the red design. Near-field maps of the red structure are consistent with a magnetic-dipole-dominated Mie resonance localized predominantly within the high-index CsPbI₃ core. The circular in-plane symmetry gives polarization-insensitive behavior at normal incidence, while the angular maps indicate that the resonance remains identifiable to oblique incidence approaching approximately 40–50°. The corresponding CIE 1931 coordinates demonstrate a broad chromaticity range, with the violet, blue, and cyan designs extending beyond the sRGB gamut while the full set lies within the reported Adobe RGB and Rec. 2020 reference triangles. The results establish a simulation-level proof of concept for an all-perovskite structural-color architecture. Practical implementation will require careful control of the optical constants, phase stability of α-CsPbI₃, film quality, and nanofabrication compatibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种全钙钛矿梯度折射率三层超表面，用于反射式结构色，其截顶圆锥形超原子由夹在两层MAPbCl3包覆层之间的黑相α-CsPbI3核组成。时域有限差分模拟表明，在三层高度固定为90/100/80 nm时，主要通过调节横向半径和晶格周期即可生成多种颜色；代表性颜色的峰值反射率接近1，谐振峰覆盖470至630 nm。近场分布显示，红色结构主要由局域在高折射率CsPbI3核内的磁偶极主导的米氏谐振产生；实际实现仍需精确控制光学常数、α-CsPbI3的相稳定性、薄膜质量和纳米加工兼容性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种全钙钛矿梯度折射率三层超表面，用于反射式结构色。该超表面基于一种截顶圆锥形超原子，其结构为夹在两层MAPbCl3包覆层之间的黑相α-CsPbI3核。该设计将此前利用GaP/TiO2实现的多层梯度折射率概念转化到化学组成相关的卤化物钙钛矿平台上。时域有限差分（FDTD）模拟表明，在三层高度固定为90/100/80 nm时，主要通过缩放横向半径和晶格周期即可生成颜色调色板。研究报道了七种代表性颜色，其模拟峰值反射率接近1，谐振峰覆盖470至630 nm。计算得到的线宽从最短波长设计的63 nm降低到红色设计的约19 nm。红色结构的近场分布图与以磁偶极为主的米氏谐振相一致，该谐振主要局域在高折射率CsPbI3核内。面内圆对称性使结构在法向入射下具有与偏振无关的行为，而角度映射表明，直到接近约40至50度的斜入射角时，谐振仍然可以被识别。相应的CIE 1931坐标显示出宽广的色度范围，其中紫色、蓝色和青色设计超出了sRGB色域，而完整颜色集合均位于所报告的Adobe RGB和Rec. 2020参考三角形之内。这些结果建立了一个全钙钛矿结构色架构的模拟层面概念验证。实际实施仍需仔细控制光学常数、α-CsPbI3的相稳定性、薄膜质量以及纳米加工兼容性。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文设计了由CsPbI3核心和MAPbCl3包层构成的卤化物钙钛矿三层超表面，并通过FDTD模拟获得高亮度、宽色域的结构色。研究表明，通过调节纳米结构横向尺寸和晶格周期，可以控制共振波长和反射颜色，并保持一定的偏振不敏感性。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的卤化物钙钛矿、光学响应和光电材料方向存在联系，但主要采用电磁学FDTD模拟，涉及缺陷、载流子动力学和第一性原理电子结构的内容较少。可借鉴其钙钛矿异质纳米结构和光场调控设计。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合GW-BSE或时变密度泛函理论计算材料的真实介电函数和激发态性质。还可研究界面电荷转移、载流子复合、光致离子迁移以及热效应对超表面性能的影响。

articles.title: AI extracts interpretable constitutive laws directly from solid-mechanics data
articles.title_zh: 人工智能直接从固体力学数据中提取可解释的本构定律
articles.abstract: Researchers at the Eastern Institute of Technology (EIT), Ningbo, have developed a graph-based approach that directly extracts concise, accurate constitutive equations from solid-material experimental data. The study, published in Science Advances, describes a method for discovering constitutive models for alloy steels, lithium metal and filled rubbers. It outperforms mainstream empirical models in predictive accuracy while preserving explicit, physically interpretable mathematical formulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 宁波东方理工大学的研究人员开发了一种基于图的方法，可直接从固体材料实验数据中提取简洁且准确的本构方程。该研究发表于《Science Advances》，并展示了该方法在合金钢、锂金属和填充橡胶本构模型发现中的应用。与主流经验模型相比，该方法具有更高的预测准确性，同时保留了明确且具有物理可解释性的数学表达。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 宁波东方理工大学（EIT）的研究人员开发了一种基于图的方法，能够直接从固体材料实验数据中提取简洁且准确的本构方程。该研究发表于《Science Advances》，介绍了这一用于发现合金钢、锂金属和填充橡胶本构模型的方法。与主流经验模型相比，该方法在预测准确性方面表现更优，同时保留了明确且具有物理可解释性的数学表达。

articles.title: Automating Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) Formulation Generation from Natural Language
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) is a central formulation for combinatorial optimization and has gained increasing attention due to its compatibility with quantum, hybrid quantum-classical, and quantum-inspired solvers. However, translating natural-language problem descriptions into correct QUBO formulations remains difficult, requiring the identification of binary variables, constraints, objective functions, penalty terms, and suitable penalty weights. This process is time-consuming and often demands substantial domain expertise. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end multi-agent framework that automatically generates QUBO formulations from natural-language problem descriptions, supported by structured or unstructured test cases. To evaluate its performance, We also introduce QUBOBench, a benchmark containing 100 combinatorial optimization problems across 12 application domains, curated from peer-reviewed literature, competitions, and canonical NP-hard problems. Experimental results show that our framework achieves 68% accuracy on QUBOBench, outperforming a direct single-call baseline by 22%. Further analysis identifies iterative self-repair as the most important component contributing to improved performance. The data and code are open-sourced at https://quitttcat.github.io/QuantumQUBOAgent.

articles.title: The Agent Incident Registry: Toward Preventing Repeated AI Agent Failures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents increasingly act through tools and delegated authority, but general incident repositories rarely capture the mechanisms needed to compare public failures with agent-security evaluations. We present the Agent Incident Registry (AIR), a source-linked catalog containing N{} records of agent-related events disclosed from Yfirst{} through Ylast{}. Each record includes supporting evidence, a stable identifier, and missingness-aware labels for causal role, disclosure class, mechanism, and outcome. Among the Nprimary{} generative-system records in which the agent acted, Rprimary{} involved realized harm (Pprimary%). Realized outcomes concentrate in in-the-wild and safety-failure records, while responsible disclosures and research demonstrations are overwhelmingly demonstrated; the aggregate share therefore characterizes collection composition rather than deployment risk. After initial curation, a second human reviewer checked all N{} records and their existing labels for completeness and correctness. In a deployment-analogue audit, InjecAgent's NInjecAgentCases{} cases occupy three of AIR's twelve surfaces and are all attacker-triggered, whereas AIR contains Nsafety{} no-adversary safety failures. AIR supports source-grounded case retrieval and evaluation-scope auditing, not failure-rate or control-efficacy estimation.

articles.title: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmark researchers and developers of large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems need to find relevant evaluations, locate their benchmark datasets and code, and understand the settings behind reported scores. We present Benchmark Radar, a living database and search engine for retrieval and discovery of AI benchmarks, covering LLM evaluation, agentic and tool-use benchmarks, coding, reasoning, safety, and domain-specific evaluations. The system combines daily discovery of benchmark papers, repositories, datasets, and releases with a searchable benchmark catalog, mentions in model cards and technical reports, and score histories. It retains source identities and citations so readers can inspect candidate benchmarks and their evaluation evidence. Daily discovery draws on 37 sources: 13 direct connectors and 24 first-party research and engineering feeds. The catalog contains 1,283 source records drawn from 4 benchmark catalogs and 12,916 numeric observations on 790 records. We describe collection and retrieval, audit the full catalog, and examine benchmark saturation, adoption trends, and the limits of score comparisons. A worked example walks through a complete prior-art search, showing how to query the catalog and inspect benchmark evidence when designing a new evaluation. We release the web dashboard with a benchmark leaderboard, a Pareto frontier view of score against measured use, saturation and trend views, daily feeds, downloadable evidence, a command-line interface (CLI) for offline queries, and reproducible analysis.

articles.title: AI-Powered Flare Combustion Efficiency Estimation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11262v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving high combustion efficiency in flare stacks is crucial for adhering to regulatory standards and controlling the release of hydrocarbons into the environment. Traditional instruments like gas analyzers and hyperspectral cameras are expensive, fragile, and require frequent calibration, which makes them impractical for remote or budget constrained industrial sites. We propose an innovative solution that combines a lightweight vision-language encoder with a compact multi-layer perceptron to predict combustion efficiency directly from low-cost thermal video footage. The fully trained model is integrated into an easy-to-deploy graphical user interface. This interface overlays predicted combustion efficiency values on each video frame, displays real-time trends in combustion efficiency, shows the distribution of combustion efficiency across all frames in the video, and allows users to export CSV reports. Over a six-month period, the system achieved 99% uptime and required less than 15 minutes of maintenance per week.

articles.title: DeFiFusion: Combining Transaction Events with Smart Contracts to Detect Price Manipulation Attacks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11008v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) has emerged as a rapidly growing blockchain-based financial service, where market transaction dynamics and underlying smart contract logic are intricately intertwined. This autonomous interplay, while eliminating centralized intermediaries, significantly expands the vulnerability surface of DeFi protocols to Price Manipulation Attacks (PMAs), which have already inflicted catastrophic financial losses. Despite their gravity, existing detection paradigms suffer from fundamental limitations. Transaction-centric methods lack awareness of contract execution semantics, making them prone to false positives under legitimate market volatility, while static contract analyses ignore real transaction behaviors and frequently report vulnerabilities that are infeasible to exploit in practice. We present DeFiFusion, a dual-modal PMA detection framework that closes this gap by jointly modeling transaction events and smart contract semantics within a unified pipeline. Our core insight is that PMA maliciousness emerges only from the interaction between transaction behaviors and the contract logic they exploit; neither signal suffices in isolation. Accordingly, we derive price-manipulation-aware event encoding for extracting fine-grained temporal and economic features tailored to manipulation patterns. We further introduce LLM-based contract semantic extraction to supply the execution-logic context that prior behavioral methods lack. To fuse these modalities, we propose a Dual-Modal Projection-Fusion Transformer with T5-style relative positional encoding, capturing the cyclic multi-stage execution structures that distinguish PMAs from benign market activity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeFiFusion consistently achieves state-of-the-art detection performance, effectively recalling 222 of the 225 PMA cases while maintaining a precision of 96.10%.

articles.title: GPU-CFR: 80x Faster Counterfactual Regret Minimization by Compiling the Game to Static Dataflow and CUDA Graph Replay
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11923v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) is one of the few large numerical workloads that still runs faster on CPUs than on GPUs. Each iteration sweeps a game tree with up to billions of states in millions of small, interdependent gather and scatter steps issued through a generic tree interface. On a GPU every kernel finishes in microseconds, so kernel launches and framework dispatch dominate the run time, and prior GPU implementations have lost to optimized CPU code. We observe that for a fixed game, everything about a CFR iteration except the numerical values is known before the first iteration runs. We propose GPU-CFR, a compiler and runtime built on this observation. It compiles any game once into static dataflow: flat edge and information-set arrays, precomputed indices, and depth-level batched passes fix the entire operation sequence, and only solver state changes between iterations. Static chance folding, depth-level execution blocks, and a dual-lane reach buffer cut the number of framework operations by up to 18.1x. Because shapes, indices, and buffer addresses never change, CUDA Graph Replay records the iteration once and replays it with a single graph launch. On one A100, across an eight-game suite that spans card games, dice games, and board games, GPU-CFR runs 29.8--80.4x faster than the fastest prior GPU CFR on the same accelerator, and 14--258x faster than LiteEFG, one of the fastest open-source CPU implementations, on the four largest games. The compiled representation carries most of that margin: on eight CPU threads with no accelerator it is already 2.2--51.1x faster than the GPU baseline. On the CPU the optimized path reproduces the reference iterates bitwise, and tree construction and graph capture pay for themselves within the first solve. GPU-CFR beats every CPU and GPU baseline on the mid-to-large games of the suite without changing the update rule.

articles.title: Biochar-based carbon sequestration: physicochemical characterization and Assessment of carbon stability
articles.abstract: Biochar has attracted a lot of attention as a possible carbon-sequestration material because pyrolysis converts carbon produced from biomass into an extremely durable, carbon-rich solid. This work evaluated the carbon-stability characteristics of wood-derived biochar produced by slow pyrolysis at 700°C for 5 hours under oxygen-limited conditions using thorough physicochemical characterization. The structural, chemical, morphological, elemental, and surface properties were assessed using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), scanning electron microscopy combined with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM–EDX), and Brunauer–Emmett–Teller (BET) analysis. While FTIR revealed distinctive hydroxyl, aliphatic C–H, and oxygen-containing functional groups, the XRD pattern revealed a mostly disordered structure with crystalline and mineral-associated phases. A surface morphology with pores and interparticle spaces was found to be uneven and diverse by SEM. 85.91 weight percent C, 9.34 weight percent O, and 4.74 weight percent Ca were displayed by EDX. A heterogeneous porous structure with nitrogen adsorption reaching around 140 cm³ STP g⁻¹ was revealed by BET analysis. Overall, the findings show that the generated biochar has qualities that are advantageous for carbon stabilization and possible long-term carbon storage. However, to quantitatively confirm carbon persistence, field research and long-term incubation are needed.

articles.title: Safe-by-design algal EPS based ZnO/zeolite bio-nanocomposite for the removal of BPA
articles.title_zh: 用于去除双酚A的安全设计型藻类胞外聚合物基氧化锌/沸石生物纳米复合材料
articles.abstract: The existence of endocrine disrupting chemical (EDCs), like bisphenol-A (BPA) creates a huge challenge for conventional wastewater treatment plants. The current study has aimed to develop a hybrid adsorption-photocatalytic material for efficient BPA removal under UV-A irradiation. The characterization of the bio-nanocomposite was using FE-SEM, EDX, FTIR and total organic carbon (TOC). Batch experiments were performed to evaluate the effects of concentration, catalyst dosage, pH and an optimal bio-nanocomposite was developed. The optimized Zeolite:ZnO:EPS ratio of 1:1:0.5 achieved the highest BPA removal under UV-A irradiation. Reactive oxygen species (ROS) scavenging experiments identified superoxide radicals as the dominant oxidative species. In addition, degradation kinetics were determined to be pseudo-first-order. The TOC analysis further confirmed approximately 96% mineralization of BPA after UV-A irradiation. For the biosafety assessments, Scenedesmus obliquus and Allium sativum were used as model organisms. The results indicate that the presence of EPS reduced oxidative stress and have improved biological compatibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 双酚A等内分泌干扰化学物给常规污水处理带来了重大挑战。本研究开发了一种在紫外-A光照下通过吸附-光催化协同作用高效去除双酚A的杂化材料，并考察了其组成、反应条件、降解动力学及生物安全性。优化后的沸石、氧化锌与胞外聚合物比例为1:1:0.5，双酚A矿化率约为96%，且胞外聚合物可降低氧化应激并改善生物相容性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双酚A（BPA）等内分泌干扰化学物（EDCs）的存在给常规污水处理厂带来了巨大挑战。本研究旨在开发一种杂化吸附-光催化材料，用于在紫外-A（UV-A）照射下高效去除BPA。研究采用场发射扫描电子显微镜（FE-SEM）、能量色散X射线光谱（EDX）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）和总有机碳（TOC）对该生物纳米复合材料进行表征。通过批量实验评估浓度、催化剂投加量和pH的影响，并制备出性能最优的生物纳米复合材料。在UV-A照射下，优化后的沸石、ZnO与EPS比例为1:1:0.5时，BPA去除率最高。活性氧（ROS）猝灭实验表明，超氧自由基是主要的氧化活性物种。此外，降解动力学被确定为拟一级动力学。TOC分析进一步证实，UV-A照射后BPA的矿化率约为96%。在生物安全性评估中，研究采用斜生栅藻（Scenedesmus obliquus）和大蒜（Allium sativum）作为模式生物。结果表明，EPS的存在降低了氧化应激，并改善了生物相容性。

articles.title: An integrated super-resolution THz imaging system based on a nonlocal freeform Bessel beam lens and high-power oscillator–radiator array
articles.title_zh: 基于非局域自由曲面贝塞尔光束透镜与高功率振荡器-辐射器阵列的一体化超分辨率太赫兹成像系统
articles.abstract: High-performance terahertz (THz) 3D imaging is critical for non-destructive evaluation. However, conventional architectures are fundamentally limited by severe chromatic aberrations, modest spatial resolution, restricted depths of focus (DOF), and the bulky nature of commercial transceivers. While metasurfaces offer a compact alternative, achieving broadband achromatic super-resolution with an extended DOF remains a formidable challenge. Here, we present a highly integrated 3D THz imaging platform that synergizes a 3D-printed nonlocal freeform Bessel-beam lens with a high-power, 65-nm CMOS oscillator-radiator array. Harnessing nonlocal interactions within the lens, we generate an achromatic super-resolution Bessel beam (0.3–1 THz) with a sub-diffraction full width at half maximum (FWHM) of 0.65λ and a robust 4.7-mm DOF. Crucially, the system overcomes conventional sidelobe limitations, enabling high-fidelity 2D imaging of intricate sub-millimeter targets (e.g., USAF 1951 charts and QR codes) alongside robust 3D volumetric imaging through highly scattering media, such as printed circuit boards. By converging standard CMOS technology with additive manufacturing, this work establishes a versatile, cost-effective paradigm for next-generation integrated THz photonics
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种高度集成的三维太赫兹成像平台，将三维打印的非局域自由曲面贝塞尔光束透镜与65纳米CMOS高功率振荡器-辐射器阵列相结合。该系统在0.3至1 THz范围内产生消色差超分辨率贝塞尔光束，实现0.65λ的亚衍射半高全宽和4.7毫米景深。系统可对复杂亚毫米目标进行高保真二维成像，并能穿过强散射介质实现稳健的三维体成像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高性能太赫兹（THz）三维成像对于无损检测至关重要。然而，传统架构从根本上受到严重色差、空间分辨率有限、景深（DOF）较小以及商用收发器体积庞大等因素的限制。尽管超表面提供了一种紧凑的替代方案，但要实现具有扩展景深的宽带消色差超分辨率仍然极具挑战。在此，我们提出了一种高度集成的三维THz成像平台，将三维打印的非局域自由曲面贝塞尔光束透镜与采用65纳米CMOS工艺的高功率振荡器-辐射器阵列相结合。利用透镜内部的非局域相互作用，我们在0.3至1 THz范围内产生了消色差超分辨率贝塞尔光束，其亚衍射半高全宽（FWHM）为0.65λ，并具有稳定的4.7毫米景深。更为重要的是，该系统克服了传统旁瓣的限制，能够对复杂的亚毫米目标（如USAF 1951分辨率板和二维码）进行高保真二维成像，同时还可穿过印刷电路板等强散射介质实现稳健的三维体成像。通过将标准CMOS技术与增材制造相结合，本工作为下一代集成太赫兹光子学建立了一种通用且具有成本效益的技术范式。

articles.title: Unravelling the improvement in resistive switching characteristics of Cu/HfO 2 /AlN/Pt ReRAM devices
articles.title_zh: Cu/HfO₂/AlN/Pt阻变存储器件阻变特性改善机制解析
articles.abstract: This work explores the resistive switching properties of sputter-deposited Cu/HfO2/AlN/Pt memory device. The effect of an ultra-thin layer of AlN deposited between HfO2 and the Pt interface was investigated in detail. We observed that the performance of the memory device improved in terms of endurance and retention. The stability of the device also improved due to the transformation of the AlN layer to an aluminium oxy-nitride (AlON) layer, which acts as a better heat sink, and the variation in SET/RESET voltages decreased. Formation/disruption of the oxygen vacancies related conducting channel (ionic filament) is accountable for the resistance state change in the device. In HRS, the current conduction mechanism is dominated by modified space charge limited current (SCLC), while Ohmic conduction is confirmed for charge transport in LRS. The device having AlN ultra-thin layer i.e. Cu/HfO2/AlN/Pt, exhibits excellent endurance up to 4800 cycles and a long non-volatile retention (~ 104 s) along with a significant HRS to LRS ratio of ~ 102. This study suggests that addition of an ultra-thin layer of high thermal conductivity material (AlN) improve the resistive switching performance of HfO2-based ReRAM devices, and could be a prominent technology in futuristic non-volatile memory applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了溅射沉积Cu/HfO₂/AlN/Pt存储器件的阻变特性，重点考察了位于HfO₂与Pt界面之间的超薄AlN层。AlN层转变为具有更好散热能力的氮氧化铝层后，器件的耐久性、保持性和稳定性得到改善，且SET/RESET电压波动减小。该器件可实现最高4800次循环耐久性、约10⁴秒的非易失性保持时间以及约10²的高低阻态电阻比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本工作研究了溅射沉积Cu/HfO₂/AlN/Pt存储器件的阻变特性。研究详细考察了沉积在HfO₂与Pt界面之间的超薄AlN层的作用。我们观察到，该存储器件的耐久性和保持性均得到改善。由于AlN层转变为氮氧化铝（AlON）层，而AlON具有更好的散热能力，器件稳定性也得到提升，同时SET/RESET电压的波动减小。与氧空位相关的导电通道（离子细丝）的形成与断裂，是导致器件电阻状态发生变化的原因。在高阻态（HRS）下，电流传导机制主要由修正的空间电荷限制电流（SCLC）主导；而在低阻态（LRS）下，则确认电荷传输遵循欧姆传导。具有AlN超薄层的Cu/HfO₂/AlN/Pt器件表现出优异的耐久性，可达4800次循环，并具有较长的非易失性保持时间（约10⁴秒）以及显著的高阻态与低阻态电阻比（约10²）。本研究表明，加入AlN这类高热导率材料的超薄层能够改善基于HfO₂的ReRAM器件的阻变性能，并有望成为未来非易失性存储器应用中的重要技术。

articles.title: Full-space multipolarization Janus reconfigurable intelligent metasurface with phase precompensation for bidirectional transmission and asymmetric reflection
articles.title_zh: 具有相位预补偿功能的全空间多极化Janus可重构智能超表面：实现双向传输与非对称反射
articles.abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) commonly control either reflection or transmission, limiting wavefront manipulation to one half-space or one propagation function. Here we present a full-space multipolarization Janus RIS that supports bidirectional reflection and orthogonally polarized bidirectional transmission within a single aperture. Each meta-atom couples a y-polarized receiving patch to an x-polarized transmitting patch through a microstrip delay line and incorporates two PIN diodes. The 00 and 11 diode states provide 1-bit phase control for forward y-polarized and backward x-polarized reflection, whereas the 01 and 10 states control bidirectional polarization-converting transmission. Delay-line phase precompensation supplies four reflection phases (0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°) and four transmission phases (0°, 45°, 90°, and 135°), mitigating the additional beam produced by 1-bit quantization under plane-wave illumination. Measurements of a 12 × 12 prototype demonstrate beam steering to ± 60°, peak gains of 18.31 dBi in reflection and 18.22 dBi in transmission, and measured aperture efficiencies of 21.3% and 20.7%, respectively. A sparse-aperture configuration further produces four simultaneous beams with orthogonal polarizations in the two half-spaces. The proposed architecture therefore consolidates bidirectional reflection, transmission, polarization conversion, and multibeam operation in one reconfigurable platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种全空间多极化Janus可重构智能超表面，可在单一孔径内实现双向反射以及正交极化的双向传输。每个超构单元通过微带延迟线将y极化接收贴片与x极化发射贴片耦合，并集成两个PIN二极管；不同二极管状态分别用于反射和偏振转换传输的相位控制。12×12原型样机实现了±60°波束扫描，反射和透射峰值增益分别为18.31 dBi和18.22 dBi，并可通过稀疏孔径产生两个半空间内具有正交极化的四个同时波束。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可重构智能表面（RIS）通常只能控制反射或传输中的一种，这使波前操控局限于一个半空间或一种传播功能。在此，我们提出了一种全空间多极化Janus RIS，可在单一孔径内实现双向反射以及正交极化的双向传输。每个超构单元通过微带延迟线将y极化接收贴片与x极化发射贴片耦合，并集成两个PIN二极管。00和11二极管状态为前向y极化反射和后向x极化反射提供1比特相位控制，而01和10状态则控制双向偏振转换传输。延迟线相位预补偿提供了四种反射相位（0°、90°、180°和270°）以及四种传输相位（0°、45°、90°和135°），从而减弱了平面波照射下1比特量化产生的额外波束。对12×12原型样机的测量表明，该器件可实现±60°波束扫描，反射和透射峰值增益分别为18.31 dBi和18.22 dBi，测得孔径效率分别为21.3%和20.7%。此外，稀疏孔径配置还可在两个半空间内产生四个具有正交极化的同时波束。因此，所提出的架构在一个可重构平台中整合了双向反射、传输、偏振转换和多波束运行功能。

articles.title: Effect of an intumescent flame-retardant coating on the pyrolysis and combustion characteristics of UV-aged wood
articles.title_zh: 膨胀型阻燃涂层对紫外老化木材热解与燃烧特性的影响
articles.abstract: Whether intumescent flame-retardant coatings retain their effectiveness on ultraviolet (UV)-aged wood remains unclear because photoaging alters the surface structure of the substrate. This study elucidated the thermal degradation pathway and fire-protective mechanism of an intumescent coating applied to UV-aged pine using thermogravimetry, isoconversional kinetics, kinetic model fitting, cone calorimetry, and char morphology analysis. The coating initiated dehydration and charring at lower temperatures but markedly delayed the main decomposition stage. Compared with UV-aged uncoated wood, the T50% increased by 49.36–69.67 ℃, while the char residue increased from 5.43–6.99% to 14.34–17.37%. The average apparent activation energy increased by 29.98 and 27.00 kJ·mol− 1 according to the Kissinger–Akahira–Sunose and Flynn–Wall–Ozawa methods, respectively. More importantly, the dominant kinetic mechanism shifted from a reaction-order model to an Avrami–Erofeev nucleation-and-growth model, revealing a transition from rapid degradation to controlled char formation. At 45 kW·m− 2, the peak heat release rate, peak mass loss rate, and total smoke production decreased by 50.44%, 44.52%, and 72.60%, respectively. Notably, the coated UV-aged wood formed a denser and more continuous honeycomb-like char layer than the coated unaged wood and exhibited the lowest fire growth tendency. These findings demonstrate that the coating remains effective after UV aging by redirecting wood pyrolysis toward condensed-phase charring and constructing a stable heat- and mass-transfer barrier.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于光老化会改变木材基材的表面结构，膨胀型阻燃涂层在紫外老化木材上能否保持阻燃效果仍不明确。本研究结合热重分析、等转化率动力学、动力学模型拟合、锥形量热和炭层形貌分析，揭示了该涂层在紫外老化松木上的热降解路径与防火机制。涂层促进了低温脱水和成炭，同时显著延缓主要分解阶段；在45 kW·m⁻²下，峰值热释放速率、峰值质量损失速率和总烟释放量分别降低50.44%、44.52%和72.60%，表明涂层仍能有效促进木材向凝聚相成炭转变并形成稳定的传热传质屏障。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于光老化会改变基材的表面结构，膨胀型阻燃涂层在紫外（UV）老化木材上能否保持其有效性仍不明确。本研究采用热重分析、等转化率动力学、动力学模型拟合、锥形量热和炭层形貌分析，阐明了膨胀型涂层应用于紫外老化松木后的热降解路径和防火保护机制。该涂层在较低温度下启动脱水和成炭，但显著延缓了主要分解阶段。与未涂层的紫外老化木材相比，50%转化温度（T50%）提高了49.36至69.67 ℃，而炭残余率则由5.43%至6.99%提高到14.34%至17.37%。根据Kissinger-Akahira-Sunose和Flynn-Wall-Ozawa方法，平均表观活化能分别提高了29.98和27.00 kJ·mol⁻¹。更重要的是，主导动力学机制由反应级数模型转变为Avrami-Erofeev成核与生长模型，揭示了木材由快速降解向受控成炭的转变。在45 kW·m⁻²热辐射强度下，峰值热释放速率、峰值质量损失速率和总烟释放量分别降低了50.44%、44.52%和72.60%。值得注意的是，涂层紫外老化木材形成的炭层比涂层未老化木材形成的炭层更加致密和连续，呈蜂窝状结构，并表现出最低的火灾增长倾向。这些发现表明，该涂层在紫外老化后仍然有效，能够将木材热解重新导向凝聚相成炭，并构建稳定的传热和传质屏障。

articles.title: Evidence-coupled bistability converts dependency structure into a recovery geometry
articles.title_zh: 证据耦合双稳态将依赖结构转化为恢复几何
articles.abstract: Dependency structure is known to constrain the order in which an adaptive system regains its capacities, but not the rest: whether recovery is self-sustaining, is held without support, stalls, or collapses. Here we place an evidence-coupled bistable cascade on a finite forward acyclic dependency chain: each capacity carries an evidence-dependent threshold, evidence accrues only while every prerequisite is online, and accumulated evidence lowers that threshold. We prove that consolidated evidence accelerates every capacity super-linearly, that the recovered and failed configurations are two stable states, and that the surface on which the root switches regime is exactly invariant, its position independent of the evidence timescale. That invariance is not bought by a postulated selector: the update follows from a two-regime Bayesian model with ambiguity-suspended updating, exclusivity arising in the sharp limit. Directional coupling then fixes the outcome: above an explicit sufficient bound every trajectory off the surface converges to full recovery or full collapse, while sufficiently weak coupling admits a stable partial state at consolidated evidence. Dependency structure thus gates when evidence can accumulate, and that gating, coupled to bistability, yields a recovery geometry whose outcomes depend on coupling strength and initial condition. Catatonia is the first biological instantiation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在有限前向无环依赖链上构建证据耦合双稳态级联系统，分析依赖结构如何影响自适应系统的恢复或崩溃。研究证明，巩固后的证据能够以超线性方式加速各项能力恢复，完全恢复与完全失败构成两个稳定状态，而根节点切换状态的临界曲面不受证据时间尺度影响。耦合强度与初始条件共同决定系统最终走向完全恢复、完全崩溃或稳定的部分恢复状态，并以紧张症作为首个生物学实例。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 已知依赖结构会约束自适应系统重新获得各项能力的顺序，但它并不能决定恢复过程的其余性质，即恢复是否能够自我维持、能否在没有支持的情况下保持、是否会停滞，或者是否会崩溃。本文在有限的前向无环依赖链上设置了一个证据耦合双稳态级联系统：每项能力都具有一个依赖证据的阈值；只有当所有先决条件均处于在线状态时，证据才会累积；而累积的证据会降低该阈值。我们证明，巩固后的证据会以超线性方式加速每项能力，恢复配置和失败配置是两个稳定状态，而根节点发生状态切换的曲面严格保持不变，其位置与证据演化的时间尺度无关。这种不变性并非通过假定一个选择器获得：更新规则源自一个具有歧义暂停更新机制的双状态贝叶斯模型，并且互斥性在锐化极限下产生。随后，方向性耦合决定了最终结果：当耦合强度高于一个明确的充分界限时，所有不位于该曲面上的轨迹都会收敛至完全恢复或完全崩溃；而当耦合足够弱时，在证据得到巩固的情况下，系统允许存在稳定的部分恢复状态。因此，依赖结构控制证据何时能够累积，而这种门控机制与双稳态相结合，形成了一种恢复几何，其结果取决于耦合强度和初始条件。紧张症是这一机制的首个生物学实例。

articles.title: Discovery of a New Class of Optical Discharges in the Lower Atmosphere
articles.title_zh: 低层大气中新型光学放电的发现
articles.abstract: Thunderstorms produce energetic particles, radio emissions, and lightning, yet optical manifestations of electrical discharges in the lower atmosphere remain largely unexplored. Here we report the discovery of a class of blue–violet optical discharges observed beneath thunderclouds. Using synchronized all-sky cameras, three-camera stereoscopic imaging, near-surface electric-field measurements, energetic-particle detectors, radio-frequency measurements, lightning observations, and cloud-base estimates at the Aragats high-altitude research station, we obtained the first comprehensive multiparametric characterization of these optical phenomena. The observations demonstrate that these emissions comprise two fundamentally different discharge regimes controlled by the polarity of the near-surface electric field. Positive electric fields produce compact, elevated blue–violet blobs and elongated luminous structures, whereas negative electric fields generate diffuse corona and streamer-corona emissions associated with grounded structures. Three-camera stereoscopy places the best-validated compact sources at approximately 50–65 m above the station. We propose a physical model in which the two optical regimes originate from different lower-thunderstorm dipoles: the LPCR–Earth dipole produces free-air streamer development, whereas the MN–Earth dipole favors corona and streamer-corona discharges on grounded objects. These observations reveal a previously unknown component of thunderstorm electrodynamics, establish a new class of atmospheric optical discharges, and introduce a new observational window into streamer formation, energetic-particle acceleration, and lightning initiation.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用多种同步观测手段，首次对雷暴云下方的蓝紫色光学放电进行了全面的多参数表征。结果表明，近地面电场极性控制着两种本质不同的放电模式：正电场产生悬空的致密光团和细长发光结构，负电场则产生与接地结构相关的弥散电晕及流光电晕。研究提出了基于不同低层雷暴偶极子的物理模型，为理解流光形成、高能粒子加速和闪电起始提供了新的观测窗口。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 雷暴会产生高能粒子、无线电辐射和闪电，但低层大气中放电的光学表现仍在很大程度上未得到探索。本文报告了一类在雷暴云下方观测到的蓝紫色光学放电。通过在阿拉加茨高海拔研究站使用同步全天空相机、三相机立体成像、近地面电场测量仪器、高能粒子探测器、射频测量设备、闪电观测设备以及云底高度估算方法，我们首次对这些光学现象进行了全面的多参数表征。观测结果表明，这些光学辐射包含两种本质不同的放电模式，并受近地面电场极性控制。正电场会产生致密的高空蓝紫色光团和细长的发光结构，而负电场则会产生与接地结构相关的弥散电晕和流光电晕辐射。三相机立体观测将验证程度最高的致密光源定位在研究站上方约50至65米处。我们提出了一个物理模型，其中两种光学放电模式分别源于不同的低层雷暴偶极子：低层正电荷区与地球构成的偶极子会产生自由空气中的流光发展，而主负电荷区与地球构成的偶极子则有利于在接地物体上形成电晕和流光电晕放电。这些观测揭示了雷暴电动力学中一个此前未知的组成部分，确立了一类新的大气光学放电，并为研究流光形成、高能粒子加速和闪电起始开辟了新的观测窗口。

articles.title: Thermoelastic damping analysis to CNTs/GPLs-reinforced FG microplate under nonlocal strain gradient theory incorporating surface effects and three-phase-lag heat conduction model
articles.title_zh: 考虑表面效应和三相滞后热传导模型的非局部应变梯度理论下碳纳米管与石墨烯纳米片增强功能梯度微板热弹性阻尼分析
articles.abstract: This study investigates thermoelastic damping (TED) in functionally graded (FG) microplates reinforced with carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and graphene platelets (GPLs). A size-dependent model is established by integrating Kirchhoff plate theory, nonlocal strain gradient theory (NSGT), surface elasticity theory (SET), and the three-phase-lag (TPL) heat conduction model. The effective elastic modulus is evaluated using the Halpin–Tsai micromechanical model, and the governing equations are solved using the complex frequency (CF) method. The effects of CNTs/GPLs distribution patterns, surface effects, hybrid reinforcement, nonlocal and strain-gradient parameters, temperature, nanofiller geometry, length-to-thickness ratio, and vibration modes on TED are systematically examined. The results show that the FG-X pattern yields the highest TED, whereas the FG-O pattern gives the lowest. Surface effects suppress TED and lead to distribution-dependent critical thicknesses, with the largest value for FG-O and the smallest for FG-A. The CNTs/GPLs hybrid system improves stiffness while maintaining considerable damping. Nonlocal softening and strain-gradient hardening regulate TED in opposite ways, respectively reducing and increasing damping. TED increases nonlinearly with temperature, but its growth rate decreases above 293 K. CNTs wall thickness significantly affects TED, while GPLs thickness has negligible influence. Increasing the length-to-thickness ratio reduces TED, and surface effects cause a localized downward bending for FG-X within 8–10 µm. Higher vibration modes enhance frequency shift and move the sensitive region toward thinner microplates. These findings provide design guidance for FG-CNTs/GPLs-based resonators, sensors, and other thin-walled microdevices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究建立了融合基尔霍夫板理论、非局部应变梯度理论、表面弹性理论和三相滞后热传导模型的尺寸相关模型，用于分析碳纳米管与石墨烯纳米片增强功能梯度微板的热弹性阻尼。结果表明，增强材料分布、表面效应、非局部参数、应变梯度参数、温度、纳米填料几何尺寸及振动模态均会显著影响阻尼。研究为相关谐振器、传感器及薄壁微器件的设计提供了依据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究分析了碳纳米管和石墨烯纳米片增强功能梯度微板中的热弹性阻尼。通过综合基尔霍夫板理论、非局部应变梯度理论、表面弹性理论和三相滞后热传导模型，建立了一个尺寸相关模型。采用Halpin–Tsai微观力学模型评估等效弹性模量，并使用复频率法求解控制方程。系统考察了碳纳米管与石墨烯纳米片的分布模式、表面效应、混杂增强、非局部参数和应变梯度参数、温度、纳米填料几何形状、长厚比以及振动模态对热弹性阻尼的影响。结果表明，FG-X分布模式产生最高的热弹性阻尼，而FG-O分布模式产生最低的热弹性阻尼。表面效应会抑制热弹性阻尼，并产生随分布模式而变化的临界厚度，其中FG-O的临界厚度最大，FG-A的临界厚度最小。碳纳米管与石墨烯纳米片混杂体系在保持较大阻尼的同时提高了刚度。非局部软化和应变梯度硬化以相反方式调节热弹性阻尼，前者会降低阻尼，后者会提高阻尼。热弹性阻尼随温度非线性增加，但在温度高于293 K后，其增长速率下降。碳纳米管的壁厚会显著影响热弹性阻尼，而石墨烯纳米片的厚度影响可以忽略。增加长厚比会降低热弹性阻尼，而表面效应会使FG-X分布的微板在8至10微米厚度范围内出现局部向下弯曲。更高阶的振动模态会增大频率偏移，并使敏感区域向更薄的微板移动。这些发现为基于功能梯度碳纳米管与石墨烯纳米片复合材料的谐振器、传感器及其他薄壁微器件提供了设计指导。

articles.title: Design of E-Core Double Mechanical Rotor Double Stator Flux Switching Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine by Analytical Model
articles.title_zh: 基于解析模型的E形铁芯双机械转子双定子磁通切换永磁同步电机设计
articles.abstract: In this paper, the design of an E-Core Double Mechanical Rotor Double Stator Flux Switching Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (ECDMRDSFSPMSM) using a sub-region method as an analytical model is presented. The family of flux switching permanent magnet machines (FSPMMs) is an appropriate candidate for high power density machines, especially in hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs). However, their drawbacks are high cogging torque due to the large number of permanent magnets and rapid entry into the saturation region under load conditions. To address these weaknesses, an E-Core structure for the FSPMM is proposed to formulate an analytical model for an acceptable design in terms of saturation and cogging torque considering the radial and tangential components of flux density over the air gap. Furthermore, to validate the proposed method, the analytical results are compared with those obtained from the numerical method known as finite element analysis (FEA).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用子域法解析模型设计一种E形铁芯双机械转子双定子磁通切换永磁同步电机。该设计旨在缓解传统磁通切换永磁电机永磁体数量较多所导致的高齿槽转矩，以及负载条件下容易快速进入磁饱和区的问题。研究通过有限元分析结果验证了解析方法的有效性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文采用子域法作为解析模型，提出了E形铁芯双机械转子双定子磁通切换永磁同步电机的设计。磁通切换永磁电机系列是高功率密度电机的合适候选方案，尤其适用于混合动力电动汽车。然而，这类电机的缺点包括因永磁体数量较多而产生较高的齿槽转矩，以及在负载条件下迅速进入磁饱和区。为解决这些不足，本文为磁通切换永磁电机提出了一种E形铁芯结构，并在考虑气隙磁通密度径向分量和切向分量的情况下构建解析模型，从而获得在磁饱和与齿槽转矩方面均可接受的设计。此外，为验证所提出的方法，本文将解析结果与被称为有限元分析的数值方法所得结果进行了比较。

articles.title: Increasing coldward shift of karst vegetation carbon sink driven by climate warming
articles.title_zh: 气候变暖驱动喀斯特植被碳汇日益向冷区转移
articles.abstract: Climate warming has reshaped the thermal and moisture environments for vegetation growth. Spatial heterogeneity in hydrothermal factors may alter vegetation ecological adaptation processes, thereby restricting carbon sink potential in relatively warm zones while enhancing it in relatively cold zones. As a result, vegetation carbon sink growth may exhibit a warm-to-cold shift. However, this potential shift remains unverified, and its spatial patterns and evolutionary mechanisms remain unclear. Karst trough valleys are characterized by a typical three-dimensional surface–subsurface dual hydrogeological structure, pronounced elevational variations, and complex combinations of slope aspects, which respectively form contrasting warm–cold zones between the surface and subsurface, low and high elevations, and sunny and shady slopes, making them representative regions for investigating the coldward shift of vegetation carbon sinks under climate warming. Based on this, taking the karst trough valley as a representative case, a three-dimensional warm–cold pattern framework based on slope aspect, elevation, and spatial structure was constructed to reveal the historical and future characteristics of the coldward shift in vegetation carbon sinks and to analyze its climatic driving mechanisms. The results showed that vegetation carbon sinks exhibited a warm-to-cold shift across the dimensions of spatial structure, elevation, and slope aspect. In terms of spatial structure, belowground net primary productivity (BNPP)/total net primary productivity (TNPP) increased at rates of 0.00026 and 0.00011 yr− 1 during the historical period and under the SSP245 scenario, respectively, indicating a continued strengthening of the growth advantage of belowground carbon sinks. Along the elevational gradient, net primary productivity (NPP) growth gradually shifted from low-elevation regions toward high-elevation regions. Under the high-emission scenario (SSP585), the NPP growth rate at high elevations was approximately twice that at middle and low elevations. Along the slope-aspect dimension, NPP growth shifted from semi-sunny and semi-shady slopes toward shady slopes. Under all three future scenarios, shady slopes exhibited a pronounced growth-rate advantage, with the highest growth rate reaching 1.22 g C m− 2 yr− 1. In addition, the results indicated that moisture conditions dominated the shift in the growth advantage of vegetation carbon sinks toward colder zones, while soil CO2 partial pressure (pCO2) exerted a pronounced effect at low elevations. This study confirms the shift in vegetation carbon sink growth advantage from warmer to colder zones and provides a new perspective for understanding the spatial reorganization of vegetation carbon sinks under climate warming.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究以喀斯特槽谷为代表，构建了基于坡向、海拔和空间结构的三维冷暖格局框架，以揭示植被碳汇向冷区转移的历史、未来特征及其气候驱动机制。结果显示，植被碳汇增长优势在地下与地表、高海拔与低海拔以及阴坡与阳坡等维度上均由暖区向冷区转移。水分条件是这一转移的主要驱动因素，而土壤二氧化碳分压在低海拔地区具有显著影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 气候变暖重塑了植被生长所处的热量和水分环境。水热因子的空间异质性可能改变植被的生态适应过程，从而限制相对温暖区域的碳汇潜力，同时增强相对寒冷区域的碳汇潜力。因此，植被碳汇的增长可能表现出由暖区向冷区转移的趋势。然而，这种潜在转移尚未得到验证，其空间格局和演化机制仍不明确。喀斯特槽谷具有典型的三维地表与地下双重水文地质结构、显著的海拔变化和复杂的坡向组合，这些特征分别在地表与地下、低海拔与高海拔以及阳坡与阴坡之间形成对比鲜明的冷暖区域，使其成为研究气候变暖条件下植被碳汇向冷区转移的代表性区域。基于此，本文以喀斯特槽谷为代表案例，构建了一个基于坡向、海拔和空间结构的三维冷暖格局框架，以揭示植被碳汇向冷区转移的历史与未来特征，并分析其气候驱动机制。结果表明，在空间结构、海拔和坡向三个维度上，植被碳汇均表现出从暖区向冷区转移的趋势。在空间结构方面，历史时期和SSP245情景下，地下净初级生产力与总净初级生产力之比分别以每年0.00026和0.00011的速率增加，表明地下碳汇的增长优势持续增强。沿海拔梯度，净初级生产力的增长逐渐由低海拔地区向高海拔地区转移。在高排放情景SSP585下，高海拔地区的净初级生产力增长率约为中、低海拔地区的两倍。沿坡向维度，净初级生产力的增长由半阳坡和半阴坡向阴坡转移。在全部三种未来情景下，阴坡均表现出显著的增长率优势，最高增长率达到每年每平方米1.22克碳。此外，结果表明，水分条件主导了植被碳汇增长优势向较冷区域的转移，而土壤二氧化碳分压在低海拔地区产生了显著影响。本研究证实了植被碳汇增长优势由较暖区域向较冷区域转移，并为理解气候变暖背景下植被碳汇的空间重组提供了新的视角。

articles.title: Research on optimization of structural parameters of steam pilot solenoid valve based on approximate model
articles.title_zh: 基于近似模型的蒸汽先导式电磁阀结构参数优化研究
articles.abstract: As a typical precision fluid control component, the opening and closing sensitivity and dynamic response performance of steam-operated solenoid valves have a significant impact on the stability of system operation. Addressing the issue of insufficient response speed in steam-operated solenoid valves, this paper focuses on their overall structural parameters and systematically analyzes the mechanism of their opening and closing response characteristics under static and dynamic conditions. Based on this, using an approximate model method, and with five parameters working air gap, number of coil turns, valve core mass, spring stiffness, and spring preload as optimization variables, quadratic regression models for the pull-in response time and release response time are constructed. Response surface methodology is then used to investigate the interaction between these structural parameters and their impact on dynamic response performance. The results show that each key structural parameter has varying degrees of influence on the pull-in and release response times. Appropriate matching of electromagnetic driving force, moving part inertia, and spring restoring force is crucial for improving the opening and closing performance of the solenoid valve. After optimization, the pull-in response time is reduced to 11.714 ms, and the release response time is reduced to 9.122 ms, significantly improving the dynamic response performance of the solenoid valve. The research results can provide a theoretical basis for the structural optimization and high dynamic response design of steam-operated solenoid valves, and have certain reference value for improving their operational stability and engineering applicability under complex and extreme working conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究针对蒸汽先导式电磁阀响应速度不足的问题，以工作气隙、线圈匝数、阀芯质量、弹簧刚度和弹簧预紧力为优化变量，建立吸合与释放响应时间的二次回归模型。响应面分析表明，电磁驱动力、运动部件惯性和弹簧恢复力的合理匹配是改善启闭性能的关键。优化后吸合响应时间降至11.714毫秒，释放响应时间降至9.122毫秒。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作为一种典型的精密流体控制元件，蒸汽先导式电磁阀的启闭灵敏度和动态响应性能对系统运行稳定性具有显著影响。针对蒸汽先导式电磁阀响应速度不足的问题，本文以其整体结构参数为研究重点，系统分析了静态和动态条件下启闭响应特性的作用机制。在此基础上，采用近似模型方法，以工作气隙、线圈匝数、阀芯质量、弹簧刚度和弹簧预紧力五个参数为优化变量，构建了吸合响应时间和释放响应时间的二次回归模型。随后采用响应面法研究这些结构参数之间的交互作用及其对动态响应性能的影响。结果表明，各关键结构参数对吸合和释放响应时间具有不同程度的影响。电磁驱动力、运动部件惯性和弹簧恢复力的合理匹配，是改善电磁阀启闭性能的关键。优化后，吸合响应时间缩短至11.714毫秒，释放响应时间缩短至9.122毫秒，电磁阀的动态响应性能得到显著改善。研究结果可为蒸汽先导式电磁阀的结构优化和高动态响应设计提供理论依据，并对提高其在复杂和极端工况下的运行稳定性与工程适用性具有一定参考价值。

articles.title: An autonomous agentic framework for cross-campaign generalization and sensor shift adaptation
articles.title_zh: 一种用于跨实验活动泛化与传感器漂移适应的自主智能体框架
articles.abstract: Although autonomous, large language model-driven systems show immense potential for orchestrating complex scientific experiments, their efficacy is constrained by two fundamental bottlenecks: context dilution, where strategic reasoning degrades as experimental history accumulates, and inter-campaign amnesia, which forces systems into computationally expensive tabula rasa explorations upon encountering novel domains. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the Multi-Objective State-Action Network (MOSAN), an autonomous cognitive information fusion framework designed for robust cross-campaign generalization and sensor shift adaptation. MOSAN achieves effective information fusion by coupling a self-evolving semantic memory with an Organic Strategic Graph Memory (OSGM), strictly orchestrated through a novel Single Ledger Architecture that isolates cognitive phases and prevents context saturation. A core mechanism of the OSGM is Cross-Domain Strategic Seeding (‘Ghost Node’ injection), a transient cold-start fusion strategy. Upon encountering novel datasets, the OSGM temporarily injects topological priors from similar past domains; these ephemeral nodes guide initial architectural deductions and are subsequently purged, allowing the system to disseminate structural knowledge across disciplines while decreasing the risk of cross-contamination. The fusion framework was validated on the challenging task of bacterial classification via Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy subject to sensor aging shifts, autonomously discovering highly accurate multi-topological architectures. Crucially, when subjected to an out-of-distribution 1D sequential modality (the ECG5000 cardiovascular dataset), the agent performed zero-shot architectural meta-learning, bypassing brute-force search to rapidly achieve 0.9930 accuracy. Finally, the framework was successfully deployed using an open-weight model (Mistral 24B) at zero API inference cost. By continuously fusing multi-epoch empirical evidence, bridging representational topologies, and actively overcoming sensor drift, MOSAN establishes a scalable and rigorous paradigm for autonomous biophysical discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出多目标状态-动作网络（MOSAN），以解决大语言模型驱动的自主科学实验系统中的上下文稀释和跨实验活动遗忘问题。该框架将自演化语义记忆、组织化战略图记忆及单一账本架构结合，并通过“幽灵节点”实现跨领域战略知识迁移。在传感器老化条件下的表面增强拉曼光谱细菌分类任务，以及分布外ECG5000数据集上，MOSAN均展示出有效的架构发现与泛化能力，并在后者达到0.9930准确率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管由大语言模型驱动的自主系统在编排复杂科学实验方面展现出巨大潜力，但其效能受到两个根本瓶颈的限制：随着实验历史不断累积，战略推理会退化的上下文稀释；以及跨实验活动遗忘，即系统在遇到新领域时被迫进行计算成本高昂的从零开始探索。为克服这些限制，本文提出多目标状态-动作网络（MOSAN），这是一种旨在实现稳健跨实验活动泛化和传感器漂移适应的自主认知信息融合框架。MOSAN通过将自演化语义记忆与组织化战略图记忆（OSGM）耦合，实现有效的信息融合；这一过程由一种新颖的单一账本架构严格编排，该架构隔离不同认知阶段并防止上下文饱和。OSGM的核心机制是跨领域战略播种，即“幽灵节点”注入，这是一种暂时性的冷启动融合策略。当遇到新数据集时，OSGM会暂时从相似的既往领域注入拓扑先验；这些短暂节点引导初始架构推断，随后被清除，使系统能够跨学科传播结构知识，同时降低跨域污染风险。该融合框架在一项具有挑战性的任务中得到验证：在传感器老化漂移条件下，利用表面增强拉曼光谱进行细菌分类；系统能够自主发现精度很高的多拓扑架构。关键的是，当面对分布外的一维序列模态，即ECG5000心血管数据集时，该智能体进行了零样本架构元学习，绕过暴力搜索并迅速达到0.9930的准确率。最后，该框架利用开放权重模型Mistral 24B成功部署，实现零API推理成本。通过持续融合多时期实验证据、连接表征拓扑，并主动克服传感器漂移，MOSAN为自主生物物理发现建立了一种可扩展且严谨的范式。

articles.title: Lattice 2-group symmetries: operators, defects, and gauging
articles.title_zh: 格点二群对称性：算符、缺陷与规范化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct and study lattice realizations of finite 2-group symmetries in 2+1d quantum lattice systems with finite-dimensional tensor-product Hilbert spaces. We focus on two broad classes of 2-groups with 0-form symmetry group G and 1-form symmetry group A: split 2-groups with trivial Postnikov class [β]inH³(G,A), and central 2-groups with trivial action ρcolon GtoAut(A). In both cases, we construct symmetry operators on the full tensor-product Hilbert space that become 2-group symmetry operators when restricted to the topological subspace of the lattice A 1-form symmetry. While the lattice split 2-group symmetry operators are onsite, the lattice central 2-group symmetry operators are not, and can only be made onsite after introducing ancillae. We extensively explore various manifestations of ρ and [β] for these lattice 2-group symmetry operators and demonstrate their agreement with expectations from quantum field theory. These manifestations arise in the transformation of operators carrying symmetry charge, the structure of lattice 2-group symmetry defects, and the dual fusion 2-category symmetries obtained by gauging the lattice 2-group symmetries. We further propose families of local symmetric Hamiltonians for both classes of lattice 2-group symmetries and identify exactly solvable limits lying in phases with spontaneous 2-group symmetry breaking and nontrivial symmetry-enriched topological order. In one such limit, the gauged Hamiltonians are exactly solvable lattice realizations of the corresponding 2-group gauge theories, whose ground-state degeneracies we calculate.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在具有有限维张量积希尔伯特空间的2+1维量子格点系统中构造并研究有限二群对称性的格点实现。作者分别讨论分裂二群和中心二群，分析其对称算符、带对称荷算符、缺陷以及规范化后的对偶融合2-范畴对称性。文中还提出局域对称哈密顿量，并给出具有自发二群对称性破缺、非平庸对称性富集拓扑序及可精确求解二群规范理论的极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在具有有限维张量积希尔伯特空间的2+1维量子格点系统中构造并研究有限二群对称性的格点实现。我们聚焦于两大类二群，其零形式对称群为G、一形式对称群为A：Postnikov类[β]属于H³(G,A)且平凡的分裂二群，以及作用ρ从G到Aut(A)平凡的中心二群。在这两种情形中，我们都在完整张量积希尔伯特空间上构造对称算符；当这些算符限制到格点A一形式对称性的拓扑子空间时，它们成为二群对称算符。虽然格点分裂二群对称算符是现场的，但格点中心二群对称算符不是现场的，只有在引入辅助自由度后才能使其成为现场的。我们广泛探索了ρ和[β]在这些格点二群对称算符中的各种体现，并证明它们与量子场论的预期一致。这些体现出现在携带对称荷算符的变换、格点二群对称缺陷的结构，以及通过规范化格点二群对称性所获得的对偶融合2-范畴对称性中。我们还为这两类格点二群对称性提出了局域对称哈密顿量族，并确定了可精确求解的极限；这些极限处于具有自发二群对称性破缺和非平庸对称性富集拓扑序的相中。在其中一个极限下，规范化后的哈密顿量是相应二群规范理论的可精确求解格点实现，我们计算了其基态简并度。

articles.title: Quantum interference between vortex- and impurity-bound states boosts thermoelectricity
articles.title_zh: 涡旋束缚态与杂质束缚态之间的量子干涉增强热电效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermoelectric effects in superconductors are generally suppressed by the approximate particle-hole symmetry of the quasiparticle spectrum, but can become pronounced near defects that host particle-hole asymmetric bound states. Here, we investigate how the local thermoelectric response is modified when multiple vortices or nonmagnetic impurities are brought into proximity. Using a lattice Bogolioubov-de Gennes approach combined with linear-response tunneling theory, we calculate the spatially resolved density of states and Seebeck coefficient in s- and d-wave superconductors. We find that the thermoelectric response can be strongly enhanced when spatially extended defect-induced states overlap. For vortices, this enhancement persists beyond the immediate core regions and originates from interference between vortex-bound states. For impurities, the thermoelectric response exhibits a comparable dependence on impurity separation in the s- and d-wave cases, although the associated spectral reconstruction is considerably more localized in the s-wave superconductor. Our results show that the spatial extent and interference of defect-induced quasiparticle states provide a means of controlling local thermoelectricity in inhomogeneous superconductors, with potential relevance for cryogenic thermoelectric sensing and energy conversion.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究多个涡旋或非磁性杂质相互接近时，缺陷束缚态的干涉如何改变超导体的局域热电响应。基于格点Bogoliubov-de Gennes方法和线性响应隧穿理论，作者发现空间延展的缺陷诱导态发生重叠时，热电响应可显著增强。该结果表明，可通过调控非均匀超导体中缺陷态的空间延展范围及其干涉来控制局域热电性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导体中的热电效应通常会受到准粒子谱近似粒子-空穴对称性的抑制，但在存在承载粒子-空穴不对称束缚态的缺陷附近，热电效应可以变得显著。本文研究当多个涡旋或非磁性杂质彼此接近时，局域热电响应如何被改变。通过采用格点Bogoliubov-de Gennes方法并结合线性响应隧穿理论，我们计算了s波和d波超导体中具有空间分辨率的态密度和塞贝克系数。我们发现，当空间延展的缺陷诱导态发生重叠时，热电响应能够得到强烈增强。对于涡旋，这种增强延伸至紧邻涡旋核的区域之外，其起源是涡旋束缚态之间的干涉。对于杂质，在s波和d波情形下，热电响应对杂质间距表现出可比的依赖关系，尽管与之相关的谱重构在s波超导体中明显更加局域化。我们的结果表明，缺陷诱导准粒子态的空间范围及其干涉为控制非均匀超导体中的局域热电性提供了一种手段，这对于低温热电传感和能量转换具有潜在意义。

articles.title: A Unified Theory of Collective Magnon and Orbiton Excitations in Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交错磁体中集体磁振子与轨道子的统一理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10708v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism has recently emerged as a distinct collinear magnetic phase exhibiting momentum-dependent spin-splitting despite vanishing net magnetization, as a consequence of inequivalent non-magnetic environments. Lately, it has been proposed that strong electronic correlations may yield spontaneous altermagnetism due to orbital ordering even for equivalent non-magnetic environments. While previous studies have largely focused on the electronic structure, a unified understanding of the collective excitations associated with these two different microscopic mechanisms stabilizing altermagnetism remains absent. Here, we develop an extended Kugel'-Khomskiĭ spin-orbital model on a decorated square lattice that simultaneously incorporates inequivalent non-magnetic environments and correlation-driven orbital ordering within a common theoretical framework. Employing a self-consistent mean-field spin-wave orbital-wave formalism, we demonstrate the emergence of mutually unhybridized but interdependent magnon and orbiton excitations exhibiting characteristic chiral-splitting. We show that the splitting originates from two distinct microscopic contributions: a lattice-dependent term arising from inequivalent non-magnetic environments and an orbital-order-induced exchange-anisotropy term that survives even for equivalent non-magnetic environments. The proposed framework therefore unifies the collective excitations associated with both types of altermagnetism. We further investigate the finite-temperature evolution of the coupled spin-orbital system, revealing the breakdown of spin-wave and orbital-wave approximations through spurious 1st-order transitions, while complementary classical Monte Carlo simulations recover the expected continuous 2nd-order behaviour. Our work establishes a unified microscopic framework for understanding collective magnon and orbiton excitations in altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 交错磁性是一种净磁化为零但具有动量依赖自旋劈裂的共线磁相，其可由不等价的非磁环境或强关联诱导的轨道有序稳定。本文在装饰方格子上建立扩展的Kugel-Khomskii自旋-轨道模型，统一描述这两种机制，并预测相互不杂化但彼此关联、具有特征性手性劈裂的磁振子和轨道子激发。劈裂分别源于晶格环境差异及轨道有序导致的交换各向异性；有限温研究还表明，经典蒙特卡洛模拟可恢复预期的连续二级相变行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交错磁性近年来被提出为一种独特的共线磁相：尽管其净磁化为零，却由于非磁环境不等价而表现出依赖动量的自旋劈裂。近来，有研究提出，即使非磁环境彼此等价，强电子关联也可通过轨道有序产生自发交错磁性。尽管以往研究主要聚焦于电子结构，但对于稳定交错磁性的这两种不同微观机制所对应的集体激发，尚缺乏统一认识。本文在装饰方格子上发展了一种扩展的Kugel-Khomskii自旋-轨道模型，在统一理论框架中同时纳入非磁环境不等价性和关联驱动的轨道有序。通过采用自洽平均场自旋波-轨道波形式主义，我们证明了彼此不发生杂化但相互依存、并呈现特征性手性劈裂的磁振子与轨道子激发的出现。我们表明，该劈裂来自两种不同的微观贡献：一种是由非等价非磁环境引起的依赖晶格的项，另一种是由轨道有序诱导的交换各向异性项，后者即使在非磁环境等价时仍然存在。因此，所提出的框架统一了与两类交错磁性相关的集体激发。我们还研究了耦合自旋-轨道系统的有限温演化，发现自旋波和轨道波近似会通过赝一级相变而失效，而互补的经典蒙特卡洛模拟则恢复了预期的连续二级行为。我们的工作为理解交错磁体中的集体磁振子和轨道子激发建立了统一的微观框架。

articles.title: Moiré Topology in Twisted Structures with Noncollinear Spin-Orbit Coupling
articles.title_zh: 具有非共线自旋-轨道耦合的扭转结构中的莫尔拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré superlattices provide a powerful platform for flat bands and correlated topological phases, yet most established examples rely on valley-contrasting Berry curvature in hexagonal lattices. Here, we propose a different route to achieve topological moiré minibands based on noncollinear spin orbit coupling in centrosymmetric type II SOC bilayers. Interlayer hybridization opens local pseudogaps and produces sharply localized Berry curvature, which twisting reconstructs into isolated topological minibands without requiring valley degrees of freedom or hexagonal symmetry. We demonstrate this mechanism in tetragonal Dresselhaus-SOC HgI2, where a Lieb-like moiré potential yields topological flat bands. To improve miniband isolation, we develop a physics-informed machine-learning surrogate that identifies stronger SOC as a key design principle and guides the replacement of Hg by Pb. The resulting PbI2 minibands are narrower and better isolated, supporting correlation-driven magnetism and tunable quantum spin Hall and Chern insulating phases, thereby providing an optimized material realization for experimental exploration.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种获得拓扑莫尔微带的新机制，基于具有非共线自旋-轨道耦合的中心对称II型自旋-轨道耦合双层体系，而不依赖谷自由度或六角晶格对称性。层间杂化形成局域赝能隙和高度局域的贝里曲率，扭转后可重构为孤立的拓扑微带。作者以四方Dresselhaus自旋-轨道耦合HgI2及经机器学习优化的PbI2为例，指出更强自旋-轨道耦合有助于获得更窄、更孤立的微带，并支持关联磁性及可调量子自旋霍尔和陈绝缘相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 莫尔超晶格为平带和关联拓扑相提供了强有力的平台，但大多数已确立的实例依赖于六角晶格中谷相反的贝里曲率。本文提出了一条不同的路径，可在中心对称的II型自旋-轨道耦合双层体系中，基于非共线自旋-轨道耦合实现拓扑莫尔微带。层间杂化打开局域赝能隙并产生高度局域的贝里曲率；经扭转重构后，即可形成孤立的拓扑微带，而无需谷自由度或六角对称性。我们在具有四方Dresselhaus自旋-轨道耦合的HgI2中展示了这一机制，其中类Lieb莫尔势产生拓扑平带。为提高微带的孤立程度，我们开发了一种物理信息驱动的机器学习代理模型，识别出更强的自旋-轨道耦合是关键设计原则，并据此指导以Pb替代Hg。所得PbI2微带更窄且孤立性更好，能够支持关联驱动磁性以及可调控的量子自旋霍尔相和陈绝缘相，从而为实验探索提供了一种优化的材料实现。

articles.title: Controlling topology in flux-mismatched Hofstadter bilayers
articles.title_zh: 磁通失配霍夫施塔特双层体系中的拓扑调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stacked two-dimensional materials provide a promising platform for electrically controlling topological electronic states. However, tunneling between layers hybridizes their bands and removes the crossings needed to change topology. We show that this does not always have to be the case. Band crossings and associated Weyl points are topologically enforced in Hofstadter bilayers whose layers experience different magnetic fluxes. When resonant magnetic Bloch multiplets carry unequal Chern numbers, their projected tunneling is topologically obstructed and must vanish at isolated momenta. Sweeping the layer bias through these zeros creates synthetic Weyl monopoles in momentum-bias space that transfer the Chern mismatch. We demonstrate two consequences: a direct transition between insulating Chern phases and a reentrant compensated metal in which Lifshitz transitions bound the metallic window while internal Weyl events reconstruct the band topology. Consequently, the fixed-filling Hall response remains continuous and nonquantized even as integer Chern number is transferred between bands. Berry-flux, TKNN, and interface calculations independently verify the mechanism and its multichannel chiral signature. We outline realizations in Moire and anomalous-Hall heterostructures, establishing flux mismatch as an experimentally accessible route to electrically programmable Chern phases and chiral transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究两层承受不同磁通的霍夫施塔特双层体系，指出当共振磁布洛赫多重态具有不等陈数时，层间投影隧穿在孤立动量点处会因拓扑阻碍而必须消失。扫过这些零点的层间偏压会在动量-偏压空间中形成合成外尔单极子，并转移陈数失配。该机制可实现绝缘陈相之间的直接转变，以及由Lifshitz转变和内部外尔事件共同限定的再入补偿金属态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 堆叠二维材料为电学调控拓扑电子态提供了很有前景的平台。然而，层间隧穿会使能带杂化，并消除改变拓扑所需的交叉点。我们表明，情况并不总是如此。在两层经历不同磁通的霍夫施塔特双层体系中，能带交叉及其相关的外尔点受到拓扑强制保护。当共振磁布洛赫多重态携带不相等的陈数时，它们的投影隧穿受到拓扑阻碍，并且必须在孤立动量点处消失。将层间偏压扫过这些零点，会在动量-偏压空间中产生合成外尔单极子，从而转移陈数失配。我们展示了两个结果：绝缘陈相之间的直接转变，以及一种再入补偿金属，其中Lifshitz转变限定金属窗口，而内部外尔事件重构能带拓扑。因此，即使整数陈数在能带间发生转移，固定填充下的霍尔响应仍保持连续且不量子化。贝里通量、TKNN以及界面计算相互独立地验证了这一机制及其多通道手征特征。我们概述了其在莫尔和反常霍尔异质结构中的实现方案，确立了磁通失配作为通向可电学编程陈相和手征输运的实验可及路径。

articles.title: Competing Interlayer Loop Currents and Superconductivity in the Bilayer t-J_perp-V Model
articles.title_zh: 双层t-J_perp-V模型中的层间环流与超导竞争
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent discovery of high-T_c superconductivity in pressurized and thin-film bilayer nickelates, featuring a strong interlayer exchange coupling, and their potential similarities with cuprate superconductors, has made this a very active topic in condensed matter physics. In the present paper we study the strongly correlated one-orbital (dₓ^₂₋y^₂) bilayer t-J_perp-V model for nickelates, where V denotes the Coulomb interactions, using a controlled large-N expansion at and beyond the mean-field level. Focusing on the out-of-plane spin exchange interaction (J_perp), we find that it triggers both out-of-plane s-wave superconductivity and an out-of-plane bond-order phase (z-BOP) instability. The z-BOP gives rise to a complex z-axis hopping dominated by its imaginary component, which drives out-of-plane currents and induces in-plane ones, spontaneously forming on the vertical plaquettes a loop-current state that breaks time-reversal symmetry. Competition between this loop-current phase and superconductivity yields a dome-shaped superconducting region, with optimal superconductivity occurring near the z-BOP quantum critical point. The resulting phase diagram features a pure loop-current region, a low-doping coexistence phase, a pure superconducting state at higher doping, and a correlated metallic state.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对具有强层间交换耦合的双层镍酸盐，本文利用受控的大N展开研究强关联单轨道双层t-J_perp-V模型。面外自旋交换J_perp同时触发面外s波超导和面外键序z-BOP不稳定性；后者通过以虚部为主的复数z轴跳跃形成破坏时间反演对称性的环流态。环流与超导的竞争形成圆顶状超导区域，最优超导位于z-BOP量子临界点附近。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期在加压和薄膜双层镍酸盐中发现的高温超导，以及这些材料所具有的强层间交换耦合和它们与铜酸盐超导体的潜在相似性，使其成为凝聚态物理中极为活跃的研究主题。本文采用在平均场层次及其以上均受控的大N展开，研究用于描述镍酸盐的强关联单轨道（dₓ²-y²）双层t-J_perp-V模型，其中V表示库仑相互作用。我们聚焦于面外自旋交换相互作用J_perp，发现它同时触发面外s波超导和面外键序相（z-BOP）不稳定性。z-BOP产生以虚部为主的复数z轴跳跃，从而驱动面外电流并诱导面内电流，自发地在垂直晶格面上形成破坏时间反演对称性的环流态。该环流相与超导之间的竞争产生了圆顶状超导区域，其中最优超导出现在z-BOP量子临界点附近。所得相图包含纯环流区域、低掺杂共存相、较高掺杂下的纯超导态以及关联金属态。

articles.title: Hyperspin Ferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 超自旋铁磁体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10930v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The behavior of spin quantum in k-space is key to identifying altermagnets (AMs) as the third kind of fundamental collinear magnetism. In contrast, non-collinear magnets,though abundant in nature,lack well-defined spin quantum numbers, and the resulting spin textures are often highly complex, which limits their potential for next-generation spintronic applications. Here we propose hyperspin, which lives in a higher-dimensional space, to address these drawbacks. Through analyzing the commutation relations between spin and Hamiltonian for a class of non-collinear magnets, we reveal it is a hyperspin, rather than the usual spin, that commutes with Hamiltonian. Unexpectedly, these non-collinear magnets should also show collinear spin-split bands in k-space like collinear AMs. We therefore classify such non-collinear magnets as hyperspin altermagnets (HAMs), as opposed to the usual collinear AMs. Our theory elucidates the fundamental physics of AMs and HAMs and provides a framework for exploring the wide range of non-collinear magnets that may possess other kinds of conserved quantities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出存在于高维空间中的“超自旋”概念，用以描述一类非共线磁体中守恒的自旋相关量。作者通过分析自旋与哈密顿量的对易关系指出，在这类体系中与哈密顿量对易的是超自旋而非通常自旋，因此其动量空间中也应出现类似共线交错磁体的共线自旋劈裂能带。文章据此将该类非共线磁体定义为超自旋交错磁体，并为寻找具有其他守恒量的非共线磁体提供理论框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 动量空间中自旋量子的行为是将交错磁体识别为第三类基本共线磁性的关键。相比之下，尽管非共线磁体在自然界中十分丰富，但它们缺乏定义良好的自旋量子数，且由此产生的自旋纹理往往高度复杂，这限制了其在下一代自旋电子学应用中的潜力。本文提出了存在于更高维空间中的超自旋，以解决这些缺点。通过分析一类非共线磁体中自旋与哈密顿量之间的对易关系，我们揭示与哈密顿量对易的是超自旋而非通常的自旋。出乎意料的是，这些非共线磁体也应当像共线交错磁体一样，在动量空间中表现出共线自旋劈裂能带。因此，我们将这类非共线磁体归类为超自旋交错磁体，以区别于通常的共线交错磁体。我们的理论阐明了交错磁体和超自旋交错磁体的基本物理，并为探索可能拥有其他类型守恒量的大量非共线磁体提供了框架。

articles.title: Emergence of spin-orbit coupling among spin, atomic orbital, and Bloch dynamics in Janus double-transition-metal MXenes
articles.title_zh: Janus双过渡金属MXene中自旋、原子轨道与布洛赫动力学之间自旋-轨道耦合的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We found a spin-orbit coupling to cause a simultaneous correlation among three degrees of freedom, the electronic spin, orbital, and Bloch dynamics in an investigation into the electronic structure of Janus double-transition-metal MXenes, Mo₂HfC₂OS and W₂HfC₂OS. In this paper, it is also revealed that the spin-orbit coupling causes a staggered spin configuration with a trigonal pattern around the Γ point near the insulating gap. We developed a reduced Hamiltonian describing the electronic states and show that the spin-orbit coupling cannot be equated with conventional forms for a single electron in solids, LS, Rashba, and Dresselhaus couplings, even in the approximation under the low-energy and small wave number condition. Because of the intrinsic shape of the conduction band, a trigonally alternating spin-momentum locking emerges with the spin axis perpendicular to the layer plane. The theoretical analysis shows that these Janus materials can provide a platform for exploring the spin-related phenomena due to the trigonal spin-momentum locking other than Rashba and Dresselhaus types.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究Janus双过渡金属MXene Mo2HfC2OS和W2HfC2OS，发现一种使电子自旋、轨道与布洛赫动力学同时关联的自旋-轨道耦合。该耦合在绝缘能隙附近的Gamma点周围产生三角形交错自旋构型和面外自旋轴的三角交替自旋-动量锁定。低能小波矢近似下，这种耦合仍不能归约为传统LS、Rashba或Dresselhaus耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在研究Janus双过渡金属MXene Mo2HfC2OS和W2HfC2OS的电子结构时，发现了一种自旋-轨道耦合，它会使电子自旋、轨道和布洛赫动力学这三种自由度同时发生关联。本文还揭示，该自旋-轨道耦合会在绝缘能隙附近的Gamma点周围引起具有三角形图样的交错自旋构型。我们构建了描述电子态的约化哈密顿量，并表明即使在低能量和小波数近似下，这种自旋-轨道耦合也不能等同于固体中单电子的传统形式，即LS、Rashba和Dresselhaus耦合。由于导带的内禀形状，出现了三角交替的自旋-动量锁定，其自旋轴垂直于层平面。理论分析表明，这些Janus材料可为探索不同于Rashba和Dresselhaus类型的、由三角自旋-动量锁定引起的自旋相关现象提供平台。

articles.title: Measuring chiral phonons
articles.title_zh: 手性声子的测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10973v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral phonons are quantized vibrations where the atomic motion in a solid breaks improper rotation symmetries. In many cases, chiral phonons possess angular momenta and are therefore selective to circularly polarized light. Both fundamental and applied research efforts on chiral phonons have been gaining increasing attention owing to their importance in a variety of fields including spintronics, spin-selective chemical reactions, thermal transport, quantum information processing and biosensing, where the bi-directional spin-lattice coupling enabled by chiral phonons can be harnessed in new ways, and potentially lead to new functionalities. Thus far, the studies of chiral phonons across diverse materials platforms have evolved largely independently within these fields, but the experimental techniques are often interrelated. In this perspective, we present a detailed description, as well as advantages and disadvantages of the current approaches for experimentally measuring chiral phonons in chiral and achiral materials. We conclude with a discussion of new methods for measuring chiral phonons. Ultimately, this work seeks to offer an experimental guide for systematically investigating the properties of chiral phonons in various materials systems and applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性声子是固体中原子运动破坏非正旋转对称性的量子化振动，通常具有角动量并对圆偏振光表现出选择性。本文作为一篇观点文章，系统介绍在手性与非手性材料中实验测量手性声子的现有方法，并比较其优点和局限。文章还讨论新的测量方案，旨在为不同材料体系和应用中的手性声子研究提供实验指南。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性声子是量子化振动，其中固体中的原子运动破坏非正旋转对称性。在许多情况下，手性声子具有角动量，因此会选择性地响应圆偏振光。由于手性声子在自旋电子学、自旋选择性化学反应、热输运、量子信息处理和生物传感等多个领域中的重要性，针对手性声子的基础和应用研究正日益受到关注；在这些领域中，可通过手性声子实现的双向自旋-晶格耦合能够以新的方式加以利用，并有望带来新的功能。迄今为止，各领域针对不同材料平台中手性声子的研究大多独立发展，但实验技术之间往往彼此关联。在这篇观点文章中，我们详细介绍了目前在手性和非手性材料中实验测量手性声子的各种方法，以及这些方法的优点和缺点。最后，我们讨论了测量手性声子的新方法。归根结底，本工作旨在为系统研究各种材料体系和应用中的手性声子性质提供实验指南。

articles.title: Silicon Solar Cell Design for >30% Efficiency via Singlet Fission
articles.title_zh: 通过单重态裂分实现效率超过30%的硅太阳能电池设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10979v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Singlet fission (SF) materials convert high-energy photons into multiple charge carriers, providing a route to exceed the efficiency limits of single-junction silicon solar cells without many of the complexities of multi-junction tandem designs. Following the first demonstration of an SF-enhanced silicon solar cell in 2025, there is a need to understand how SF materials can be effectively integrated into high-efficiency industrial silicon devices and translated from proof of concept to a manufacturable technology. Using coupled optical and electrical simulations, we assess the efficiency potential of several industrially relevant silicon cell architectures combined with SF materials. Interdigitated back-contact (IBC) cells offer the greatest potential for improvement due to unrestricted front-surface access and can achieve efficiencies exceeding 33%. However, performance is highly sensitive to front-surface passivation quality. Appropriate silicon design, particularly controlled surface doping and fixed interfacial charge, can mitigate recombination losses and relax passivation requirements for ultra-thin exciton-transfer layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 单重态裂分材料可将高能光子转化为多个电荷载流子，为超越单结硅太阳能电池效率极限提供路径。本文通过耦合光学和电学模拟，评估多种工业相关硅电池架构与单重态裂分材料结合后的效率潜力，发现叉指式背接触电池可超过33%。不过，器件性能对前表面钝化质量高度敏感；通过控制表面掺杂和固定界面电荷可降低复合损失，并放宽超薄激子转移层对钝化的要求。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单重态裂分材料可将高能光子转化为多个电荷载流子，从而提供一条超越单结硅太阳能电池效率极限的途径，同时避免多结串联设计中的许多复杂性。在2025年首次演示单重态裂分增强型硅太阳能电池之后，人们需要理解如何将单重态裂分材料有效整合进高效率工业硅器件，并将其从概念验证转化为可制造技术。我们利用耦合光学和电学模拟，评估了若干种具有工业相关性的硅电池架构与单重态裂分材料结合时的效率潜力。叉指式背接触电池由于前表面可无障碍利用，具有最大的改进潜力，且效率可超过33%。然而，性能对前表面钝化质量高度敏感。恰当的硅器件设计，尤其是受控的表面掺杂和固定界面电荷，可缓解复合损失，并降低超薄激子转移层对钝化性能的要求。

articles.title: A substrate booster for P-type 2D ferromagnetic semiconductor
articles.title_zh: 用于p型二维铁磁半导体的衬底增强方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin transistors with its both charge and spin properties tuned via electrostatic gating are believed capable for widespread use, which however have proven challenging due to the extreme rareness of their physical base -- magnetic semiconductors. The latter are limited within very few systems including diluted magnetic semiconductors (DMS) and two-dimensional ferromagnetic semiconductors (2D-FMS), and known to suffer from inadequate gate-tunability of their electric and/or magnetic properties. Here, we show a substrate engineering paradigm by interfacing few-layered Cr₂Ge₂Te₆ (FL-CGT) with an antiferromagnetic insulator CrOCl. Owing to the subtle interfacial charge transfer couplings, CGT can be drastically turned from an ambipolar semiconductor into a high performance P-type semiconductor. When cooled below the Curie temperature, the ON-OFF ratio in such substrate-boosted FMS field-effect transistor (FET) reaches 10⁵ with its coercive field Hc of magnetic hysteresis loop tunable by a factor of more than 200%, enabling {gate-assisted magnetic switching in the prototype semiconducting spin transistor architecture}. A crossover from critical power-law scaling to a dual power-law behaviour under heavy hole doping was further observed. Our findings signify an efficient interfacial charge transfer and electrically modulated magnetic anisotropy energy supported by calculations. This high performance P-type FMS-FET system suggests that active substrate-boosting paradigm might be a powerful path for the investigation of future gate-tunable spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过将少层Cr2Ge2Te6与反铁磁绝缘体CrOCl构建界面，提出一种衬底工程方案，将前者从双极性半导体显著转变为高性能p型半导体。低于居里温度时，该衬底增强型铁磁半导体场效应晶体管的开关比可达10⁵，磁滞回线的矫顽场可被栅压调节超过200%，从而支持栅辅助磁开关。实验还观察到重空穴掺杂下从临界幂律标度到双幂律行为的交叉，计算结果支持界面电荷转移和电调磁各向异性能的解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 同时具有可由静电栅压调节的电荷和自旋性质的自旋晶体管，被认为有望得到广泛应用；然而，由于其物理基础，即磁性半导体，极为稀缺，这一目标一直难以实现。磁性半导体仅限于少数体系，包括稀磁半导体和二维铁磁半导体，并且已知其电学和或磁学性质的栅压可调性不足。本文展示了一种衬底工程范式：将少层Cr2Ge2Te6与反铁磁绝缘体CrOCl构建界面。由于微妙的界面电荷转移耦合，CGT可从双极性半导体显著转变为高性能p型半导体。当冷却至居里温度以下时，这种衬底增强型铁磁半导体场效应晶体管的开关比达到10⁵，其磁滞回线的矫顽场Hc可调节超过200%，从而在原型半导体自旋晶体管架构中实现栅辅助磁开关。在重空穴掺杂下，进一步观察到从临界幂律标度向双幂律行为的交叉。我们的发现表明，计算结果支持高效的界面电荷转移和电学调制的磁各向异性能。这一高性能p型铁磁半导体场效应晶体管系统表明，主动衬底增强范式可能是研究未来栅压可调自旋电子器件的一条有力途径。

articles.title: In-plane magnetic field control of anomalous Hall response enabled by magnetic anisotropy engineering
articles.title_zh: 由磁各向异性工程实现的面内磁场反常霍尔响应调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Engineering magnetic anisotropy provides a powerful route to control magnetization orientation and unlock emerging functionalities in opto-spintronic and current-driven devices. Beyond its role in magnetization reversal, the effective anisotropy can strongly influence the magnetotransport response, offering an additional degree of freedom to tune new device functionalities. In this work, we report a magnetotransport study of a ferrimagnetic [Tb/Co]× ₅ multilayer grown with a Tb thickness gradient, whose wedge-shaped tilts the uniaxial anisotropy axis slightly away from the film normal. Anomalous Hall resistivity measurements from 80 K to 300 K reveal a spin reorientation transition, while the angular dependence of the magnetotransport responses exposes the crucial role of the tilted anisotropy. A simplified macrospin model reproduces the full angular response across the transition and shows that the observed anomalous Hall effect when the in-plane magnetic field is applied originates from the tilt of the uniaxial anisotropy axis, which supplies a built-in symmetry-breaking mechanism, enabling in-plane field control over the out-of-plane anomalous Hall response, sign included. These findings establish tilted magnetic anisotropy as a promising route toward Hall effect-based sensor applications and highlight Tb/Co multilayers as a versatile platform for anisotropy-engineered spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有Tb厚度梯度的[Tb/Co]×5亚铁磁多层膜，其中楔形结构使单轴各向异性轴略微偏离薄膜法线。80至300 K的反常霍尔电阻率测量揭示了自旋重取向转变，角度依赖输运响应则表明倾斜各向异性至关重要。宏自旋模型说明，面内磁场下出现的反常霍尔效应源自倾斜单轴各向异性提供的内建对称性破缺，可调控面外霍尔响应及其符号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁各向异性工程为调控磁化取向并释放光自旋电子和电流驱动器件中的新兴功能提供了有力途径。除在磁化反转中的作用外，有效各向异性还可强烈影响磁输运响应，为调节新型器件功能提供额外自由度。本文报道了对一种亚铁磁[Tb/Co]×5多层膜的磁输运研究，该薄膜具有Tb厚度梯度，其楔形结构使单轴各向异性轴略微偏离薄膜法线方向。在80 K至300 K范围内的反常霍尔电阻率测量揭示了自旋重取向转变，而磁输运响应的角度依赖性则显示出倾斜各向异性的关键作用。一个简化的宏自旋模型再现了跨越该转变的完整角度响应，并表明，在施加面内磁场时观察到的反常霍尔效应源于单轴各向异性轴的倾斜；这种倾斜提供了内建的对称性破缺机制，从而能够利用面内磁场调控面外反常霍尔响应，包括其符号。这些发现确立了倾斜磁各向异性作为面向霍尔效应传感器应用的一条有前景路径，并突出了Tb/Co多层膜作为磁各向异性工程自旋电子器件通用平台的价值。

articles.title: Slow Dynamics and the Geometry of Jammed Packings
articles.title_zh: 缓慢动力学与堵塞堆积的几何结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Saddle points in the energy landscape of granular packings dominate the discrete steepest descent dynamics and ultimately determine the path that an out of mechanical equilibrium packing will follow and the resulting stable minimum that it will find. The saddle points that ultimately determine the resulting minima tend to be low-index saddle points. For models with an analytic energy landscape, such as the p-spin model, the steepest descent minimization path is affected by higher-index saddle points, which pull the system towards saddle points of decreasing index before arriving at the minima. Here, we examine the steepest descent minimization path of granular packings and compare them to the p-spin model. We show that the granular packing steepest descent minimization paths act like their smooth energy landscape counterparts and get attracted by saddle points. The index versus time curves for all models follow a shifted, stretched exponential. We further show that the shape parameter for the granular packings is unchanged when the energy landscape is modified to become analytic (Gaussian potential in a harmonic well) or non-local (Mari-Krzakala-Kurchan). The p-spin, on the other hand, has a significantly larger shape parameter. The reason is not due to the dimensionality, packing fraction, nonanalyticity, or the locality of the Hamiltonian of the models. The exact reason for the discrepancy in the shape parameter is ststill an unsolved mystery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较颗粒堆积与p-spin模型的最陡下降最小化路径，研究能量景观中鞍点对缓慢动力学的影响。结果表明，颗粒堆积的路径同样会被鞍点吸引，所有模型的鞍点指数-时间曲线均遵循平移的拉伸指数形式。颗粒堆积的形状参数不受能量景观解析性或非局域性的改变影响，但p-spin模型的该参数显著更大，且差异的确切原因仍未解决。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 颗粒堆积能量景观中的鞍点主导离散最陡下降动力学，并最终决定一个处于力学非平衡状态的堆积将遵循的路径以及它将找到的稳定极小值。最终决定所得极小值的鞍点往往是低指标鞍点。对于具有解析能量景观的模型，例如p-spin模型，最陡下降最小化路径会受到更高指标鞍点的影响；这些鞍点先将系统拉向指标逐渐降低的鞍点，之后系统才到达极小值。本文考察了颗粒堆积的最陡下降最小化路径，并将其与p-spin模型进行比较。我们表明，颗粒堆积的最陡下降最小化路径与其光滑能量景观对应物类似，都会受到鞍点吸引。所有模型的鞍点指标随时间变化曲线均遵循一种平移的拉伸指数形式。我们进一步表明，当能量景观被修改为解析形式，即谐势阱中的高斯势，或被修改为非局域形式，即Mari-Krzakala-Kurchan模型时，颗粒堆积的形状参数并不改变。相较之下，p-spin模型具有显著更大的形状参数。其原因并非模型的维度、堆积密度、非解析性或哈密顿量的局域性所致。形状参数出现这一差异的确切原因至今仍是未解之谜。

articles.title: Fingerprints of Excitonic Collective Modes in the Two-Dimensional Electron Gas
articles.title_zh: 二维电子气中激子集体模的指纹特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The two-dimensional homogeneous electron gas (2D HEG) is a prototype system of fundamental interest that can be realized experimentally over a wide range of densities. Here, we investigate its collective charge excitations at low densities, using time-dependent density functional theory. We demonstrate that, beyond traditional plasmons, new collective excitonic modes emerge for a Wigner-Seitz radius larger than rₘₐₜₕᵣₘ ₛ approx 1. These excitonic modes leave characteristic fingerprints in experimentally accessible quantities, namely, asymmetric peak structures in the loss function and very strong Friedel-like oscillations in the static linear density response that increase when the system approaches a regime of instability. Indeed, at low enough densities the collective modes cross the zero energy axis, indicating an instability of the paramagnetic 2D HEG towards the formation of a charge-density-wave phase with excitonic origin. These findings provide valuable insights for the experimental detection of excitonic collective modes in tunable 2D electron systems and contribute to the fundamental understanding of many-body effects in low-density electron gases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用时间依赖密度泛函理论研究低密度二维均匀电子气的集体电荷激发，发现除传统等离激元外，当Wigner-Seitz半径大于约1时会出现新的集体激子模。这些模式在损失函数中产生非对称峰结构，并在静态线性密度响应中形成强烈且随不稳定性临近而增强的类Friedel振荡。足够低的密度下，集体模穿越零能量轴，表明顺磁二维电子气可能发生具有激子起源的电荷密度波不稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维均匀电子气是一个具有基础研究意义的原型体系，并且可在很宽的密度范围内通过实验实现。本文采用时间依赖密度泛函理论，研究其在低密度下的集体电荷激发。我们证明，除传统等离激元之外，当Wigner-Seitz半径大于约1时，会出现新的集体激子模。这些激子模在实验可及的量中留下特征性指纹，即损失函数中的非对称峰结构，以及静态线性密度响应中极强的类Friedel振荡；当系统接近不稳定区域时，这些振荡会增强。实际上，在足够低的密度下，集体模会穿越零能量轴，这表明顺磁二维均匀电子气对于形成具有激子起源的电荷密度波相是不稳定的。这些发现为在可调二维电子系统中实验探测激子集体模提供了有价值的见解，并有助于从根本上理解低密度电子气中的多体效应。

articles.title: Interplay of spin-lattice and electronic coupling far above Neel ordering in 2D antiferromagnetic CrPS4 and its interface manifestation
articles.title_zh: 二维反铁磁体CrPS4中远高于奈尔有序温度的自旋-晶格与电子耦合及其界面表现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A short-range spin correlation driven, strongly intercoupled spin-phonon-electronic state far above TN (~38K) is identified in the low dimensional van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS4. Temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy reveals spin-phonon coupling persisting up to T*~120K, concomitant with local lattice distortion. The setting of vibronic progression in photoluminescence spectra suggests the strengthening of electron-phonon coupling around T*. Furthermore, both the electrical transport and optoelectronic response also change significantly at T*. The results indicate that spin-phonon coupling above TN in CrPS4 originates from local lattice distortion induced by short range magnetic correlations which in turn enhances the electron-phonon interaction.
