We present a low-complexity bidirectional digital interconnect that enables simultaneous transmission and reception of baseband logic signals over a single coaxial cable. The circuit combines a discrete passive resistive hybrid providing line termination and directional separation, a single logic gate as line driver, and a commercial differential receiver used as a comparator. No modulation, transformer coupling, adaptive calibration, or active analog or digital echo cancellation is required. The design target is full-duplex operation at 200 MBit/s over 10 m of standard RG-178 cable. An analytical treatment of the hybrid network determines the system parameter that maximizes the differential signal amplitude at the receiver, while circuit simulations predict the deterministic timing errors resulting from imperfect directional separation. Experimental measurements confirm the predicted deterministic jitter and show good agreement with the simulation results. For typical laboratory coaxial cables up to 10 m, the measured peak-to-peak edge timing error remains below 1.2 ns. A bidirectional transmission experiment with randomized data demonstrates a clearly open eye diagram. It was found that the transceiver inherently provides loopback functionality when the transmission line is left open. The proposed approach provides a simple, protocol-independent bidirectional physical link which may be useful in laboratory instrumentation where cable routing is constrained.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种低复杂度双向数字互连，可在单根同轴电缆上同时传输和接收基带逻辑信号。电路由离散无源电阻式混合器、单个逻辑门线路驱动器和商用差分接收器组成，无需调制、变压器耦合、自适应校准或有源模拟/数字回波消除。针对10米标准RG-178电缆的200 Mbit/s全双工目标，实验测得边沿定时误差低于1.2纳秒，并观察到清晰张开的眼图和线路开路时固有的环回功能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代全双工通信系统（例如千兆以太网）能够在具有挑战性的传输介质上实现高数据率，但需要复杂的电路和不简单的数字接口。对于实验室仪器而言，目标可能是在短距离、受控良好的同轴电缆上实现中等带宽的全双工通信，同时尽量降低电路和接口复杂度。本文提出一种低复杂度双向数字互连，可在单根同轴电缆上同时传输和接收基带逻辑信号。该电路结合了一个用于线路端接和方向分离的离散无源电阻式混合器、一个作为线路驱动器的单逻辑门，以及一个作为比较器使用的商用差分接收器。该方案无需调制、变压器耦合、自适应校准，也无需有源模拟或数字回波消除。设计目标是在10米标准RG-178电缆上实现200 Mbit/s全双工运行。对混合网络的解析处理确定了能够最大化接收器差分信号幅度的系统参数，而电路仿真预测了由不完善的方向分离产生的确定性定时误差。实验测量证实了预测的确定性抖动，并显示出与仿真结果的良好一致性。对于长度不超过10米的典型实验室同轴电缆，实测峰峰值边沿定时误差保持在1.2纳秒以下。采用随机数据进行的双向传输实验显示出清晰张开的眼图。研究还发现，当传输线处于开路状态时，收发器会自然提供环回功能。所提出的方法是一种简单、与协议无关的双向物理链路，可用于电缆布线受到限制的实验室仪器。

articles.title: Intensity-guided pose-free multiview fusion for single photon sensing
articles.title_zh: 面向单光子传感的强度引导无位姿多视角融合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.25666v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Single-photon light detection and ranging (LiDAR) extends active three-dimensional sensing at the fundamental level and has found applications in extreme environments involving long-range operation, low-reflectance targets, and adverse visibility. However, the acquired measurements often give rise to single-photon point clouds that are sparse, spatially non-uniform, and corrupted by outliers and depth distortions, making multi-view registration challenging especially when sensor poses are not accurately known. In this work, we present a geometry-intensity coupled registration framework (GIC-Reg) of pose-free multi-view fusion for single-photon sensing. It is established by combining physical-aware preprocessing, joint geometry-intensity grid feature aggregation, global matching, and local ambiguity disambiguation to estimate inter-view rigid transformations and hence to construct a globally consistent reconstruction. On the synthetic benchmark, it admits the lowest relative rotation error (RRE), relative translation error, and root mean square error across all background-noise and dropout rates, in comparison to baselines. Notably, under the most degraded dropout, it reduces the RRE from 13.167^circ to 8.459^circ compared with the learning-based baseline. Furthermore, experimental results on real multi-view data acquired at about 80~m show that it achieves more reliable global orientation and local alignment. Our results show that photon intensity provides an effective physical cue for stabilizing multiview registration in single-photon point cloud, and thus our work aids significant progress in exploring practical utility of single-photon sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 单光子激光雷达能够在长距离、低反射率目标和恶劣能见度环境下实现主动三维感知，但所得点云通常稀疏、空间分布不均匀，并受到离群点和深度畸变影响。本文提出几何–强度耦合的无位姿多视角融合配准框架GIC-Reg，通过物理感知预处理、联合几何–强度网格特征聚合、全局匹配和局部歧义消除来估计视角间刚体变换。在合成数据集上，该方法在各种背景噪声和丢失率下均取得最低的相对旋转误差、相对平移误差和均方根误差；在最严重的丢失条件下，相对旋转误差由学习型基线的13.167度降至8.459度。真实约80米多视角数据实验也表明，该方法能够获得更可靠的全局方向和局部对齐结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单光子光探测与测距（LiDAR）从根本上扩展了主动三维感知能力，并已应用于长距离工作、低反射率目标和能见度不佳等极端环境。然而，所获取的测量结果通常形成稀疏、空间分布不均匀且受到离群点和深度畸变污染的单光子点云，这使得多视角配准变得困难，尤其是在传感器位姿不准确已知的情况下。本文提出一种用于单光子传感无位姿多视角融合的几何–强度耦合配准框架（GIC-Reg）。该框架结合物理感知预处理、联合几何–强度网格特征聚合、全局匹配和局部歧义消除，以估计视角之间的刚体变换，进而构建全局一致的重建结果。在合成基准数据集上，与基线方法相比，该方法在所有背景噪声和数据丢失率下均取得最低的相对旋转误差（RRE）、相对平移误差和均方根误差。特别是在最严重的数据丢失条件下，与基于学习的基线相比，该方法将RRE从13.167度降低至8.459度。此外，在约80米处采集的真实多视角数据上，实验结果表明该方法能够实现更可靠的全局方向估计和局部对齐。研究结果表明，光子强度提供了一种有效的物理线索，可以稳定单光子点云的多视角配准，从而推动单光子传感实际应用的进一步探索。

articles.title: Amplification of Weak Forces via Parametric Interactions and Non-Markovian Effects in Cavity Optomechanics
articles.title_zh: 腔光机学中通过参量相互作用与非马尔可夫效应放大弱力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.17810v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Weak force amplification describes the process of amplifying a faint low-frequency signal by means of an additional high-frequency modulation, which plays a vital role in quantum sensing and high-precision measurement. However, the potential enhancement of weak-force amplification in non-Markovian environments has received little attention. In this paper, we firstly study the amplification of weak forces within cavity-optomechanical systems incorporating a degenerate optical parametric amplifier (DOPA) under the Markovian assumption. The results show that the weak force can be effectively amplified by using two high-frequency signals via vibrational resonance through adjusting the strength and phase of the DOPA with different pumping frequencies. Moreover, we extend the study of the amplification of the weak force to the non-Markovian environment which consists of a collection of infinite oscillators. We illustrate that the amplification exhibits a conversion from the non-Markovian regime to Markovian regime by controlling environmental spectral width. This conversion leads to enhancements of amplification, which originates from the excitation backflow obtained through the interaction between the cavity and non-Markovian environment. By controlling DOPA to amplify weak forces, the study achieves amplification in the non-Markovian regime, offering new directions for quantum optics research.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了腔光机系统中弱力的放大，并考虑了简并光学参量放大器和非马尔可夫环境的影响。在马尔可夫假设下，通过调节参量放大器的强度和相位以及泵浦频率，两个高频信号可借助振动共振有效放大弱力。进一步研究表明，通过控制环境谱宽，可以实现从非马尔可夫到马尔可夫状态的转换；由腔与非马尔可夫环境相互作用产生的激发回流能够增强放大效果，为量子光学中的弱力探测提供新的方向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 弱力放大是利用额外的高频调制来放大微弱低频信号的过程，在量子传感和高精度测量中发挥着重要作用。然而，非马尔可夫环境对弱力放大可能产生的增强作用仍鲜有研究。本文首先在马尔可夫假设下，研究包含简并光学参量放大器（DOPA）的腔光机系统中的弱力放大。结果表明，通过调节DOPA的强度和相位，并配合不同的泵浦频率，可以利用振动共振借助两个高频信号有效放大弱力。随后，作者将弱力放大的研究扩展到由无穷多个振子组成的非马尔可夫环境。研究表明，通过控制环境的谱宽，放大过程会发生从非马尔可夫状态到马尔可夫状态的转换。这种转换能够增强放大效果，其原因是腔与非马尔可夫环境相互作用产生了激发回流。通过控制DOPA来放大弱力，该研究实现了非马尔可夫状态下的放大，为量子光学研究提供了新的方向。

articles.title: Near-frustration-free electronic structure Hamiltonian representations and lower bound certificates
articles.title_zh: 近无挫折自由电子结构哈密顿量表示与下界证书
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.05069v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hamiltonian representations based on the sum-of-squares (SOS) hierarchy provide rigorous lower bounds on ground-state energies and facilitate the design of efficient classical and quantum simulation algorithms. This work presents a unified framework connecting SOS decompositions with variational two-particle reduced density matrix (v2RDM) theory. We demonstrate that the ``weighted'' SOS ansatz naturally recovers the dual of the v2RDM program, enabling the strict enforcement of symmetry constraints such as particle number and spin. We provide explicit SOS constructions for the Hubbard model and electronic structure Hamiltonians, ranging from spin-free approximations to full rank-2 expansions. We also highlight theoretical connections to block-invariant symmetry shifts. Numerical benchmarks on molecular systems and Iron-Sulfur clusters validate these near frustration-free representations, demonstrating their utility in improving spectral gap amplification and reducing block encoding costs in quantum algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了平方和（SOS）分解与变分二粒子约化密度矩阵理论之间的统一框架，并表明加权SOS Ansatz能够自然恢复v2RDM程序的对偶形式，同时严格施加粒子数和自旋等对称性约束。作者为Hubbard模型和电子结构哈密顿量给出了从无自旋近似到完整秩二展开的显式SOS构造，并讨论其与块不变对称性平移的理论联系。分子体系和铁硫簇的数值基准表明，这些近无挫折自由表示有助于改善谱隙放大并降低量子算法中的块编码成本。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于平方和（SOS）层级的哈密顿量表示能够为基态能量提供严格的下界，并有助于设计高效的经典和量子模拟算法。本文提出一个统一框架，将SOS分解与变分二粒子约化密度矩阵（v2RDM）理论联系起来。作者证明，加权SOS Ansatz能够自然地恢复v2RDM程序的对偶形式，从而严格施加粒子数和自旋等对称性约束。本文为Hubbard模型和电子结构哈密顿量给出了显式的SOS构造，范围从无自旋近似到完整的秩二展开。作者还强调了这些构造与块不变对称性平移之间的理论联系。针对分子体系和铁硫簇的数值基准验证了这些近无挫折自由表示的有效性，表明它们能够改善谱隙放大，并降低量子算法中的块编码成本。

articles.title: Topological Necessities: Mechanism-Invariant Strategic Subgoals for Cross-Embodiment Goal-Conditioned Control
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon goal-conditioned reinforcement learning delegates control to a high-level module that proposes subgoals, but existing subgoals are implicit byproducts of value functions or latent actions, tied to the executor that produced them. We study a different object: a route-conditioned order of unavoidable stages that every successful executor must traverse, recoverable from offline trajectories and belonging to none of them. Its defining properties are topological: an unskippable stage is a separating set that every admissible path must cross, and a loop in free space forces a route choice. We read the two by homology in dimensions 0 and 1 over a transport-weighted carrier built from successful trajectories, yielding an enumerable gate set with shell-level certificates; the certified gates are what we call topological necessities. Certified gates enter the decision loop as a recursive topological gate hierarchy. Under a fixed, isomorphic free space, the object survives executor replacement: gates frozen on PointMaze data transfer without retraining to Ant and Humanoid, attaining the highest Humanoid aggregate under a unified interface (96.1), with +36.0 over a map-privileged reference on the multi-route task (p=1.4e-5); the planner saturates PointMaze (100+/-0) and matches or exceeds the strongest baselines on AntMaze (giant +22.9) and Kitchen (+15.8/+12.6).

articles.title: EMMI: Edge Multi-Modal Intelligence for Communication-Efficient MLLM Inference via Fused Representation Compression
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11058v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language mod- els (MLLMs) have opened new opportunities for edge intelligence by enabling reasoning across heterogeneous sensor modalities, such as vision, text, and telemetry data. However, deploying these capabilities on resource-constrained edge platforms remains challenging due to the substantial computational, memory, and communication demands of modern MLLMs. Rather than transmitting raw sensor observations or partitioning neural networks at intermediate layers, Edge Multi-Modal Intelligence (EMMI) communicates a compact representation between edge devices and server resources, enabling communication-efficient edge MLLM inference. To achieve this, EMMI performs modality-specific encoding, cross-modal representation fusion, and learned compression at the edge, transmitting only a compact latent representation to server-side resources for high-capacity MLLM reasoning. This representation-centric design reduces communication overhead, preserves local data privacy, and provides a fixed-size interface between heterogeneous edge devices and server-side MLLMs. Evaluation on a representative multimodal benchmark demonstrates that EMMI can reduce the communication payload by 32x while maintaining comparable downstream accuracy, resulting in up to a 3.4x reduction in estimated end-to-end inference latency under bandwidth-constrained edge conditions.

articles.title: Bidirectional Multimodal Fusion of Sky Images and Time-Series for Solar Forecasting with Large Language Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Short-term photovoltaic (PV) power and global horizontal irradiance (GHI) forecasts are essential for effective dispatch, reserve scheduling, and grid operations. At these forecasting horizons, errors are predominantly driven by cloud induced ramps: relying solely on historical numerical data may struggle to anticipate an incoming cloud, making ground-based sky images a crucial complementary physical signal. Furthermore, forecast performance is highly sensitive to location and local observing conditions, creating a strong need for site-specific data that are often scarce. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated competitive performance and high data efficiency in time-series forecasting. Despite their success, existing LLM-based forecasting methods remain predominantly unimodal, relying primarily on historical numerical time-series data. Effectively incorporating sky imagery into an LLM-based forecasting framework remains under-explored and an open challenge. In this paper, we propose SolCloudLLM, an LLM-based multimodal forecasting framework. SolCloudLLM aligns sky-image patches with time-series patches and fuses their corresponding representations through bidirectional multimodal fusion, yielding a unified representation that is subsequently mapped into the embedding space of an LLM. Extensive experiments on the SIRTA and SKIPP'D datasets demonstrate that SolCloudLLM consistently outperforms the best baseline methods in MSE across all forecasting horizons, achieving a maximum relative MSE reduction of 25.4%. Stratified analysis further indicates that the benefits of multimodal fusion are concentrated primarily under cloudy conditions. Notably, SolCloudLLM achieves the best performance in nearly all few-shot settings, whereas other deep learning baselines experience substantial performance degradation and are frequently outperformed by the non-learning physical method.

articles.title: A Dynamic Fusion Large Language Model for Traffic Flow Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于交通流预测的动态融合大语言模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Traffic flow prediction is a core supporting technology for intelligent transportation systems. It uses historical data to infer future traffic dynamics in specific areas, thereby helping to alleviate congestion and improve resource allocation efficiency. Traditional neural networks struggle to break through accuracy limits due to their reliance on singular feature modeling, while large language models (LLMs) suffer from insufficient capture of spatial topological information and mining spatiotemporal correlation. This study proposes a Dynamic Fusion Large Language Model (DF-LLM) for traffic flow prediction. The model incorporates three core components: spatiotemporal embedding module, spatiotemporal fusion module, and LLM backbone. The spatiotemporal embedding module enables synergistic representation of multi-scale spatiotemporal features. The spatiotemporal fusion module integrates spatial topology and dynamic dependencies via graph convolution. The LLM backbone adopts a differentiated parameter adaptation strategy to balance training efficiency and traffic data adaptability. Additionally, it introduces a context aggregation attention module to strengthens global dependencies. More importantly, the LLM backbone takes the residual connections to mitigate the gradient vanishing in deep networks. Experiments show that DF-LLM has achieved better performance by comparing the metrics on all the four datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于交通流预测的动态融合大语言模型（DF-LLM），由时空嵌入模块、时空融合模块和大语言模型骨干组成。该模型通过图卷积融合空间拓扑与动态依赖，并采用差异化参数适配、上下文聚合注意力和残差连接，以提升交通数据适应性及全局依赖建模能力。在四个数据集上的实验表明，DF-LLM在各项指标上均取得了更优性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交通流预测是智能交通系统的核心支撑技术。它利用历史数据推断特定区域未来的交通动态，从而有助于缓解拥堵并提高资源配置效率。传统神经网络依赖单一特征建模，难以突破精度上限；而大语言模型（LLM）对空间拓扑信息和时空相关性的捕捉与挖掘能力不足。为此，本研究提出一种用于交通流预测的动态融合大语言模型（DF-LLM）。该模型包含三个核心组成部分：时空嵌入模块、时空融合模块和大语言模型骨干。时空嵌入模块能够协同表征多尺度时空特征。时空融合模块通过图卷积整合空间拓扑与动态依赖。大语言模型骨干采用差异化参数适配策略，以平衡训练效率与交通数据适应性。此外，模型引入上下文聚合注意力模块，以强化全局依赖关系。更重要的是，大语言模型骨干采用残差连接，以缓解深层网络中的梯度消失问题。实验结果表明，与其他方法相比，DF-LLM在全部四个数据集的各项指标上均取得了更好的性能。

articles.title: A Dataset and Model for Imputing Water Surface Elevation on a Large and Extremely Sparse Spatiotemporal Graph
articles.title_zh: 用于在大型且极度稀疏的时空图上补全水面高程的数据集与模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous monitoring of water surface elevation across river networks is critical for flood forecasting, water resource management, and understanding the global water cycle. Yet, the scarcity of in situ gauges across much of the globe constrains the development of reliable modeling frameworks. Satellite altimetry has the potential to alleviate this problem but its use is currently hindered by sparse temporal coverage. To this end, we introduce AmazonSWE, a dataset for training and evaluating large-scale spatiotemporal graph imputation methods that integrates processed satellite altimetry measurements from a range of sources, including the recent wide-swath SWOT sensor. The dataset covers over 19K river sections and 10 years (2016-2026) in the Amazon river basin, with in situ gauges held out for evaluation. Besides contributing a novel real-world use case with the potential for societal impact, AmazonSWE introduces significant technical challenges: with fewer than 1% of sections observed per day, the dataset is far sparser than existing imputation benchmarks, and its directed acyclic river topology is both structurally different from and larger than graphs in existing datasets. We show that prior spatiotemporal graph imputation methods are not adapted to this topology, scale and sparsity, and propose a simple bidirectional selective state space model that outperforms them by sampling connected subgraphs and flattening space and time into a single token sequence with topology-aware positional encodings. Compared to the state-of-the-art published method for SWOT-based WSE densification, which integrates statistics with physical modeling, our model reduces RMSE against in situ gauges by 18-39%, while producing predictions for every river section rather than only those with sufficient nearby satellite coverage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出AmazonSWE数据集，用于训练和评估大规模时空图补全方法，覆盖亚马孙河流域超过1.9万个河段及2016至2026年的数据，并融合多源卫星测高观测。针对每日观测河段不足1%、河流拓扑具有有向无环结构等挑战，研究提出双向选择性状态空间模型，通过拓扑感知位置编码和连通子图采样进行补全。该模型相较已有方法表现更优，并使相对于原位水位计的均方根误差降低18%至39%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对河网水面高程进行连续监测，对于洪水预报、水资源管理以及理解全球水循环至关重要。然而，全球大部分地区原位水位计的稀缺限制了可靠建模框架的发展。卫星测高有望缓解这一问题，但目前其应用受到时间覆盖稀疏的制约。为此，我们提出AmazonSWE数据集，用于训练和评估大规模时空图补全方法。该数据集整合了来自多种来源的经处理卫星测高数据，包括近期的宽幅SWOT传感器观测，覆盖亚马孙河流域超过1.9万个河段以及10年时间范围（2016至2026年），并将原位水位计数据留作评估。除提供一个具有潜在社会影响的新型真实世界应用外，AmazonSWE还带来了显著的技术挑战：每天观测到的河段少于全部河段的1%，因此该数据集比现有补全基准数据集稀疏得多；同时，其有向无环河流拓扑在结构上不同于且规模大于现有数据集中的图。我们表明，已有的时空图补全方法并不适用于这种拓扑、规模和稀疏程度，并提出一种简单的双向选择性状态空间模型。该模型通过采样连通子图，并利用拓扑感知位置编码将空间与时间展平为单一标记序列，从而超越了已有方法。与已发表的、基于SWOT并用于水面高程稠密化的最先进方法相比，该模型相对于原位水位计的均方根误差降低了18%至39%，同时能够为每个河段生成预测，而不仅限于那些附近具有足够卫星覆盖的河段。

articles.title: Dynamic language model representations for multi-objective reaction optimisation
articles.title_zh: 用于多目标反应优化的动态语言模型表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optimising chemical reactions across multiple objectives, such as yield, selectivity, and safety, is central to chemical synthesis, and model-driven approaches depend critically on how reaction components are represented. Established featurisations are either chemically uninformative, as with one-hot encodings, or, as with molecular descriptors, do not readily extend across chemically distinct components. For structurally and functionally diverse components, it is therefore unclear what a shared representation should contain. Constructing such a representation is itself a challenging research undertaking that must be revisited for each new reaction system. Here we bypass this step by learning the reaction representation dynamically from text. Textual descriptions of reaction conditions are encoded by a fine-tuned language model trained jointly with Gaussian process surrogates, yielding task-adaptive representations within a multi-objective Bayesian optimisation loop. Across nickel- and palladium-catalysed cross-couplings in both sequential and parallel experimentation regimes, this approach reaches optimisation convergence in fewer experiments than descriptor libraries or one-hot encoding. Applied prospectively to a palladium-catalysed cyanation spanning mixed ligand denticity and heterogeneous additives, and to a three-objective asymmetric hydrogenation across chiral iridium and ruthenium catalyst families, two rounds of high-throughput experimentation (192 reactions, under 3% of each design space) delivered conditions translating directly to gram scale in 94% and 84% isolated yield, the latter at 99.6% enantiomeric excess.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过从文本中动态学习反应表征，解决多目标化学反应优化中的特征表示问题。研究将反应条件的文本描述输入经微调的语言模型，并与高斯过程代理模型联合训练，在多目标贝叶斯优化循环中获得任务自适应表征。在镍催化和钯催化偶联反应，以及前瞻性的氰化和不对称氢化实验中，该方法以更少实验达到收敛，并获得可放大到克级的高收率和高对映选择性条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在多个目标之间优化化学反应，例如产率、选择性和安全性，是化学合成的核心任务，而基于模型的方法在很大程度上取决于如何表征反应组分。已有的特征化方法要么缺乏化学信息，例如独热编码；要么难以扩展到化学性质不同的组分，例如分子描述符。对于结构和功能多样的组分，共享表征应包含哪些内容仍不明确。构建这种表征本身就是一项具有挑战性的研究任务，并且每面对一个新的反应体系都必须重新开展。本文通过从文本中动态学习反应表征来绕过这一过程。研究将反应条件的文本描述编码为经过微调的语言模型，并与高斯过程代理模型联合训练，从而在多目标贝叶斯优化循环中获得任务自适应表征。在镍催化和钯催化交叉偶联反应中，无论采用序贯实验还是并行实验，该方法都比描述符库或独热编码使用更少的实验次数达到优化收敛。进一步地，在一个涵盖不同配体齿数和非均相添加剂的钯催化氰化反应，以及一个涉及手性铱和钌催化剂家族的三目标不对称氢化反应中进行前瞻性应用，两轮高通量实验共包含192个反应，仅占每个设计空间的不到3%，所得条件分别以94%和84%的分离收率直接放大到克级，其中后者的对映体过量达到99.6%。

articles.title: SoK: Privacy Attacks on Machine Learning via Explainable AI
articles.title_zh: 知识体系综述：通过可解释人工智能对机器学习发起的隐私攻击
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10627v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning explanations reveal model behavior beyond predictions, creating attack surfaces for model confidentiality and data privacy. We systematize 25 studies that exploit explanations for model extraction, membership inference, and model inversion, treating attribute inference as partial inversion. Existing work is often labeled only black- or white-box, obscuring substantial differences in what explanation signal reaches an adversary. We therefore separate model knowledge from explanation acquisition and identify five paths: target-released, attacker-derived, secondary disclosure, privileged access, and released global artifacts. Across these paths, explanations reduce extraction cost, expose membership signals through explanation statistics, recourse distance, and explanation-guided robustness, and support spatial or algebraic reconstruction of private inputs. We compare system and threat models, explanation signals, auxiliary knowledge, target models, modalities, query budgets, evaluation metrics, reported performance, and defenses. Our analysis shows that no explanation family is uniformly unsafe and no defense is uniformly effective. Risk depends on which signal is exposed, how it is acquired, which asset is targeted, and what the attacker already knows. We argue that explanation privacy should therefore be evaluated as an end-to-end disclosure problem, with defenses matched to the acquisition path and protected asset.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统梳理了利用机器学习解释实施模型提取、成员推断和模型反演的25项研究，并将属性推断视为部分反演。研究区分了模型知识与解释获取方式，归纳出目标模型发布、攻击者推导、二次披露、特权访问和已发布全局工件五种路径。分析表明，隐私风险取决于暴露的解释信号、获取方式、攻击目标及攻击者已有知识，因此解释隐私应被视为端到端的信息披露问题，并针对不同获取路径和受保护资产设计防御措施。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习解释揭示了超出预测结果之外的模型行为，从而形成了威胁模型机密性和数据隐私的攻击面。本文系统化梳理了利用解释实施模型提取、成员推断和模型反演的25项研究，并将属性推断视为部分反演。现有工作通常仅被标记为黑盒或白盒，这掩盖了攻击者实际获得的解释信号存在显著差异这一事实。因此，我们将模型知识与解释获取方式分离，并确定了五种路径：目标模型发布、攻击者推导、二次披露、特权访问以及已发布的全局工件。沿着这些路径，解释可以通过解释统计量、反事实追索距离和解释引导的鲁棒性降低模型提取成本，暴露成员信号，并支持对私有输入进行空间或代数重构。我们比较了系统模型与威胁模型、解释信号、辅助知识、目标模型、数据模态、查询预算、评估指标、报告的性能以及防御措施。分析表明，没有任何一种解释家族始终不安全，也没有任何一种防御始终有效。风险取决于暴露了何种信号、信号如何被获取、攻击者针对何种资产，以及攻击者事先掌握了哪些信息。因此，我们认为解释隐私应当作为一个端到端的信息披露问题进行评估，并使防御措施与获取路径及受保护资产相匹配。

articles.title: A Quantum-Inspired Dequantization Method for Diagonally Weighted Matrix Functions: Application to Learning with Optimized Random Features
articles.title_zh: 一种用于对角加权矩阵函数的量子启发去量子化方法：应用于带优化随机特征的学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10729v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum-inspired classical algorithms have dequantized several quantum machine learning routines by replacing quantum linear-algebra subroutines with classical counterparts. However, the sampler based on quantum singular value transformation (QSVT) for learning with optimized random features is not covered by existing dequantization frameworks, because the matrix to be inverted is not itself available through sampling access. In this work, we develop a classical algorithm to address this type of quantum-advantage candidate. Our method samples heavy indices, reduces the transformation to a small principal block, and outputs a sparse classical representation with operator-norm guarantees. Applying this method dequantizes the sampler for optimized random features, giving a classical sampler with prescribed accuracy and polynomially related runtime. These results show that the factorization underlying a quantum block encoding can itself provide sufficient classical structure even when sampling-and-query access to the composite matrix is unavailable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种经典算法，用于去量子化一类现有框架无法覆盖的量子机器学习采样器。该方法通过采样高权重索引、将变换约化为小型主块，并输出具有算子范数保证的稀疏经典表示，解决待求逆矩阵无法直接获得采样访问的问题。应用于优化随机特征学习后，该方法得到具有规定精度且运行时间呈多项式相关的经典采样器，表明量子块编码背后的分解本身可以提供足够的经典结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子启发的经典算法已经通过用经典对应方法替代量子线性代数子程序，对若干量子机器学习流程进行了去量子化。然而，现有去量子化框架并未覆盖用于优化随机特征学习的、基于量子奇异值变换（QSVT）的采样器，因为需要求逆的矩阵本身无法通过采样访问获得。本文提出一种经典算法，以处理这类量子优势候选方法。我们的方法对高权重索引进行采样，将变换约化为一个小型主块，并输出具有算子范数保证的稀疏经典表示。将该方法应用于优化随机特征的采样器后，我们得到一个具有规定精度且运行时间呈多项式相关的经典采样器。这些结果表明，即使无法获得对复合矩阵的采样与查询访问，量子块编码背后的分解本身也能够提供足够的经典结构。

articles.title: A variational physics-informed graph neural network for heterogeneous solid mechanics
articles.title_zh: 用于非均质固体力学的变分物理信息图神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10983v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Stress localization in heterogeneous solids is governed by the bimaterial interface, where the displacement field remains C⁰-continuous, while in-plane stresses jump due to the stiffness mismatch. Coordinate-based physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) represent this jump via a prescribed regularization width or a weighted interface penalty, making their accuracy sensitive to how phase-contrast changes are handled. This work presents a variational, label-free physics-informed graph neural network (PI-GNN) in which the heterogeneity is carried by the discretization rather than by the trial field. The solver operates on a conforming adaptive mesh graph, assigns constitutive behavior per element, and minimizes the discrete total potential energy as a single unweighted objective in which only first derivatives appear. The discrete energy on piecewise-linear elements coincides with the finite element (FE) Ritz functional. Dirichlet conditions are enforced by construction, with no penalty term, no interface weight, and no prescribed transition width. Using one fixed architecture, optimizer, and loss across small-strain elasticity and finite-strain Neo-Hookean hyperelasticity in two and three dimensions, the von Mises error remains below 3.58% across a stiffness-contrast sweep spanning (Eᵢₙc/Eₘₐₜin[10⁻²,10²]), where a strong-form PINN degrades to 5.58%, and its displacement error reaches 7.66% against 0.49% for the PI-GNN. A trained network halves the (σₓₓ) error of an energy-based PINN (5.01% versus 10.94%). Training cost exceeds a single FE solve by more than an order of magnitude, so the construction is a variationally consistent, penalty-free interface representation for parametric surrogates and inverse identification rather than a replacement for a one-off FE analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种无标签的变分物理信息图神经网络（PI-GNN），通过离散化而非试探场表示材料非均质性，并在自适应共形网格图上最小化离散总势能。该方法无需罚项、界面权重或预设过渡宽度即可构造满足狄利克雷边界条件的界面表示。在二维和三维小应变弹性及有限应变Neo-Hookean超弹性测试中，其冯·米塞斯误差在广泛刚度对比范围内低于3.58%，但训练成本超过单次有限元求解一个数量级以上。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出无监督的变分物理信息图神经网络，用自适应网格图和离散总势能最小化求解非均匀固体力学问题。方法通过有限元Ritz泛函处理材料界面应力跃迁，并避免人为设置界面惩罚项和过渡宽度。
articles.focus_relation: 论文与团队图神经网络和材料模拟存在较弱的方法学关联，但其目标是连续介质固体力学求解，不直接涉及团队关注的原子尺度电子、磁性、铁电或缺陷物理。其变分图学习思想可作为多尺度力学耦合研究的补充参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议仅在开展铁电畴壁、相变应变场或器件尺度多物理场模拟时阅读。可考察其离散能量最小化框架能否与原子级机器学习势和相场模型进行多尺度耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非均质固体中的应力局部化受双材料界面控制：位移场保持C0连续，而面内应力由于刚度失配发生跳变。基于坐标的物理信息神经网络（PINN）通过预设的正则化宽度或加权界面罚项表示这种跳变，因此其精度容易受到如何处理相间对比变化的影响。本文提出一种变分、无标签的物理信息图神经网络（PI-GNN），其中非均质性由离散化而非试探场承载。该求解器运行于共形自适应网格图上，为每个单元指定本构行为，并将离散总势能作为唯一的无加权目标进行最小化，其中只出现一阶导数。分片线性单元上的离散能量与有限元（FE）Ritz泛函一致。狄利克雷边界条件通过构造方式施加，无需罚项、界面权重或预设过渡宽度。在二维和三维的小应变弹性及有限应变Neo-Hookean超弹性问题中，使用同一个固定的架构、优化器和损失函数，在刚度对比度从10⁻²到10²的扫描范围内，冯·米塞斯误差始终低于3.58%；相比之下，强形式PINN的误差升至5.58%，而其位移误差达到7.66%，PI-GNN则为0.49%。经过训练的网络将基于能量的PINN的σxx误差降低了一半，即从10.94%降至5.01%。训练成本超过单次有限元求解一个数量级以上，因此，该方法的定位是为参数化代理模型和逆向识别提供一种满足变分一致性且无需罚项的界面表示，而不是取代一次性的有限元分析。

articles.title: Rebalancing Token Importance in Language Models with TF-IDF Weighted Cross-Entropy Loss
articles.title_zh: 利用TF-IDF加权交叉熵损失重新平衡语言模型中的词元重要性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11029v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models are typically trained under uniform token weighting, which allows frequent and low-information tokens to dominate learning and can increase the tendency to memorize surface-level text spans. To address this, we present an information-weighted cross-entropy loss that rescales token-level contributions using TF-IDF statistics, emphasizing semantically informative tokens while down-weighting ubiquitous ones. Experiments on five decoder-only LLMs ranging from 1.1B to 13B parameters show consistent reductions in memorized substring length while preserving perplexity and downstream task performance. Under LoRA fine-tuning, TF-IDF reduces average substring memorization length by 14% across all five models. Under full-weight fine-tuning on TinyLLaMA 1.1B, the reduction reaches 58%. Our approach is architecture-agnostic and can be incorporated into existing training pipelines with less than 3% computational overhead, offering a lightweight and principled way to mitigate memorization without disrupting standard training dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种信息加权交叉熵损失，利用TF-IDF统计量重新调整词元级贡献，使语义信息丰富的词元获得更高权重，并降低普遍出现词元的影响。对五个参数量从11亿至130亿的仅解码器大语言模型进行实验表明，该方法在保持困惑度和下游任务性能的同时，持续减少记忆的子字符串长度。LoRA微调时平均减少14%，在TinyLLaMA 11亿参数模型的全参数微调中减少58%，计算开销低于3%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大语言模型通常采用统一的词元权重进行训练，这会使高频且低信息量的词元主导学习，并可能增强模型对表层文本片段的记忆倾向。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种信息加权交叉熵损失，利用TF-IDF统计量重新调整词元级贡献，强调语义信息丰富的词元，同时降低普遍出现词元的权重。对五个参数量从11亿至130亿不等的仅解码器大语言模型进行的实验表明，该方法在保持困惑度和下游任务性能的同时，持续减少模型记忆的子字符串长度。在LoRA微调下，TF-IDF使五个模型的平均子字符串记忆长度减少14%。在TinyLLaMA 11亿参数模型上进行全参数微调时，减少幅度达到58%。该方法与架构无关，可以以低于3%的计算开销集成到现有训练流程中，为缓解记忆问题提供一种轻量且有原则的方法，同时不扰动标准训练动态。

articles.title: Coherent Floquet quantum reservoirs for molecular property prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于分子性质预测的相干Floquet量子储备池
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11071v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) uses quantum dynamics to represent input histories for prediction through a trained classical readout. Discrete time crystals (DTCs) exhibit robust subharmonic responses under periodic driving, and previous work has used their dynamics to construct DTC-QRC. Here we construct a DTC-based reservoir architecture to predict molecular properties from structural and dynamical observations. Coherent Floquet evolution processes local molecular graph events and surface-hopping frames, while controlled reset regulates the contribution of earlier inputs. Measurements at the end of each input sequence yield a feature vector of fixed dimension. Trained classical decoders use this vector for inhibitor-activity and blood--brain-barrier permeability classification and electronic-gap forecasting, while the reservoir parameters remain fixed during training. With matched input lengths and output widths, DTC-QRC outperforms echo-state networks on long-prefix graph classification and the studied ethene gap forecasting tasks. Dephasing lowers performance in both applications, consistent with a role for coherent propagation. Experiments on the Quafu superconducting quantum cloud platform show that pair observables retain task information under device noise. The architecture provides a common framework for molecular screening and time-resolved property prediction using quantum reservoir computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子储备池计算利用量子动力学表示输入历史，并通过训练经典读出层完成预测。本文构建一种基于离散时间晶体的储备池架构，以结构和动力学观测预测分子性质，并通过受控重置调节早期输入的贡献。该方法用于抑制剂活性、血脑屏障通透性分类和电子能隙预测，在若干任务上优于回声状态网络；退相干会降低性能，表明相干传播发挥了作用，超导量子云平台实验也显示成对观测量在设备噪声下仍保留任务信息。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子储备池计算（QRC）利用量子动力学表示输入历史，并通过训练经典读出层进行预测。离散时间晶体（DTC）在周期驱动下表现出稳健的亚谐响应，已有研究利用其动力学构建DTC-QRC。本文构建一种基于DTC的储备池架构，用于根据结构和动力学观测预测分子性质。相干Floquet演化处理局部分子图事件和表面跳跃帧，而受控重置则调节较早输入的贡献。在每个输入序列结束时进行测量，得到固定维度的特征向量。训练得到的经典解码器利用该向量进行抑制剂活性和血脑屏障通透性分类，并预测电子能隙；储备池参数在训练过程中保持固定。在输入长度和输出宽度匹配的条件下，DTC-QRC在长前缀图分类以及所研究的乙烯能隙预测任务中优于回声状态网络。退相干会降低两类应用中的性能，这与相干传播所发挥的作用一致。在夸父超导量子云平台上的实验表明，成对观测量在设备噪声下仍能保留任务信息。该架构为利用量子储备池计算开展分子筛选和时间分辨性质预测提供了一个统一框架。

articles.title: Generative Replay Mitigates Sample Starvation in Quantum Architecture Search
articles.title_zh: 生成式回放缓解量子架构搜索中的样本匮乏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11248v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can automate quantum architecture search, but its scalability is limited when useful circuit trajectories become rare in the rapidly expanding search space. Existing replay mechanisms reuse observed transitions; the proposed learned model produces additional predicted one step transitions from real state-action seeds. Here we introduce GenQAS, a tensor network-guided RL framework that combines a fixed matrix product state warm-start with prioritized generative replay. A learned local transition model generates synthetic circuit transitions on demand and mixes them with real experience during Double Deep Q-Network updates. Under a random exploration analysis, near ground state circuits occupy a rapidly shrinking region of the accessible state space. We investigate whether real data anchored synthetic replay can improve the effective training signal in this regime. Across chemical Hamiltonian benchmarks from 6 to 12 qubits, GenQAS improves fixed-budget success probability and identifies compact circuits at competitive energy error. At 12 qubits, it improves final success probability by up to 7.0× over passive replay. On a 15-qubit transverse field Ising model, GenQAS increases success probability from 12% to 21%. In a noisy 6-qubit BeH₂ transfer experiment, generative replay reduces the steps to chemical accuracy by 92.7%. These results show that generative replay can mitigate sample starvation in quantum architecture search and support more resource efficient circuit discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出GenQAS，一种由张量网络引导的强化学习框架，将固定的矩阵乘积态热启动与优先级生成式回放相结合。学习到的局部状态转移模型根据真实状态—动作种子生成合成电路转移，并在双重深度Q网络更新中与真实经验混合。6至12量子比特化学哈密顿量基准和15量子比特横场伊辛模型实验表明，该方法提升了固定预算下的成功概率；在12量子比特任务中相较被动回放最高提升7倍，在含噪6量子比特BeH2迁移实验中达到化学精度所需步数减少92.7%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强化学习（RL）能够自动化量子架构搜索，但当有用的电路轨迹在迅速扩大的搜索空间中变得稀少时，其可扩展性会受到限制。现有回放机制会重复利用已观测到的转移；本文提出的学习模型则根据真实状态—动作种子生成额外的、预测得到的单步转移。我们提出GenQAS，一种由张量网络引导的强化学习框架，将固定的矩阵乘积态热启动与优先级生成式回放相结合。学习到的局部状态转移模型按需生成合成电路转移，并在双重深度Q网络更新过程中将其与真实经验混合。在随机探索分析下，接近基态的电路占据可访问状态空间中迅速缩小的区域。我们研究了在这种情形下，以真实数据为锚定的合成回放是否能够改善有效训练信号。在6至12量子比特的化学哈密顿量基准上，GenQAS提高了固定预算下的成功概率，并以具有竞争力的能量误差发现紧凑电路。在12量子比特任务中，相较被动回放，其最终成功概率最高提高7.0倍。在15量子比特横场伊辛模型上，GenQAS将成功概率从12%提高到21%。在含噪的6量子比特BeH2迁移实验中，生成式回放使达到化学精度所需的步数减少92.7%。这些结果表明，生成式回放能够缓解量子架构搜索中的样本匮乏，并支持更高资源效率的电路发现。

articles.title: Bio-inspired Learning and Decision-Making with Probabilistic In-Memory Computing Hardware: Part 1
articles.title_zh: 利用概率型存内计算硬件开展仿生学习与决策：第一部分
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11281v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning and decision-making in animals are often modeled as Bayesian processes, where sensory evidence is integrated with prior beliefs to guide behavior in the face of uncertainty. But what are the inherent neural dynamics that give rise to this ability, and how could they be replicated in computing systems? This abstract discusses a biologically grounded framework in which noisy neural and synaptic dynamics perform inference and learning via stochastic sampling from an internal energy function, capturing uncertainty over latent states and model parameters through neural and synaptic variability, respectively. This enables approaches such as predictive coding networks to account for epistemic uncertainty via Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling. Drawing a parallel between intrinsic noise in biological systems and electrical noise in emerging probabilistic analogue memory technologies, we highlight how analogue in-memory computing hardware naturally emerges as the solution for massively scalable and energy-efficient probabilistic inference.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论一种具有生物学基础的框架，将动物的学习和决策理解为贝叶斯过程，并通过随机采样实现不确定性下的推断与学习。噪声神经和突触动力学从内部能量函数中进行随机采样，分别通过神经和突触变异性表示潜在状态与模型参数的不确定性。该框架使预测编码网络能够通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样处理认知不确定性，并指出模拟存内计算硬件中的电噪声可对应生物系统的内在噪声，从而支持大规模、低能耗的概率推断。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 动物的学习和决策通常被建模为贝叶斯过程：感知证据与先验信念相结合，从而在不确定性下指导行为。但这种能力所依赖的内在神经动力学是什么，以及如何在计算系统中复制这种能力？本文摘要讨论一种具有生物学基础的框架。在该框架中，带噪声的神经和突触动力学通过从内部能量函数中进行随机采样来执行推断和学习，并分别利用神经变异性和突触变异性表示潜在状态与模型参数的不确定性。这使得预测编码网络等方法能够通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样解释认知不确定性。通过将生物系统中的内在噪声与新兴概率模拟存储技术中的电噪声相类比，我们强调，模拟存内计算硬件可以自然地成为实现大规模、高能效概率推断的解决方案。

articles.title: Explainability Assistant: A Conversational XAI Interface for Interpreting Energy Consumption Models
articles.title_zh: 可解释性助手：用于解释能源消耗模型的对话式可解释人工智能界面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11860v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Energy consumption forecasting relies on increasingly complex machine learning (ML) models, such as Genetic Programming-based symbolic regressors, whose predictions can be difficult for facility managers and building operators to interpret. Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques address this opacity, but traditional XAI dashboards require substantial technical expertise and provide limited flexibility for dynamic, context-aware inquiry. Conversational XAI systems offer a promising alternative; however, previous approaches, such as TalkToModel, were constrained by rigid custom grammars and achieved only 76.8% intent-parsing accuracy. This paper introduces the Explainability Assistant, an open-source conversational XAI system that leverages the function-calling capabilities of modern Large Language Models (LLMs) to overcome these limitations. The system achieves 94% intent-parsing accuracy, supports flexible natural language interaction, and adapts to different ML problem types without task-specific fine-tuning. We present the system's architecture and report results from a comparative evaluation conducted with energy domain specialists, contrasting the Explainability Assistant with a traditional XAI dashboard. The evaluation suggests improved usability and consistent task accuracy, with all experts unanimously preferring the conversational interface for practical use.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出开源的可解释性助手，一种利用现代大语言模型函数调用能力的对话式可解释人工智能系统，用于解释能源消耗预测模型。该系统能够灵活理解自然语言意图，支持不同机器学习问题类型，且无需针对任务进行微调，意图解析准确率达到94%，高于此前方法的76.8%。与传统可解释人工智能仪表板的比较评估表明，该系统具有更好的可用性和稳定的任务准确率，所有参与评估的能源领域专家均偏好对话式界面。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 能源消耗预测越来越依赖复杂的机器学习模型，例如基于遗传编程的符号回归模型，而设施管理人员和建筑运营人员往往难以理解这些模型的预测结果。可解释人工智能（XAI）技术能够解决这种不透明性，但传统XAI仪表板需要较高的技术专业知识，并且对动态、具备上下文的信息查询支持有限。对话式XAI系统提供了一种有前景的替代方案；然而，既有方法如TalkToModel受到固定自定义语法的限制，其意图解析准确率仅为76.8%。本文提出Explainability Assistant，即可解释性助手，这是一种开源的对话式XAI系统，利用现代大语言模型（LLM）的函数调用能力克服上述限制。该系统的意图解析准确率达到94%，支持灵活的自然语言交互，并且能够适应不同类型的机器学习问题，无需针对具体任务进行微调。本文介绍了系统架构，并报告一项与能源领域专家开展的比较评估结果，将可解释性助手与传统XAI仪表板进行了对比。评估表明，对话式界面具有更好的可用性和稳定的任务准确率，所有专家均一致偏好将该对话式界面用于实际工作。

articles.title: 3D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Novel View Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 用于毫米波雷达新视角合成的三维点溅射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11894v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Solving novel view synthesis (NVS) for millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar requires a renderer that is physically faithful, complex-valued, and multi-viewpoint-tractable. No prior method achieves these three properties simultaneously. Differentiable Monte Carlo (MC) ray tracers implement the radar forward model directly with explicit material modeling and complex outputs, but do not scale to the multi-view optimization NVS demands. Optical-NVS ports of NeRF, hash grids, and 3D Gaussians train fast but discard phase and replace explicit material modeling with opaque learned features, restricting them to power-only range-azimuth (RA) magnitudes. We propose 3D Point Splatting (3DPS), the first differentiable point renderer for radar, derived directly from the standard solid-angle form of the radar equation. Each oriented 3D point carries an ITU-R P.2040 material model, evaluated in closed form, with the resulting complex phasor splatted into range bins through a precomputed point spread function (PSF). The complex-valued output makes the renderer product-agnostic. The same optimized scene yields analog-to-digital converter (ADC), complex range profile (CRP), and RA outputs through standard fast Fourier transform (FFT) pipelines without retraining for each format. On six outdoor ColoRadar scenes, 3DPS reaches 0.587 mean Pearson correlation on held-out RA images. This is between 1.7x and 5.2x the three optical-NVS baselines (RadarSplat, Radar Fields, DART). Training takes approximately 3 minutes per scene on a single RTX 4090.
articles.abstract_zh: 毫米波雷达新视角合成需要同时具备物理真实性、复数值输出和多视角可优化性的渲染器。本文提出3D点溅射（3DPS），一种直接由雷达方程标准立体角形式推导的可微点渲染器，其中每个定向三维点携带ITU-R P.2040材料模型，并通过预计算点扩散函数将复数相量溅射到距离单元。该方法无需针对不同输出格式重新训练，在六个室外ColoRadar场景上的留出距离—方位图像中达到0.587的平均Pearson相关系数，约需单个RTX 4090训练每个场景3分钟。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 解决毫米波雷达的新视角合成（NVS）问题，需要一种同时具备物理真实性、复数值表示和多视点可处理性的渲染器。此前没有任何方法能够同时实现这三种性质。可微蒙特卡洛（MC）光线追踪器通过显式材料建模和复数输出直接实现雷达前向模型，但无法扩展到新视角合成所需的多视角优化。面向光学新视角合成的NeRF、哈希网格和三维高斯方法训练速度较快，但会丢弃相位信息，并以不透明的学习特征替代显式材料建模，因此只能生成仅包含功率的距离—方位（RA）幅度。我们提出三维点溅射（3DPS），这是首个用于雷达的可微点渲染器，直接由雷达方程的标准立体角形式推导而来。每个定向三维点都携带一个ITU-R P.2040材料模型，该模型以闭式形式计算，所得复数相量通过预计算的点扩散函数（PSF）溅射到距离单元中。复数值输出使该渲染器与具体产品格式无关。同一个优化后的场景可以通过标准快速傅里叶变换（FFT）流程生成模数转换器（ADC）数据、复数距离剖面（CRP）和RA输出，无需针对每种格式重新训练。在六个室外ColoRadar场景上，3DPS在留出的RA图像上达到0.587的平均Pearson相关系数，约为三个光学新视角合成基线方法（RadarSplat、Radar Fields和DART）的1.7至5.2倍。使用单个RTX 4090进行训练时，每个场景约需3分钟。

articles.title: Semidefinite Programming for Quantum Channel Learning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12502v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The problem of reconstructing a quantum channel from a sample of classical data is considered. When the total fidelity can be represented as a ratio of two quadratic forms (e.g., in the case of mapping a mixed state to a pure state, projective operators, unitary learning, and others), Semidefinite Programming (SDP) can be applied to solve the fidelity optimization problem with respect to the Choi matrix. A remarkable feature of SDP is that the optimization is convex, which allows the problem to be efficiently solved by a variety of numerical algorithms. We have tested several commercially available SDP solvers, all of which allowed for the reconstruction of quantum channels of different forms. A notable feature is that the Kraus rank of the obtained quantum channel typically comprises less than a few percent of its maximal possible value. This suggests that a relatively small Kraus rank quantum channel is typically sufficient to describe experimentally observed classical data. The theory was also applied to the problem of reconstructing projective operators from data. Finally, we discuss a classical computational model based on quantum channel transformation, performed and calculated on a classical computer, possibly hardware-optimized.

articles.title: The observational partial order of causal structures with latent variables
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.07891v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: For two causal structures with the same set of visible variables, one is said to observationally dominate the other if the set of distributions over the visible variables realizable by the first contains the set of distributions over the visible variables realizable by the second. Knowing such dominance relations is useful for adjudicating between these structures given observational data. Here, we consider the problem of determining the partial order of equivalence classes of causal structures with latent variables relative to observational dominance. We provide a complete characterization of the dominance order in the case of three visible variables, and a partial characterization in the case of four visible variables. Our techniques also help to identify which observational equivalence classes have a set of realizable distributions that is characterized by nontrivial inequality constraints, analogous to Bell inequalities and instrumental inequalities. We find evidence that as one increases the number of visible variables, the equivalence classes satisfying nontrivial inequality constraints become ubiquitous. (Because such classes are the ones for which there can be a difference in the distributions that are quantumly and classically realizable, this implies that the potential for quantum-classical gaps is also ubiquitous.) Furthermore, we find evidence that constraint-based causal discovery algorithms that rely solely on conditional independence constraints have a significantly weaker distinguishing power among observational equivalence classes than algorithms that go beyond these (i.e., algorithms that also leverage nested Markov constraints and inequality constraints).

articles.title: Statistically Valid Post-Training Hyperparameter Selection: From Tuning to Guarantees
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25601v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Post-training hyperparameter selection is a critical step in the deployment of modern artificial intelligence systems, given the need to tune degrees of freedom of pre-trained models such as inference-time parameters, implementation-level settings, and thresholds driving decision rules. Despite its practical importance, hyperparameter selection is typically performed using best-effort empirical methods such as grid search or Bayesian optimization, which provide no formal statistical guarantees on reliability or safety. This monograph, intended for an audience of signal processing and machine learning researchers, presents a unified statistical framework for reliable post-training hyperparameter selection, centered on the learn-then-test (LTT) paradigm. LTT formulates the hyperparameter selection problem as multiple hypothesis testing over a candidate set of hyperparameters. The framework enables the choice of hyperparameters that provably satisfy application-specific reliability requirements---such as bounds on average risk, quantile risk, or information-theoretic constraints---with explicit, finite-sample control of error probabilities. The supporting statistical machinery, namely p-values, e-values, and concentration inequalities, is developed from first principles.

articles.title: Thermodynamic properties of anisotropic diluted semimagnetic semiconductor quantum dots
articles.abstract: This study investigates the thermodynamic and magnetic properties of electrons in diluted magnetic semiconductor quantum dots with anisotropic harmonic potential under the influence of a magnetic field. The dependence of the specific heat capacity and magnetic moment on the magnetic field and temperature is investigated. At low temperatures, a Schottky anomaly is observed in the temperature dependence of the specific heat capacity. Calculations show that the Mn ion exhibits antiferromagnetic properties as an electron gas at x = 0 and becomes paramagnetic at x = 0.115. PACS: 73.63. Fg

articles.title: Measurement of complex dielectric constant of Al2O3 -TiO2 and Cr2O3 plasma spray coatings between 75 and 220 GHz
articles.abstract: Plasma-sprayed coatings on metal substrates are commonly used to absorb radiation in the millimeter-wave range for high-power applications, where flat thin absorbers are mandatory, to avoid arcing and to ensure good heat transport to the substrate. ISTP-CNR (formerly IFP-CNR) has used plasma-sprayed coatings for many years in high power bolometric loads for millimeter waves. Literature on electromagnetic properties of the coatings is sparse in this frequency range. This paper reports measurements on samples of Al2O3(40%) + TiO2(60%) and Cr2O3 already measured at 170 GHz at Stuttgart University. The measurements are over an extended frequency range, including frequencies of interest for diagnostics on the JT-60SA tokamak. TiO2 samples were measured too, but they are too thick for extracting useful information with the method used here. The dielectric properties are obtained with a best-fit to free-space reflectivity measurements as a function of polarization, frequency and angle of incidence. The general model for wave transmission and reflection at the interface between linear, homogeneous, isotropic media is also briefly outlined.

articles.title: Buoyancy and velocity slip effects on squeezing fluid flow conveying ternary hybrid nanoparticles and gyrotactic microorganisms between two circular disks with convective boundary condition
articles.abstract: The theoretical concept of squeezing fluid flow is of great significance in various industrial uses. The operation of automatic gear systems, hydraulic brakes, lubrication techniques, heating and cooling systems, power steering devices, radiators, and water pumps in vehicles relies on the principle of compressing fluids. In this study, the effects of buoyancy and velocity slip on squeezing fluid flow conveying Nickel (Ni), magnetite (Fe 3 O 4), and diamond (C) nanoparticles with gyrotactic microorganisms over a pair of convectively heated circular disks are examined. The selection of these tiny particles is attributed to their remarkable heat retention and thermal efficiency in diverse industrial settings. The equations governing the fluid model, together with their boundary conditions, are transformed from partial differential equations to ordinary differential equations using established similarity variables. The Homotopy Analysis Method in MATHEMAT-ICA software is employed to derive a semi-analytical solution for the resulting nonlinear ordinary differential equations, which ensures the accuracy of the findings through the h-curve. Numerical simulations carried out in MATLAB software confirmed the limited case utilizing a fourth-order Runge-Kutta integration scheme, which provides excellent accuracy. The results shown in tables and graphs indicate that buoyancy accelerated the fluid velocity at the surface just as the velocity slip enhanced the local skin friction, mass transfer rate, and density of microorganisms.

articles.title: Sensitive Determination of Coomassie Brilliant Blue Using a Dual-Emission Ratiometric Fluorescent Probe Composed of Sulfur Quantum Dots and Gold Nanoclusters
articles.abstract: Coomassie Brilliant Blue (CBB) is widely used for protein staining, but its residues may pose environmental and biological risks, creating a need for simple and sensitive detection methods. In this work, a dual-emission ratiometric fluorescent probe was constructed from sulfur quantum dots (S-QDs; blue emission at 430 nm) and BSA-templated gold nanoclusters (Au NCs; red emission at 640 nm). CBB preferentially attenuated the Au NC emission through the inner filter effect (IFE). The fluorescence intensity ratio(F430/F640) exhibited a linear correlation with CBB concentration from 0.1 to 100 µM (R2 = 0.991). The limit of detection was calculated to be 0.01 µM (3σ), around six times lower than that of the single-emission Au NC probe, accompanied by improved calibration sensitivity. The spectral overlap between CBB absorption and Au NC emission, together with the nearly unchanged fluorescence lifetime, supported IFE as the predominant sensing mechanism and indicated that dynamic quenching was not dominant. The probe was applied to CBB determination in a BSA model matrix and two real samples, and the results agreed well with those obtained by HPLC-MS/MS. By using the S-QD emission as an internal reference, the ratiometric strategy reduced common-mode signal fluctuations and improved measurement reliability, providing a potential approach for CBB determination in food-related and biological matrices.

articles.title: Shorter fire-return intervals rearrange fuel arrays in dry forests of southeastern Australia
articles.abstract: Shortening fire-return intervals are pushing fire-tolerant ecosystems in temperate Australia beyond their ecological limits, producing alternative vegetation states with markedly different composition and structure. While the structural effects of these regime shifts on fire-tolerant eucalypt forests are increasingly documented, their consequences for flammability remain largely untested. We compared fuel structure and load, surface fuel flammability, and modelled point-based fire behaviour between areas retaining a Eucalyptus overstorey under typical fire regimes (reference state) and alternative states in fire-tolerant native forests of southeastern Australia. Fuel hazard was visually assessed using an established field protocol, and surface fuels were sampled for laboratory flammability testing. Point-based fire behaviour was modelled using Vesta Mk2 across five weather scenarios spanning prescribed-burn to extreme wildfire conditions. Fuel hazard scores were significantly higher for surface and elevated strata in alternative states, but higher for near-surface and bark strata in reference states. However, laboratory flammability tests showed that surface fuels from alternative states were less ignitable, combustible, and consumable than those from reference states. Modelled fire behaviour showed consistently taller flames in alternative states across all weather scenarios, though rate of spread was greater only under the most extreme conditions. Spotting distances were consistently higher in reference states. These results show that alternative-state eucalypt forests produce a distinct fire behaviour signature: lower surface fuel flammability, greater flame height, but reduced spotting potential. The landscape-scale implications of this altered fire behaviour for subsequent fire regimes and the persistence of alternative states warrant further investigation.

articles.title: First Experimental Realization of a Cable-Free and Battery-Free Spatial Power Grid Infrastructure
articles.abstract: Modern electronic platforms remain fundamentally constrained by wired AC/DC distribution infrastructure and electrochemical battery storage, which introduce mass overhead, thermal runaway risks, and ecological waste. Traditional wireless power transfer (WPT) architectures—such as near-field Qi magnetic induction (≤ 1 cm) and far-field radiative RF/microwave beams—fail to achieve room-scale delivery due to rapid free-space path loss (1/r2) and stringent Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) human safety limits. Here, we present the world’s first experimental realization of a cable-free and battery-free spatial power grid infrastructure based on Algorithmic Topological Resonance (ATR) and nonradiative evanescent wave coupling. Controlled by a spatiotemporal resonance condition RJM(pk,K) < 10−12, multi-element transmitter arrays embedded in surfaces construct a bounded evanescent field. Matched receiver devices equipped with a monolithic Finite-Field Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC) harvest power directly with a constant empirical transfer efficiency of 92.5±0.8% across indoor radii of 15m and dynamic mobility corridors up to 500 m. By integrating Adiabatic Charge Recovery Logic (ACRL), the receiver achieves 94.7% switching energy reclamation, maintaining thermal elevation below 0.05◦C and SAR exposure below 1.0 × 10−4 W/kg (< 1/1000 of regulatory limits). Residual memory states are purged within 23.94 ms (<0.01% remanence) via Fowler- Nordheim field emission under a −5V bias. Building upon the theoretical framework of our companion study under peer review at Scientific Reports, this spatial grid establishes a scalable, intrinsically human-safe, zero-carbon power distribution paradigm that completely eliminates chemical batteries (0 kg) and physical charging cables.

articles.title: Mie Optical Computing
articles.abstract: Optical computing is emerging as a promising paradigm for next-generation information processing. Diffractive optical processors rely on spatially distributed trainable degrees of freedom, leading to extended architectures. Here, we propose a compact neuromorphic optical-computing approach where the entire trainable transformation is implemented by a single Mie scatterer. By formulating computation in vector spherical harmonics basis, trainable modal couplings can be concentrated within a finite object through its T-matrix. Since available T-matrix parameters scale as the fourth power of maximal multipole order, this architecture can overcome trainable-parameter-density limitations of conventional spatially distributed diffractive processors. We demonstrate classification of phase-encoded MNIST images using scattered-field intensity. At a particle size parameter of ka = 15, the trained T-matrix reaches approximately 90% test accuracy, comparable to a single-layer artificial neural network. Similar performance can be achieved using near-fields, enabling on-chip integration. We show how reciprocity, passivity, and particle symmetry constrain performance: passivity reduces the accessible operator space while improving robustness, whereas symmetry reduces the number of independent parameters. Finally, we inverse-design a non-absorbing dielectric scatterer that realizes the classification task with 84% accuracy. These results demonstrate that nontrivial neuromorphic transformations can be encoded within the multipolar response of a single compact scatterer.

articles.title: A Nanoscale Pixel Architecture for High-Efficiency AlGaN Ultraviolet-C (UV-C) Light-Emitting Diodes
articles.abstract: AlGaN ultraviolet-C (UV-C) light-emitting diodes hold great promise for disinfection, water purification, and non-line-of-sight communication, yet their adoption is constrained by low external quantum efficiency (EQE) arising from high threading dislocation densities, poor p-type doping, and inefficient extraction of dominant transverse-magnetic (TM) polarized emission. Here, we demonstrate the first top-down fabricated ~400 nm AlGaN UV-C nanopixel array, and present a pixel-area driven experimental comparison of planar micropixel and nanopixel UV-C LEDs over a [20 μm]2 footprint, supported by a systematic micropixel scaling study from [60 μm]2 to [20 μm]2. The nanopixel arrays deliver peak power densities exceeding 10 W/cm2, with an EQE of >1%. Electromagnetic simulations using the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method show a ~3–4× enhancement in TM-polarized light extraction compared to planar counterparts. Furthermore, Monte Carlo statistical modelling reveals a substantial reduction in dislocation density within nanoscale pixels, which further contributes to the light output enhancement of the nanopixels. These results establish top-down nanopixel architectures as a scalable route to high-efficiency UV-C emitters, identify UV-transparent sub-micrometer planarization as the key remaining materials challenge, and delineate the design space for further efficiency gains in the challenging deep UV spectral range.

articles.title: Bimetallic cobalt-nickel phosphide composite biomass carbon materials as efficient electrocatalysts for zinc-air batteries
articles.title_zh: 作为高效锌空气电池电催化剂的双金属钴镍磷化物复合生物质碳材料
articles.abstract: Zinc-air batteries (ZABs) are promising energy storage devices, but their efficiency is limited by the sluggish kinetics of the oxygen reduction and evolution reactions (ORR/OER). While composites of transition metal phosphides (TMPs) and nitrogen-doped carbon (NC) are attractive bifunctional catalysts, their performance is constrained by unclear synergistic mechanisms in bimetallic sites and challenges in designing structures that balance active site exposure with stability.To address this, we synthesized a series of CoMP@NC (M = Mn, Fe, Ni) catalysts using chitosan-derived carbon. The optimized CoNiP@NC exhibits excellent ORR activity (onset potential: 0.876 V) and OER performance (overpotential: 503 mV at 10 mA cm⁻²). Theoretical calculations indicate that Ni doping modulates the electronic structure of Co sites, lowering the reaction barrier. Furthermore, a rechargeable ZAB with a CoNiP@NC cathode demonstrated stable cycling for 240 hours, outperforming the Pt/C-RuO₂ benchmark. These results highlight CoNiP@NC as a highly efficient and durable bifunctional electrocatalyst for ZABs.
articles.abstract_zh: 锌空气电池的效率受到氧还原反应和析氧反应动力学缓慢的限制。本研究以壳聚糖衍生碳为基础，制备了一系列CoMP@NC（M = Mn、Fe、Ni）催化剂，其中优化后的CoNiP@NC表现出优异的双功能电催化性能。理论计算表明，Ni掺杂能够调控Co位点的电子结构并降低反应能垒；以CoNiP@NC为阴极的可充电锌空气电池可稳定循环240小时，性能优于Pt/C-RuO₂基准体系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 锌空气电池（ZABs）是具有发展前景的储能装置，但其效率受到氧还原反应（ORR）和析氧反应（OER）动力学缓慢的限制。尽管过渡金属磷化物（TMPs）与氮掺杂碳（NC）的复合材料是具有吸引力的双功能催化剂，但其性能受到双金属位点协同机制尚不明确，以及难以设计兼顾活性位点暴露与稳定性的结构等因素的制约。为解决这一问题，我们利用壳聚糖衍生碳合成了一系列CoMP@NC（M = Mn、Fe、Ni）催化剂。优化后的CoNiP@NC表现出优异的ORR活性（起始电位：0.876 V）和OER性能（在10 mA cm⁻²下的过电位：503 mV）。理论计算表明，Ni掺杂能够调控Co位点的电子结构，从而降低反应能垒。此外，以CoNiP@NC为阴极的可充电锌空气电池实现了240小时的稳定循环，性能优于Pt/C-RuO₂基准体系。这些结果表明，CoNiP@NC是一种用于锌空气电池的高效且耐用的双功能电催化剂。

articles.title: Scenario-driven flood resilience assessment and critical node identification for urban road networks
articles.title_zh: 情景驱动的城市道路网络洪涝韧性评估与关键节点识别
articles.abstract: Urban flooding driven by extreme rainfall is growing in both frequency and severity. As the carrier of evacuation, rescue, and repair operations during floods, the road network is a lifeline on which urban disaster response depends. Most existing assessments, however, build on a single flood scenario, and critical nodes are identified mainly by topological importance, with actual flood exposure seldom considered jointly. This study uses the observed hyetographs of three extreme storms to drive pluvial flood simulations of the same urban road network, building flood evolution scenarios that span short-duration concentrated, multi-peak intense, and long-duration persistent rainfall patterns. A failure–reopening rule converts hourly water depths into dynamic resilience curves, from which five metrics are extracted, namely threshold-crossing times, resilience trough, recovery time, resilience loss, and fragmentation amplification ratio. A two-criterion method then identifies critical nodes by combining structural importance with flood exposure, and reinforcement replay tests its effectiveness. The three scenarios produce three distinct resilience processes, from instantaneous collapse–rebound, through oscillatory collapse, to sustained suppression. The scenario with the deepest trough does not suffer the largest resilience loss, so no single metric can characterize the whole process. Most of the topologically important nodes sit on roads that stay dry during the floods, and reinforcing by topology alone barely improves resilience. Local inundation is amplified into network-wide connectivity loss, with every 1% of failed nodes at the trough resulting in an approximate 3% loss in network performance. Reinforcing 1000 two-criterion critical nodes (1.6% of the network) cuts resilience loss by 22.3%–28.4% across the three scenarios, more than 5 times the reduction of structure-only selection and more than 23 times that of network-wide random selection. These results reveal how rainfall pattern, terrain, and network topology jointly shape road network flood resilience, and provide a testable quantitative basis for prioritizing flood-proofing reinforcement under limited budgets.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对极端降雨引发的城市内涝，本研究利用三场极端暴雨的实测雨型驱动同一道路网络的积水模拟，构建了涵盖短时集中、多峰强降雨和长时持续降雨的洪涝演化情景。研究通过失效—重开放规则构建动态韧性曲线，并结合结构重要性与洪涝暴露度识别关键节点。结果表明，不同降雨情景会产生显著不同的韧性过程，单一指标无法完整刻画网络性能；强化1000个双准则关键节点可使三种情景下的韧性损失降低22.3%—28.4%，显著优于仅基于结构或随机选择的强化方式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 极端降雨驱动的城市洪涝在发生频率和严重程度上均不断增加。作为洪涝期间疏散、救援和修复行动的承载体，道路网络是城市灾害响应所依赖的生命线。然而，现有大多数评估建立在单一洪涝情景之上，关键节点的识别也主要依据拓扑重要性，很少将实际洪涝暴露度纳入联合考量。本研究利用三场极端暴雨的实测雨型驱动同一道路网络的积水模拟，构建了涵盖短时集中降雨、多峰强降雨和长时持续降雨模式的洪涝演化情景。研究采用失效—重开放规则，将逐小时积水深度转换为动态韧性曲线，并从中提取五项指标，即阈值穿越时间、韧性谷值、恢复时间、韧性损失和碎片化放大比。随后，研究提出一种双准则方法，通过结合结构重要性与洪涝暴露度识别关键节点，并通过强化回放测试其有效性。三种情景产生了三种不同的韧性过程，分别表现为瞬时崩溃—反弹、振荡式崩溃和持续受抑。谷值最深的情景并未产生最大的韧性损失，因此不存在能够表征整个过程的单一指标。大多数拓扑重要节点位于洪涝期间保持干燥的道路上，仅依据拓扑进行强化对韧性的改善极为有限。局部积水会被放大为全网络连通性损失，在谷值时每增加1%的失效节点，网络性能约损失3%。强化1000个双准则关键节点（占网络的1.6%）可使三种情景下的韧性损失降低22.3%—28.4%，其降幅超过仅基于结构选择方式的5倍，也超过全网络随机选择方式的23倍以上。这些结果揭示了降雨模式、地形和网络拓扑如何共同塑造道路网络的洪涝韧性，并为有限预算下优先开展防洪加固提供了可检验的定量依据。

articles.title: In vitro antibacterial activity of ethanolic peel and seed extracts of sweet orange (Citrus sinensis) against Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli
articles.title_zh: 甜橙（Citrus sinensis）乙醇果皮和种子提取物对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌的体外抗菌活性
articles.abstract: Background Antimicrobial resistance in common pathogens such as Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli has renewed interest in antibacterial agents derived from plants. The peels and seeds of sweet orange (Citrus sinensis) are abundant agro-processing residues that are rich in bioactive compounds but are usually discarded. This study compared the in vitro antibacterial activity of ethanolic peel and seed extracts of C. sinensis against a Gram-positive and a Gram-negative organism.Methods Dried peels and seeds were extracted by ethanolic maceration, and the crude extracts were reconstituted in 2% dimethyl sulphoxide to give concentrations of 20, 40, 60 and 80% w/v (200–800 mg/mL). Antibacterial activity against S. aureus (ATCC 43300) and E. coli (ATCC 25922) was determined in triplicate by the agar well diffusion method, with gentamicin and sterile distilled water as positive and negative controls. Zones of inhibition were analysed by one-way and two-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) and independent-samples t-tests.Results Both extracts inhibited the two organisms in a concentration-dependent manner. The largest zones were produced by the 80% peel extract against S. aureus (12.33 ± 0.58 mm) and E. coli (12.33 ± 1.53 mm). One-way ANOVA confirmed a significant effect of concentration for every extract–organism combination (p < 0.05). Two-way ANOVA identified concentration as the dominant factor for both organisms, with a significant extract × concentration interaction for E. coli (p = 0.046) but not for S. aureus (p = 0.705). The peel produced numerically larger zones than the seed, but the difference was not statistically significant (S. aureus, p = 0.091, Cohen's d = 0.85; E. coli, p = 0.840). S. aureus was generally more susceptible than E. coli.Conclusions Ethanolic peel and seed extracts of C. sinensis, and particularly the peel, showed concentration-dependent antibacterial activity against both test organisms. The findings support the potential of sweet orange processing residues as a low-cost source of antibacterial compounds and add value to a commonly discarded agro-waste, while indicating the need for determination of minimum inhibitory and bactericidal concentrations and for phytochemical characterisation in future work.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究比较了甜橙果皮和种子乙醇提取物对革兰氏阳性菌金黄色葡萄球菌和革兰氏阴性菌大肠杆菌的体外抗菌活性。两种提取物均表现出浓度依赖性抑菌作用，其中80%果皮提取物对两种细菌产生了最大的抑菌圈，且金黄色葡萄球菌总体上比大肠杆菌更易感。结果表明，尤其是果皮提取物，可能成为低成本抗菌化合物来源，并可提升甜橙加工废弃物的利用价值，但仍需进一步测定最低抑菌浓度和最低杀菌浓度并开展植物化学成分表征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 背景：金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌等常见病原体的抗菌药物耐药性问题，使人们重新关注植物来源的抗菌剂。甜橙（Citrus sinensis）的果皮和种子是富含生物活性化合物、但通常被丢弃的大量农产品加工残余物。本研究比较了C. sinensis乙醇果皮和种子提取物对一种革兰氏阳性菌和一种革兰氏阴性菌的体外抗菌活性。方法：将干燥果皮和种子通过乙醇浸渍法提取，并将粗提取物用2%二甲基亚砜重新配制，得到20%、40%、60%和80%（w/v）的浓度（200—800 mg/mL）。采用琼脂孔扩散法，以庆大霉素和无菌蒸馏水分别作为阳性和阴性对照，对金黄色葡萄球菌（ATCC 43300）和大肠杆菌（ATCC 25922）的抗菌活性进行三次重复测定。抑菌圈采用单因素和双因素方差分析（ANOVA）以及独立样本t检验进行分析。结果：两种提取物均以浓度依赖方式抑制两种微生物。80%果皮提取物对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌产生了最大的抑菌圈，分别为12.33 ± 0.58 mm和12.33 ± 1.53 mm。单因素方差分析证实，对于每一种“提取物—微生物”组合，浓度均具有显著影响（p < 0.05）。双因素方差分析显示，浓度是影响两种微生物的主要因素；对于大肠杆菌，提取物与浓度之间的交互作用显著（p = 0.046），而对于金黄色葡萄球菌则不显著（p = 0.705）。果皮产生的抑菌圈在数值上大于种子，但差异无统计学意义（金黄色葡萄球菌，p = 0.091，Cohen's d = 0.85；大肠杆菌，p = 0.840）。总体而言，金黄色葡萄球菌比大肠杆菌更易感。结论：C. sinensis乙醇果皮和种子提取物，尤其是果皮提取物，对两种受试微生物均表现出浓度依赖性抗菌活性。研究结果支持将甜橙加工残余物开发为低成本抗菌化合物来源的潜力，并有助于提升一种常见农业废弃物的价值；同时也表明，未来需要测定最低抑菌浓度和最低杀菌浓度，并开展植物化学成分表征。

articles.title: Defect2Tree
articles.title_zh: Defect2Tree：制造缺陷的拓扑树表征框架
articles.abstract: Manufacturing-induced void defects remain a major barrier to the reliable production of carbon-fibre-reinforced polymer (CFRP) components because their highly irregular three-dimensional morphologies cannot be adequately represented by conventional strip, circular, or elliptical idealizations. Such simplifications discard critical topological features, including branching, connectivity, boundary curvature, and crack-prone tips, thereby limiting topology-sensitive defect assessment and subsequent failure prediction. Here, we propose Defect2Tree, a topology-preserving manufacturing-defect characterization framework that converts CT-resolved void morphologies in CFRP into skeleton-tree representations. By integrating geometric descriptors, boundary curvature, degree centrality, and trunk orientation, Defect2Tree constructs a tree-heterogeneous tensor that links real defect topology with mechanically relevant crack response. To isolate the mechanical influence of defect topology, CT-derived void contours were reproduced as through-holes in DLP-printed resin surrogate specimens, which were tested under tensile loading to measure strain evolution and crack propagation. A Boundary Attention Dilation algorithm was developed to identify crack-tip plastic zones, and a strain-intensity-factor moment was introduced to establish an E criterion for Strain field intensity beyond conventional stress-intensity and energy-release fracture criteria. Coupled with a physics-guided random forest predictor, Defect2Tree predicts crack-growth direction with 93.64% accuracy for a conical defect and 86.57%–95.75% accuracy across six representative defect morphologies. Together, these results establish an integrated and mechanically interpretable route from CT-resolved defect topology to experimentally supported crack-growth assessment, bridging CT-based defect detection and structural-integrity evaluation while offering a potentially transferable framework for other porous materials and complex defect morphologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 制造过程中产生的孔隙缺陷具有高度不规则的三维形貌，传统条带、圆形或椭圆形理想化模型难以充分表示其拓扑特征。本研究提出Defect2Tree，将CT解析的碳纤维增强聚合物孔隙形貌转换为保拓扑的骨架树表示，并结合几何描述符、边界曲率、度中心性和主干方向建立树异质张量。结合实验力学测试、边界注意力膨胀算法、应变强度因子矩和物理引导随机森林模型，该方法对不同缺陷形貌的裂纹扩展方向预测准确率达到86.57%—95.75%，为从缺陷检测到结构完整性评价提供了可解释路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 制造过程中产生的孔隙缺陷仍然是可靠生产碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRP）构件的主要障碍，因为其高度不规则的三维形貌无法通过传统的条带形、圆形或椭圆形理想化模型得到充分表示。这类简化会丢失包括分支、连通性、边界曲率和易发生裂纹的尖端在内的关键拓扑特征，从而限制对缺陷进行拓扑敏感性评估以及后续失效预测。本文提出Defect2Tree，这是一种保留拓扑的制造缺陷表征框架，可将CT解析的CFRP孔隙形貌转换为骨架树表示。通过整合几何描述符、边界曲率、度中心性和主干方向，Defect2Tree构建了一个树异质张量，将真实缺陷拓扑与力学相关的裂纹响应联系起来。为分离缺陷拓扑的力学影响，研究将CT获得的孔隙轮廓复制为DLP打印树脂替代试样中的贯穿孔，并在拉伸载荷下进行测试，以测量应变演化和裂纹扩展。研究开发了边界注意力膨胀算法，用于识别裂纹尖端塑性区；同时引入应变强度因子矩，以建立应变场强度的E判据，从而超越传统的应力强度因子和能量释放率断裂判据。结合物理引导的随机森林预测器，Defect2Tree对锥形缺陷的裂纹扩展方向预测准确率达到93.64%，对六种代表性缺陷形貌的预测准确率达到86.57%—95.75%。总体而言，这些结果建立了一条从CT解析的缺陷拓扑到实验支持的裂纹扩展评估的集成且具有力学可解释性的路径，连接了基于CT的缺陷检测与结构完整性评价，同时为其他多孔材料和复杂缺陷形貌提供了一个可能具有迁移性的框架。

articles.title: DualAttentionNet: A Lightweight Dual-Attention Framework for Robust Multi-Class EEG Digit Decoding
articles.abstract: The visual classification of a stimulus by electroencephalography (EEG) has been a significant line of investigation in Brain Computer Interface (BCI) systems. The current issue of converting EEG signals into useful cognitive representations, including digit recognition, is a difficult issue because of low signal to noise ratio, high inter trial variability and overlapping neural tracks. This paper presents a DualAttentionNet with a multi-class EEG digit classification system based on Visual MNIST. The offered model improves the traditional EEGNet model by incorporating two channel-attention blocks. The architectural design attains 92.36% classification accuracy, being superior to all the architectures compared and at the same time with 92.36 computational efficiency. Under the analysis of signal variability and explainability, statistical analysis indicates the strength of the model. It is a strong, interpretable and reproducible multi-class EEG-based classification framework. The outcomes emphasise the significance of organised attention systems and streamlined training interventions in enhancing the performance of EEG decoding. The code is available at: https://github.com/mrirashid/EEG-Based-MNIST-Digit-Classification.

articles.title: Earth-abundant CZTS/MIL-125-NH2 heterojunctions for enhanced visible-light Cr(VI) reduction: Interfacial charge dynamics and mechanistic insights
articles.abstract: The development of efficient, stable, and earth-abundant photocatalysts for the reduction of highly toxic Cr(VI) under visible light remains a significant challenge. Herein, a novel heterojunction system is reported based on the integration of Cu2ZnSnS4 (CZTS) kesterite nanoparticles (size ~ 10 nm) into the titanium-based metal–organic framework MIL-125-NH2. A series of MIL-125-NH2/CZTS nanocomposites with varying CZTS loadings (5, 10, 25, and 50 wt%) was synthesized via a solvothermal approach in the presence of preformed CZTS nanoparticles. Structural (XRD, Raman, SEM) and optical (DRS) analyses confirm the formation of intimate heterointerfaces with preserved crystallinity and extended visible-light absorption up to 800 nm. Mott–Schottky analysis reveals that the NC25 composite (25% CZTS) exhibits a high carrier density (5.7 × 1022 cm− 3) and an optimized flat-band potential, promoting efficient charge transfer. Photoelectrochemical measurements demonstrate that NC25 delivers a significantly enhanced photocurrent response (73.3 µA cm− 2 at 0 V vs Ag/AgCl), outperforming both individual components and layered architectures. Under visible-light irradiation, the NC25 nanocomposite achieves a remarkable Cr(VI) reduction rate constant of 3.4 × 10− 2 min⁻¹, approximately twice that of pristine MIL-125-NH2. Wavelength-dependent photocatalytic kinetics reveal a 22-fold decrease in the reduction rate when the excitation shifts from 440 nm (dual excitation) to 568 nm (selective CZTS excitation) confirming that synergistic photoexcitation is essential for efficient charge separation, consistent with a type-II heterojunction. This work highlights the pivotal role of interface design in MOF-based hybrid systems, offering a cost-effective and non-toxic alternative for solar-driven environmental remediation.

articles.title: Generating is not discovering: a pre-registered physics judge for AI-proposed superconductors, calibrated on six known superconductors and one negative control
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models now propose millions of "stable" crystal structures, and their own referees have shown that stability is not discovery; no public benchmark asks whether a candidate has the physics to do a job. For superconductors the job is twofold: to pair, with a definite gap symmetry, and to become wire. We present a physics judge that answers both from a structure alone (DFT+U, a gated Wannier model, the full rank-4 RPA susceptibility on a 24³ mesh, the linearized gap equation, an irreducible-representation classifier, a manufacturability funnel) and measure what it says about what generators propose. With answer keys pre-registered before computing, the judge was calibrated on six known superconductors (Nb, Nb₃Sn, MgB₂, BaFe₂As₂, La₂₋ₓSrₓCuO₄, YBa₂Cu₃O₇), recovering the expected class in all six after two dated corrections. On the ruthenium analogue of the iron pnictide, with two runs and their criterion pre-registered the day before, it returns a null verdict at the same physical interaction where iron gives s± (λ₁ le 0.0007 versus 0.096; critical U 4.17 versus 0.97 eV); the pre-registered equal-alpha run fails the letter of the criterion, and we declare the resolution in favour of absolute U as post-hoc. The funnel reproduces the industrial map with thresholds fixed before running. Three generation audits follow: a descriptor sweep over 150 Materials Project metals re-finds the canon; 1,248 MatterGen structures yield 0 candidates that are new, stable and carry a pairing motif; mechanism filters over 47,893 compounds, validated by a blind hold-out, re-derive the community's analogies: geometry plus d-count is necessary but not sufficient. Generation re-finds what is known; judgment is the bottleneck. We propose a public benchmark over the eleven lists of AI-proposed superconductor candidates, none of which classifies gap symmetry.

articles.title: Geometric Ginzburg-Landau theory of charge ordering and commensurability
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The concept of quantum geometry has recently led to reinvigorated insights in a wide range of fields including physical responses, superconductivity, and optical transitions, with effects most pronounced in systems with nearly flat dispersion. Here, we show that it plays an essential role in charge density wave formation (CDW) -- an important physical phenomenon that is responsible for driving various sharp changes in material transport properties including metal-insulator transitions. We derive an effective Ginzburg-Landau theory including uncharted contributions and, as a highlight, discover a general criterion for both CDW formation and commensurability transitions where underlying electron-phonon interactions manifest purely as electronic quantum geometric enhancements/suppressions. We benchmark our framework in a class of transition-metal dichalcogenides and resolve a longstanding puzzle where well-established purely kinetic CDW criteria fail in describing the correct ordering wavevector. Besides rendering robust criteria and fundamental insights that are immediately relevant to several experimental charge ordering systems, our theory can also be applied directly to other phonon-mediated phases such as superconductivity, and can be used as an important tool to explore the interplay between various such states. More generally, our framework provides a recipe for investigating the role of quantum geometry in phase transitions.

articles.title: Dissipative quantum mechanics of Andreev bound states
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a microscopic scheme that allows to describe ac Josephson effect in superconducting junctions in terms of dissipative quantum dynamics of subgap Andreev bound states. This approach is particularly useful for highly transparent junctions at subgap bias voltages in which case a non-trivial combination of Landau-Zener tunneling between Andreev levels and their instability due to quasiparticle escape into continuum may play an important role. In the low bias regime, we evaluate the non-equilibrium current-phase relation of superconducting junctions at arbitrary transmissions and identify a sub-Ohmic phase-dependent dissipative contribution to the current controlled by quasiparticle dynamics near the superconducting gap edge.

articles.title: Thermal Stability of Encapsulated Molecular Structures with Extended OH-Hydrogen-Bond Chains
