The 70% device has the highest gain, but qubit readout SNR and assignment fidelity Fₐ instead peak at 60%. Using this method, we map Fₐ against HEMT LNA dc power consumption for each device. Fₐ does not simply saturate with increasing power. For several devices it declines above a device-dependent power well below typical operating points. For the 60% device, which has the highest overall Fₐ, about 1~mW is needed to maintain Fₐ > 85%. Across all four devices, Fₐ > 80% is reached with as little as about 0.3~mW, roughly an order of magnitude below typical operating points. These results establish a qubit-referenced benchmarking methodology and provide practical guidance for amplifier selection and bias in power-constrained multi-qubit readout systems.

articles.title: Quantum Feature Engineering for Credit Default Prediction: When and Why IQP Circuits Help Linear Classifiers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10505v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Credit default prediction is a tabular classification problem in which modest gains in F1 translate directly into reduced financial exposure. We ask whether Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time (IQP) circuits can produce features that improve a classifier over both its raw classical baseline and Kernel PCA - the strongest unsupervised classical non-linear alternative - at an equal feature budget. The dataset provides 23 financial attributes per client; for an n-qubit circuit we select n of them, encode each as a rotation angle, and read 2n expectation values back out as new features. The motivation for using a quantum circuit is computational: an n-qubit IQP circuit runs in constant depth and encodes feature correlations in a 2ⁿ-dimensional Hilbert space, whereas classical simulation of its exact output statistics scales exponentially in n. Using the UCI Default of Credit Card Clients dataset and five-fold cross-validation, we find that appending 16 IQP features (n = 8 qubits) to a Logistic Regression model raises F1 from 0.462 to 0.517 (+0.055, p < 0.0001). Kernel PCA, the next-best method, reaches only 0.493 at the same feature count; the gap survives Benjamini-Hochberg correction across 12 tests (p = 0.00007). No other classifier - Random Forest, SVM, XGBoost, or k-NN - benefits, which points to a linear-expressivity mechanism rather than a generic improvement. We also show that how the 8 input features are chosen matters: Random Forest importance-guided selection reaches F1 = 0.523, while encoding maximally uncorrelated features drops it to 0.496, demonstrating that the circuit amplifies informative structure rather than creating it from scratch.

articles.title: Every Activation Boosted: Scaling General Reasoner to 1 Trillion Open Language Foundation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.22115v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Ling 2.0, a series reasoning-oriented language foundation built upon the principle that every activation boosts reasoning capability. Designed to scale from tens of billions to one trillion parameters under a unified Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm, Ling 2.0 emphasizes high sparsity, cross-scale consistency, and efficiency guided by empirical scaling laws. The series includes three non-thinking (instruct) models - Ling-mini-2.0, Ling-flash-2.0, and Ling-1T - ranging from 16B to 1T total parameters and achieving up to 7-fold active-compute efficiency compared with dense counterparts. Ling 2.0 integrates coordinated innovations across model architecture, pre-training, post-training, and infrastructure: a high-sparsity MoE with MTP for efficient reasoning, reasoning-oriented data and mid-training CoT activation, reinforcement-based fine-tuning (DFT, Evo-CoT), and full-scale FP8 training with fine-grained heterogeneous pipelines. At the trillion scale, Ling-1T establishes a new Pareto frontier of reasoning accuracy versus computational efficiency, demonstrating that sparse activation, when properly aligned with reasoning objectives, enables scalable and efficient intelligence. Collectively, Ling 2.0 provides a coherent, open, and efficient foundation for advancing future reasoning and thinking models, including the Ring series built upon the same base.

articles.title: The Sample Complexity of Quantum Entanglement Allocation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10141v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How many past requests are needed to decide which qubits should share entanglement? We show that the answer depends on the allocation choices created by the queries: a larger memory can require no more data. The memory stores a classical bit and answers requests through a fixed detector that preserves coherence within each measured sector. For independent commuting X- and Z-type Pauli queries, we characterize the full attainable prediction-contrast region and construct encodings that preserve the bit at every nonzero vertex. With sharp reports, a d-qubit path and groups of at most k qubits have minimax excess error after m requests proportional to k⁻¹min1,sqrtdlog(k+1)/m, uniformly for 2≤ k

articles.title: Optimal Low-Rank Quantum State Tomography with Bounded-Sample Joint Measurements
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10514v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We determine the optimal sample complexity of low-rank quantum state tomography when each measurement may act jointly on at most t samples. For sufficiently small ε, estimating an unknown state on C^d of rank at most r to trace norm error ε with constant success probability requires, and is achievable with,  Θleft( fracdrε² maxleft1,frac rsqrt tright right) samples. The lower bound allows the protocol to choose each joint measurement adaptively using all previous classical outcomes; the matching upper bound is nonadaptive. Thus joint measurements on at most t samples improve the complexity of algorithms making single-sample measurements by at most a factor sqrt t. Further, measuring order r² samples jointly is necessary and sufficient to attain the unrestricted collective rate. For the lower bound, we vary the support of a state with fixed uniform spectrum and bound the Fisher information trace of every joint measurement on t samples. The adaptive Fisher chain rule and the van Trees inequality then give the trace norm lower bound. For the upper bound, we construct and analyze a nonadaptive tomography protocol based on a Gaussian joint measurement. An explicit second moment identity and a conditional Gaussian law outside the state's support give a rank-dependent error analysis, yielding the matching rate.

articles.title: Black-Box Red Teaming of Agentic AI: A Taxonomy-Driven Framework for Automated Risk Discovery
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic systems are rapidly moving to production, where they read untrusted inputs, call tools with real permissions, and act autonomously, expanding the security surface beyond chat-only models. Yet standard evaluations remain single-turn and fail to capture multi-step agent vulnerabilities. We present a systematic black-box framework for risk-aware agent evaluation requiring only basic system descriptions. Our approach introduces: (1) a seven-domain taxonomy mapping observable behaviors to risk categories, (2) fully automated SAGE-RT red teaming producing 120 adversarial scenarios per domain, and (3) human-validated evaluation using LLM judges. Empirical validation across two agent architectures (CrewAI and AutoGen) with four base models reveals alarming patterns: 56.25% average governance risk, 65% privacy risk in multi-agent configurations, and agent behavior vulnerabilities reaching 85%. Our black-box approach effectively identifies critical architectural vulnerabilities without privileged access, providing a scalable path toward safer agent deployments.

articles.title: AgentAudit: An Open, Extensible Framework for Full-Lifecycle Trust Evaluation of AI Agents
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing evaluation frameworks mostly assess only one part of AI agents, such as task completion (AgentBench) or security robustness (AgentDojo, ASB), rather than the complete pipeline of planning, tool selection, tool execution, memory and reasoning. Failures can occur at any stage, yet existing benchmarks rarely identify their precise source. AgentAudit evaluates the entire execution trace across ten capability, grounding, security and behavioural dimensions, namely instruction integrity, planner, memory, tool selection, tool invocation, tool correctness, alignment, tool faithfulness, security and execution integrity, combined with behavioural classification and failure attribution to pinpoint the exact stage responsible for an observed failure. AgentAudit can evaluate any LLM-based AI agent, since it attaches to the agent instead of replacing it. It reads only the recorded execution trace and does not interfere with how the agent runs, so it places no constraint on the agent's internal implementation. We evaluate five language models (OpenAI GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 5, Sarvam 105B, Llama 3.3 70B and Gemini 2.5 Flash) across nine capability and adversarial tasks. Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5 obtain the highest mean Composite Trust Scores (95.1 and 80.6 out of 100, respectively), while Sarvam 105B, Llama 3.3 70B and Gemini 2.5 Flash trail substantially (57.6, 45.7 and 22.6). All traces were scored by a single fixed judge model, which was itself one of the evaluated models, a limitation discussed in Section VII.E. More importantly, models with similar task-completion behaviour can diverge sharply in trustworthiness, as several non-frontier models are repeatedly classified Unsafe_Compliance on adversarial tasks rather than merely failing them, a distinction that pass/fail benchmarks cannot surface.

articles.title: Scores Alone Do Not Prove Discovery: The Discovery Certification Protocol for Auditing AI Research Agents
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09219v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI research agents combine prior knowledge, public sources, and experimental feedback to produce useful results. The Discovery Certification Protocol (DCP) turns claims about these results into executable recovery and feedback tests. Gate 1 validates useful improvement on sealed evaluation. Gate 2 gives matched agents the registered starting information and observed Web content while withholding the target research history. Every valid method reaching the numerical target supplies a recovery witness and triggers the Core veto. DCP Core requires adequate controls, zero observed recoveries, and a finite-sample bound on recovery in one fresh registered episode. Optional Gate 3 measures the average effect of truthful feedback relative to a specified neutral policy from a shared checkpoint. DCP Evidence adds this effect after independent null calibration and a registered effect margin. Two controlled audits exercise the complete protocol in SQLite optimization and virtual catalyst control under different models. Each produced zero recoveries in 96 episodes, with an upper bound of 0.0468. Each paired study yielded 30 truthful recoveries and zero neutral recoveries, with passing 60-pair null studies. Additional cases exercise Core, recovered, and audit-incomplete decisions. A deterministic, LLM-free verifier reproduces the decisions from frozen evidence. DCP provides a common evidence language for useful outcomes, alternative routes, and feedback effects across AI research.

articles.title: Talking to Itself While Coding: What Makes Comments Help Code Generation?
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09242v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate natural-language comments while writing code, and these comments become part of the context used to generate the code that follows. However, it remains unclear which properties of comments affect code-generation performance. We study this question through observational analyses and controlled interventions. On LiveCodeBench, neither comment frequency nor broad comment intent reliably predicts pass@1. We then prefill weaker recipient models with comment blocks written by stronger source models, allowing us to separate comment surface form from the solution content they convey. Comments from source solutions that pass the tests raise recipient pass@1 by 17.2% on average. In contrast, comments describing failed solutions provide no reliable gain, while comments written for a different problem reduce pass@1 by 20.8%. Finally, across a wide range of models and prompt variants, most recipient models show no significant recovery of the external-comment gain, and the best case recovers only 24%. These results show that comments help code generation not merely because they are comments, but because they can provide correct solution content that prompting cannot reliably elicit.

articles.title: In RAG We Trust? Measuring Robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Under Document Poisoning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09243v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model in retrieved documents, which reduces hallucination but creates a new attack surface: if retrieved text is tampered with, the model may repeat the falsehood. We study how much a small quantized model, Llama 3.1 8B, degrades when a fraction of its retrieved context is poisoned. Three corruption strategies are tested, entity swap, number swap, and negation, each applied to zero, one, two, or three of the three retrieved passages, over a factorial sweep of 588 runs on a fact-checking task built from FEVER. Accuracy falls from 77.9% on clean context to 43.5% when all three passages are corrupted. Entity swap flips the largest share of answers that were correct on clean context. Number-based corruption stays flat while poisoned passages are a minority and jumps once they form a majority, a pattern we re-check with query-level bootstrap intervals. The model rarely invents new falsehoods; its dominant reaction is to abstain, and a lexical overlap proxy of unsupported generation falls under attack rather than rising. The study is a small-scale measurement with coarse automated labels; we treat the strategy contrasts as suggestive until decoding is controlled and stronger adjudication is in place.

articles.title: Improving 5G AI-RAN MCS Selection by Predicting Retransmissions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09324v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Link Adaptation (LA) in 5G NR is inherently reactive, relying on channel measurements and HARQ feedback that may become quickly obsolete when the channel changes quickly. This data is also noisy, making it hard to track accurately, and has to be fed to real-time controllers with feedback-loop effects which are hard to troubleshoot. This explains why most practical deployments select simple but robust algorithms, which accept that the lag can leave the scheduler operating at overly aggressive or unnecessarily conservative rates, trading spectrum efficiency for predictable performance. In this paper, we improve on this status-quo with NOSTRAdAMUS, a predictive LA framework which adds foresight to existing algorithms without replacing or redesigning them. NOSTRAdAMUS predicts whether a retransmission will occur in the next radio frame from recent HARQ history, and applies corrections to the Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) selected by the underlying policy. We benchmark several ML models and show that Gradient Boosting achieves 82.9% accuracy overall with high-confidence interventions that are correct 94.2% of the time, and an inference latency of 5.5 μs. We train the model based on data collected Over-the-Air (OTA) on the X5G testbed, using the open-source OpenAirInterface (OAI) 5G stack, NVIDIA Aerial, and COTS O-RAN Radio Units and User Equipments. The model is then deployed as a dApp, which we evaluate OTA as well as on various channels with hardware-in-the-loop channel emulators. This includes 3GPP TDL and CDL channels, SISO and MIMO configurations, and pedestrian and vehicular mobility. Our evaluation shows that without retraining, and across this variety of scenarios, the dApp augments two SOTA LA algorithms, and increases goodput by up to 71.5% while reducing retransmissions by up to 71.8%. This demonstrates the robustness and generalization capabilities of our approach.

articles.title: An Experimental Evaluation of Multimodal Prompt Injection Attacks on Agentic AI Frameworks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09404v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agentic AI frameworks let a language model plan, keep memory, and call tools that reach real files, mail, and services. Most of these agents also read images, which gives an attacker a way to put text into the agent's context without going through the user. We present MMPIBench, a reproducible benchmark that measures what happens next. It delivers a fixed set of attacks through six visual carriers (OCR text, overlays, EXIF metadata, QR codes, fake interfaces, and hybrids) and records how far each injected instruction travels through the agent, from perception through planning to the tool call. Across 720 runs covering six frameworks, five foundation models, six carriers, and four attacker objectives, attacks complete in approximately 1% of runs but are attempted in 12.8%, and the gap is closed almost entirely at the planning step, where the model reads the injected instruction and declines to act on it. The model matters far more than the framework for whether an instruction is acted on. One model never attempts an attack and recognizes the injection in 59.7% of runs, while two others attempt in 23.6%. We then extend the benchmark to audio, the only other raw perceptual channel current frontier models accept. Only two of the five models ingest audio and only three of the six frameworks deliver it, but where the signal arrives the attack completes in 49% of cells, and in 75% for one model. Reporting completion alone therefore understates exposure, and perceptual channels beyond vision are narrower but much less defended.

articles.title: GANDR: Claim Auditing for Verifiable Legal Answer Generation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10293v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In high-stakes domains such as legal practice, a language-model answer is only useful to the extent that a reader can verify each claim against the source the system cites. Current grounded-generation pipelines score the answer as a whole, so a correct conclusion can rest on fabricated or loosely matched citations and still score well. Closing this gap requires both a system built for per-claim verification and an evaluation that measures it. We introduce GANDR (Grounded ANswer DRafter), a two-agent system in which a Drafter writes an answer in a structured legal-reasoning format and a separate Critic, with the same view as a human verifier, audits each claim against its cited source and emits a per-claim audit trace on every round. We pair it with a strict correctness criterion requiring every citation to resolve to a passage the retriever returned. On a 185-item legal benchmark where all six systems share one backbone, one retrieval surface, and one citation instruction, GANDR ranks first on every primary metric, reaching 70.8% strict accuracy and leading the strongest baseline by 11.3 points (p<0.01). Reverting the protocol-anchored commit rule lowers strict accuracy by 22.7 points, and the strict lead stays positive on three further backbones, at +3.2 to +6.5 points. This lead traces to the Drafter configuration and the protocol-anchored commit, not to rewriting. Against two law-trained annotators the audit flags under-supported claims at F1 0.84 as a binary detector, while its four-way verdict labels agree only weakly and are advisory. Code is available upon request.

articles.title: Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10522v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Foundation vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit broad intelligence about the world, yet translating this intelligence into robot control remains challenging. We present Show-Harness, an Embodied Harness that enables VLMs to "play" robots through a compact semantic interface linking intent to action. Show-Harness exposes discrete semantic action units that VLMs can naturally reason over, while embodiment-specific interpreters deterministically ground them into local robot actions, keeping the VLM directly responsible for fine-grained physical decisions. Through the same interface, Show-Harness demonstrates the feasibility of (1) directly unlocking closed-source frontier VLMs for zero-shot robot control, and (2) adapting small-scale open-source VLMs for low-cost deployment with just a few GPU-hours of fine-tuning. We further develop GUMI (GUI Manipulation Interface), which extends the same semantic action space to GUI-based demonstration collection, allowing humans and agents to "play" robots across embodiments without specialized teleoperation hardware. Extensive experiments show that Show-Harness-equipped VLM agents generalize robustly across tasks, embodiments, and environments, outperforming representative agentic and VLA paradigms. These results suggest that the right interface can unlock substantial embodied capability from foundation VLMs, without requiring additional model capacity or costly embodiment-specific pretraining.

articles.title: FrontierChallenge: Evaluating Scientific Workflow Completion
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24979v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scientific agents increasingly analyze data, execute code, and produce research artifacts, yet most benchmarks emphasize final answers, isolated programs, or a single domain. We introduce FrontierChallenge, a cross-domain benchmark comprising 300 end-to-end scientific workflows. In this paper, we release and evaluate 97 of these tasks, spanning quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, materials characterization, analytical chemistry, life science, and electrochemistry/environment. Each task provides fixed inputs and specifies a bundle of required scientific deliverables. We evaluate twelve frontier models with three agent scaffolds. Pass Rate measures the fraction of tasks satisfying the full-completion criterion, while Avg. Score captures partial progress. Each of the best-performing configurations completed only 20 of the 97 released tasks, yielding a Pass Rate of 20.6%. Partial progress translated especially poorly into complete delivery in analytical chemistry and electrochemistry/environment: Avg. Scores reached 87.6 and 94.9, but the highest Pass Rates were only 4% and 0%. Among non-passing Claude Code trajectories, 75.5% still ended with language claiming completion. Complementary HDS6 process scores correlate strongly with task outcomes, supporting FrontierChallenge as a benchmark of Heavy Duty Solver capabilities. These findings show that neither high partial scores nor confident claims of completion reliably indicate that a scientific task has been fully delivered, highlighting the need to evaluate end-to-end workflow execution and the completeness of scientific deliverables together.

articles.title: Beyond Prompts: Measuring and Optimizing LLM Tool-Agent Harnesses
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05736v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLM tool agents can be improved without retraining by modifying the runtime harness around a fixed model: prompts, tool interfaces, middleware, state handling, and recovery logic. We study this setting as resource-bounded harness selection for fixed-model multi-turn tool agents, with the search surface scoped to prompts and tool-boundary middleware: edits are guarded intercepts at the tool boundary, not arbitrary rewriting of agent execution logic. Our optimizer-agnostic protocol reports mean held-out lift, worst-condition lift, repeatability, logged cost diagnostics, and RelLift95(B), a conservative estimate of the held-out gain of the harness selected under budget B. We instantiate the protocol with prompt-only and prompt-plus-middleware optimizers, including PRISM, which clusters failures and routes repairs to prompt, tool-boundary middleware, or joint edit surfaces within a Pareto search. On BFCL multi-round, tau2-Retail, and tau2-Telecom, PRISM obtains mean held-out lifts of 14.2, 14.9, and 10.1 percentage points and positive empirical RelLift95 on all three benchmarks, and a component ablation attributes the margin chiefly to failure-surface routing and the edit-pattern constraint. Across optimizers, the results show that some search procedures can occasionally find large gains but still choose brittle updates, so the reliability of the chosen harness should be reported alongside average held-out lift.

articles.title: BTBR: A Bayesian-Theory-Driven Probabilistic-Fuzzy Framework for Implicit Bias Removal in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2408.10608v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may encode biased associations from heterogeneous training corpora that are not immediately visible under ordinary prompting, but can surface when the model is steered toward particular demographic personas. Such behavior often manifests not as explicit toxic output, but as systematic performance differences across semantically equivalent tasks, making the resulting bias difficult to detect and mitigate. To address this issue, we formalize the implicit bias problem as persona-induced performance disparity and argue that bias evidence should be treated as a graded signal rather than a binary label. Motivated by this observation, we model biased knowledge as a fuzzy subset equipped with an explicit membership function that reflects the strength of bias evidence for each candidate example. Building on this formulation, we propose Bayesian-Theory-based Bias Removal (BTBR), a hybrid probabilistic-fuzzy framework for identifying and removing latent bias traces from model parameters. BTBR first performs likelihood-ratio screening to measure how strongly candidate samples align with a target biased persona, then converts high-membership samples into structured knowledge triples, and finally applies targeted model editing with a lightweight fuzzy rule scheduler to reduce collateral performance degradation under high entanglement risk. Extensive experiments across multiple bias sources, tasks, model families and editing backends show that BTBR consistently reduces persona-induced performance gaps while preserving general reasoning ability. These results demonstrate that combining probabilistic evidence with fuzzy degree modeling provides an effective and practical approach for mitigating implicit bias in large language models.

articles.title: Robust Fisher-Information Echo Scheduling for Two-Component CPMG NMR Relaxometry Under Uncertain T2 Values: A Computational Study
articles.abstract: Multiexponential transverse-relaxation measurements are sensitive not only to signal-to-noise ratio but also to where the decay is sampled. This computational study develops a robust Fisher-information design for selecting 32 echo/sample times for two-component Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill (CPMG) NMR relaxometry when the short and long T2 values and component fraction are not known in advance. A biexponential signal model was parameterized by amplitude, T2,short, T2,long, and short-component fraction. A 120-member prior ensemble spanning T2,short = 8–35 ms, T2,long approximately 55–300 ms, and fractions 0.15–0.85 was used to construct a greedy robust D-optimal schedule on a 0.4–400 ms candidate raster. The resulting schedule was compared with 32-point linear and logarithmic schedules using Fisher-information metrics and 150-repetition nonlinear Monte Carlo fits in three benchmark regimes at signal-to-noise ratios of 40 and 80. The robust schedule increased the prior-averaged log determinant of the information matrix by 2.41 relative to linear sampling, equivalent to an approximately 11-fold determinant ratio under the common parameter scaling. At SNR 80, robust sampling reduced T2,short relative RMSE from 10.1% to 7.1% in the well-separated case and from 31.9% to 19.4% in the low-short-fraction case. Performance remained difficult when the two relaxation times were close, revealing a fundamental identifiability limitation rather than an optimizer failure. The results provide a reproducible route to acquisition design for sparse or multi-train CPMG relaxometry.

articles.title: Stabilizing Quantum Effects in Open Systems Through Dynamic Coupling Modulation
articles.abstract: This work transforms the quantum frequency converter (QFC) from a passive transducer into an actively controllable quantum interface through dynamic control of its coupling coefficient �(t). While conventional parametric amplifiers are inherently noisy, the QFC represents a fundamental, noiseless limit of quantum parametric interaction. By engineering κ(t) to be time-dependent, we demonstrate that a single modulation waveform achieves what previously required multiple nonlinear components: entanglement generation from initially separable states, suppression of entanglement sudden death, strong photon antibunching, and—remarkably—two-photon blockade without intrinsic nonlinearity, induced purely through temporal control. This work does not merely optimize an existing device—it redefines its function. By showing that a single, experimentally simple modulation can induce nonlinear quantum phenomena in a linear system, stabilize entanglement against decoherence, and provide exact analytical control, we establish dynamic coupling modulation as a new paradigm for quantum state engineering in any bilinear, parametrically driven platform.

articles.title: Research on Electrochemical-Mechanical Composite Polishing Electrode Design and Process Testing of 316 Stainless Steel Deep Long Holes
articles.abstract: In order to the problem of poor surface quality in the mechanical polishing of deep and long holes in 316 stainless steel, this paper proposes an electrochemical-mechanical hybrid polishing method. A mathematical model of the electrochemical-mechanical composite polishing electrode is established, and a simulation study on the hybrid polishing electrode for deep and long holes is carried out based on the optimization of the proportion of electrochemically active interfaces. The design of the electrochemical-mechanical hybrid polishing electrode for deep and long holes in stainless steel is completed. Under the process parameters of a voltage of 3.25V, polishing pressure of 0.08MPa, electrode rotational speed of 564r/min, and polishing time of 144s, the surface roughness of 316 stainless steel deep and long holes with a length of 80 mm and inner diameter of 3.5mm is improved from Ra3.2µm to Ra0.1µm.

articles.title: Storms Under Water: Wind-driven impacts on a north temperate deep stratified lake
articles.abstract: Lake Champlain is a deep, temperate freshwater lake that experiences summer stratification, which limits interactions between surface and deep waters. Wind-induced storms disrupt this phenomenon by altering thermal stability. We collected high-frequency vertical temperature profiles in Lake Champlain’s Main Lake segment during the warm seasons 2016-2025 in 50 m water. We estimated the frequency, timing, and intensity of thermal changes in the water column and classified them into five severity levels (Level 1-5). From 2016 to 2025, a total of 77 storms exceeded an epilimnion depth of 25m between July 15 and September 15. These events occurred five to ten times each fall, with the highest frequency in 2018 with the occurrence of ten storms. The lowest frequency occurred in 2024 with just five events, however they were mainly intense storms (Levels 3-5). Each storm exhibited distinct dynamics likely influenced by variations in wind forcing and stratification strength. Combining storm detections and classifications with nearby wind observations, we compiled a mean state of storm levels (i.e., Level 1-5) and created level-specific metrics. Wind forcing and epilimnion response occurred faster at the onset than during their respective recovery. Levels 4 and 5 were shown to be strong enough to temporarily collapse the metalimnion below the stratification threshold, consistent with localized turbulent entrainment (LTE). These findings establish a baseline for characterizing storm-induced thermal disturbances and suggest that seiche or internal wave activity may contribute to subsurface impacts that continue after surface wind forcing has weakened or dissipated.

articles.title: Winding feature and thermal evolution of the gapped Dirac magnons in CrI₃
articles.abstract: Author(s): Weiliang Yao, Matthew B. Stone, Colin L. Sarkis, Yi Li, Ruixian Liu, Xingye Lu, and Pengcheng Dai Here, the authors use inelastic neutron scattering to investigate gapped Dirac magnons in the van der Waals ferromagnet CrI 3 . With high-quality single crystals, they directly resolve the characteristic winding of magnon spectral weight around the K point of the hexagonal Brillouin zone, which provides a key signature of Dirac magnons. The authors further show that the magnon energies exhibit an approximately T 2 thermal renormalization, consistent with magnon-magnon interactions. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 134413] Published Thu Sep 10, 2026

articles.title: Vestigial nematic order at zero temperature in two-dimensional frustrated quantum antiferromagnets
articles.abstract: Author(s): Matthew C. O'Brien and Eduardo Fradkin Recent numerical advances have renewed interest in the two-dimensional quantum J 1 - J 3 Heisenberg antiferromagnet, but a detailed analytical theory has remained lacking. Here, the authors apply a semiclassical effective field theory and large- N analysis. They show that previously overlooked interactions stabilize a quantum vestigial nematic phase at zero temperature, where discrete rotational symmetry is spontaneously broken despite the loss of long-range antiferromagnetic spiral order. This phase continues the known finite-temperature nematic phase, reflecting enhanced quantum fluctuations near the classical Lifshitz point. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 134414] Published Thu Sep 10, 2026

articles.title: Three-dimensional zigzag correlations in the van der Waals Kitaev magnet RuBr₃
articles.abstract: Author(s): H. Gretarsson, R. Iwazaki, F. Sato, H. Gotou, S. Francoual, J. Nasu, Y. Imai, K. Ohgushi, J. Chaloupka, B. Keimer, and H. Suzuki Van der Waals materials can be exfoliated into ultrathin sheets, suggesting that their magnetism should also be two-dimensional. Using resonant x-ray scattering, the authors reveal here a different picture in the Kitaev magnet RuBr 3 : zigzag magnetic correlations exhibit spectral weight redistribution along the interlayer direction. Bromine’s spatially extended 4 p orbitals strengthen interlayer magnetic interactions. The results demonstrate that an exfoliable crystal can host three-dimensional magnetism, challenging a common assumption about layered quantum materials and showing how ligand chemistry controls magnetic dimensionality. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L140404] Published Thu Sep 10, 2026

articles.title: Distinguishing apparent and hidden altermagnetism via uniaxial strain in CsV₂Te₂O
articles.abstract: Author(s): San-Dong Guo, Cheng-Xiang Chai, Dun-Cheng Liang, Feng-Ren Fan, and Yang Liu Hidden altermagnetism was theoretically proposed and then experimentally confirmed in the metal Cs₁−δV₂Te₂O, which exhibits two nearly degenerate ground-state magnetic configurations (C type and G type), corresponding, respectively, to apparen… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 144412] Published Thu Sep 10, 2026
articles.focus_summary: 该研究通过理论分析和实验结果，区分Cs₁−δV₂Te₂O中的表观交替磁性与隐藏交替磁性。研究指出，单轴应变能够调控两种近简并磁性基态及其相关的磁性响应。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的交替磁性、磁性材料、非共线磁性、应变工程和磁性拓扑性质研究高度相关。其利用应变区分不同磁性构型的思路可用于设计可调控自旋电子学材料。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步计算应变调控下的自旋分裂、磁各向异性、输运性质和拓扑表面态，并建立相应的自旋哈密顿量或有效模型。建议关注两种磁性构型的能量差、对称性判据和实验可观测信号。

articles.title: Hidden ferroelectric chiral ground state of silver niobate
articles.abstract: Author(s): Safari Amisi, Fernando Gómez-Ortiz, Eric Bousquet, and Philippe Ghosez Silver niobate is a conventional perovskite oxide compound, known to exhibit a rich polymorphism. Although often classified as antiferroelectric, its low-temperature structure remains unclear. Here, first-principles calculations reveal a previously overlooked and unusual rhombohedral ferroelectric p… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 154106] Published Thu Sep 10, 2026
articles.focus_summary: 该研究利用第一性原理计算研究银铌酸盐的低温结构和多晶型行为。结果发现其可能存在此前未被充分认识的菱方铁电手性基态，从而修正了其传统反铁电分类。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的铁电、多铁、钙钛矿氧化物、极化和对称性分析方向直接相关。铁电手性基态及其与反铁电相之间的竞争，对研究极化翻转、相变和畴结构具有参考意义。

articles.title: Predicting methane and nitrogen adsorption in ZSM-5 and FAU-13X zeolites with a SAFT-VR-Mie classical density functional theory
articles.abstract: We present a classical density functional theory (cDFT) framework based on the SAFT-VR-Mie equation of state for the prediction of gas adsorption in zeolitic materials, using a fully three-dimensional atomistic external potential built directly from crystallographic data. The approach is applied to methane and nitrogen adsorption in two structurally and chemically distinct zeolites: the high-silica ZSM-5 and the cation-rich FAU-13X; with a single fluid–oxygen interaction parameter calibrated on one experimental high-loading point, the model accurately reproduces methane adsorption isotherms over the full pressure range and at three temperatures (273, 313, and 363 K). The same calibration scheme transfers without further adjustment from cation-free to Na-exchanged frameworks and from ZSM-5 to FAU-13X, demonstrating the transferability of the parameters across temperatures, fluids, and zeolite structures. Isosteric heats of adsorption and Henry’s law constants derived from the simulated isotherms are consistent with experimental values. Nitrogen adsorption in cation-rich FAU-13X is, however, systematically underestimated; we discuss this limitation in light of the spherical, electroneutral monomeric assumptions inherent to the current SAFT-VR-Mie parameterization. The combination of SAFT-VR-Mie cDFT with realistic three-dimensional external potentials provides a transferable, computationally efficient, and physically rigorous foundation for adsorption modeling in nanoporous materials.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Effective theory of quantum phases in the dipolar planar rotor chain
articles.abstract: In this work, we develop a theoretical description of the collective behavior of interacting dipolar planar rotors by using time independent perturbation theory and a small angle quadratic approximation. The ground state properties of both the ordered and disordered quantum phases of the system are directly calculated and analyzed. Time-independent perturbation theory is shown to be appropriate for the disordered phase. For the ordered phase, we construct a quadratic approximation based on the stable equilibrium configurations of the dipolar ordering; we show that the inclusion of the quartic terms from the expansion of the potential energy is essential to correct the shift in the energy spectrum due to quantization ambiguities. Numerical techniques such as exact diagonalization and density matrix renormalization group are used to benchmark the quality of both approximations.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Homogenized spin–charge transport in random heterogeneous chiral molecular media
articles.abstract: We formulate an effective-medium theory for scale-separated bulk diffusive or hopping spin–charge transport in random heterogeneous chiral media. Starting from a supplied steady, local, open-system linear-response law for a four-component charge–spin voltage field, periodic or stationary-ergodic cell problems give deterministic homogenized coefficients while preserving positivity and Onsager–Casimir reciprocity. The effective charge–spin blocks describe convention-qualified bulk conversion after disorder, tortuosity, current focusing, and orientational averaging; terminal lead fluxes, absorbed angular momentum, spin accumulation, and detector voltages additionally require specified boundary conditions. For a rank-one longitudinal path ansatz, the weak-contrast coefficient along film normal n is proportional to OCISS(n)=χ(p⋅n)3. Random positions can therefore support longitudinal conversion, whereas isotropic orientations and head-tail-symmetric nematic order cancel this rank-one contribution even in an enantiopure medium. A one-dimensional bulk-film solution gives the internal spin–charge fields and terminal fluxes for specified contacts. Spin accumulation is odd under reversal of the reciprocal chirality-induced spin selectivity coefficient, whereas the passive scalar two-terminal conductance correction is even for the nonmagnetic spin-diagonal boundary problem considered here.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Time-resolved investigation of photocatalytic allene deracemization with kinetic modeling and force-field-based molecular dynamics
articles.abstract: Chiral thioxanthones were shown to be promising energy transfer catalysts for the photoinduced catalysis of organic molecules. In recent years, they were successfully applied in photocatalytic deracemization and kinetic resolution reactions with high enantiomeric excess rates. Previous computational investigations focused on static investigation mostly using density functional theory. In this study, we use force field-based molecular dynamics to explore the dissociation dynamics of a photocatalyst–substrate complex comprised of a primary allene amide (substrate) and a functionalized chiral thioxanthone (catalyst). Leveraging the quantum mechanically derived force-field framework enables the efficient simulation of the molecules in the ground and excited states. We derive kinetic parameters for the complex dissociation and use them in a kinetic reaction model. Our study indicates that the experimentally observed temperature optimum results from a different temperature dependence of the photoinduced energy transfer and the dissociation and association processes of the substrate–catalyst complexes.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

This article reviews the major advances since the previous overview in 2020, covering new modules and methodology, infrastructure changes, and performance benchmarks.

articles.title: Atomistic framework for glassy polymer viscoelasticity across twenty frequency decades
articles.abstract: Glassy polymers are central to engineering applications, yet their viscoelastic response over broad frequency and temperature ranges remains difficult to characterize. We extend non-affine deformation theory by incorporating a time-dependent memory kernel within the generalized Langevin equation for atomistic non-affine motions, yielding frequency-dependent mechanical response. Applied to poly(methyl methacrylate), the method captures the shear modulus and relaxation spectrum over more than twenty decades of frequency, from hundreds of terahertz to the millihertz regime, thus bridging polymer mechanics from ordinary to extreme scales. Our predictions show quantitative consistency with independent estimates from oscillatory-shear molecular dynamics, Brillouin scattering, ultrasonic spectroscopy, split-Hopkinson testing, and dynamic mechanical analysis, thereby demonstrating a unified theoretical–computational route for multiscale characterization of polymer glasses.

articles.title: Rotation-Induced Electron Flow as a Driver of Localized Magnetic Activity in Neutron Star Surface Layers
articles.title_zh: 旋转诱导的电子流：中子星表层局域磁活动的驱动机制
articles.abstract: Neutron stars are highly magnetized, rapidly rotating compact remnants produced primarily through the core collapse of massive stars. In this study, the impact of neutron star rotation on the surface magnetic structure through rotation-driven electron flow and its resulting local magnetic activity is investigated using magnetohydrodynamic equations. Specifically, an analytical formulation, complemented by numerical methods, is developed to derive the rotation-induced toroidal component and resulting effective surface magnetic fields, accounting for electron degeneracy pressure, gravitational, centrifugal, Lorentz and Coriolis forces. The results show that the local radial electron current density decreases radially. Furthermore, rotation-driven electron current generates additional local magnetic components that modify the surface field distribution . Consequently, the effective surface magnetic field exhibits distinct latitudinal variations relative to the unperturbed field. This redistribution may provide a physical pathway to create magnetic interaction zones and emphasizes the crucial role of rotation in producing surface magnetic anisotropy and localized magnetic activities, such as micro-flares, bursts, and hotspots. Ultimately, our model provides an analytical framework for investigating the role of rotation-driven electron transport in neutron star surface magnetic evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用磁流体动力学方程，探讨中子星旋转通过驱动电子流影响表面磁结构并产生局域磁活动的机制。结果表明，旋转驱动的电子电流会引入额外的局域磁场分量，改变表面磁场分布并产生明显的纬度差异。该机制可能为微耀斑、爆发和热点等局域磁活动的形成提供物理途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中子星是主要由大质量恒星核心坍缩产生的、具有强磁场并快速旋转的致密遗迹。在本研究中，利用磁流体动力学方程，研究了中子星旋转通过旋转驱动的电子流及其所产生的局域磁活动对表面磁结构的影响。具体而言，研究建立了一个结合数值方法的解析模型，用于推导旋转诱导的环向分量及其产生的有效表面磁场，并考虑了电子简并压、引力、离心力、洛伦兹力和科里奥利力。结果表明，局域径向电子电流密度随半径增加而减小。此外，旋转驱动的电子电流会产生额外的局域磁场分量，从而改变表面磁场分布。因此，相对于未受扰动的磁场，有效表面磁场表现出明显的纬度变化。这种重新分布可能为形成磁相互作用区域提供物理途径，并凸显旋转在产生表面磁各向异性和局域磁活动，如微耀斑、爆发和热点方面的关键作用。最终，本模型为研究旋转驱动的电子输运在中子星表面磁场演化中的作用提供了一个解析框架。

articles.title: Fluctuation-Free Quadrature and Thermodynamic Response Functions
articles.title_zh: 无涨落求积与热力学响应函数
articles.abstract: The fluctuationlessness theorem replaces the matrix representation of an operator-valued function f(hat t) by f evaluated at the truncated matrix representation of hat t, discarding the emphfluctuation terms; the resulting one-node-to-n-node hierarchy is a quadrature-like rule for expectation-value integrals. We give this construction a classical statistical-thermodynamic reading. The n-node fluctuation-free estimate of an ensemble average coincides with the n-point Gauss quadrature generated by the moments of the ensemble measure, hence it reproduces the first 2n moments---the cumulants to order 2n-1---exactly. Three consequences follow: the single node is the mean-field limit; the leading discarded fluctuation term is the energy variance and therefore the isochoric heat capacity, so that the truncation error of the estimator is itself a physical response function; and each further node restores one more cumulant/response order. We confirm the picture on solvable models and then use it in two ways. First, coupling the fluctuation-free rule with a cut High Dimensional Model Representation turns one high-dimensional configurational integral into O(d²) two-dimensional ones, with order-by-order convergence and polynomial cost. Second, on the Curie--Weiss model the geometric convergence rate of the estimator degrades once the free-energy functional develops degenerate maxima, so the loss of convergence tracks the ferromagnetic transition. We illustrate the approach on the anharmonic vibrational heat capacity of a model molecule, where it reproduces a full-tensor reference and, being deterministic, furnishes response functions that stochastic estimators handle poorly. The underlying quadrature identity is classical; the contribution is the thermodynamic dictionary and its high-dimensional deployment. Mathematics Subject Classification 65D32 · 82B05 · 41A55 · 82-08
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将无涨落定理置于经典统计热力学框架下进行解释，指出其n节点估计等同于由系综测度矩生成的n点高斯求积，并能精确再现前2n个矩。该方法表明，单节点近似对应平均场极限，而被舍弃的首项涨落与能量方差及定容热容直接相关。研究还将该规则用于高维构型积分和居里–外斯模型，展示了其在降低计算成本、刻画铁磁相变及计算分子振动热容方面的作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无涨落定理用在截断矩阵表示中对算符值函数f(t帽)的求值，替代了对算符值函数的矩阵表示，并舍弃其中的“涨落项”；由此得到的从单节点到n节点的层级结构，是一种类似求积的期望值积分规则。本文赋予这一构造以经典统计热力学解释。系综平均的n节点无涨落估计等同于由系综测度的矩生成的n点高斯求积，因此能够精确再现前2n个矩，即精确再现至2n−1阶的累积量。由此得到三个结果：单节点情形是平均场极限；被舍弃的首个主导涨落项是能量方差，因而也是定容热容，所以估计器的截断误差本身就是一个物理响应函数；每增加一个节点，就会恢复一个更高阶的累积量或响应阶次。我们在可解析求解的模型上验证了这一图景，随后从两个方面加以应用。首先，将无涨落规则与截断的高维模型表示相结合，可以把一个高维构型积分转化为数量为O(d²)的二维积分，并实现逐阶收敛和多项式计算成本。其次，在居里–外斯模型中，一旦自由能泛函形成退化极大值，估计器的几何收敛速率就会降低，因此收敛性的丧失能够追踪铁磁相变。我们还以一个模型分子的非简谐振动热容为例进行说明；该方法再现了完整张量参考结果，并且由于具有确定性，能够提供随机估计器难以准确处理的响应函数。其基础求积恒等式是经典的；本文的贡献在于建立热力学对应关系，并将其应用于高维问题。数学学科分类：65D32·82B05·41A55·82-08。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning Framework for Rapid Aerodynamic Prediction of Trailing-Edge Morphing Airfoils at Low Reynolds Numbers
articles.title_zh: 低雷诺数下后缘变形翼型快速气动预测的物理信息机器学习框架
articles.abstract: Trailing-edge morphing airfoils with parabolic camber profiles offer superior aerodynamic performance over conventional hinged surfaces, yet Reynolds-Averaged Navier–Stokes (RANS) simulation cost constrains design-space exploration to sparse grids. This study validates a physics-informed machine learning (PIML) surrogate framework trained on 456 ANSYS Fluent cases spanning two morphing architectures — Parabolic Flap (PF) and Traditional Flap (TF) — across three TEMA configurations (50:50, 60:40, 70:30 chord ratios), a NACA 2412 baseline, eight angles of attack (− 3° to + 18°), four deflection angles (0°–15°), and three Reynolds numbers (1.91×10⁵–3.18×10⁵). Four surrogate architectures — Random Forest, Gradient Boosting (GB), Multilayer Perceptron, and Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) — simultaneously predict lift, drag, pitching moment, lift-to-drag ratio, and five surface pressure metrics. Physics-informed feature engineering incorporating trigonometric angle-of-attack decomposition and a dimensionless δ²/Re interaction term reduces prediction error by up to 18%. The GB surrogate achieves cl R² = 0.974 (5-fold CV: 0.974 ± 0.007), while GPR provides calibrated 95% confidence intervals identifying post-stall regimes as maximum-uncertainty zones. Design-space maps at zero CFD cost confirm PF universally outperforms TF; PF TEMA 50:50 achieves l/d = 184.6 versus 124.2 for TF at Re = 3.18×10⁵, with surrogate evaluation completing in under two seconds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并验证了一个物理信息机器学习代理框架，用于快速预测低雷诺数后缘变形翼型的气动性能。该框架基于456个ANSYS Fluent算例，比较了随机森林、梯度提升、多层感知器和高斯过程回归四种模型，并同时预测升力、阻力、俯仰力矩、升阻比及表面压力指标。结果表明，物理信息特征工程可使预测误差最多降低18%，梯度提升模型具有较高精度，高斯过程回归则能识别后失速高不确定性区域；设计空间分析显示，抛物线襟翼在所研究条件下普遍优于传统襟翼。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有抛物线弯度分布的后缘变形翼型相比传统铰接式舵面具有更优的气动性能，但雷诺平均纳维–斯托克斯方程（RANS）模拟的成本限制了设计空间只能采用稀疏网格进行探索。本研究验证了一个物理信息机器学习（PIML）代理框架，该框架基于456个ANSYS Fluent算例，覆盖两种变形结构——抛物线襟翼（PF）和传统襟翼（TF）——三种TEMA构型（弦长比50:50、60:40和70:30）、一个NACA 2412基准翼型、八个攻角（−3°至+18°）、四个偏转角（0°–15°）以及三个雷诺数（1.91×10⁵–3.18×10⁵）。四种代理模型架构——随机森林、梯度提升（GB）、多层感知器和高斯过程回归（GPR）——同时预测升力、阻力、俯仰力矩、升阻比以及五项表面压力指标。融入攻角三角分解和无量纲δ²/Re交互项的物理信息特征工程，最多可使预测误差降低18%。GB代理模型达到C_L的R²=0.974（五折交叉验证为0.974±0.007），而GPR能够提供经过校准的95%置信区间，并将后失速状态识别为不确定性最大的区域。在无需CFD计算成本的情况下生成的设计空间图表明，PF在所有研究条件下均优于TF；在Re=3.18×10⁵时，PF TEMA 50:50的升阻比达到184.6，而TF为124.2，且代理模型评估在两秒以内完成。

articles.title: Accessibility, Infrastructure, and Systemic Failures in the 2025 Altadena (Eaton) Wildfire: A Wildland–Urban Interface Analysis of Emergency Evacuation Systems
articles.title_zh: 2025年阿尔塔迪纳（伊顿）野火中的可达性、基础设施与系统性失效：野地–城市交界区应急疏散系统分析
articles.abstract: The 2025 Altadena (Eaton) wildfire in Los Angeles County represents a critical case study in wildland–urban interface (WUI) disaster vulnerability, highlighting systemic deficiencies in evacuation infrastructure, accessibility planning, and governance. The event demonstrates how physical hazards, when combined with constrained road networks, limited accessibility integration, and emergency-response challenges, can disproportionately affect vulnerable populations. This study employs a mixed-methods case-study approach incorporating GIS-supported spatial analysis, conceptual–semi-empirical evacuation modeling, accessibility analysis, regulatory comparison, and review of government, agency, media, and documentary survivor accounts. Findings indicate that the Eaton Fire exposed weaknesses in: 1) Evacuation-route redundancy, 2) Emergency communication, 3) Accessibility integration, and 4) Coordination among interdependent systems. Applicable California and Los Angeles County requirements are distinguished from model codes and later standards used only as comparative resilience benchmarks. The findings identify a community-scale coordination gap among independently administered life-safety systems and support the proposed Accessible Wildfire Evacuation Model (AWEM), an integrated framework linking wildfire exposure, evacuation infrastructure, emergency communication, accessibility, and emergency-response coordination to improve equitable WUI evacuation resilience.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以2025年洛杉矶县阿尔塔迪纳（伊顿）野火为案例，分析野地–城市交界区灾害脆弱性及疏散系统中的基础设施、可达性规划和治理缺陷。研究采用混合方法，结合GIS空间分析、概念性半经验疏散建模、可达性分析、法规比较以及多来源幸存者叙述。结果揭示了疏散路线冗余、应急通信、无障碍整合和跨系统协调方面的不足，并提出将火灾暴露、疏散基础设施、通信、可达性与应急协调相连接的可达性野火疏散模型，以提升公平的野地–城市交界区疏散韧性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 2025年洛杉矶县阿尔塔迪纳（伊顿）野火是研究野地–城市交界区（WUI）灾害脆弱性的一个关键案例，凸显了疏散基础设施、可达性规划和治理方面的系统性缺陷。该事件表明，当物理灾害与受限的道路网络、有限的可达性整合以及应急响应挑战相结合时，脆弱人群可能受到不成比例的影响。本研究采用混合方法案例研究，结合GIS支持的空间分析、概念性半经验疏散建模、可达性分析、法规比较，以及对政府、机构、媒体资料和幸存者纪录叙述的审查。研究结果表明，伊顿大火暴露出以下方面的弱点：1）疏散路线冗余；2）应急通信；3）可达性整合；4）相互依赖系统之间的协调。研究将适用的加利福尼亚州和洛杉矶县要求，与仅作为韧性比较基准使用的示范性规范及后续标准区分开来。研究结果识别出由分别管理的生命安全系统之间缺乏社区尺度协调所造成的差距，并支持提出可达性野火疏散模型（AWEM）。该综合框架将野火暴露、疏散基础设施、应急通信、可达性和应急响应协调联系起来，以改善野地–城市交界区疏散的公平性与韧性。

articles.title: Adaptive and accuracy-aware multiple data assimilation in a three step framework
articles.title_zh: 三步框架中的自适应且精度感知的多重数据同化
articles.abstract: The ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation (ES-MDA) is an algorith-mic framework for the ensemble-based solution of inverse problems in reservoir engineering (and beyond). ES-MDA gradually transitions a prior ensemble to a posterior ensemble. The details of how this transition, or “multiple data assimilation ,” is implemented defines the accuracy and computational cost of ES-MDA. We show that many popular, adaptive variants of ES-MDA can be understood within a simple three-step framework: inflation proposal, pre-analysis revision, and post-analysis revision. The three steps interact to resolve a trade-off between accuracy (many assimilations with small updates) and efficiency (few assimilations with large updates), inherent to ES-MDA. We then present a new adaptive and accuracy-aware method, ES-MDA-A2, that combines large updates with a “catch-up” mechanism that decreases the update size allowing for additional assimilations if the accuracy is low. ES-MDA-A2 requires only two inputs: a targeted accuracy and a maximum number of data assimilations. We test existing and new ES-MDA variants in systematic numerical experiments with a toy model, two electromagnetic inversions with field data, and a subsurface flow reservoir simulation. We find that ES-MDA-A2 resolves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off differently from existing methods, leading to accurate inversions at a reasonable computational cost in all experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将带多重数据同化的集合平滑器（ES-MDA）的多种自适应变体统一理解为一个三步框架：膨胀提议、分析前修正和分析后修正。作者提出了新的自适应精度感知方法ES-MDA-A2，通过较大更新与“追赶”机制相结合，在精度不足时减小更新步长并增加同化次数。针对玩具模型、含实测数据的电磁反演和地下流体储层模拟的实验表明，该方法能够以合理计算成本获得准确反演。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 带多重数据同化的集合平滑器（ES-MDA）是一种基于集合求解反问题的算法框架，应用于储层工程及其他领域。ES-MDA逐步将先验集合过渡为后验集合。如何实施这一过渡，即“多重数据同化”，决定了ES-MDA的精度和计算成本。我们表明，许多流行的ES-MDA自适应变体都可以在一个简单的三步框架内得到理解：膨胀提议、分析前修正和分析后修正。这三个步骤相互作用，用于解决ES-MDA固有的精度与效率权衡，即许多次小幅更新与少数几次大幅更新之间的权衡。随后，我们提出一种新的自适应且精度感知的方法ES-MDA-A2，该方法将大幅更新与一种“追赶”机制相结合；当精度不足时，该机制会减小更新幅度，从而允许进行更多次同化。ES-MDA-A2只需要两个输入：目标精度和数据同化的最大次数。我们在系统性数值实验中测试了现有及新提出的ES-MDA变体，实验对象包括一个玩具模型、两个使用现场数据的电磁反演问题，以及一个地下流体储层模拟。我们发现，ES-MDA-A2以不同于现有方法的方式解决了精度–效率权衡问题，并在所有实验中以合理的计算成本实现了准确反演。

articles.title: Selective Removal of Organoarsenic Species and Aromatic Amine Compounds from Industrial Wastewater Using a Periwinkle Shell-Derived Chitosan–Lemon Waste Biofunctionalized Composite
articles.title_zh: 利用滨螺壳源壳聚糖–柠檬废弃物生物功能化复合材料选择性去除工业废水中的有机砷物种和芳香胺化合物
articles.abstract: Organoarsenic species and aromatic amines are toxicologically significant industrial wastewater pollutants that have been comparatively neglected as chitosan-graft target contaminants relative to dyes, heavy metals, and phthalates. This study valorised two co-located agro-industrial waste streams, periwinkle shell and lemon fruit waste, into a chitosan–lemon waste graft (CLWG) and evaluated its performance against real textile-associated industrial effluent from Kaduna, Nigeria. Chitosan was extracted from periwinkle shells and grafted with citric-acid-treated lemon waste; unmodified chitosan and the CLWG were characterised by scanning electron microscopy with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDX) and attenuated total reflectance Fourier-transform infrared (ATR-FTIR) spectroscopy, and applied in batch trials at 0.5 g and 1.0 g doses over 4 h and 8 h contact times. SEM revealed a marked shift from the compact, fine-grained morphology of unmodified chitosan to a coarser, more heterogeneous, and porous surface after grafting, and EDX confirmed successful modification through the emergence of nitrogen (0.00 to 4.65 atomic %) alongside a sharp decline in calcium (78.22 to 2.21 atomic %), consistent with exposure of the chitosan-derived phase and leaching of the native shell mineral during synthesis. ATR-FTIR showed new carbonyl and altered glycosidic bands after grafting, and further band splitting and new low-frequency features after adsorption, indicating direct functional-group involvement in pollutant binding. Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry identified an aromatic amine (benzenamine, 2,6-diethyl-), a nitrosated aniline derivative, and an arsenous acid trimethylsilyl ester in the untreated effluent; all three were undetectable at every tested CLWG dose and contact time, while two transient nitrogen-containing aromatic byproducts observed only at the lowest dose and shortest contact time were themselves absent by 8 h or at the 1 g dose. These findings indicate that a low-cost, dual-agro-waste-valorised chitosan graft can achieve apparent complete removal of both organoarsenic and aromatic amine pollutant classes from real industrial wastewater, supporting its potential as a circular-economy remediation strategy for resource-limited settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究将滨螺壳和柠檬果废弃物两种农业工业废物流转化为壳聚糖–柠檬废弃物接枝物（CLWG），并评估其处理尼日利亚卡杜纳纺织相关工业废水的性能。表征结果显示，接枝使壳聚糖表面变得更粗糙、非均质且多孔，并引入了新的官能团。气相色谱–质谱分析发现，未经处理废水中的芳香胺、亚硝基化苯胺衍生物和亚砷酸三甲基硅酯，在所有测试剂量和接触时间下均无法检出，表明该低成本复合材料具有同时去除有机砷和芳香胺污染物的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 与染料、重金属和邻苯二甲酸酯相比，有机砷物种和芳香胺是工业废水中具有重要毒理学意义、但作为壳聚糖接枝目标污染物受到相对忽视的污染物。本研究将两种来源相近的农业工业废物流——滨螺壳和柠檬果废弃物——资源化制备为壳聚糖–柠檬废弃物接枝物（CLWG），并评估其对尼日利亚卡杜纳市真实纺织相关工业废水的处理性能。研究从滨螺壳中提取壳聚糖，并将其与经柠檬酸处理的柠檬废弃物进行接枝；随后使用扫描电子显微镜–能量色散X射线光谱（SEM-EDX）和衰减全反射傅里叶变换红外光谱（ATR-FTIR）对未改性壳聚糖和CLWG进行表征，并在0.5 g和1.0 g投加量以及4 h和8 h接触时间下开展批量实验。SEM结果显示，接枝后材料由未改性壳聚糖紧密、细颗粒状的形貌明显转变为更粗糙、更不均质且具有孔隙的表面；EDX通过氮元素的出现（原子百分比由0.00升至4.65%）以及钙元素的大幅下降（由78.22%降至2.21%），证实了改性成功。这与壳聚糖来源相的暴露以及合成过程中原生壳矿物质的浸出相一致。ATR-FTIR显示，接枝后出现了新的羰基峰，糖苷键相关谱带发生改变；吸附后进一步出现谱带分裂和新的低频特征，表明官能团直接参与了污染物结合。气相色谱–质谱分析在未经处理的废水中鉴定出一种芳香胺（2,6-二乙基苯胺）、一种亚硝基化苯胺衍生物和一种亚砷酸三甲基硅酯；在所有测试的CLWG剂量和接触时间下，这三种物质均无法检出，而仅在最低剂量和最短接触时间下观察到的两种短暂含氮芳香副产物，在8 h时或采用1 g剂量时也已消失。这些结果表明，这种由两类农业废弃物资源化制备的低成本壳聚糖接枝物，能够从真实工业废水中实现有机砷和芳香胺两类污染物表观上的完全去除，支持其作为资源受限地区循环经济型修复策略的应用潜力。

articles.title: Dynamically Tunable Electromagnetically Induced Transparency in a Vanadium-Dioxide-Based Terahertz Metasurface
articles.title_zh: 基于二氧化钒的太赫兹超表面中动态可调的电磁诱导透明
articles.abstract: A dynamically tunable terahertz (THz) electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) metasurface integrated with vanadium dioxide (VO2) is proposed and numerically investigated. The unit cell comprises gold resonators and VO2 strips patterned on a silicon dioxide substrate. When VO2 is in the insulating state (σ = 2×102 S/m), the bright resonator is directly excited by the incident THz wave, while the dark resonator is indirectly activated through near-field coupling. Destructive interference between these coupled modes generates a pronounced EIT transparency window at approximately 0.72 THz with a peak transmission of 0.82. The underlying mode-coupling mechanism is corroborated by electric-field distributions and a coupled Lorentz-oscillator model, which exhibits excellent agreement with full-wave simulations. As VO2 undergoes an insulator-to-metal transition (σ = 2×105 S/m), the dramatically increased conductivity reconstructs the surface current distribution and enhances ohmic losses in the dark mode, thereby disrupting the phase-matching condition required for EIT. Consequently, the original transparency window is suppressed, and the spectral response is reconfigured into a broad transmission band near 0.50 THz. Furthermore, the metasurface exhibits tunable slow-light characteristics, achieving a maximum group delay of approximately 5–6 ps in the insulating state. Parametric analysis reveals that the VO2 gap length critically governs the coupling strength and resonance position. Owing to its simple geometry, wideband tunability, and dynamic control of both amplitude and dispersion, the proposed VO2-integrated metasurface offers a promising platform for reconfigurable THz modulators, optical switches, filters, and slow-light devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并数值研究了一种集成二氧化钒（VO2）的动态可调太赫兹电磁诱导透明超表面。VO2在绝缘态时，明、暗谐振器通过近场耦合产生约0.72 THz的明显透明窗口；转变为金属态后，电流分布和损耗改变使EIT被抑制，并形成约0.50 THz附近的宽透射带。该结构还表现出可调慢光特性，适用于可重构太赫兹调制器、开关、滤波器和慢光器件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出并数值研究了一种集成二氧化钒（VO2）的动态可调太赫兹（THz）电磁诱导透明（EIT）超表面。该单元结构由图案化在二氧化硅衬底上的金谐振器和VO2条带组成。当VO2处于绝缘态（σ=2×10² S/m）时，明谐振器由入射太赫兹波直接激发，而暗谐振器通过近场耦合被间接激活。这些耦合模式之间的相消干涉在约0.72 THz处产生一个显著的EIT透明窗口，峰值透射率为0.82。电场分布和耦合洛伦兹振子模型证实了其潜在的模耦合机制，该模型与全波仿真结果高度一致。随着VO2发生绝缘体—金属转变（σ=2×10⁵ S/m），显著增加的电导率重构了表面电流分布，并增强了暗模中的欧姆损耗，从而破坏了EIT所需的相位匹配条件。因此，原有透明窗口被抑制，光谱响应被重构为0.50 THz附近的宽透射带。此外，该超表面表现出可调慢光特性，在绝缘态下实现了约5–6 ps的最大群时延。参数分析表明，VO2间隙长度对耦合强度和谐振位置具有关键控制作用。由于其几何结构简单、宽带可调性以及对振幅和色散的动态控制能力，所提出的VO2集成超表面为可重构太赫兹调制器、光开关、滤波器和慢光器件提供了一个有前景的平台。

articles.title: Machine Learning‐Guided Elucidation of Spacer‐Dependent Crystallization Pathways in Quasi‐2D Perovskites: Linear vs. Branched Spacer Cations
articles.title_zh: 机器学习指导解析准二维钙钛矿中间隔阳离子依赖的结晶路径：线性与支化间隔阳离子
articles.abstract: Angewandte Chemie International Edition, EarlyView.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文为《德国应用化学》EarlyView论文，围绕准二维钙钛矿中不同有机间隔阳离子对结晶路径的影响展开。根据题名，研究重点可能是利用机器学习辅助比较线性与支化间隔阳离子在结晶过程中的作用；具体实验设计、模型方法和结论需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 《德国应用化学》国际版，EarlyView。该工作围绕机器学习指导下对准二维钙钛矿中间隔阳离子依赖结晶路径的阐明展开，比较线性与支化间隔阳离子的影响。由于所给摘要仅包含期刊和在线预发表元数据，未提供具体研究方法、数据或结论，详细内容需查阅原文。

articles.title: Ferroelectric Phonon‐Dressed Exciton Polarons Enable Internal Charge Separation in Strongly Confined 2D Perovskites
articles.title_zh: 铁电声子修饰的激子极化子在强限域二维钙钛矿中实现内部电荷分离
articles.abstract: Angewandte Chemie International Edition, EarlyView.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文为《德国应用化学》EarlyView论文，主题涉及强限域二维钙钛矿中的铁电声子、激子极化子与内部电荷分离。基于题名可知，作者关注声子耦合和极化效应对激发态电荷分离的作用；具体机制和证据需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 《德国应用化学》国际版，EarlyView。该工作围绕强限域二维钙钛矿中铁电声子修饰的激子极化子如何实现内部电荷分离展开。由于所给摘要仅包含期刊和在线预发表元数据，未提供具体实验、理论方法或结论，详细内容需查阅原文。
articles.focus_summary: 论文研究强限域二维钙钛矿中的铁电声子修饰激子极化子，指出铁电晶格振动能够形成激子极化子并促进内部电荷分离。该机制有望改善二维钙钛矿中的光生载流子分离和光电转换性能。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的铁电材料、二维钙钛矿、电子-声子耦合、极化子、光电性质和界面电荷转移方向高度相关。其铁电声子驱动电荷分离机制可与非绝热分子动力学、GW-BSE 和载流子输运计算结合。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步利用第一性原理和非绝热动力学定量研究铁电极化、声子模式与激子解离速率之间的关系。还可比较不同层数、应变、界面堆垛和缺陷对激子极化子稳定性及电荷分离效率的影响。

articles.title: Could quantum protocols make electronic voting more secure?
articles.title_zh: 量子协议能否让电子投票更安全？
articles.abstract: Electronic voting, the use of electronic systems to cast, record or count votes, could potentially simplify the process of electing new political leaders or other representatives. While some countries have already started using internet-connected devices or electronic voting machines at polling stations, the trustworthiness, security and anonymity of electronic voting systems are still widely debated.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论量子协议是否可能提升电子投票的安全性。电子投票可简化投票、记录和计票流程，但联网投票设备和电子投票机在可信性、安全性与匿名性方面仍存在广泛争议。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子投票，即使用电子系统来投出、记录或统计选票，可能简化选举新的政治领导人或其他代表的过程。虽然一些国家已经开始在投票站使用联网设备或电子投票机，但电子投票系统的可信性、安全性和匿名性仍然受到广泛讨论。

articles.title: Performance of universal machine learning potentials in global optimization of inorganic crystal structures
articles.title_zh: 通用机器学习势在无机晶体结构全局优化中的性能
articles.abstract: Rapid development of universal machine learning potentials (uMLPs) and expansion of training data sets are reshaping the state of the art in atomistic simulation, highlighting the need for concurrent systematic benchmarking of their capabilities. Global optimization is among the most demanding uMLP applications because unconstrained exploration includes probing motifs not present in reference sets. We examined twelve pretrained uMLPs in unconstrained evolutionary searches to assess whether these models can consistently predict complex nonmagnetic crystal structure ground states under ambient pressure across diverse inorganic systems. Our findings demonstrate that the considered M3GNet, MACE-MATPES, MACE-mh-1, SevenNet, EquiformerV2, EquiformerV3, MatterSim, GRACE, eSEN, Orb-v3, PET-MAD, and PET-OAM models span a wide performance range, from near ab initio to essentially non-predictive, in their ability to resolve competing phases within low-energy basins. Additional tests on hcp-Zn, MB (M = Cr, Mn, and Fe), and LiB ( ) ground states reveal that several uMLPs capture fine energy differences arising from subtle electronic structure features.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统评估了十二种预训练通用机器学习势在无约束演化搜索中预测无机晶体基态结构的能力。结果显示，不同模型性能差异很大，从接近第一性原理到几乎不具预测性不等；额外测试还表明若干模型可捕捉由细微电子结构特征引起的小能量差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通用机器学习势（uMLP）的快速发展和训练数据集的扩展正在重塑原子尺度模拟的前沿水平，同时凸显出对其能力进行同步系统基准测试的必要性。全局优化是最具挑战性的uMLP应用之一，因为无约束探索包括探测参考数据集中不存在的结构基元。我们在无约束演化搜索中考察了十二种预训练uMLP，以评估这些模型能否在环境压力下、跨多样无机体系，稳定预测复杂非磁性晶体结构的基态。我们的研究结果表明，所考察的M3GNet、MACE-MATPES、MACE-mh-1、SevenNet、EquiformerV2、EquiformerV3、MatterSim、GRACE、eSEN、Orb-v3、PET-MAD和PET-OAM模型在解析低能量盆地内竞争相方面的能力覆盖了很宽的性能范围，从接近从头算水平到基本不具预测性不等。对hcp-Zn、MB（M=Cr、Mn和Fe）以及LiB（ ）基态的额外测试显示，若干uMLP能够捕捉由细微电子结构特征产生的精细能量差异。
articles.focus_summary: 论文系统评估了12种通用机器学习势在无约束无机晶体结构全局优化中的表现，重点考察其对复杂晶体基态和低能竞争相的识别能力。结果显示，不同模型性能差异显著，部分模型能够捕捉由细微电子结构差异引起的能量差别。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、晶体结构预测、全局优化和高通量材料筛选方向高度相关。其基准测试方法和模型比较结果可用于评估团队发展的等变神经网络势及其在未知结构空间中的可靠性。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步关注不同机器学习势在磁性、缺陷、极性结构和长程库仑相互作用体系中的泛化能力。可结合主动学习和第一性原理重校准，建立面向铁电体、磁性材料和电池材料的结构搜索基准。

articles.title: PQuantML: a tool for end-to-end hardware-aware model compression
articles.title_zh: PQuantML：一种面向端到端硬件感知模型压缩的工具
articles.abstract: PQuantML is a new open-source, hardware-aware neural network model compression library tailored to end-to-end workflows. Motivated by the need to deploy performant models to environments with strict latency constraints, PQuantML simplifies training of compressed models by providing a unified interface to apply pruning and quantization, either jointly or individually. The library implements multiple pruning methods with different granularities, as well as fixed-point quantization with support for high-granularity quantization (HGQ). We evaluate PQuantML on the jet substructure classification task, so-called jet tagging, an on-edge problem related to real-time large Hadron collider data processing. Using various pruning methods with fixed-point quantization, PQuantML achieves substantial parameter and bit-width reductions while maintaining accuracy. We benchmark PQuantML’s pruning and fixed-point quantization against QKeras, and validate that its integrated HGQ algorithm implementation reproduces the standalone HGQ library results.
articles.abstract_zh: PQuantML是一个新的开源硬件感知神经网络压缩库，面向端到端工作流程。它提供统一接口支持剪枝与定点量化，并在喷注子结构分类任务中实现显著的参数量和位宽降低，同时保持精度；作者还将其与QKeras及独立HGQ库结果进行了基准比较和验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: PQuantML是一个新的开源、硬件感知神经网络模型压缩库，专为端到端工作流程而设计。出于将高性能模型部署到具有严格延迟约束环境中的需求，PQuantML通过提供统一接口来单独或联合应用剪枝和量化，从而简化压缩模型的训练。该库实现了多种具有不同粒度的剪枝方法，以及支持高粒度量化（HGQ）的定点量化。我们在喷注子结构分类任务，即所谓喷注标记上评估PQuantML，这是一个与大型强子对撞机实时数据处理相关的边缘端问题。结合各种剪枝方法和定点量化，PQuantML在保持准确率的同时实现了显著的参数量和位宽降低。我们将PQuantML的剪枝和定点量化与QKeras进行了基准比较，并验证其集成的HGQ算法实现能够复现独立HGQ库的结果。

articles.title: Beyond Crease Geometry: Multistability in Origami-Inspired Structures through Local Fold Architectures
articles.title_zh: 超越折痕几何：通过局部折叠架构在折纸启发结构中实现多稳态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Origami-inspired tubular structures provide a versatile platform for shape morphing, with multistability achieved predominantly through crease-network geometry. Expanding the range of morphing behaviors can therefore require increasingly intricate crease patterns that become more difficult to model and fabricate, ultimately constraining the realizable morphing landscape. Here, we expand the design space of origami-inspired structures beyond geometry by introducing localized instabilities within the crease network, thereby creating compliant multistable structures whose local fold architectures govern global deformation and stability through both constitutive mechanics and geometric constraints. To relate local fold architectures to global multistability, we develop and experimentally validate a modeling framework in which compliant folds are represented as continuous fields that capture spatially varying bistable mechanics. Force- and displacement-controlled design maps demonstrate that global deformation and stability can be programmed through the fold architecture's local parameters. Redistributing bistability within a fixed crease-network topology shifts the global response between compliant, spatially distributed deformation in semi-bistable architectures and discrete transitions within a hierarchically organized space of stable configurations in fully bistable architectures. These results establish a local-to-global design principle for programming both the stable configurations of a structure and the transition pathways connecting them, expanding the design space for multistable metamaterials, adaptive morphing structures, and soft robotic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出通过在折痕网络中引入局部不稳定性来扩展折纸启发结构的设计空间，而不只依赖折痕网络几何。作者建立并实验验证了将柔顺折叠表示为空间变化双稳态连续场的模型，表明局部折叠参数可编程调控整体变形、稳定性和构型转换路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 折纸启发的管状结构为形状变形提供了一个多功能平台，其多稳态主要通过折痕网络几何来实现。因此，扩展变形行为的范围可能需要越来越复杂的折痕图案，而这些图案更难建模和制造，最终限制了可实现的变形景观。在这里，我们通过在折痕网络中引入局部不稳定性，将折纸启发结构的设计空间扩展到几何之外，从而创造出柔顺多稳态结构，其局部折叠架构通过本构力学和几何约束共同支配整体变形与稳定性。为了将局部折叠架构与整体多稳态联系起来，我们开发并实验验证了一个建模框架，其中柔顺折叠被表示为能够捕捉空间变化双稳态力学的连续场。力控制和位移控制的设计图表明，整体变形和稳定性可以通过折叠架构的局部参数进行编程。在固定折痕网络拓扑内重新分配双稳态性，会使整体响应在半双稳态架构中的柔顺、空间分布式变形，与全双稳态架构中稳定构型分层组织空间内的离散转变之间发生转换。这些结果确立了一种由局部到整体的设计原则，用于编程结构的稳定构型以及连接它们的转变路径，从而扩展多稳态超材料、自适应变形结构和软体机器人系统的设计空间。

articles.title: Kibble-Zurek Dynamics in Two-dimensional Frustrated Systems with a Neural Foundation-state Subspace Method
articles.title_zh: 利用神经基础态子空间方法研究二维受挫系统中的Kibble-Zurek动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal scaling generated when a strongly interacting quantum many-body system is driven across a continuous phase transition provides a dynamical probe of equilibrium criticality. Accessing this regime numerically in two dimensions is challenging because it requires accurate real-time evolution of correlated many-body states over many system sizes and driving rates. We introduce a Neural Foundation-state Subspace (NFS) method for near-adiabatic dynamics. A foundation neural-network quantum state represents the ground-state manifold along the driving path, and a small fidelity-selected subset defines a fixed variational subspace. The many-body Schrödinger equation then reduces to the evolution of a few linear coefficients, with projected operators reusable across ramp times. We validate the method on the two-dimensional transverse-field Ising model, recovering the expected Kibble-Zurek scaling and critical exponents in quantitative agreement with ground-state quantum Monte Carlo estimates. Applied to the frustrated square-lattice J₁-J₂ Heisenberg model up to 16 × 16 clusters, our approach provides strong numerical evidence of Kibble-Zurek mechanism across the Néel-to-spin-liquid transition at J₂/J₁=0.49, yielding ν=1.23(15) and η=0.409(19) at fixed z=1, consistent with static estimates and supporting the proposed continuous critical behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出神经基础态子空间（NFS）方法，用于研究接近绝热驱动下二维量子多体系统穿越连续相变时的Kibble-Zurek动力学。作者在二维横场伊辛模型中验证了该方法，并将其用于受挫方格晶格J1-J2海森堡模型，给出了支持Néel态到自旋液体连续临界行为的数值证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当强相互作用量子多体系统被驱动穿越连续相变时产生的普适标度，为平衡临界性提供了一种动力学探针。在二维中以数值方式进入这一机制具有挑战性，因为这需要在许多系统尺寸和驱动速率下对关联多体态进行精确实时演化。我们提出一种用于近绝热动力学的神经基础态子空间（NFS）方法。一个基础神经网络量子态表示沿驱动路径的基态流形，而一个通过保真度筛选的小子集定义固定的变分子空间。随后，多体薛定谔方程化约为少数线性系数的演化，且投影算符可在不同斜坡时间之间重复使用。我们在二维横场伊辛模型上验证了该方法，恢复了预期的Kibble-Zurek标度和临界指数，并与基态量子蒙特卡罗估计定量一致。将该方法应用于最大16×16团簇的受挫方格晶格J1-J2海森堡模型时，我们的方法为J2/J1=0.49处从Néel态到自旋液体转变中的Kibble-Zurek机制提供了强有力的数值证据，在固定z=1时得到ν=1.23(15)和η=0.409(19)，这与静态估计一致，并支持所提出的连续临界行为。

articles.title: Quantum Quenches across the Bose-glass Transition
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05589v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Due to their intrinsic interplay between long-range order and quasi-disorder, quasicrystalline systems provide a rich platform for investigating novel quantum phenomena. Here we study the non-equilibrium dynamics following quantum quenches across the superfluid to Bose-glass transition using ultracold bosons in an optical quasicrystal. Fast quenches into the Bose glass regime induce a quantum walk in momentum space that spreads over increasingly higher momentum orders. Conversely, quenches into the superfluid regime initiate a real-space quantum walk of initially localized atoms, forming a light-cone-like structure bounded by Lieb-Robinson limits. Characteristic timescales reveal strong links to the underlying Hamiltonian and are governed primarily by quasi-disorder strength in the Bose glass phase, and by tunneling strength in the superfluid phase. Finally, we analyze slower quenches into deeper lattices and observe the decay of coherence across the phase transition.

articles.title: Pair density wave order from non-symmorphic momentum symmetry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a class of microscopic lattice models in which pair density wave order emerges in the asymptotically exact weak coupling limit. The underlying mechanism is due to non-symmorphic momentum symmetry implied by the models' projective space group representation of electrons. Our mechanism suggests moiré systems and extended s-wave altermagnets as potential hosts for pair density wave order.

articles.title: First principles calculations of electric-field-driven topological phase transitions in silicene, germanene and stanene
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05633v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergence of two-dimensional topological materials, particularly the group-14 monolayers known as silicene, germanene, and stanene has opened promising pathways for next-generation nanoelectronics and spintronics. Their buckled honeycomb structure and strong spin-orbit coupling allow for bandgap engineering via a perpendicular electric field, leading to topological phase transitions (TPTs) from non-trivial to trivial insulating states. However, precise determination of the critical electric field E_zcr at which these transitions occur remains challenging, with tight-binding models often underestimating these values. Here, we present a first-principles framework that combines density-functional theory (DFT), maximally localized Wannier functions, and evolution of the Wannier charge centers (WCC) to accurately characterize TPTs in silicene, germanene, and stanene through the Z₂ topological invariant. In contrast to earlier work, at each electric-field strength we run fully self-consistent ab initio simulations to obtain the screened electronic structure, accounting for the material's dielectric response from both electrons and ions. From these converged results we construct a Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonian at each electric field strength, which then enables a gauge-invariant calculation of the Z₂ topological invariant. This methodology yields significantly more accurate numerical predictions of E_zcr, 0.020 and 0.250 V/Å for silicene and germanene, respectively. Compared to previous approaches, our framework delivers a marked quantitative improvement for predicting topological phase boundaries, essential for guiding the design of topological field-effect transistors and electrostatically controlled quantum devices based on two-dimensional materials.
articles.focus_summary: 论文采用自洽密度泛函理论、最大局域化Wannier函数和Wannier电荷中心，研究垂直电场驱动的silicene、germanene和stanene拓扑相变。通过计算Z₂拓扑不变量并考虑电子和离子屏蔽，论文获得了更可靠的临界电场。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的第一性原理计算、Wannier插值、二维材料、拓扑材料、强自旋轨道耦合和电场调控方向直接相关。其自洽处理外场屏蔽和拓扑不变量的流程可用于研究二维磁性、铁电或异质结体系中的拓扑相变。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步考察应变、层间堆叠、缺陷和衬底效应对临界电场及拓扑边界态的影响。也可将该方法拓展到具有磁序的二维材料，研究电场驱动的磁拓扑相变和自旋输运响应。

articles.title: Gauge-covariant magnetic Bloch sums for general multiorbital Hofstadter models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate a unified treatment of the Hofstadter problem for general two-dimensional multiorbital Peierls tight-binding Hamiltonians using a gauge-covariant magnetic Bloch-sum basis. The construction retains the full Bravais geometry, arbitrary intracell orbital positions, and the original hopping table, so lattice geometry, orbital embedding, hopping range, and orbital content can all be handled within the same framework. At rational flux Φ/Φ₀=p/q, commuting magnetic translations reduce the Peierls Hamiltonian to minimal qNᵣₘ ₒᵣb× qNᵣₘ ₒᵣb blocks. Their dimension depends only on the flux through the primitive cell, even when the fractional orbital coordinates are irrational. Electromagnetic gauge transformations act by unitary conjugation within the construction and do not alter the required magnetic supercell. We derive an explicit sparse matrix in an oblique Landau gauge and establish the associated band counting, spectral redundancy, Chern-number formulation, magnetic spatial constraints, and flux periodicity. Numerical examples include elementary lattices, topological and flat-band models, and a spinful 22-band Wannier Hamiltonian of monolayer MoS₂, demonstrating a direct interface with first-principles electronic-structure calculations. As a complementary representation, we also derive exact generalized Harper equations from the same hopping data and relate them to the finite magnetic-Bloch blocks.

articles.title: A magneto-mechanical gyroscope with spintronic readout
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05668v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gyroscopes are essential elements in navigation, consumer electronics, robotics, and aerospace applications. Most micro electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) implementations rely on capacitive sensing mechanisms, which limit the dimensional scaling to the micrometer scale. In this work, we introduce a MEMS-like two-degree-of-freedom (2-DOF) gyroscope that exploits the rectification functionality of magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) as its readout mechanism and as the transducer of the mechanical dynamics. Experimentally characterized MTJs have been used to calibrate and perform an experiment-informed design of the magneto-mechanical model combining micromagnetic theory with 2-DOF mechanical equations. We demonstrated that the output is linear with angular rate, and that the proposed device is able to extract the angular rate in dynamic cases exploiting a homodyne demodulation approach. The results open a path towards a compact, complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS)-compatible readout pathway that relaxes reliance on tight capacitive gaps and motivates multi-physics designs of the device.
