Here we show how observational constraints on white dwarf magnetic field strengths, ages, and masses can be used to constrain the viability of proposed origin mechanisms. Using data from both an expanded catalog of 1158 MWDs and a 20 pc volume-limited sample from Gaia DR2, we find that the fossil field mechanism overpredicts the number of magnetic white dwarfs, which suggests, that additional constraints beyond just the WD mass being contained in the progenitor convective core is required to determine which WDs retain fossil fields. Crystallization dynamos occur too late to explain the bulk of magnetic white dwarfs. With the progenitor envelope dynamos impeded by the theoretical challenge of depositing a field from envelope to white dwarf core, the two disk dynamo mechanisms emerge as the field origin mechanisms most resilient to present constraints, with mergers best able to explain the young, high mass, strongly magnetized MWDs. The methods herein also reveal observational data gaps and motivate future acquisition of more complete data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用磁性白矮星的磁场强度、年龄和质量观测约束，评估多种起源机制的可行性。基于1158颗磁性白矮星扩展目录和Gaia DR2的20秒差距体积限制样本，研究发现化石磁场机制会高估磁性白矮星数量，结晶发电机出现得过晚，包层发电机也面临磁场沉积到核心的理论困难。相比之下，盘发电机机制最能经受现有观测约束，其中并合机制尤其能够解释年轻、高质量且强磁化的磁性白矮星。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性白矮星（MWD）的起源一直是一个长期存在的谜题。已提出的起源机制包括：从前身星对流核心中冻结并保留下来的化石磁场；前身星包层中的发电机；在足够寒冷的白矮星中由结晶驱动的发电机；以及由白矮星—白矮星并合或低质量恒星、行星伴星受潮汐撕裂所形成的并合吸积盘发电机。本文展示了如何利用白矮星磁场强度、年龄和质量的观测约束，来限制所提出起源机制的可行性。利用包含1158颗磁性白矮星的扩展目录以及来自Gaia DR2的20秒差距体积限制样本，我们发现化石磁场机制会高估磁性白矮星的数量。这表明，除了白矮星质量是否位于前身星对流核心范围内之外，还需要额外约束，才能确定哪些白矮星保留了化石磁场。结晶发电机出现得太晚，无法解释大多数磁性白矮星。前身星包层发电机则受到这样一个理论难题的阻碍：如何将包层中的磁场沉积到白矮星核心。相比之下，两种盘发电机机制成为目前观测约束下最稳健的磁场起源机制，其中并合机制最能够解释年轻、高质量且强磁化的磁性白矮星。本文所采用的方法还揭示了观测数据方面的缺口，并推动未来获取更加完整的数据。

articles.title: Photonic Mode Description of the Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonian States
articles.title_zh: Jaynes–Cummings哈密顿量态的光子模描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.07333v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonian provides the elemental description of a two-level system interacting with a photonic mode. In this work, we review the Jaynes-Cummings formalism for an electronic two-level system. The purpose is to summarize and connect together the key theory concepts relevant for the transmission response probed typically in the experiments. The review provides a photonic mode description of the response with analytical results for several limiting cases. These expressions are useful for gaining understanding and intuition on what influences the measured response. We also connect the photonic response to several key concepts in the field: the dispersive shift in qubit readout, the quantum capacitance of semiconductor nanostructures and the effective dissipation rate of the two-level system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文回顾描述二能级电子系统与光子模相互作用的Jaynes–Cummings形式主义，并总结与实验中常见传输响应相关的关键理论概念。文章从光子模角度描述响应，并给出若干极限情形下的解析结果，以帮助理解测量响应的影响因素。作者还将光子响应与量子比特读出的色散移位、半导体纳米结构的量子电容以及二能级系统的有效耗散率联系起来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Jaynes–Cummings哈密顿量提供了二能级系统与光子模相互作用的基本描述。在本文中，我们回顾用于描述电子二能级系统的Jaynes–Cummings形式主义。本文旨在总结并联系与实验中通常探测的传输响应相关的关键理论概念。该综述从光子模角度给出响应的描述，并为若干极限情形提供解析结果。这些表达式有助于理解和直观把握哪些因素会影响测得的响应。我们还将光子响应与该领域的几个关键概念联系起来，包括量子比特读出中的色散移位、半导体纳米结构的量子电容，以及二能级系统的有效耗散率。

articles.title: Neuromodulation-inspired gated associative memory networks: extended memory retrieval and emergent multistability
articles.title_zh: 受神经调制启发的门控联想记忆网络：扩展记忆检索与涌现多稳态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.13859v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Classical autoassociative memory models have been central to understanding emergent computations in recurrent neural circuits across diverse biological contexts. However, they typically neglect neuromodulatory agents that are known to strongly shape memory capacity and stability. Here we introduce a minimal, biophysically motivated associative memory network in which neuropeptide-like signals are modeled by a self-adaptive, activity-dependent gating mechanism. Using many-body simulations and dynamical mean-field theory, we show that such gating fundamentally reorganizes the attractor structure: the network bypasses the classical spin-glass transition, maintaining robust, high-overlap retrieval far beyond the standard critical capacity. Mechanistically, when the gates act as fully open or fully closed switches, gating stabilizes transient "ghost" remnants of stored patterns even far above the Hopfield limit, converting a single memory fixed-point attractor into a cluster of fixed points. The retrieved state is set by the initial overlap rather than quantized to the stored pattern. This graded dependence may be exploited for input-driven computation with persistent activity. These results establish that neuromodulation-like gating alone, without modifying synaptic weights or introducing explicit higher-order couplings, can dramatically expand memory capacity, eliminate catastrophic breakdown, and reshape a discrete attractor landscape into a rich continuum, suggesting a general and biologically accessible route to enhanced computational capabilities in neural circuits and neuromorphic architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种具有生物物理动机的联想记忆网络，以自适应、依赖活动的门控机制模拟神经肽样信号。多体模拟和动力学平均场理论表明，门控能够绕过经典自旋玻璃转变，使网络在远超标准临界容量的范围内保持高重叠、稳健的记忆检索。完全开启或关闭的门控还会稳定存储模式的瞬态“幽灵”残余，将单一记忆固定点吸引子转化为固定点簇，并形成由初始重叠决定的连续检索状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典自联想记忆模型一直是理解不同生物学背景下递归神经回路中涌现计算的核心工具。然而，这些模型通常忽略神经调制剂，而众所周知，神经调制剂会强烈影响记忆容量和稳定性。在本文中，我们引入一种具有最小结构且受生物物理启发的联想记忆网络，其中神经肽样信号由一种自适应的、依赖活动的门控机制建模。通过多体模拟和动力学平均场理论，我们表明，这种门控从根本上重组了吸引子结构：网络绕过了经典自旋玻璃转变，即使远超标准临界容量，仍能保持稳健的高重叠记忆检索。从机制上看，当门控充当完全开启或完全关闭的开关时，即使远高于Hopfield极限，门控也能稳定存储模式短暂的“幽灵”残余，从而将单一的记忆固定点吸引子转化为固定点簇。检索到的状态由初始重叠决定，而不是量化到某个存储模式上。这种分级依赖性可以用于具有持续活动的输入驱动计算。这些结果表明，仅神经调制样门控本身，无需修改突触权重或引入显式高阶耦合，就能够显著扩展记忆容量、消除灾难性崩溃，并将离散吸引子景观重塑为丰富的连续体，为神经回路和神经形态架构增强计算能力提供了一条普适且具有生物可行性的路径。

articles.title: Deep networks learn to parse uniform-depth context-free languages from local statistics
articles.title_zh: 深度网络学会从局部统计中解析均匀深度的上下文无关语言
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06065v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding how the structure of language can be learned from sentences alone is a central question in both cognitive science and machine learning. Studies of the internal representations of Large Language Models (LLMs) support their ability to parse text when predicting the next word, while representing semantic notions independently of surface form. Yet, which data statistics make these feats possible, and how much data is required, remain largely unknown. Probabilistic context-free grammars (PCFGs) provide a tractable testbed for studying these questions. However, prior work has focused either on the post-hoc characterization of the parsing-like algorithms used by trained networks; or on the learnability of PCFGs with fixed syntax, where parsing is unnecessary. Here, we (i) introduce a tunable class of PCFGs in which both the degree of ambiguity and the correlation structure across scales can be controlled; (ii) provide a learning mechanism -- an inference algorithm inspired by the structure of deep convolutional networks -- that links learnability and sample complexity to specific language statistics; and (iii) validate our predictions empirically across deep convolutional and transformer-based architectures. Overall, we propose a unifying framework where correlations at different scales lift local ambiguities, enabling the emergence of hierarchical representations of the data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究仅凭句子中的统计规律如何学习语言结构，并提出一类可调的概率上下文无关文法，用于控制歧义程度和跨尺度相关结构。作者构造了受深度卷积网络结构启发的推理算法，将可学习性和样本复杂度与特定语言统计联系起来，并在深度卷积网络和Transformer架构上进行了验证。结果表明，不同尺度的相关性能够消除局部歧义，促进数据层次化表示的涌现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解仅从句子中学习语言结构的方式，是认知科学和机器学习中的核心问题。对大型语言模型（LLM）内部表示的研究支持这样一种观点：LLM能够在预测下一个词时解析文本，同时能够表示独立于表层形式的语义概念。然而，哪些数据统计特征使这些能力成为可能，以及需要多少数据，仍在很大程度上未知。概率上下文无关文法（PCFG）为研究这些问题提供了一个可处理的测试平台。然而，以往工作要么关注训练后对网络所使用的类解析算法进行刻画，要么研究具有固定语法结构的PCFG的可学习性，在后一种情况下并不需要解析。本文开展了三项工作：（i）引入一类可调的PCFG，其中可以控制歧义程度以及跨尺度的相关结构；（ii）提供一种受深度卷积网络结构启发的学习机制，将可学习性和样本复杂度与特定的语言统计特征联系起来；（iii）在深度卷积网络和基于Transformer的架构上对预测进行了经验验证。总体而言，我们提出了一个统一框架：不同尺度上的相关性能够消除局部歧义，从而使数据的层次化表示得以涌现。

articles.title: Bulk-boundary correspondence of (1+1)D symmetric gapped phases
articles.title_zh: (1+1)维对称有隙相的体–边界对应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19137v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We develop an operator-algebraic framework for boundary conditions and bulk-boundary correspondence in one-dimensional gapped phases with categorical symmetry. Working directly in the thermodynamic limit, we construct half-infinite fusion spin chains and commuting-projector boundary Hamiltonians from a unitary fusion category C, an indecomposable semisimple right C-module category M, a Q-system QinC specifying the bulk phase, and a right Q-module KinMQ, regarded as an object of MQop, specifying the boundary. We prove that these Hamiltonians have unique ground states and that the resulting realization functor MQoptoBCond is an equivalence, so simple boundary conditions are classified by simple objects of MQ and general boundary conditions by their finite direct sums. We also give a microscopic formulation of the boundary symmetry topological field theory using DHR bimodules of the boundary quasi-local algebra. For a half-infinite fusion spin chain, the boundary DHR category is monoidally equivalent to (CMvee)rev, and the canonical action of the bulk DHR category on it agrees with the categorical action of Z₁(Crev). Finally, we identify the action of the boundary DHR category on boundary conditions with the categorical action of (CMvee)rev on MQop. This yields a one-dimensional bulk-boundary correspondence: the enriched monoidal category describing the bulk is the enriched center of the enriched category describing the boundary.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个算子代数框架，用于研究具有范畴对称性的一维有隙相中的边界条件和体–边界对应，并直接在热力学极限下构造半无限融合自旋链与对易投影边界哈密顿量。作者证明，边界实现函子是等价的，因此简单边界条件由相应模范畴中的简单对象分类，一般边界条件由其有限直和给出。研究还通过边界准局域代数的DHR双模构造边界对称拓扑场论的微观描述，并由此得到一维体–边界对应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了一个算子代数框架，用于研究具有范畴对称性的一维有隙相中的边界条件和体–边界对应。我们直接在热力学极限下工作，并从幺半融合范畴C、一个不可分解的半单右C-模范畴M、规定体相的Q-系统Q∈C，以及一个右Q-模K∈M_Q出发，构造半无限融合自旋链和对易投影边界哈密顿量，其中K被视为M_Q^op的对象，用于规定边界。我们证明这些哈密顿量具有唯一基态，并且所得实现函子M_Q^op→BCond是一个等价，因此简单边界条件由M_Q中的简单对象分类，一般边界条件则由这些对象的有限直和分类。我们还利用边界准局域代数的DHR双模，给出了边界对称拓扑场论的微观表述。对于半无限融合自旋链，边界DHR范畴与(CM^∨)^rev单幺等价，而体DHR范畴对它的规范作用与Z₁(C^rev)的范畴作用一致。最后，我们确定了边界DHR范畴在边界条件上的作用，即与(CM^∨)^rev在M_Q^op上的范畴作用相一致。这给出了一维体–边界对应：描述体相的富集幺半范畴，是描述边界的富集范畴的富集中心。

articles.title: Fate of "Space-like singularities" in c=1 Matrix Model
articles.title_zh: c=1矩阵模型中“类空奇点”的命运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31925v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A class of time dependent backgrounds in two dimensional String Theory leads to superluminal Liouville walls on the worldsheet. In the dual double scaled c=1 matrix model these backgrounds involve eigenvalues leaking out to infinity, and the collective field fluctuations become strongly coupled along space-like regions, resembling singularities. We realize these backgrounds as results of quantum quenches in the matrix model, retaining non-linear terms in the matrix potential, thus departing from a double scaling limit. Working in the fermion picture in a Thomas-Fermi approximation, we show that while the early time behavior of the phase space density near the maximum of the potential agrees with that obtained in the double scaled theory, at times of the order (log N) the effect of the IR wall becomes significant. At later times, with a characteristic winding time of order (log N)², folds on the fermi surface proliferate and eventually cover the allowed region in phase space densely. Using action-angle variables, we show that the phase space density oscillates around a time independent and angle independent value rapidly at late times. A coarse-grained density in the angle space relaxes to a time independent equilibrium value as a power law with an exponent largely independent of the details of the initial state. Thus, the appearance of a space-like singularity is an artifact of the strict double scaling limit. We comment on the interpretation of the final state in String Theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维弦理论中导致超光速Liouville墙的时间依赖背景，以及其在对偶双标度c=1矩阵模型中的表现。通过保留矩阵势的非线性项并将这些背景实现为量子淬火，作者发现红外墙在约log N时间后变得重要，随后费米面褶皱大量产生，并在约(log N)²的缠绕时间尺度上密集覆盖允许相空间区域。结果表明，类空奇点是严格双标度极限的产物；晚期粗粒化相空间密度按幂律弛豫到时间无关的平衡值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维弦理论中的一类时间依赖背景会在世界面上产生超光速Liouville墙。在对偶的双标度c=1矩阵模型中，这些背景涉及本征值泄漏到无穷远，而集体场涨落在类空区域变得强耦合，呈现出类似奇点的行为。我们通过在矩阵模型中保留矩阵势的非线性项来将这些背景实现为量子淬火，从而偏离双标度极限。我们在Thomas–Fermi近似下采用费米子表述，表明在势能最大值附近，相空间密度的早期时间行为与双标度理论得到的结果一致；但在约log N的时间之后，红外墙的影响变得显著。在更晚的时间，即具有约(log N)²特征缠绕时间之后，费米面上的褶皱大量产生，并最终在允许的相空间区域内密集覆盖。利用作用–角变量，我们表明，在晚期，相空间密度会快速围绕一个与时间和角度均无关的值振荡。角度空间中的粗粒化密度则按照幂律、以基本上与初始态细节无关的指数弛豫到一个与时间无关的平衡值。因此，类空奇点的出现是严格双标度极限的产物。我们还讨论了最终态在弦理论中的解释。

articles.title: Vacuum Spin-Torsion Energy Density and Two-Modulus Stability on S²timesCP²
articles.title_zh: S²×CP²上的真空自旋–挠率能量密度与双模稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Einstein--Cartan--Kaluza--Klein compactification on S²timesCP², elimination of the non-propagating torsion generates a quartic spin-current contact interaction whose vacuum expectation value is nonzero even at zero fermion occupation. We reduce the ten-dimensional ΓABC structure to the zero-mode sector and find that the reduction is channel-resolved: each of the three internal Cartan-plane bilinears contribute with the opposite sign to the external (axial) channel, so that the full trace is Rcₕ = Tᵣₘ ᵥₐc/Tᵣₘ ₐₓᵢₐₗ = 1 + 3,(-1) = -2. The vacuum term is therefore twice the axial estimate and opposite in sign, and, combined with the elimination constant c₁₀ = -κ₁₀/32, verified by explicit Clifford computation, it is attractive and proportional to Nᵣₘ fₐₘ². We obtain the separated-point correlator, which in the continuum scales as Nᵣₘ fₐₘ² d_R/(V₆,r⁶), and, conditional on the physical quantum-boundary prescription, evaluate it at the minimum supported separation. The finite-density piece of the same correlator has the same sign and grows with chemical potential. Binding deepens after nucleation; the single-particle Hartree self-contraction vanishes for chiral zero modes. Using the derived 1/(a₁²a₂⁴) vacuum term with the Einstein-frame curvature and quantized-flux contributions, we analyze a coupled two-modulus toy potential. At fiducial couplings, the (m,n)=(3,3) sector has a finite-radius stationary point with positive Hessian in both radion directions, while the four-family (4,3) minimum lies beyond the adopted quantum-curvature boundary. The three-family sector (1,5) is also locally stable but is less bound. 3-family dominance of the thermal nucleation weight further imposes the condition κ₄ lesssim 7.5,(16/B),ell_P². These results serve as inputs to our higher-level synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究Einstein–Cartan–Kaluza–Klein理论在S²×CP²紧致化中的真空自旋–挠率能量密度及双模稳定性。消除非传播挠率后，得到即使在费米子占据数为零时真空期望值仍非零的四次自旋流接触相互作用；其完整迹与外部轴向通道符号相反且大小为后者的两倍。结合爱因斯坦框架曲率和量子化磁通贡献，作者分析了双模有效势，并发现基准耦合下(3,3)扇区存在两个径向模均具有正Hessian的有限半径驻点，而(4,3)极小值超出所采用的量子曲率边界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在S²×CP²上的Einstein–Cartan–Kaluza–Klein紧致化中，消除非传播的挠率会产生一个四次自旋流接触相互作用；即使费米子占据数为零，该相互作用的真空期望值也非零。我们将十维Γ结构约化到零模扇区，并发现这种约化具有通道分辨性质：三个内部Cartan平面双线性项中的每一项，都对外部（轴向）通道贡献相反的符号，因此完整迹满足R_ch=T_rm^vac/T_rm^axial=1+3(-1)=-2。由此，真空项是轴向估计值的两倍且符号相反；再结合消除常数c₁₀=-κ₁₀/32（通过显式Clifford计算得到验证），该项具有吸引性，并与N_rm f_am²成正比。我们得到分离点关联函数；在连续极限下，它按N_rm f_am² d_R/(V₆ r⁶)标度，并在物理量子边界处方成立的条件下，于允许的最小支持间距处对其进行评估。同一关联函数的有限密度部分具有相同符号，并随化学势增大。成核后束缚进一步加深；对于手征零模，单粒子Hartree自收缩为零。利用推导出的1/(a₁²a₂⁴)真空项以及爱因斯坦框架曲率和量子化磁通贡献，我们分析了一个耦合双模玩具势。在基准耦合下，(m,n)=(3,3)扇区具有一个有限半径驻点，并且两个径向方向上的Hessian均为正；而四族(4,3)极小值位于所采用的量子曲率边界之外。三族扇区(1,5)也具有局部稳定性，但束缚较弱。三族在热成核权重中的主导性进一步要求κ₄≲7.5(16/B)ℓ_P²。这些结果将作为更高层次综合研究的输入。

articles.title: A Spectral Phase Admissibility Certificate for Complex Linear Maps
articles.title_zh: 复线性映射的谱相位可接受性证书
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02911v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The paper imports the Kontsevich Segal Witten criterion from quantum gravity into machine learning to evaluate complex linear maps Standard techniques analyze magnitude or positive definiteness whereas this method exclusively limits the collective phase of a spectrum The researchers create three distinct differentiable certificates comprising a determinant sector a subset product envelope and the full criterion The subset envelope prevents all exterior power eigenvalues from touching the negative real axis This constraint precisely matches the accept or reject choices of an exponential minor enumeration while reducing processing expenses drastically The team provides a differentiable enforcement application via a Schur parameterization The document also identifies crucial boundaries regarding where this system works The constraint cannot balance deep linear propagation since restricting the phase budget damages eigenvector conditioning Furthermore the technique remains completely blind to magnitude based targets like normalizing flow likelihoods Thus researchers must restrict this tool specifically to models that process the argument of a spectral product
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将量子引力中的Kontsevich–Segal–Witten判据引入机器学习，用于评估复线性映射，并专门限制谱的整体相位而非幅值或正定性。作者构造了行列式扇区、子集乘积包络和完整判据三种可微证书，其中子集包络可防止所有外幂特征值接触负实轴，并与指数次枚举的接受或拒绝结果一致，同时显著降低计算开销。研究还通过Schur参数化实现可微约束，并指出该方法不适合平衡深层线性传播，也无法处理依赖幅值的目标。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文将Kontsevich–Segal–Witten判据从量子引力引入机器学习，用于评估复线性映射。传统技术分析幅值或正定性，而该方法专门限制谱的整体相位。研究者构造了三种不同的可微证书，包括行列式扇区、子集乘积包络以及完整判据。子集包络能够防止所有外幂的特征值接触负实轴；这一约束与指数次枚举所作出的接受或拒绝选择完全一致，同时大幅降低了处理成本。作者通过Schur参数化给出了可微约束的实现方法。本文还指出了该系统适用范围的重要边界：由于限制相位预算会损害特征向量条件性，该约束无法平衡深层线性传播。此外，该方法完全无法处理基于幅值的目标，例如归一化流的似然。因此，研究者必须将这一工具专门限制在处理谱乘积辐角的模型中。

articles.title: Observational Viability of φ²-Superpotential Inflation with GUP-Induced Corrections
articles.title_zh: 具有GUP诱导修正的φ²超势暴胀的观测可行性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a φ²-superpotential inflationary model within a GUP-inspired quantum-gravity framework. Using horizon thermodynamics, we review the GUP-corrected Friedmann equations obtained by combining the temperature--surface-gravity relation with a modified entropy--area law. Reformulating the dynamics via a superpotential W(φ) with φ=φ(a), we obtain the corresponding slow-roll parameters and derive GUP-modified expressions for the scalar spectral index and the tensor-to-scalar ratio, leading to a deformation of the standard inflationary consistency relation. Adopting the quadratic ansatz W(φ)=tfrac12m²φ², we evaluate the observables (nₛ,r) and compare them with the Planck 2018 TT, TE, EE + lowE + lensing + BK18 + BAO, DESI + CMB + DESY5, and Planck2018 + ACT + lensing + BK18 + BAO (from DESI) datasets. The analysis shows that, for moderately negative values of the effective GUP parameter β and sub-unity values of the phenomenological superpotential parameter C, the model predictions can fall within the 68% and 95% confidence regions of current observations. These results indicate that GUP-inspired corrections can shift the (nₛ,r) predictions of a quadratic superpotential toward the observationally favored region.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在广义不确定性原理（GUP）启发的量子引力框架下研究φ²超势暴胀模型，并利用视界热力学推导GUP修正的Friedmann方程。通过引入超势W(φ)并令φ=φ(a)，作者得到慢滚参数、标量谱指数和张量标量比的修正表达式，从而改变标准暴胀一致性关系。与多组Planck、DESI、DES和ACT观测数据比较表明，在有效GUP参数适度为负且超势参数C小于1时，模型预测可落入当前观测的68%和95%置信区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在GUP启发的量子引力框架下研究一个φ²超势暴胀模型。利用视界热力学，我们通过结合温度–表面引力关系与修正的熵–面积定律，回顾GUP修正的Friedmann方程。通过使用φ=φ(a)的超势W(φ)重新表述动力学，我们得到相应的慢滚参数，并推导出GUP修正的标量谱指数和张量标量比表达式，从而导致对标准暴胀一致性关系的变形。采用二次形式W(φ)=1/2 m²φ²，我们计算观测量(nₛ,r)，并将其与Planck 2018 TT、TE、EE+lowE+透镜+BK18+BAO，DESI+CMB+DESY5，以及Planck2018+ACT+透镜+BK18+BAO（来自DESI）数据集进行比较。分析表明，当有效GUP参数β取适度的负值、现象学超势参数C小于1时，该模型的预测可以落入当前观测的68%和95%置信区域。这些结果表明，GUP启发的修正能够将二次超势模型在(nₛ,r)平面上的预测移向观测偏好的区域。

articles.title: Scaling Neural Network Quantum States for Ab Initio Quantum Chemistry
articles.title_zh: 用于从头算量子化学的神经网络量子态扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural-network quantum states (NNQSs) can represent many-electron wave functions without explicitly enumerating the determinant space, but their accuracy depends jointly on model size and variational-optimization effort. Here we characterize this dependence for a physics-conditioned autoregressive NNQS trained separately on two six-molecule source benchmarks. Across eight model sizes and five optimization milestones, we find that model size and optimization steps jointly shape the energy error. The capacity advantage of larger models becomes more apparent with sufficient optimization, while the returns from additional optimization vary with model size. We capture this coupling using an interaction scaling law and quantify the cumulative compute of each evaluated configuration. The resulting error-compute Pareto frontiers provide a practical decision rule for jointly selecting model size and optimization steps under a given compute budget within the evaluated range. Furthermore, we find that this beneficial scaling trend persists during fine-tuning on held-out N₂. Pretrained models show decreasing error with increasing model size, with a steeper reduction following pretraining on the Hard benchmark. Together, these results place autoregressive neural quantum states within the broader landscape of empirical neural scaling and open a quantitative route toward the systematic scaling of neural quantum solvers for ab initio quantum chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经网络量子态能够在不显式枚举行列式空间的情况下表示多电子波函数，但其精度同时取决于模型规模和变分优化投入。本文基于两个六分子源基准，系统考察了八种模型规模和五个优化阶段下二者对能量误差及计算成本的共同影响，并提出交互缩放定律以刻画这种耦合关系。所得误差—计算量帕累托前沿可用于在给定计算预算内联合选择模型规模和优化步数；该有利的缩放趋势在留出氮分子上的微调中也得以保持。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经网络量子态（NNQS）无需显式枚举行列式空间即可表示多电子波函数，但其精度共同取决于模型规模和变分优化投入。本文针对分别在两个六分子源基准上训练的、经过物理条件化的自回归神经网络量子态，刻画了这种依赖关系。在八种模型规模和五个优化阶段中，我们发现，模型规模与优化步数共同决定能量误差。经过充分优化后，大模型的容量优势变得更加明显，而额外优化所带来的收益则随模型规模而变化。我们利用交互缩放定律描述这种耦合关系，并量化每一种所评估配置的累计计算量。由此得到的误差—计算量帕累托前沿，为在所评估范围内给定计算预算下联合选择模型规模和优化步数提供了实用的决策规则。此外，我们发现，这种有利的缩放趋势在留出氮分子（N₂）上的微调过程中仍然存在。预训练模型的误差随模型规模增大而降低，并且在困难基准上进行预训练后，这种下降更加陡峭。总体而言，这些结果将自回归神经量子态置于更广泛的经验神经网络缩放研究图景中，并为从头算量子化学神经网络求解器的系统扩展开辟了一条定量路径。

articles.title: The Whittaker-Maxwell Scaffolding. Scaffolding or template: what remains of a model when it is removed
articles.title_zh: 惠特克—麦克斯韦脚手架：模型被移除后，作为脚手架还是模板，究竟还剩下什么
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper discusses the metaphor, originating with Whittaker, according to which Maxwell's model of molecular vortices was the scaffolding by means of which the equations of electromagnetism were erected, removed afterwards without consequence for the building. It is argued here that the metaphor describes badly what happened, and it is shown that whoever upholds it today transcribes, within that same text, the quotations that belie it. The paper examines what was actually removed in 1865, which materials of the model still operate inside the equations under other names, and proposes in its place the figure of the template, taken from sheet-metal layout work. The discussion is situated with respect to the work of Daniel M. Siegel and Cameron Lazaroff-Puck, who maintain from the history of science the constitutive character of the model. It closes with a criterion for telling one case from the other.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论惠特克提出的一个比喻：麦克斯韦的分子涡旋模型仿佛是搭建电磁学方程的脚手架，建筑完成后即可移除而不影响整体结构。作者认为这一比喻并不能准确描述历史事实，并考察了1865年实际被移除的内容以及模型中仍以其他名称存在于方程内的成分。文章据此借用钣金放样中的“模板”概念替代“脚手架”，并提出区分两种情况的判据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文讨论惠特克提出的一个比喻，即麦克斯韦的分子涡旋模型是借以搭建电磁学方程的脚手架，随后被移除，而不会对这座建筑造成影响。本文认为，这一比喻很不恰当地描述了所发生的事情，并指出，如今仍坚持这一比喻的人，会在同一篇文本中转录出那些实际上与该比喻相矛盾的引文。本文考察了1865年究竟移除了模型中的什么内容，以及模型中的哪些材料仍以其他名称在方程内部发挥作用，并提出以取自钣金放样工作的“模板”这一形象取代“脚手架”。相关讨论结合了Daniel M. Siegel和Cameron Lazaroff-Puck的研究；二人从科学史角度坚持模型所具有的构成性作用。文章最后提出一个用于判断某一案例属于哪种情况的标准。

articles.title: Direct Four-Spacecraft Measurement of Reconnection Exhaust Thickness in the Solar Wind
articles.title_zh: 太阳风中磁重联排气区厚度的四航天器直接测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The thickness of a reconnecting solar wind current sheet is normally inferred from a single spacecraft as the product of the boundary-normal speed and the crossing duration. Multipoint measurements have tested this method for generic solar wind current sheets and constrained the geometry of reconnection exhausts, but a direct comparison with single-spacecraft thickness estimates for the same reconnection-associated crossings is still lacking. We analyze four current-sheet crossings observed by Magnetospheric Multiscale in the pristine solar wind on 2017 November 10 the two boundaries of a confirmed reconnection exhaust and two nearby current sheets. The tetrahedron separation was approx 16 km. Cross-correlation of the magnetic-field ramps gives millisecond-level lag uncertainties, boundary normals to 4^circ-8^circ and speeds to 5%-8%, while single-threshold timing at these separations is noise dominated. The exhaust edges are 29-31 ion inertial lengths (dᵢ) thick. The two edge normals differ by 22^circ (68% interval [19^circ,26^circ]), resolving a nonparallel exhaust geometry. At the exhaust edges, the measured boundary speeds agree with three standard single-spacecraft estimates to 4%-15% and remain within about one Alfvén speed of the plasma motion. Estimating the normal from one spacecraft is the larger source of error, though the thickness is still recovered to within tens of percent when a degenerate minimum-variance solution is rejected. At the actively reconnecting sheet, the boundary speed exceeds the local plasma speed along the normal by 29% ± 10%.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用磁层多尺度任务于2017年11月10日在原始太阳风中观测到的四次电流片穿越事件，直接测量磁重联排气区的厚度，并与单航天器估计进行比较。磁场跃迁的互相关分析给出了较小的时间延迟不确定度、4°至8°的边界法向以及5%至8%的速度不确定度；排气区边缘厚度为29至31个离子惯性长度。结果显示，两侧边界具有非平行几何结构，单航天器方法通常可在数十个百分点的精度内恢复厚度，但法向估计是主要误差来源；在主动重联电流片处，边界法向速度比局地等离子体法向速度高29%±10%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 重联太阳风电流片的厚度通常由单航天器测量得到，即取边界法向速度与穿越持续时间的乘积。多点测量已经检验了这一方法在一般太阳风电流片中的适用性，并约束了磁重联排气区的几何形状，但对于同一组与磁重联相关的穿越事件，直接测量结果与单航天器厚度估计之间的比较仍然缺失。我们分析了磁层多尺度任务于2017年11月10日在原始太阳风中观测到的四次电流片穿越事件，其中包括一个已确认重联排气区的两个边界和附近的两个电流片。四面体航天器之间的间距约为16千米。对磁场跃迁进行互相关分析得到毫秒量级的延迟不确定度、4°至8°的边界法向不确定度以及5%至8%的速度不确定度，而在这些间距下使用单阈值计时会受到噪声主导。排气区边缘的厚度为29至31个离子惯性长度（dᵢ）。两个边缘的法向相差22°，其68%区间为[19°，26°]，从而分辨出非平行的排气区几何结构。在排气区边缘，测得的边界速度与三种标准单航天器估计结果相差4%至15%，并且与等离子体运动速度的差异始终约不超过一个阿尔芬速度。使用单航天器估计法向是更大的误差来源，不过在排除退化的最小方差解后，厚度仍可在数十个百分点以内得到恢复。在主动重联电流片处，边界速度沿法向超过局地等离子体速度29%±10%。

articles.title: Overlimiting Ion Transport and Reaction Limitations in Charged Porous Media
articles.title_zh: 带电多孔介质中的超极限离子传输与反应限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrochemical reaction rates are controlled by both interfacial charge-transfer kinetics and reactive-ion transport. In charged porous media, fixed charges enrich reactive counterions near pore walls, enabling transport beyond the classical diffusion limit via surface conduction (SC). Under overlimiting conditions, classical Butler-Volmer kinetics predict indefinitely increasing current with overpotential, contrasting with microscopic electron-transfer theories, which impose a finite reaction-limited current. Here, we couple the one-dimensional leaky membrane model to coupled ion-electron transfer (CIET) kinetics to examine the interplay between transport and reaction limitations. The limiting behavior is governed by the scaled surface charge (tildeρₛ) and a Damköhler number (Da) comparing reaction-limited and diffusion-limited currents. We derive analytical limiting-current expressions for neutral, positive, and negatively charged porous media, mapping underlimiting-to-overlimiting transitions in the (Da,tildeρₛ) plane. By preventing reactive-ion depletion, SC restores polarization-curve sensitivity to charge-transfer kinetics that would otherwise be obscured by diffusion limitation. Fitting to published Cu electrodeposition data in charged AAO membranes yields Daapprox24. CIET parameters fitted to AAO(-) also describe AAO(+) and predict a finite AAO(-) reaction limit beyond the applied voltage range. These results provide a framework for distinguishing transport-limited and reaction-limited responses in electrochemical systems and establish charged porous media as platforms to reveal electrochemical reaction-kinetic descriptors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将单维泄漏膜模型与耦合离子—电子转移动力学相结合，研究带电多孔介质中传输限制和电化学反应限制的相互作用。固定电荷通过表面传导富集反应性反离子，使体系能够超越经典扩散极限；其极限行为由无量纲表面电荷和达姆科勒数共同控制。作者推导了不同孔介质电荷状态下的解析极限电流表达式，并利用铜电沉积数据拟合得到Da约为24，同时预测了负电AAO膜在实验电压范围之外的有限反应极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电化学反应速率同时受到界面电荷转移动力学和反应性离子传输的控制。在带电多孔介质中，固定电荷会在孔壁附近富集反应性反离子，并通过表面传导（SC）实现超越经典扩散极限的传输。在超极限条件下，经典的Butler–Volmer动力学预言电流会随过电位无限增加，这与微观电子转移理论相矛盾；后者要求存在有限的反应限制电流。在本文中，我们将单维泄漏膜模型与耦合离子—电子转移（CIET）动力学相结合，以研究传输限制与反应限制之间的相互作用。极限行为由无量纲表面电荷（tildeρₛ）和达姆科勒数（Da）控制，后者比较反应限制电流与扩散限制电流。我们推导了中性、正电和负电多孔介质的解析极限电流表达式，并在（Da，tildeρₛ）平面上描绘了从低于极限到超越极限的转变。表面传导通过防止反应性离子耗尽，使极化曲线重新表现出对电荷转移动力学的敏感性，而这种敏感性原本会被扩散限制所掩盖。将模型拟合到已发表的带电阳极氧化铝（AAO）膜中铜电沉积数据后，得到Da约为24。拟合AAO(-)所得的CIET参数同样能够描述AAO(+)的行为，并预测AAO(-)在所施加电压范围之外存在有限的反应极限。这些结果为区分电化学系统中的传输限制响应和反应限制响应提供了一个框架，并确立了带电多孔介质作为揭示电化学反应动力学描述符的平台。

articles.title: Hall-MHD in driven turbulence FLASH simulations
articles.title_zh: 受驱湍流FLASH模拟中的霍尔磁流体力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The origin of magnetic fields in turbulent astrophysical systems has long been a central problem in plasma astrophysics. Fluctuation dynamos are a class of field amplification mechanisms that occur in turbulent magnetohydrodynamics whereby stochastically forced motions of plasma at sufficiently high magnetic Reynolds numbers exponentially amplify magnetic energy. For steady forcing, such dynamos saturate with magnetic energies at a sizable fraction of the turbulent kinetic energy. Although fluctuation dynamo is widely studied within the framework of resistive magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) and driven-turbulence numerical simulations, this work explores the difference when the Hall term is included in the magneto-fluid's generalized Ohm's law. The inclusion is motivated in part by recent high energy-density plasma experiments studying fluctuation dynamo that are governed by an extended magnetohydrodynamics (xMHD) ansatz, which includes the Hall term. We first discuss the details of the Hall-MHD implementation in the FLASH code, the tool we use to model xMHD fluctuation dynamo. We then investigate the influence of the Hall term on the fluctuation dynamo in a three-dimensional periodic box, driven with stochastic forcing at the box scale. We compare cases with a Hall term of varying magnitude to no-Hall cases with respect to the magnetic field growth rate, saturation level, and magnetic field structure. The Hall-MHD fluctuation dynamo is found to saturate at lower magnetic energies and with fewer small-scale magnetic structures than the no-Hall cases. Both findings are consistent with the interpretation that the Hall term acts as an additional, non-linear transport term, akin to an enhanced turbulent diffusivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在FLASH代码中实现并研究包含霍尔项的广义磁流体力学模型，以考察其对三维受驱湍流涨落发电机的影响。与不含霍尔项的磁流体力学情形相比，霍尔磁流体力学中的涨落发电机在更低的磁能水平达到饱和，并形成更少的小尺度磁结构。作者认为，这两种结果都支持如下解释：霍尔项相当于额外的非线性输运项，作用类似于增强的湍流扩散率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 湍流天体物理系统中磁场的起源长期以来一直是等离子体天体物理学的核心问题。涨落发电机是一类发生在湍流磁流体力学中的磁场放大机制；当磁雷诺数足够高时，随机受迫的等离子体运动会使磁能呈指数增长。在稳定驱动下，这类发电机达到饱和时，磁能会达到湍动能的相当大比例。尽管涨落发电机通常在电阻磁流体力学和受驱湍流数值模拟框架内得到研究，本文探讨了在磁流体广义欧姆定律中加入霍尔项后产生的差异。加入霍尔项的部分动机来自近期研究涨落发电机的高能量密度等离子体实验，这些实验由包含霍尔项的扩展磁流体力学（xMHD）假设所支配。我们首先讨论FLASH代码中霍尔磁流体力学的实现细节；FLASH是我们用于模拟xMHD涨落发电机的工具。随后，我们研究在三维周期性盒中、以盒尺度随机受迫驱动的涨落发电机受霍尔项影响的情况。我们将不同霍尔项强度的情形与不含霍尔项的情形进行比较，考察磁场增长率、饱和水平以及磁场结构。结果发现，霍尔磁流体力学涨落发电机在较低的磁能处达到饱和，并且小尺度磁结构少于不含霍尔项的情形。这两项发现都与如下解释一致：霍尔项充当额外的非线性输运项，其作用类似于增强的湍流扩散率。

articles.title: Multi-Angle Beam Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy for Diffraction-Contrast-Free Magnetic Imaging
articles.title_zh: 用于无衍射对比磁成像的多角度束扫描透射电子显微镜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent development of the differential phase contrast (DPC) scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) technique has significantly advanced materials science supported by high-sensitivity detectors and powerful data processing. Especially the 4D-STEM technique, employing a pixelated camera as a STEM detector, enables extensive information acquisition through post-processing of large datasets. However, magnetic or electric field imaging using DPC is often disturbed by diffraction contrasts intrinsic to the crystalline material. In this paper, we demonstrate elimination of the diffraction contrasts for magnetic field imaging by using angularly distributed multiple electron beams generated by a multi-hole aperture within the 4D-STEM framework. This multi-angle beam configuration suppresses irrelevant crystalline contrast and yields direct magnetic information with high sensitivity from the specimen. Furthermore, we performed various image analysis to extract and interpret magnetic domain structures and domain walls.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在4D扫描透射电子显微镜框架内，利用多孔径产生角度分布的多束电子束，以消除差分相位衬度成像中的晶体衍射对比。该多角度束构型能够抑制无关的晶体对比，并以较高灵敏度直接获得样品的磁场信息。研究还通过多种图像分析方法提取并解释了磁畴结构和畴壁特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，差分相位衬度（DPC）扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）技术的发展，在高灵敏度探测器和强大数据处理能力的支持下，显著推动了材料科学的发展。特别是采用像素化相机作为STEM探测器的4D-STEM技术，能够通过对大型数据集进行后处理来获取丰富的信息。然而，利用DPC进行磁场或电场成像时，往往会受到晶体材料固有衍射对比的干扰。本文在4D-STEM框架内，利用多孔径产生的角度分布多束电子束，展示了如何消除磁场成像中的衍射对比。这种多角度束构型能够抑制无关的晶体对比，并以高灵敏度从样品中获得直接的磁信息。此外，我们还进行了多种图像分析，以提取并解释磁畴结构和畴壁。

articles.title: Formation and interaction of two-dimensional electron-acoustic solitons and breathers in superthermal plasmas
articles.title_zh: 超热等离子体中二维电子声孤子与呼吸子的形成及相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nonlinear evolution and mutual interaction of two-dimensional electron acoustic (EA) nonlinear structures in superthermal plasma environment are studied. The plasma model consists of inertial cold electrons, superthermal hot electrons described by kappa (κ) distribution, and stationary ions providing overall charge neutrality. Using the extended Poincaré-Lighthill-Kuo (PLK) reductive perturbation technique, a pair of two-sided Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (KP) equations governing right- and left-propagating EA solitary waves (EASWs) is derived. Exact analytical solutions of the KP equations, including single soliton, multisoliton, breather, and lump structures, are obtained via the Hirota bilinear method. The effects of key plasma parameters such as hot electron concentration, temperature ratio, and superthermality index on the characteristics of these nonlinear excitations are examined. Particular attention is devoted to the head-on collision dynamics between solitons, breather-soliton, and breather-breather interactions. The results reveal quasi-elastic collisions accompanied by phase shifts, transient amplitude modulation, and localized energy concentration, with clear distinctions between oscillatory and non-oscillatory mode interactions. The present study provides new insights into multidimensional electron acoustic wave (EAW) dynamics and energy redistribution mechanisms in superthermal space plasmas, with direct relevance to planetary magnetospheric environments such as Saturn's ring region.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了超热等离子体环境中二维电子声非线性结构的演化与相互作用。等离子体由惯性冷电子、服从κ分布的超热热电子以及维持总体电中性的静止离子组成；通过扩展的Poincaré–Lighthill–Kuo约化摄动法，推导出描述右行和左行电子声孤波的双向Kadomtsev–Petviashvili方程。利用Hirota双线性方法获得了单孤子、多孤子、呼吸子和脉冲团等解析解，并分析了碰撞中的相移、瞬态振幅调制和局域能量集中现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了超热等离子体环境中二维电子声（EA）非线性结构的非线性演化及其相互作用。等离子体模型由惯性冷电子、服从κ分布的超热热电子以及提供总体电中性的静止离子组成。利用扩展的Poincaré–Lighthill–Kuo（PLK）约化摄动技术，推导出一对控制右行和左行电子声孤立波（EASW）的双向Kadomtsev–Petviashvili（KP）方程。通过Hirota双线性方法，获得了KP方程的单孤子、多孤子、呼吸子和脉冲团结构等精确解析解。研究考察了热电子浓度、温度比和超热指数等关键等离子体参数对这些非线性激发特征的影响。文章特别关注孤子之间、呼吸子与孤子之间以及呼吸子彼此之间的迎头碰撞动力学。结果表明，这些碰撞近似弹性，并伴随相移、瞬态振幅调制和局域能量集中，同时振荡模态相互作用与非振荡模态相互作用之间存在明显差异。本研究为超热空间等离子体中的多维电子声波（EAW）动力学和能量再分配机制提供了新的认识，并与土星环区域等行星磁层环境直接相关。

articles.title: X-dispersionless solver for electromagnetic and axion fields in a cylindrical particle-in-cell code
articles.title_zh: 柱坐标粒子模拟代码中电磁场与轴子场的无色散X分裂求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03550v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a quasi-cylindrical direction-splitting (QDS) dispersionless Maxwell solver for the open-source EPOCH particle-in-cell framework. The method preserves the exact axial phase velocity for every retained azimuthal mode by advecting transverse transport variables with the cΔ t=Δ x shift. Building on the same transport viewpoint, we formulate an axion solver that advances the Klein--Gordon equation and the axion-regenerated electromagnetic fields within the QDS solver, so that axion--photon coupling is handled self-consistently. Benchmarks demonstrate that the cylindrical QDS solver reproduces the standard Yee wakefield structure while removing the axial group-velocity error and reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude. In the resonant axion generation test via two-color laser mixing, the QDS solver eliminates the spurious vacuum source term and maintains phase matching, whereas the Yee solver suffers from rapid dephasing due to numerical dispersion. The proposed algorithm therefore enables quasi-3D simulations of axion--photon physics in laser-plasma interaction with dispersion-free laser transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为开源EPOCH粒子模拟框架开发了一种准柱坐标方向分裂无色散麦克斯韦求解器。该方法通过以cΔt=Δx的平移推进横向输运变量，使每个保留的方位模态都保持精确的轴向相速度。作者进一步在同一输运观点下构造轴子求解器，自洽推进Klein–Gordon方程及轴子再生的电磁场；基准测试表明，该方法能够消除轴向群速度误差、显著降低计算成本，并在共振轴子产生问题中保持相位匹配。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为开源EPOCH粒子模拟框架开发了一种准柱坐标方向分裂（QDS）无色散麦克斯韦求解器。该方法通过使用cΔt=Δx的平移推进横向输运变量，使每个保留的方位模态都保持精确的轴向相速度。在相同的输运观点基础上，我们构造了一个轴子求解器，在QDS求解器内推进Klein–Gordon方程和轴子再生的电磁场，从而以自洽方式处理轴子—光子耦合。基准测试表明，柱坐标QDS求解器能够重现标准Yee算法的尾场结构，同时消除轴向群速度误差，并将计算成本降低数个数量级。在通过双色激光混频实现共振轴子产生的测试中，QDS求解器消除了虚假的真空源项并保持了相位匹配，而Yee求解器则因数值色散而迅速失谐。因此，所提出的算法能够以无色散的激光输运实现激光—等离子体相互作用中轴子—光子物理的准三维模拟。

articles.title: Low stray-field ion pump configuration for cold atom experiments
articles.title_zh: 冷原子实验用低杂散磁场离子泵构型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ion pumps used in cold-atom experiments generate stray magnetic fields that can perturb magneto-optical trapping, shift Zeeman sensitive energy levels, and introduce systematic errors in precision spectroscopy. We numerically investigate a compact low-stray-field ion pump configuration designed to reduce magnetic flux leakage through the ultrahigh-vacuum port without increasing the overall pump size. Starting from a simplified magnetic model of a standard ion pump, we study two complementary modifications: auxiliary permanent magnets surrounding the original pump magnets with opposite magnetisation, and a soft-magnetic honeycomb field stopper integrated at the pump port. The resulting combined configuration strongly reduces the magnetic flux density outside the pump. In the geometry considered here, the field at 10 mm from the UHV port is reduced by 97.9%, while the calculated reduction in effective pumping speed due to the honeycomb stopper is 17.9%. These results indicate that engineered magnetic compensation and field-guiding structures can support more compact cold-atom vacuum systems while preserving pumping performance. Further work should validate the design with nonlinear magnetostatic modelling, molecular-flow simulations, and measurements on a complete pump geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文数值研究了一种紧凑型低杂散磁场离子泵构型，旨在降低磁通量通过超高真空端口泄漏的问题，同时不增加泵的整体尺寸。研究考察了两种互补改进：在原有泵磁体周围布置反向磁化的辅助永磁体，以及在泵端口集成软磁蜂窝状磁场阻挡结构。在所研究几何构型中，端口外10毫米处的磁场降低了97.9%，而蜂窝阻挡结构导致的有效抽速降低为17.9%；作者指出仍需通过非线性磁静力学建模、分子流模拟和完整泵体实验验证该设计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 冷原子实验中使用的离子泵会产生杂散磁场，从而扰动磁光阱、改变对塞曼效应敏感的能级，并在精密光谱学中引入系统误差。我们对一种紧凑型低杂散磁场离子泵构型进行了数值研究，该构型旨在减少磁通量通过超高真空端口的泄漏，同时不增加泵的整体尺寸。研究从标准离子泵的简化磁学模型出发，考察了两种互补的改进方案：在原有泵磁体周围布置反向磁化的辅助永磁体，以及在泵端口集成软磁蜂窝状磁场阻挡结构。所得组合构型显著降低了泵外部的磁通密度。在所考虑的几何结构中，距离超高真空端口10毫米处的磁场降低了97.9%，而计算得到的蜂窝阻挡结构造成的有效抽速降低为17.9%。这些结果表明，经过设计的磁补偿和磁场引导结构能够在保持抽气性能的同时，支持更加紧凑的冷原子真空系统。未来工作应通过非线性磁静力学建模、分子流模拟以及在完整泵体上的测量来验证该设计。

articles.title: Machine learning-assisted design and explainable optimization of CdSnP2-based integrated solar-photodetector devices
articles.title_zh: 基于机器学习的CdSnP2集成太阳能—光电探测器件设计与可解释优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CdSnP2-based integrated solar cell-photodetector (SC-PD) devices employing CdS and CuGaSe2 (CGS) as the window and back surface field (BSF) layers, respectively are investigated using a hybrid machine learning (ML)-assisted SCAPS-1D framework. Device optimization is performed by varying the thickness, doping concentration, and defect density of individual layers. SCAPS-generated data are used to train six ML models and one deep learning model, with ensemble-based algorithms exhibiting the highest predictive accuracy. The ML-guided optimization identifies the n-CdS/p-CdSnP2 (CTP)/p+-CGS architecture as the optimum configuration among thirteen candidate structures. Incorporation of a 200 nm CGS BSF layer significantly enhances both photovoltaic and photodetection performance, increasing the efficiency from 20.67% to 32.69%, responsivity from 0.53 AW-1 to 0.72 AW-1, and detectivity from 2.51x1014 Jones to 1.78x1016 Jones. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis reveales that band-offset engineering, particularly at the window/absorber and absorber/BSF interfaces, together with absorber properties, governs device performance. These findings demonstrate the potential of CdSnP2 and the proposed data-driven SCAPS-ML framework for the accelerated design of high-efficiency multifunctional optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用结合机器学习与SCAPS-1D的混合框架，研究采用CdS窗口层和CuGaSe2背表面场层的CdSnP2集成太阳能电池—光电探测器件，并优化各层的厚度、掺杂浓度和缺陷密度。机器学习引导的优化从13种候选结构中确定n-CdS/p-CdSnP2/p+-CGS为最优构型；加入200纳米CGS背表面场层后，效率由20.67%提高至32.69%，响应度由0.53 A W⁻¹提高至0.72 A W⁻¹，探测率由2.51×10¹⁴ Jones提高至1.78×10¹⁶ Jones。SHAP分析表明，窗口层/吸收层和吸收层/背表面场界面的能带偏移设计，以及吸收层性质，是决定器件性能的主要因素。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文利用机器学习（ML）辅助的SCAPS-1D混合框架，研究了基于CdSnP2的集成太阳能电池—光电探测器件；其中分别采用CdS和CuGaSe2（CGS）作为窗口层和背表面场（BSF）层。器件优化通过改变各个层的厚度、掺杂浓度和缺陷密度来实现。利用SCAPS生成的数据训练了六种机器学习模型和一种深度学习模型，其中基于集成的算法表现出最高的预测精度。机器学习引导的优化从13种候选结构中确定n-CdS/p-CdSnP2（CTP）/p+-CGS架构为最优构型。加入200纳米的CGS背表面场层后，光伏性能和光电探测性能均得到显著增强：效率从20.67%提高到32.69%，响应度从0.53 A W⁻¹提高到0.72 A W⁻¹，探测率从2.51×10¹⁴ Jones提高到1.78×10¹⁶ Jones。SHapley加性解释（SHAP）分析显示，能带偏移工程，尤其是窗口层/吸收层和吸收层/背表面场界面的能带偏移设计，以及吸收层性质，共同主导器件性能。这些发现展示了CdSnP2以及所提出的数据驱动SCAPS-ML框架在加速设计高效率多功能光电器件方面的潜力。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作将机器学习与SCAPS-1D器件模拟结合，优化CdSnP2太阳电池-光电探测器中各层的厚度、掺杂浓度和缺陷密度。结果确定了CdS/CdSnP2/CGS结构为较优方案，并指出界面能带偏移和吸收层性质是提升光伏及探测性能的关键因素。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的光电和能源材料、半导体缺陷、界面电荷转移、机器学习及太阳能电池方向相关。其主要价值在于器件级参数优化和可解释性分析，但与团队擅长的第一性原理缺陷物理、载流子动力学和GW-BSE计算相比，微观机制深度较弱。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议用第一性原理计算补充CdS/CdSnP2、CdSnP2/CGS界面的能带排列、缺陷形成能、界面态和电荷转移，并结合GW-BSE提高光学预测可靠性。进一步可将缺陷俘获、非辐射复合和载流子输运参数从原子尺度计算输入SCAPS，建立跨尺度器件优化模型。

articles.title: Computing high-order mixed derivatives in physics-informed neural networks using multi-index Bell polynomials
articles.title_zh: 利用多指标Bell多项式计算物理信息神经网络中的高阶混合导数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks for high-order partial differential equations require mixed input derivatives and their gradients with respect to the network parameters. Standard implementations obtain an order-K derivative by repeated automatic differentiation. We instead organize the forward recursion of the multivariate Faà di Bruno formula and its explicit backpropagation over a prescribed downward-closed set of multi-indices, with the Bell-polynomial convolutions tabulated once. The forward pass carries only the derivatives the differential operator requires. The backward pass propagates gradients from losses formed from any subset of them, including nonlinear products and coupled fields. Both recursions are exact up to roundoff and avoid nested computational graphs. An independent Taylor-jet implementation, symbolic checks of the test problems, and finite differences verify derivatives and loss gradients through order seven. On one CPU core, the method evaluates 330 mixed derivatives with respect to four inputs through order seven and the corresponding loss gradient without the memory failures observed for several nested implementations. Numerical tests include third-, fifth-, and seventh-order dispersive equations, incompressible flow, and a manufactured five-field electrohydrodynamic system. The seventh-order Zakharov-Kuznetsov test in 3+1 dimensions has a relative solution error of 6×10⁻⁴.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对高阶偏微分方程的物理信息神经网络需要计算混合输入导数及其关于网络参数的梯度。本文组织多变量Faà di Bruno公式的前向递推，并在预先给定的向下封闭多指标集合上实现显式反向传播，从而避免嵌套计算图，同时仅携带微分算子所需的导数。该方法通过独立Taylor喷流实现、符号检验和有限差分验证了七阶以内的导数与损失梯度，并在单核CPU上计算了四个输入、七阶以内的330个混合导数及相应梯度而未出现若干嵌套实现中的内存故障。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 针对高阶偏微分方程的物理信息神经网络需要混合输入导数以及这些导数关于网络参数的梯度。标准实现通过重复自动微分来获得K阶导数。与此不同，我们在预先规定的向下封闭多指标集合上，组织多变量Faà di Bruno公式的前向递推及其显式反向传播，并将Bell多项式卷积预先制表。前向过程只携带微分算子所需的导数。反向过程则从由这些导数的任意子集形成的损失出发传播梯度，其中包括非线性乘积和耦合场。两种递推在舍入误差范围内都是精确的，并且避免了嵌套计算图。通过独立的Taylor喷流实现、对测试问题的符号检验以及有限差分，我们验证了七阶以内的导数和损失梯度。在单个CPU核心上，该方法能够计算关于四个输入、七阶以内的330个混合导数及其相应的损失梯度，而若干嵌套实现出现了内存故障。数值测试包括三阶、五阶和七阶色散方程、不可压缩流，以及一个人为构造的五场电流体动力学系统。在3+1维的七阶Zakharov–Kuznetsov测试中，所得解的相对误差为6×10⁻⁴。

articles.title: ESRIcascade.jl: A Julia package for fast computation of the Economic Systemic Risk Index
articles.title_zh: ESRIcascade.jl：用于快速计算经济系统性风险指数的Julia软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work presents ESRIcascade.jl, a Julia package for computing the Economic Systemic Risk Index (ESRI). The package combines computational efficiency with a documented interface designed for research workflows. Our benchmarks show that ESRIcascade.jl is from 140 to 300 times faster than existing implementations. For a realistically sized synthetic economy, this reduces computational time from 16 hours to 7 minutes. By reducing computation times, ESRIcascade.jl makes repeated analyses of larger production networks practical and feasible and may enable broader use of ESRI in empirical and methodological research. The package and its documentation are freely available at https://github.com/Devetak/ESRIcascade.jl under the MIT License.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了用于计算经济系统性风险指数（ESRI）的Julia软件包ESRIcascade.jl。该软件包兼顾计算效率和面向科研工作流的文档化接口，基准测试显示其速度比现有实现快140至300倍；对于规模符合实际的合成经济体，计算时间由16小时缩短至7分钟。该工具有望使较大生产网络的重复分析更加可行，并促进ESRI在实证和方法学研究中的应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文介绍了ESRIcascade.jl，这是一个用于计算经济系统性风险指数（ESRI）的Julia软件包。该软件包将计算效率与面向科研工作流设计的文档化接口相结合。基准测试显示，ESRIcascade.jl的速度比现有实现快140至300倍。对于一个规模符合实际的合成经济体，这使计算时间从16小时缩短到7分钟。通过缩短计算时间，ESRIcascade.jl使对更大生产网络进行重复分析变得切实可行，并可能推动ESRI在实证研究和方法学研究中的更广泛应用。该软件包及其文档以MIT许可证免费提供。

articles.title: A regenerating free-energy register for protein-templated period-2 DNA synthesis by Drt3b
articles.title_zh: Drt3b 介导的蛋白模板化周期 2 DNA 合成中的再生自由能寄存器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deng et al. discovered that Drt3b synthesizes protein-primed poly(AC) DNA without a nucleic-acid template. The structures reveal a finite protein architecture and product-associated contacts, but not the renewable dynamical rule that converts a bounded pocket into a long period-2 sequence. We propose that Drt3b is a regenerating protein-substrate free-energy register. The framework specifies a sampled quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) potential of mean force and a preregistered, within-domain first-order electronic-descriptor map for edge-specific activation barriers; physical curvature is admitted only through a training-frozen Taylor-remainder bound that widens uncertainty but never corrects a held-out mean. Conditional hazards derived from those barriers are averaged over unresolved conformational, hydration, protonation, and metal-coordination trajectories to yield a semi-Markov event kernel. Pointwise ratios of competing hazards are therefore fixed by the same barrier differences and preregistered prefactor rules that govern exit timing, so nucleotide choice and dwell statistics are co-generated rather than separately fitted. A regime gate separates stationary or slowly driven experiments, analyzed by a joint sequence-time cycle determinant, from genuinely nonstationary protocols, analyzed by the full age-structured tilted propagator. The decisive test is one locked parameterization: without condition-specific refitting, it must jointly predict nucleotide choice, waiting-time laws, product-length tails, and the rank, minors, null spaces, and rescue structure of perturbation responses. An independent 2026 DRT3 study supplies a stringent cross-construct transport test after sequence and structural alignment are frozen. The proposal requires neither coherent quantum computation nor coupling to an external field.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对 Deng 等发现的 Drt3b 无核酸模板合成蛋白引发 poly(AC) DNA 的现象，提出 Drt3b 是一种再生的蛋白-底物自由能寄存器。该框架将 QM/MM 平均力势、电子描述符映射、条件风险率和半 Markov 事件核结合起来，用于共同预测核苷酸选择和停留时间统计。作者提出决定性检验是使用一套锁定参数化，在无条件特异性再拟合的情况下联合预测序列、等待时间、产物长度和扰动响应结构，并强调该方案不需要相干量子计算或外场耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Deng 等发现，Drt3b 在没有核酸模板的情况下合成蛋白引发的 poly(AC) DNA。这些结构揭示了有限的蛋白架构和与产物相关的接触，但没有揭示将有界口袋转化为长周期 2 序列的可更新动力学规则。我们提出，Drt3b 是一种再生的蛋白-底物自由能寄存器。该框架规定了一个采样的量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）平均力势，以及一个预注册的、结构域内一阶电子描述符映射，用于边缘特异性活化势垒；物理曲率只通过训练冻结的 Taylor 余项界限被允许，该界限会扩大不确定性，但绝不修正留出均值。由这些势垒导出的条件风险率，在未解析的构象、水合、质子化和金属配位轨迹上取平均，从而得到一个半 Markov 事件核。因此，竞争风险率的逐点比值由相同的势垒差异和预注册的前因子规则固定，这些规则也支配退出时间，因此核苷酸选择和停留统计是共同生成的，而不是分别拟合的。一个状态门将平稳或缓慢驱动实验与真正非平稳方案区分开来；前者通过联合序列-时间循环行列式分析，后者通过完整的年龄结构倾斜传播子分析。决定性检验是一套锁定的参数化：在没有条件特异性再拟合的情况下，它必须联合预测核苷酸选择、等待时间规律、产物长度尾部，以及扰动响应的秩、子式、零空间和救援结构。一个独立的 2026 年 DRT3 研究在序列和结构比对冻结后，提供了严格的跨构建体转运检验。该提案既不需要相干量子计算，也不需要与外部场耦合。

articles.title: Magnetic Dipole Hyperfine Constants of 15 Energy Levels in ¹⁶⁹Tm II Determined by Collinear Laser Fluorescence Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 利用共线激光荧光光谱测定 ¹⁶⁹Tm II 中 15 个能级的磁偶极超精细常数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03997v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present measurements of the hyperfine structure, transition frequencies and relative intensities in 14 lines of 169Tm+ ions starting from the 4f¹³({}²!F^o₇/₂)6s₁/₂ (7/2, 1/2)₃,₄^o levels. The magnetic dipole hyperfine (A) constant of all 15 involved ionic levels are determined, 14 of which have sub-MHz accuracy. For five levels no previous measurements were reported, while all others are in excellent agreement with the literature and improve on the previous accuracy by typically 1 - 2 orders of magnitude. We compare transition strengths and include improved transition frequencies. These results are useful for the quantum computing community, modelling of Tm⁺ abundances in stellar spectra, as well as for an ongoing measurement program on short-lived Tm isotopes at ISOLDE/CERN.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究测量了 ¹⁶⁹Tm⁺ 离子 14 条谱线的超精细结构、跃迁频率和相对强度，并确定了 15 个相关离子能级的磁偶极超精细 A 常数。其中 14 个常数达到亚 MHz 精度，5 个能级此前未见测量报道，其余结果与文献高度一致且通常将精度提高 1 至 2 个数量级。结果可服务于量子计算、恒星光谱中 Tm⁺ 丰度建模，以及 ISOLDE/CERN 短寿命铥同位素测量计划。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们给出了对 ¹⁶⁹Tm⁺ 离子 14 条谱线中超精细结构、跃迁频率和相对强度的测量，这些谱线起始于 4f¹³({}²!F^o₇/₂)6s₁/₂ (7/2, 1/2)₃,₄^o 能级。我们确定了全部 15 个相关离子能级的磁偶极超精细 A 常数，其中 14 个具有亚 MHz 精度。对于 5 个能级，此前没有测量报道；其余所有能级均与文献结果高度一致，并且通常将先前精度提高了 1 至 2 个数量级。我们比较了跃迁强度，并纳入了改进后的跃迁频率。这些结果对于量子计算领域、恒星光谱中 Tm⁺ 丰度建模，以及 ISOLDE/CERN 正在开展的短寿命铥同位素测量计划均有用。

articles.title: Stochastic Operator Inference for reduced-order modeling of capillary wave turbulence using experimental measurements
articles.title_zh: 利用实验测量的随机算子推断进行毛细波湍流降阶建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04008v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modeling complex physical phenomena directly from experimental data poses fundamental challenges: measurement devices introduce noise and biases into the data, the governing equations are often unknown or intractable, and the dynamics observed experimentally may exhibit stochastic behavior. In this paper, we consider capillary wave turbulence---an example of nonlinear wave interactions at a microfluidic interface---measured by ultra-high-speed digital holographic microscopy. With the goal to learn an efficient model directly from these data, we adapt a stochastic extension of Operator Inference to learn low-dimensional stochastic differential equation representations of the microscale wave dynamics from experimental measurements. Each experiment is repeated 16 times, and 10 different conditions are created by changing the nondimensional acoustic capillary number through an excitation device. In addition, we propose a new strategy to select the reduced-order model dimension, based on both mean and covariance errors. We further add Tikhonov regularization to the stochastic Operator Inference framework and show that, beyond its conventional role as a numerical stabilization technique in deterministic settings, it has a physically meaningful interpretation as controlling the spectral content of the learned stochastic dynamics. We demonstrate that the resulting stochastic reduced-order models faithfully capture salient physical features of capillary wave turbulence across a range of experimental conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文面向由超高速数字全息显微术测得的微流控界面毛细波湍流，提出随机算子推断方法以直接从实验数据学习低维随机微分方程模型。研究还提出基于均值误差和协方差误差的降阶维度选择策略，并在随机算子推断中加入 Tikhonov 正则化。结果表明，所得随机降阶模型能够在多种实验条件下忠实捕捉毛细波湍流的关键物理特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 直接从实验数据对复杂物理现象进行建模面临根本性挑战：测量设备会向数据中引入噪声和偏差，控制方程往往未知或难以处理，并且实验观测到的动力学可能表现出随机行为。本文考虑毛细波湍流，这是微流控界面上非线性波相互作用的一个例子，并通过超高速数字全息显微术进行测量。为实现直接从这些数据中学习高效模型的目标，我们改造了一种算子推断的随机扩展，用于从实验测量中学习微尺度波动力学的低维随机微分方程表示。每个实验重复 16 次，并通过激励装置改变无量纲声毛细数来创建 10 种不同条件。此外，我们提出了一种新的降阶模型维度选择策略，同时基于均值误差和协方差误差。我们进一步向随机算子推断框架中加入 Tikhonov 正则化，并表明它除了在确定性设置中作为数值稳定化技术的传统作用之外，还具有物理上有意义的解释，即控制所学习随机动力学的谱内容。我们证明，所得随机降阶模型能够在一系列实验条件下忠实捕捉毛细波湍流的显著物理特征。

articles.title: Sub-barrier peaks in atom-atom-ion three-body recombination
articles.title_zh: 原子-原子-离子三体复合中的势垒下峰
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04106v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid atom-ion experiments have recently entered the few-partial wave regime in which magnetically tunable Feshbach resonances dominate the three-body loss dynamics. This necessitates a treatment of three-body recombination that can incorporate the role of the resonant dimer channel. Here, we develop a two-step Lindemann-type model for resonant atom-atom-ion three-body recombination that combines multichannel quantum-defect theory for the long-range polarization potential with a universal quantum-capture treatment of the inelastic atom-dimer step. We show that within our model, rate competition can lead to a peak in the three-body-recombination cross section of higher partial-wave channels at energies well below their corresponding centrifugal barrier. Investigating the resulting loss rates under numerically obtained non-thermal collision-energy distributions, we find that these effects survive the energy averaging and can be observed in state-of-the-art hybrid experimental setups. Our findings pave the way for a detailed characterization of atom-ion Feshbach resonances via the analysis of inelastic three-body-recombination processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对混合原子-离子实验中 Feshbach 共振主导三体损失动力学的情形，发展了一个共振原子-原子-离子三体复合的两步 Lindemann 型模型。模型结合长程极化势的多通道量子亏损理论与非弹性原子-二聚体步骤的普适量子俘获处理。研究发现，速率竞争可在高偏波通道的三体复合截面中产生远低于相应离心势垒能量的峰，并且这些效应在先进实验装置中可观测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合原子-离子实验最近已进入少数偏波区，在该区中可磁调谐的 Feshbach 共振主导三体损失动力学。这要求一种能够纳入共振二聚体通道作用的三体复合处理方法。在这里，我们发展了一个用于共振原子-原子-离子三体复合的两步 Lindemann 型模型，该模型将用于长程极化势的多通道量子亏损理论与非弹性原子-二聚体步骤的普适量子俘获处理相结合。我们表明，在我们的模型中，速率竞争能够在高偏波通道的三体复合截面中导致一个峰，该峰出现在远低于其相应离心势垒的能量处。通过研究在数值获得的非热碰撞能量分布下产生的损失率，我们发现这些效应在能量平均后仍然存在，并可在最先进的混合实验装置中观测到。我们的发现为通过分析非弹性三体复合过程来详细表征原子-离子 Feshbach 共振铺平了道路。

articles.title: Twin-photon generation in a silicon nitride microresonator
articles.title_zh: 硅氮化物微谐振器中的孪生光子产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04171v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photonic chips with silicon nitride (Si₃N₄) microring resonators are well established as heralded single-photon sources, but their operation as frequency-degenerate twin-photon sources has not previously been demonstrated. Here, we realise a twin-photon source at telecommunication wavelengths in a Si₃N₄ ring microresonator via an inverse four-wave mixing (FWM) process, in which two photons from spectrally distinct pumps are converted into a pair of identical twin photons. The measurements show a maximum coincidence-to-accidental ratio (CAR) of 5.4±0.6. In addition, the microresonator functions as a heralded single-photon source through pump-degenerate spontaneous four-wave mixing (SFWM), exhibiting a spectral purity of P=0.67±0.05 and a heralded anti-bunching of g⁽²⁾ₕ(0)=0.0042±0.0015. Together, these results demonstrate both photon-generation schemes on a single integrated Si₃N₄ platform, highlighting its potential for scalable, tailored quantum light generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在硅氮化物环形微谐振器中通过逆四波混频过程实现了通信波长处的频率简并孪生光子源。测量显示最大符合偶然比为 5.4±0.6。该器件还可通过泵浦简并自发四波混频作为预报单光子源，展示了单一集成 Si₃N₄ 平台上两类光子产生方案的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 带有硅氮化物（Si₃N₄）微环谐振器的光子芯片已被充分确立为预报单光子源，但其作为频率简并孪生光子源的运行此前尚未得到证明。在这里，我们通过逆四波混频（FWM）过程，在 Si₃N₄ 环形微谐振器中实现了通信波长处的孪生光子源，在该过程中，来自光谱上不同泵浦的两个光子被转换为一对相同的孪生光子。测量显示最大符合偶然比（CAR）为 5.4±0.6。此外，该微谐振器还通过泵浦简并自发四波混频（SFWM）作为预报单光子源，表现出 P=0.67±0.05 的光谱纯度和 g⁽²⁾ₕ(0)=0.0042±0.0015 的预报反聚束。综合来看，这些结果在单一集成 Si₃N₄ 平台上展示了两种光子产生方案，凸显了其在可扩展、可定制量子光生成方面的潜力。

articles.title: Oscillating Heat Transfer Prediction in Porous Structures Using Generative AI-Assisted Explainable Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 利用生成式 AI 辅助的可解释机器学习预测多孔结构中的振荡换热
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.11863v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting and interpreting thermal performance under oscillating flow in porous structures remains a critical challenge due to the complex coupling between fluid dynamics and geometric features. This study introduces a data-driven wGAN-LBM-Nested_CV framework that integrates generative deep learning, numerical simulation based on the lattice Boltzmann method (LBM), and interpretable machine learning to predict and explain the thermal behavior in such systems. A wide range of porous structures with diverse topologies were synthesized using a Wasserstein generative adversarial network with gradient penalty (wGAN-GP), significantly expanding the design space. High-fidelity thermal data were then generated through LBM simulations across various Reynolds (Re) and Strouhal numbers (St). Among several machine learning models evaluated via nested cross-validation and Bayesian optimization, XGBoost achieved the best predictive performance for the average Nusselt number (Nu) (R²=0.9981). Model interpretation using SHAP identified the Reynolds number, Strouhal number, porosity, specific surface area, and pore size dispersion as the most influential predictors, while also revealing synergistic interactions among them. Threshold-based insights, including Re > 75 and porosity > 0.6256, provide practical guidance for enhancing convective heat transfer. This integrated approach delivers both quantitative predictive accuracy and physical interpretability, offering actionable guidelines for designing porous media with improved thermal performance under oscillatory flow conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 wGAN-LBM-Nested_CV 数据驱动框架，结合生成式深度学习、格子 Boltzmann 数值模拟和可解释机器学习，以预测并解释多孔结构中振荡流下的热行为。研究用 wGAN-GP 扩展多孔结构设计空间，并通过 LBM 在不同 Reynolds 数和 Strouhal 数下生成高保真热数据。XGBoost 对平均 Nusselt 数取得最佳预测性能，SHAP 分析识别出关键影响因素及其协同作用，并给出提升对流换热的阈值型设计启示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于流体动力学与几何特征之间复杂耦合，在多孔结构的振荡流下预测和解释热性能仍是一项关键挑战。本研究提出一种数据驱动的 wGAN-LBM-Nested_CV 框架，该框架集成了生成式深度学习、基于格子 Boltzmann 方法（LBM）的数值模拟和可解释机器学习，用于预测并解释此类系统中的热行为。研究使用带梯度惩罚的 Wasserstein 生成对抗网络（wGAN-GP）合成了大量具有多样拓扑的多孔结构，显著扩展了设计空间。随后，通过 LBM 模拟在不同 Reynolds 数（Re）和 Strouhal 数（St）下生成高保真热数据。在通过嵌套交叉验证和贝叶斯优化评估的多种机器学习模型中，XGBoost 对平均 Nusselt 数（Nu）取得了最佳预测性能（R²=0.9981）。使用 SHAP 进行的模型解释确定 Reynolds 数、Strouhal 数、孔隙率、比表面积和孔径离散度是最具影响力的预测因子，同时还揭示了它们之间的协同相互作用。基于阈值的见解，包括 Re > 75 和孔隙率 > 0.6256，为增强对流换热提供了实践指导。这种集成方法同时提供了定量预测精度和物理可解释性，为设计在振荡流条件下具有改进热性能的多孔介质提供了可操作指南。

articles.title: A discontinuous Petrov-Galerkin finite-element framework for the simulation of microwave-heated flows
articles.title_zh: 用于微波加热流动模拟的间断 Petrov-Galerkin 有限元框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03155v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a high-order multiphysics solver for the simulation of microwave-heated flows. The solver couples a discontinuous Petrov-Galerkin (DPG) finite element method for the time-harmonic Maxwell equations with continuous Galerkin finite element methods for the heat equation and the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. We validate the electromagnetic solver against multiple benchmark problems: wave propagation in a rectangular waveguide, a cavity problem with a singular solution, and a microwave-heated obstacle problem, comparing our results against numerical and experimental data from the literature. The results confirm the validity of the implementation and demonstrate its ability to perform adaptive mesh refinement using the DPG method's built-in error estimator. The final part of the study showcases the capabilities of the multiphysics framework through simulations of microwave-heated flow around obstacles with singular geometric features. These results highlight the potential of the proposed framework for the simulation and optimization of microwave-assisted chemical processes. Finally, the developed high-order multiphysics solver has a low memory footprint, since the electromagnetic solver relies on a Conjugate Gradient (CG) iterative solver and the fluid solver is implemented in a matrix-free fashion, making the overall approach scalable and well-suited for large-scale parallel simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出用于模拟微波加热流动的高阶多物理场求解器，将时间谐波 Maxwell 方程的 DPG 有限元方法与热方程和不可压 Navier-Stokes 方程的连续 Galerkin 有限元方法耦合。作者通过多个电磁基准问题验证求解器，并展示其利用 DPG 内置误差估计器进行自适应网格加密的能力。最终模拟表明，该框架适用于具有奇异几何特征障碍物周围的微波加热流动，并具备可扩展、低内存占用的大规模并行潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种用于模拟微波加热流动的高阶多物理场求解器。该求解器将用于时间谐波 Maxwell 方程的间断 Petrov-Galerkin（DPG）有限元方法，与用于热方程和不可压 Navier-Stokes 方程的连续 Galerkin 有限元方法相耦合。我们通过多个基准问题验证电磁求解器：矩形波导中的波传播、具有奇异解的腔体问题以及微波加热障碍物问题，并将我们的结果与文献中的数值和实验数据进行比较。结果证实了实现的有效性，并展示了其利用 DPG 方法内置误差估计器进行自适应网格加密的能力。研究的最后部分通过对具有奇异几何特征的障碍物周围微波加热流动进行模拟，展示了该多物理场框架的能力。这些结果凸显了所提出框架在微波辅助化学过程模拟与优化方面的潜力。最后，所开发的高阶多物理场求解器具有较低内存占用，因为电磁求解器依赖共轭梯度（CG）迭代求解器，而流体求解器以无矩阵方式实现，使整体方法具有可扩展性并非常适合大规模并行模拟。

articles.title: Bifurcations in the Heliosphere: Global-scale Coronal Pseudostreamer Evolution and the Creation of Secondary Heliospheric Current Sheets
articles.title_zh: 日球层中的分岔：全球尺度日冕伪流光演化与次级日球电流片的形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03298v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The heliospheric current sheet (HCS) is the boundary between open magnetic fields of opposite polarity in the solar wind that connect back to their respective open flux regions in the corona. The HCS is often described as a disc-like sheet warped by the combined effects of the inclination of the magnetic equator on the Sun, solar rotation, and solar wind expansion. The HCS is an extension of the helmet streamer belt-the closed-flux region resulting from the global dipole component of the observed photospheric magnetic field. In the absence of a strong dipole, a dominant quadrupole can result in two separate HCSs. Here we report on a set of idealized, axisymmetric solar wind simulations designed to study the transition of the single-HCS corona and inner heliosphere into a multiple-HCS configuration, run with the WindPredict-AW PLUTO MHD code. We systematically vary the relative strengths of the dipole/quadrupole contributions to the global field and show this results in the formation of a large-scale, closed-flux pseudostreamer that interacts with the ambient solar wind. We find that when the dipole and quadrupole magnitudes are approximately equal, our model corona can oscillate between a one- and two-HCS configuration on the timescale of days-to-weeks. We characterize the plasma dynamics of the transition of a global-scale pseudostreamer into a localized, secondary helmet-streamer belt with its own HCS surrounding a newly-opened, opposite-polarity coronal hole. We discuss the implications of our results for solar cycle evolution and the dynamic coupling of the highly structured corona and inner heliosphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究用理想化轴对称太阳风模拟考察单一日球电流片的日冕和内日球层如何转变为多电流片构型。作者系统改变全球磁场中偶极与四极贡献的相对强度，发现可形成与背景太阳风相互作用的大尺度闭合磁通伪流光。模型表明，当偶极和四极强度近似相等时，日冕可在数日至数周时间尺度上于单电流片和双电流片构型之间振荡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 日球电流片（HCS）是太阳风中相反极性开放磁场之间的边界，这些磁场向回连接到日冕中各自的开放磁通区域。HCS 通常被描述为一种盘状片结构，受到太阳上磁赤道倾角、太阳自转和太阳风膨胀的共同作用而发生弯曲。HCS 是盔状流光带的延伸，后者是由观测到的光球磁场的全球偶极分量产生的闭合磁通区域。在不存在强偶极的情况下，占主导的四极可能导致两个分离的 HCS。在这里，我们报告一组理想化轴对称太阳风模拟，旨在研究单 HCS 日冕和内日球层向多 HCS 构型的转变，这些模拟使用 WindPredict-AW PLUTO MHD 代码运行。我们系统改变全球磁场中偶极和四极贡献的相对强度，并表明这会导致形成一个与背景太阳风相互作用的大尺度闭合磁通伪流光。我们发现，当偶极和四极的大小近似相等时，我们的模型日冕可以在数日至数周的时间尺度上在单 HCS 和双 HCS 构型之间振荡。我们表征了全球尺度伪流光转变为局地次级盔状流光带时的等离子体动力学，该次级盔状流光带具有自身的 HCS，并环绕一个新近打开的相反极性日冕洞。我们讨论了这些结果对于太阳周期演化以及高度结构化日冕与内日球层动态耦合的意义。

articles.title: The Role of Preceding CMEs and SIRs in Enhancing Shock Acceleration of Electrons
articles.title_zh: 前导日冕物质抛射与流相互作用区在增强电子激波加速中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03709v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The role of large-scale pre-existing interplanetary structures, including preceding coronal mass ejections (CMEs) and stream interaction regions (SIRs), in shaping the shock acceleration environment for energetic electrons remains not fully understood. In this study, we investigate nine interplanetary shocks observed by the Solar Terrestrial Relations Observatory (STEREO) that are associated with significant MeV electron enhancements, as such enhancements are rarely observed at interplanetary shocks. We combine remote-sensing observations, drag-based modeling, and in-situ measurements to analyze the shock propagation through pre-existing interplanetary structures. Eight of the nine events are associated with a preceding slow or intermediate-speed CME, while six shocks are in-situ observed propagating within preceding ICMEs, indicating that large-scale upstream trapping structures are a common feature of these events. Further analysis identifies three distinct scenarios associated with enhanced electron acceleration: shocks propagating through preceding ICMEs, shock-SIR interactions, and direct injection of flare-accelerated electrons into SIRs. As a representative shock-in-ICME event, the 2012 January 29 low-β, quasi-perpendicular shock (θBₙsim87^circ) is further investigated using observations together with one-dimensional Monte Carlo test-particle simulations of a shock propagating into a large-scale upstream magnetic loop. The simulation suggests that the upstream loop prolongs electron residence near the shock and substantially enhances acceleration efficiency. These results demonstrate that large-scale interplanetary structures can precondition the upstream magnetic environment, providing favorable conditions for prolonged electron residence and efficient shock acceleration.
articles.abstract_zh: 大尺度预先存在的行星际结构可能通过改变激波上游磁环境，增强高能电子的激波加速。对九个与显著MeV电子增强相关的行星际激波进行研究发现，前导CME、前导ICME和激波-SIR相互作用是三种主要情形。模拟表明，上游大尺度磁环能够延长电子在激波附近的停留时间，从而显著提高加速效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 包括前导日冕物质抛射（CME）和流相互作用区（SIR）在内的大尺度预先存在的行星际结构，如何塑造高能电子的激波加速环境，仍未得到充分理解。在本研究中，我们考察了由太阳—地球关系天文台（STEREO）观测到的九个行星际激波，这些激波均与显著的MeV电子增强相关，因为在行星际激波处很少观测到此类增强。我们结合遥感观测、基于阻力的模型和原位测量，分析激波穿过预先存在的行星际结构时的传播过程。九个事件中的八个与先前出现的慢速或中速CME相关，其中六个激波被原位观测到正在前导ICME内部传播，这表明大尺度上游俘获结构是这些事件的共同特征。进一步分析确定了与增强电子加速相关的三种不同情形：激波在前导ICME内部传播、激波与SIR相互作用，以及耀斑加速电子直接注入SIR。作为一个具有代表性的ICME内激波事件，我们进一步研究了2012年1月29日的低β准垂直激波（θBn约为87°），所采用的方法结合了观测数据与一维蒙特卡罗测试粒子模拟，模拟对象是一个向大尺度上游磁环传播的激波。模拟表明，上游磁环能够延长电子在激波附近的停留时间，并显著提高加速效率。这些结果表明，大尺度行星际结构能够预先调节上游磁环境，为电子长时间停留和高效激波加速提供有利条件。

articles.title: FPGA Implementation of a CNN-based Topological Trigger for HL-LHC
articles.title_zh: 面向高亮度大型强子对撞机的基于卷积神经网络拓扑触发器的FPGA实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.09428v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The implementation of convolutional neural networks in programmable logic, for applications in fast online event selection at hadron colliders, is studied. In particular, an approach based on full event images for classification is studied, including hardware-aware optimisation of the network architecture, and evaluation of physics performance using simulated data. A range of network models are identified that can be implemented within resources of current FPGAs, as well as the stringent latency requirements of HL-LHC trigger systems. A candidate model that can be implemented in the CMS L1 trigger for HL-LHC is shown to be capable of excellent signal/background discrimination for a key HL-LHC channel, HH(bbbb), although the performance depends strongly on the degree of pile-up mitigation prior to image generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在可编程逻辑中实现卷积神经网络，以用于强子对撞机的快速在线事例选择。研究重点是基于完整事例图像的分类方法，并结合硬件感知的网络架构优化和模拟数据上的物理性能评估。结果表明，某一候选模型可部署于CMS高亮度大型强子对撞机一级触发器，并能在HH→bbbb道中实现出色的信号与背景判别，但其性能高度依赖图像生成前对堆积效应的抑制程度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了在可编程逻辑中实现卷积神经网络，以应用于强子对撞机中的快速在线事例选择。具体而言，研究了一种基于完整事例图像进行分类的方法，其中包括网络架构的硬件感知优化，以及利用模拟数据对物理性能进行评估。研究确定了一系列网络模型，它们既能够在当前FPGA的资源范围内实现，也能够满足高亮度大型强子对撞机（HL-LHC）触发系统严格的延迟要求。研究显示，一个可部署于CMS高亮度大型强子对撞机一级触发器的候选模型，能够在一个关键的高亮度大型强子对撞机物理道HH（bbbb）中实现出色的信号与背景判别能力，不过其性能强烈依赖于图像生成之前对堆积效应的抑制程度。

articles.title: CARDIO-Affect: A Hamiltonian-Variability Framework for Spatio-Temporal Emotional Pattern Recognition with Manifold-Based Individual and Group Profiling
articles.title_zh: CARDIO-Affect：用于时空情感模式识别及流形个体与群体刻画的哈密顿量变异性框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.16046v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present CARDIO-Affect, a complex-systems theoretical framework for long-term emotional dynamics in bounded social groups, with explicit uncertainty quantification at every layer. Long-period naturalistic emotion in stable small groups exhibits hallmarks of complex systems -- multi-stable attractors, weak chaos, long-range memory, and sparse heterogeneous coupling -- invisible to conventional short-clip facial-emotion analysis. CARDIO-Affect treats individual emotion as a multi-stable nonlinear stochastic dynamical system and group emotion as a sparsely-coupled network with emergent macrostates, formalised through six propositions and four pillars: (i) statistical mechanics with neural-parameterised Hamiltonian SDE over asymmetric potentials; (ii) information geometry on a 45-dimensional Fisher-Rao manifold; (iii) topological data analysis for invariant trajectory signatures; (iv) HRV-inspired Emotional Variability Analytics (EVA) decomposing each person-day into multi-scale time/frequency/nonlinear measures. We validate on the first 30.1-month longitudinal in-the-wild facial-emotion corpus (companion: arXiv:2510.15221) by discovering three falsifiable paradoxes: Sparse-Contagion (R₀=0.36, density 2.7%, 8 BH-FDR edges), Asymmetric-Persistence (negative dwell 5.85x positive, 1.77D potential gap), and Crisis-Inversion (Shanghai 2022 lockdown naive d=-0.40 collapses to permutation-p=0.94 under BSTS + synthetic-control). On synthetic benchmarks, CARDIO-EBM v2 matches asymptotically optimal Granger on linear VAR data (Class A AUROC 0.984+/-0.012 vs Granger 0.997+/-0.001, 5 seeds) but fails on tanh-coupled nonlinear data (Class B AUROC 0.490 vs Granger 0.796), a documented limitation of the linear mask-self estimator. We release framework code and the full reproduction pipeline.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出CARDIO-Affect，用于描述受限社会群体中的长期情感动力学，并在各层级显式量化不确定性。该框架结合神经参数化哈密顿随机微分方程、Fisher-Rao信息几何、拓扑数据分析和多尺度情感变异性分析。基于纵向自然场景面部情感数据，研究发现了稀疏传染、不对称持续性和危机反转三个可证伪现象，同时报告了模型在非线性耦合数据上的局限性，并公开了代码与复现实验流程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出CARDIO-Affect，这是一个用于描述受限社会群体中长期情感动力学的复杂系统理论框架，并在每一层显式进行不确定性量化。稳定小群体中的长周期自然情境情感表现出复杂系统的特征，包括多稳态吸引子、弱混沌、长程记忆和稀疏异质耦合，而这些特征在传统的短片段面部情绪分析中是不可见的。CARDIO-Affect将个体情感视为多稳态非线性随机动力系统，并将群体情感视为具有涌现宏观状态的稀疏耦合网络，具体通过六个命题和四个支柱加以形式化：（i）采用具有非对称势的神经参数化哈密顿随机微分方程的统计力学；（ii）45维Fisher-Rao流形上的信息几何；（iii）用于不变轨迹特征分析的拓扑数据分析；（iv）受心率变异性启发的情感变异性分析（EVA），将每个人每天的情感分解为多尺度的时间域、频率域和非线性指标。我们在首个为期30.1个月的真实场景纵向面部情感语料库上进行了验证，该语料库的配套研究见arXiv:2510.15221，并发现了三个可证伪的悖论：稀疏传染（R0=0.36、密度为2.7%、8条经BH-FDR校正的边）、不对称持续性（负面情感的停留时间是正面情感的5.85倍，势差为1.77D），以及危机反转（2022年上海封控期间，朴素估计的d=-0.40在BSTS加合成控制方法下坍缩为置换检验p=0.94）。在合成基准测试中，CARDIO-EBM v2在合成线性VAR数据上达到了与渐近最优格兰杰方法相近的表现（5个随机种子下，A类AUROC为0.984±0.012，而格兰杰方法为0.997±0.001），但在双曲正切耦合的非线性数据上表现失败（B类AUROC为0.490，而格兰杰方法为0.796），这表明线性掩码自估计器存在已记录的局限性。我们公开了框架代码和完整的复现实验流程。

articles.title: On large-scale wind-drift ocean currents: An asymptotic approach in spherical coordinates
articles.title_zh: 大尺度风生海洋漂移洋流：球坐标下的渐近方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06473v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Starting from the Navier--Stokes equations in rotating spherical coordinates with depth-varying density and eddy viscosity, we derive an asymptotic model describing non-equatorial wind-generated ocean drift currents. Our approach allows for large-scale flows that cannot be captured by classical tangent-plane approximations. The strategy is to perform a careful scaling and to perform a double asymptotic expansion with respect to two small parameters arising from the scaling: the Rossby number and the ratio between the Ekman depth and the Earth's radius. We obtain a system of linear ordinary differential equations with nonlinear boundary conditions governing the leading-order dynamics, highlighting that the dynamics is governed by the linear terms, whereas the nonlinear ones, related to the injection and dissipation of kinetic energy, appear only at higher order. We use the leading-order equations to compare our model with the simplest theory of ocean circulation due to Sverdrup and note that, even at this level of simplification, our equations have the potential to provide deeper insight. Subsequently, focusing on Ekman flows, we prove existence and uniqueness of the leading-order solution, which retains the classical Ekman spiral structure for arbitrary eddy viscosity profiles. Finally, we compute the surface deflection angle of the wind-driven current for three explicit eddy viscosity profiles, obtaining results consistent with observations. In addition, we derive the governing equations for the first-order correction with respect to the Rossby number and provide a priori bounds for its solution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从具有随深度变化的密度和涡黏性的旋转球坐标Navier–Stokes方程出发，推导描述非赤道风生海洋漂移洋流的渐近模型。通过对罗斯贝数和厄克曼深度与地球半径之比进行双重渐近展开，得到由线性常微分方程和非线性边界条件构成的领先阶模型。该模型保留了任意涡黏性剖面下的经典厄克曼螺旋结构，并给出了表面偏转角及罗斯贝数一阶修正的结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从旋转球坐标下、具有随深度变化的密度和涡黏性的Navier–Stokes方程出发，推导出一个描述非赤道风生海洋漂移洋流的渐近模型。我们的方法能够处理经典切平面近似无法描述的大尺度流动。具体策略是进行仔细的尺度分析，并针对由该尺度分析产生的两个小参数进行双重渐近展开，这两个参数分别是罗斯贝数以及厄克曼深度与地球半径之比。我们得到一个由线性常微分方程和非线性边界条件构成的系统，用以控制领先阶动力学，并揭示动力学由线性项主导，而与动能注入和耗散有关的非线性项只在更高阶出现。我们利用领先阶方程将该模型与Sverdrup提出的最简单海洋环流理论进行比较，并指出，即使在这一简化层次上，我们的方程也有望提供更深入的认识。随后，我们聚焦于厄克曼流，证明了领先阶解的存在性和唯一性，并表明该解在任意涡黏性剖面下仍保留经典的厄克曼螺旋结构。最后，我们针对三种显式涡黏性剖面计算了风驱动洋流的表面偏转角，所得结果与观测一致。此外，我们推导了关于罗斯贝数的一阶修正所满足的控制方程，并为其解给出了先验界。

articles.title: Revealing Magnon-Photon Coupling in Ultrathin Magnetic Films Using the Derivative-Divide Method
articles.title_zh: 利用导数-相除法揭示超薄磁性薄膜中的磁振子-光子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.10770v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnon-photon coupling in planar cavities provides a promising platform for integrated cavity magnonics devices. However, its characterization becomes challenging in ultrathin magnetic films because their weak magnetic response can be obscured by the much stronger microwave background. Here, we employ the derivative-divide method to extract the field-dependent magnetic response from transmission measurements of split-ring resonators. The method reveals clear magn-photon anticrossings that are hardly discernible in conventional transmission spectra and enables quantitative extraction of the coupling strength. We resolve coupling in yttrium iron garnet films down to 60 nm and extend the approach to conductive CoFeB films down to 5 nm. Our results demonstrate a practical method for characterizing magno-photon coupling in ultrathin magnetic films, providing an experimental route toward cavity magnonics systems based on ultrathin magnetic films.
articles.abstract_zh: 平面腔中的磁振子-光子耦合为集成腔磁学器件提供了平台，但超薄磁性薄膜的微弱磁响应容易被强微波背景掩盖。本文采用导数-相除法，从裂环谐振器的透射测量中提取随磁场变化的磁响应，并清晰解析出常规透射谱中难以辨认的反交叉现象。该方法在厚度低至60纳米的钇铁石榴石薄膜和厚度低至5纳米的导电CoFeB薄膜中均实现了耦合强度的定量提取。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平面腔中的磁振子-光子耦合为集成腔磁学器件提供了一个有前景的平台。然而，在超薄磁性薄膜中，由于磁响应较弱，耦合特性的表征可能具有挑战性，因为磁响应会被强得多的微波背景所掩盖。在这里，我们采用导数-相除法，从裂环谐振器的透射测量中提取随磁场变化的磁响应。该方法揭示了清晰的磁振子-光子反交叉，而这些反交叉在传统透射谱中几乎难以辨认，并能够定量提取耦合强度。我们在厚度低至60纳米的钇铁石榴石薄膜中分辨出耦合，并将该方法扩展到厚度低至5纳米的导电CoFeB薄膜。我们的结果展示了一种表征超薄磁性薄膜中磁振子-光子耦合的实用方法，为构建基于超薄磁性薄膜的腔磁学系统提供了实验途径。

articles.title: Learning shadows to predict quantum ground state correlations
articles.title_zh: 学习量子阴影以预测量子基态关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.00052v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a variational scheme inspired by classical shadow tomography to compute ground state correlations of quantum spin Hamiltonians. Shadow tomography allows for efficient reconstruction of expectation values of arbitrary observables from a bag of repeated, randomized measurements, called snapshots, on copies of the state ρ. The prescription allows one to infer expectation values of M k-local observables to accuracy ϵ using just N sim 3^k logM /ϵ² snapshots when measurements are performed in locally random bases. Turning this around, a bag of snapshots can be considered an efficient representation of the state ρ, particularly for estimating low-weight observables, such as terms in a local Hamiltonian needed to estimate the energy. Inspired by this, we consider a variational scheme wherein a bag of N parametrized snapshots is used to represent the putative ground state of a desired local spin Hamiltonian and optimized to lower the energy with respect to it. Additional constraints in the form of positivity of reduced density matrices, motivated by work in quantum chemistry, are employed to ensure compatibility of the predicted correlations with the underlying Hilbert space. Despite the limited set of imposed constraints, we show that the optimized ensemble of snapshots yields fairly accurate estimates of the ground state energy and other correlations, including those that do not appear in the set of constraints used in optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种受经典阴影层析启发的变分方案，用于计算量子自旋哈密顿量的基态关联。该方法以一组参数化测量快照表示候选基态，并通过降低局域哈密顿量能量进行优化，同时利用约化密度矩阵的正定性约束保证预测关联与底层希尔伯特空间相容。尽管施加的约束有限，优化后的快照集合仍能较准确地估计基态能量及未直接用于优化约束的其他关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种受经典阴影层析启发的变分方案，用于计算量子自旋哈密顿量的基态关联。阴影层析允许人们从对量子态ρ的多个副本进行重复随机测量所获得的一组快照中，高效重构任意可观测量的期望值。该方法表明，当测量在局域随机基底中进行时，只需N约为3的k次方乘以log M再除以ε的平方个快照，就能够以精度ε推断M个k-局域可观测量的期望值。反过来看，一组快照可以被视为量子态ρ的一种高效表示，尤其适用于估计低权重可观测量，例如用于估计能量的局域哈密顿量项。受此启发，我们考虑一种变分方案，其中使用由N个参数化快照组成的集合来表示目标局域自旋哈密顿量的候选基态，并通过针对该哈密顿量降低能量对其进行优化。我们进一步施加了约化密度矩阵正定性形式的约束，这些约束受到量子化学相关工作的启发，用于确保预测得到的关联与底层希尔伯特空间相容。尽管施加的约束集合有限，我们仍然表明，优化后的快照集合能够较准确地估计基态能量和其他关联，包括那些未出现在优化所用约束集合中的关联。

articles.title: Quantum Skyrmions in Mixed States of Light and Their Nested Topology
articles.title_zh: 光的混合态中的量子斯格明子及其嵌套拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.23571v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Topological quasiparticles of light, such as classical and quantum optical skyrmions, have so far relied on fully coherent or pure quantum states whose topology is encoded in the entanglement between polarization and two-dimensional spatial modes. Here we show that skyrmionic topology can emerge directly within the density matrix of a mixed quantum state. We introduce a framework in which a coherence-Stokes vector defines a topological texture over the density matrix, enabling the realization of quantum skyrmions using only a pseudospin and a real or synthetic one-dimensional space of modes. For a single photon, the density matrix is analogous to the coherence matrix of classical light, and can be encoded using partially coherent electromagnetic fields. We further analyze the topological texture encoded in a bipartite entangled photon pair, showing how skyrmions arise not only in the full bi-photon system, but also in its reduced subspaces with any pseudospin-mode combination simultaneously. We then explore the robustness of such skyrmions to environmental noise, and discover their persistence in mixed-quantum states of multiple photons. Finally, we propose a feasible experimental route to generate and measure such skyrmions using integrated photonic networks, and suggest avenues for similar implementations in other quantum systems.
