articles.abstract_zh_full: 硅酸盐玻璃在严苛服役环境中的应用需要在机械载荷和表面摩擦学条件下对结构强度进行精确评估。由于玻璃强度由表面缺陷和微裂纹支配，而不是一种内禀材料性质，因此通常广泛采用由内部拉伸区平衡的表面残余压缩场来抑制缺陷张开。本研究并非依赖传统许用应力准则来确定产品验收，而是采用基于应力强度因子 KI 以及基本材料极限的断裂力学框架：用于快速断裂的临界应力强度因子 KIC，以及用于延时静疲劳失效的阈值应力强度因子 KIth。利用权函数法（WFM），我们对受到非均匀内部残余应力场和外部载荷作用的二维连续（2D-Continuous）表面裂纹，在一般表面缺陷深度范围内评估 KI。针对零风险和中等风险设计方法，建立了缺陷稳定性准则。最后，评估了外加机械应力和热应力与内部残余应力场之间的相互作用与叠加。

articles.title: Non-uniform quantum geometry stabilizes generalized Wigner crystals
articles.title_zh: 非均匀量子几何稳定广义 Wigner 晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré materials host fractional Chern insulators and electron crystals in close proximity, but the mechanism selecting between them remains an open question. We address this competition in Chern bands with ideal but momentum-dependent quantum geometry -- Aharonov-Casher bands. We present an ansatz wave function for generalized Wigner crystals and, by comparing its energy to that of the competing Laughlin-like state, map out the phase diagram at filling fraction ν=1/m as a function of the degree of geometric non-uniformity. Our work identifies quantum geometry-controlled zero point fluctuations of the charge density of the generalized Wigner crystal as the mechanism controlling its relative stability, implying a kind of quantum Lindemann criterion for the crystal-liquid phase boundary.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注莫尔材料中分数量子陈绝缘体与电子晶体之间的竞争机制。作者在具有理想但动量依赖量子几何的 Chern 能带中构造广义 Wigner 晶体试探波函数，并与类 Laughlin 态比较能量，从而绘制填充分数 ν=1/m 下随几何非均匀性变化的相图。结果指出，量子几何调控的电荷密度零点涨落决定了广义 Wigner 晶体的相对稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 莫尔材料中分数量子陈绝缘体和电子晶体彼此邻近，但决定二者之间选择的机制仍是一个开放问题。我们在具有理想但动量依赖量子几何的 Chern 能带——Aharonov-Casher 能带——中处理这一竞争。我们提出了广义 Wigner 晶体的试探波函数，并通过将其能量与竞争性的类 Laughlin 态进行比较，绘制了在填充分数 ν=1/m 下，作为几何非均匀性程度函数的相图。我们的工作识别出由量子几何控制的广义 Wigner 晶体电荷密度零点涨落，是控制其相对稳定性的机制，这意味着晶体—液体相边界存在一种量子 Lindemann 判据。

articles.title: A Superconducting Peierls Instability
articles.title_zh: 一种超导 Peierls 不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Peierls instability is a foundational mechanism in condensed matter physics, showing how the electron--phonon interaction can transform a simple metal into an insulating state with a new lattice periodicity. In a one-dimensional (1D) metal the Peierls instability follows from the enhanced electronic response at wavevector Q=2k_F (connecting the Fermi points) producing a Kohn anomaly: a softening of the phonon mode at the same wavevector. Condensation of this mode then generates the tell-tale Peierls periodic lattice distortion and charge-density wave (CDW) that gaps the electronic spectrum. Here we show an analogous instability at the edge of a two-dimensional (2D) superconductor, where a dispersing Andreev bound state (ABS) hosts Bogoliubov Fermi points at ± k_c. The enhanced quasiparticle response at the connecting wavevector Q=2k_c couples directly to pairing-fluctuations and produces a superconducting Kohn anomaly: a softening of a pairing mode at the same wavevector. Condensation of this mode then generates an edge pair-density wave (PDW) that gaps the ABS. We refer to this as a superconducting Peierls instability and identify the boundary quasiparticle structure that enables it. As a concrete realization, we consider a square-lattice extended Hubbard model whose mixed-symmetry s+d+ip state hosts a dispersing ABS with zero-energy crossings at finite edge momenta. Using self-consistent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) calculations we show that the order parameter develops an edge PDW, with the wavevector set by the superconducting Kohn anomaly, that gaps the ABS crossings. Our results identify a novel mechanism for spontaneous translation-symmetry breaking in a superconductor. As this superconducting Peierls mechanism does not require an extensive zero-energy flat band or topologically protected edge states, it may apply broadly to unconventional superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了二维超导体边缘处与传统 Peierls 不稳定性类似的新机制。边缘 Andreev 束缚态中的 Bogoliubov 费米点会在连接波矢处产生增强的准粒子响应，软化配对模并诱导边缘配对密度波，从而打开能隙。作者通过扩展 Hubbard 模型和自洽 BdG 计算验证该机制，指出其可能广泛适用于非常规超导体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Peierls 不稳定性是凝聚态物理中的一个基础机制，它展示了电子—声子相互作用如何将简单金属转变为具有新晶格周期性的绝缘态。在一维（1D）金属中，Peierls 不稳定性源于在波矢 Q=2k_F（连接费米点）处增强的电子响应，从而产生 Kohn 异常：同一波矢处声子模的软化。随后该模的凝聚产生典型的 Peierls 周期性晶格畸变和电荷密度波（CDW），并使电子能谱开隙。本文中，我们展示了二维（2D）超导体边缘处的一种类似不稳定性，其中色散型 Andreev 束缚态（ABS）在 ± k_c 处具有 Bogoliubov 费米点。连接波矢 Q=2k_c 处增强的准粒子响应直接耦合到配对涨落，并产生超导 Kohn 异常：同一波矢处配对模的软化。随后该模的凝聚产生边缘配对密度波（PDW），并使 ABS 开隙。我们将其称为超导 Peierls 不稳定性，并识别出使其成为可能的边界准粒子结构。作为一个具体实现，我们考虑了平方晶格扩展 Hubbard 模型，其混合对称性的 s+d+ip 态具有色散型 ABS，并在有限边缘动量处出现零能交叉。利用自洽 Bogoliubov--de Gennes（BdG）计算，我们表明序参量会发展出边缘 PDW，其波矢由超导 Kohn 异常设定，并使 ABS 交叉开隙。我们的结果识别出一种超导体中自发平移对称性破缺的新机制。由于这种超导 Peierls 机制不需要广延的零能平带或拓扑保护边缘态，它可能广泛适用于非常规超导体。

articles.title: Wavefunctions for Anyon Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 任意子超导体的波函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04187v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anyon superconductivity arises from the condensation of mobile anyons rather than from a conventional Cooper instability, yet a systematic wavefunction description remains lacking. We develop a hierarchy-wavefunction construction for superconducting states derived from parent topological orders and identify their off-diagonal long-range order, condensate charge, chiral central charge, and residual topological order through the plasma analogy and topological field theories. We construct Abelian and non-Abelian examples descending from the semion state, a ν=2/3 hierarchy state, the ν=1/3 Laughlin state, ν=1 integer quantum Hall state, and Pfaffian state. Remarkably, for the semion case, the superconducting many-semion wavefunction is equivalent to a state of fermionized anyons filling two effective Landau levels, recovering Laughlin's original construction of semion superconductor. Finally, we show that hierarchy wavefunctions emerge naturally in the dilute, long-distance limit of the anyon-Hilbert-space formulation, which applies to ideal Chern bands and moiré bands of twisted bilayer MoTe₂. Our results establish a unified wavefunction-level framework linking anyon condensation, superconducting order, and topological field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究为由母体拓扑序衍生的任意子超导态建立层级波函数构造。作者通过等离子体类比和拓扑场论识别其非对角长程序、凝聚体电荷、手征中心荷和残余拓扑序，并构造了多个 Abelian 与非 Abelian 示例。结果建立了连接任意子凝聚、超导有序和拓扑场论的统一波函数层面框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 任意子超导性源于可移动任意子的凝聚，而非传统 Cooper 不稳定性，但系统性的波函数描述仍然缺失。我们发展了一种层级波函数构造，用于由母体拓扑序衍生的超导态，并通过等离子体类比和拓扑场论识别其非对角长程序、凝聚体电荷、手征中心荷以及残余拓扑序。我们构造了源自 semion 态、ν=2/3 层级态、ν=1/3 Laughlin 态、ν=1 整数量子 Hall 态和 Pfaffian 态的 Abelian 与非 Abelian 示例。值得注意的是，对于 semion 情形，超导多 semion 波函数等价于费米化任意子填充两个有效 Landau 能级的状态，从而恢复了 Laughlin 最初的 semion 超导体构造。最后，我们表明，层级波函数会在任意子 Hilbert 空间表述的稀薄、长距离极限中自然出现，该表述适用于理想 Chern 能带和扭转双层 MoTe₂ 的莫尔能带。我们的结果建立了一个统一的波函数层面框架，将任意子凝聚、超导有序和拓扑场论联系起来。

articles.title: Unraveling the PFAS helix: A statistical approach
articles.title_zh: 解开 PFAS 螺旋：一种统计学方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02935v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The extreme persistence of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in the environment is rooted in their three-dimensional molecular conformation. The helical twist adopted by perfluoroalkyl chains due to hyperconjugation involving their recalcitrant C-F bonds governs their resistance to degradation, yet a quantitative, continuous metric for helicity has remained absent. Here we introduce a data-driven framework that quantifies backbone helicity using three statistical descriptors: void-state (binary occupancy) spatial autocorrelations, local backbone principal component analysis, and persistent homology. We further validate each statistical descriptor against geometric dihedral benchmarks and DFT-calculated Vibrational Circular Dichroism (VCD) spectra. The framework is initially established on a homologous series of perfluorocarboxylic acids (FC2 through FC16) and their hydrogenated analogues, then extended across perfluorosulfonic acids, fluorotelomer alcohols, polyfluoroalkyl hexanoic acid analogues, and longer-chain PFOA and PFOS analogues. Agreement between statistical, geometric, and spectroscopic definitions of helicity is established for PFCAs and extended to structurally distinct subfamilies, including PFOA analogues of varying fluorine content and perfluorosulfonic acids, demonstrating that the descriptors are robust to changes in headgroup chemistry and fluorine substitution pattern. The framework provides a chemistry-agnostic toolset for incorporating backbone conformation into predictive models of PFAS environmental fate and degradation reactivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种数据驱动框架，用三个统计描述符量化 PFAS 主链螺旋性，并将其与二面角基准和 DFT 计算的振动圆二色谱进行验证。框架首先用于全氟羧酸同系物及其氢化类似物，随后扩展到多类 PFAS 子族。结果表明，这些描述符对头基化学和氟取代模式变化具有稳健性，可用于将主链构象纳入 PFAS 环境归趋和降解反应性预测模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）在环境中的极端持久性根源于其三维分子构象。由其难降解 C-F 键参与的超共轭导致全氟烷基链采取螺旋扭转，这支配了它们的抗降解性；然而，目前仍缺少一种用于螺旋性的定量连续指标。本文中，我们引入一个数据驱动框架，利用三种统计描述符量化主链螺旋性：空隙态（二元占据）空间自相关、局域主链主成分分析以及持久同调。我们进一步将每一种统计描述符同几何二面角基准以及 DFT 计算的振动圆二色谱（VCD）谱进行验证。该框架首先建立在全氟羧酸（FC2 至 FC16）的同系物系列及其氢化类似物之上，随后扩展到全氟磺酸、氟调聚醇、多氟烷基己酸类似物以及更长链的 PFOA 和 PFOS 类似物。对于 PFCAs，并进一步对于结构不同的子族，包括氟含量不同的 PFOA 类似物和全氟磺酸，统计学、几何学和光谱学对螺旋性的定义之间达成一致，表明这些描述符对于头基化学和氟取代模式的变化具有稳健性。该框架提供了一套与具体化学种类无关的工具，可将主链构象纳入 PFAS 环境归趋和降解反应性的预测模型。

articles.title: Non-Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser Quantum Sensors for Quantum Parameter Estimation
articles.title_zh: 用于量子参数估计的非 Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser 量子传感器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03092v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-KAM (Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser) systems, when subjected to weak time-dependent perturbations, exhibit an abrupt transition to classical chaos through the breakdown of invariant phase-space tori. We showcase the utilization of non-KAM systems in the quantum regime as quantum sensors, leveraging their sensitivity at resonances. Quantum Fisher information (QFI) is a central quantity in quantum parameter estimation theory that measures how much information a quantum state contains about an unknown parameter that is encoded into it. In other words, it quantifies the sensitivity of a quantum state to small changes in that parameter. In this work, through numerical analysis in conjunction with analytical results, we study the performance of the non-KAM systems for quantum sensing applications by computing the QFI. We find that the growth of the QFI is remarkably enhanced when the resonance condition is satisfied. For frequency estimation under Floquet unitary encodings, we derive a transport bound: if the mean excitation number grows as langlehat n(t)ranglesim tα, the QFI obeys I(t)lesssim t²α⁺². The quantum kicked harmonic oscillator, a paradigmatic non-KAM system, realizes the full hierarchy: localized dynamics (α=0) yield quadratic growth, delocalized diffusion along stochastic webs (α=1) yields quartic growth, and translationally invariant resonances (α=2) saturate the bound with anomalous hexic growth, I(t)sim t⁶, established analytically at resonance R=2 and numerically at R=4. The enhancement stems from resonance-induced translational symmetry rather than exponential instability, identifying non-KAM resonances as a metrological resource distinct from chaos-assisted and criticality-based sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出将非 KAM 系统在量子区域中作为量子传感器使用，利用其在共振处的高灵敏度。作者通过数值和解析方法研究量子 Fisher 信息，发现满足共振条件时其增长显著增强，并推导了 Floquet 酉编码下频率估计的输运界。以量子受踢谐振子为例，研究表明非 KAM 共振可作为一种不同于混沌辅助和临界性传感的计量资源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非 KAM（Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser）系统在受到弱时间依赖扰动时，会通过不变相空间环面的破裂而突然转变为经典混沌。我们展示了在量子区域中将非 KAM 系统用作量子传感器的方式，并利用其在共振处的灵敏度。量子 Fisher 信息（QFI）是量子参数估计理论中的核心量，用于衡量一个量子态中包含多少关于被编码到该态中的未知参数的信息。换言之，它量化了量子态对该参数微小变化的灵敏度。在本工作中，我们结合数值分析和解析结果，通过计算 QFI 来研究非 KAM 系统在量子传感应用中的性能。我们发现，当共振条件得到满足时，QFI 的增长会显著增强。对于 Floquet 酉编码下的频率估计，我们推导出一个输运界：若平均激发数按 ⟨n̂(t)⟩∼ t^α 增长，则 QFI 满足 I(t)≲ t⁽²α⁺²⁾。量子受踢谐振子是一个典型的非 KAM 系统，它实现了完整的层级：局域化动力学（α=0）产生二次增长，沿随机网的离域扩散（α=1）产生四次增长，而平移不变共振（α=2）则以反常的六次增长 I(t)∼t⁶ 饱和该界，这一点在共振 R=2 处得到解析证明，并在 R=4 处得到数值证明。这种增强源于共振诱导的平移对称性，而非指数不稳定性，从而将非 KAM 共振识别为一种不同于混沌辅助传感和基于临界性的传感的计量资源。

articles.title: Spin-to-polarization mapping with a coherent quantum dot-cavity receiver
articles.title_zh: 利用相干量子点-腔接收器实现自旋到偏振的映射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03910v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coherent light-matter interfaces controllably modifying the state of a photon upon interaction with a stationary qubit are a key resource for implementing deterministic entangling gates for optical quantum technologies. This requires a one-to-one mapping between the state of the scattered photon and that of the embedded qubit. Here, we present an experimental signature of such a bijection by leveraging the spin-induced Kerr rotation present in a low-noise charged quantum dot-micropillar cavity device. Through time-resolved polarization measurements, we project the electron spin to one of its eigenstates with 95±2% fidelity with a single reflected photon detection, and follow the subsequent spin relaxation through the detection of a second reflected photon. We demonstrate that, after a transient regime governed by the trion radiative lifetime, two orthogonal polarization states can be produced, each associated to a given spin eigenstate. While the current results are limited by a timescale competition between electron spin relaxation and trion radiative lifetime, they could be improved using hole spins displaying increased relaxation times. Our work paves the way towards deterministic logic gates exploiting this one-to-one mapping between a spin and the polarization of a scattered photon.
articles.abstract_zh: 能够在静止量子比特与光子相互作用后可控地改变光子状态的相干光-物质界面，是实现光学量子技术中确定性纠缠门的关键资源。本文利用低噪声带电量子点-微柱腔器件中的自旋诱导克尔旋转，通过时间分辨偏振测量，展示了散射光子状态与嵌入式量子比特状态之间一一对应的实验特征。单次反射光子探测可将电子自旋以95±2%的保真度投影到本征态之一，并通过第二个反射光子探测跟踪后续自旋弛豫。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 能够在静止量子比特与光子相互作用后可控地改变光子状态的相干光-物质界面，是实现光学量子技术中确定性纠缠门的关键资源。这要求散射光子的状态与嵌入式量子比特的状态之间存在一一对应关系。在此，我们利用低噪声带电量子点-微柱腔器件中存在的自旋诱导克尔旋转，展示了这种双射关系的实验特征。通过时间分辨偏振测量，我们借助一次反射光子探测，以95±2%的保真度将电子自旋投影到其某一本征态，并通过探测第二个反射光子跟踪随后的自旋弛豫。我们证明，在由三重态辐射寿命控制的瞬态阶段之后，可以产生两个正交偏振态，且每个偏振态分别对应一个给定的自旋本征态。尽管当前结果受到电子自旋弛豫与三重态辐射寿命之间时间尺度竞争的限制，但使用具有更长弛豫时间的空穴自旋可以进一步改善这一结果。我们的工作为利用自旋与散射光子偏振之间这种一一映射关系实现确定性逻辑门铺平了道路。

articles.title: Discrete time crystals in disordered anisotropic Heisenberg chains
articles.title_zh: 无序各向异性海森堡链中的离散时间晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04037v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A discrete time crystal is an out-of-equilibrium phase of matter characterized by the spontaneous breaking of discrete time-translation symmetry. Using extensive numerical simulations based on matrix-product-state methods, we provide evidence for discrete time-crystalline behavior in strongly disordered spin chains with Heisenberg interactions, including the isotropic point, subject to periodic driving. Starting from a many-body localized regime, we observe that rotations induced by delta kicks produce a pronounced subharmonic response at half the drive frequency in spin observables. We investigate the stability of this response against rotation-angle errors through entanglement entropy, quantum Fisher information, short-range spin correlations, and restricted-control ergotropy. Increasing the rotation error reveals an intermediate dynamical regime separating the time-crystalline and Floquet-localized responses. In this regime, most observables exhibit signatures of weakly correlated dynamics reminiscent of Anderson localization.
articles.abstract_zh: 离散时间晶体是一种非平衡物态，其特征是离散时间平移对称性自发破缺。作者利用基于矩阵乘积态方法的大规模数值模拟，发现具有海森堡相互作用的强无序自旋链在周期驱动下，包括各向同性点在内，都呈现离散时间晶体行为的证据。旋转误差会导致时间晶体响应与Floquet局域化响应之间出现中间动力学区域，其中多数观测量表现出类似安德森局域化的弱关联动力学特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离散时间晶体是一种非平衡物态，其特征是离散时间平移对称性的自发破缺。我们使用基于矩阵乘积态方法的大规模数值模拟，为具有海森堡相互作用的强无序自旋链在周期驱动下表现出离散时间晶体行为提供了证据，其中包括各向同性点。从多体局域化区域出发，我们观察到，δ脉冲诱导的旋转会在自旋观测量中产生驱动频率一半处显著的亚谐波响应。我们通过纠缠熵、量子费舍尔信息、短程自旋关联以及受限控制的遍历功，研究了该响应对旋转角误差的稳定性。随着旋转误差增大，会出现一个介于时间晶体响应和Floquet局域化响应之间的中间动力学区域。在这一中间区域，大多数观测量都表现出弱关联动力学的特征，让人联想到安德森局域化。

articles.title: Cutting corners: exciting and magical bounds from the cusp bootstrap
articles.title_zh: 切掉尖角：来自尖点自洽性引导的激发态与“神奇”界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04041v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An illuminating probe of the dynamics of a line defect is the global geometry of its worldline. For a conformal line defect in a conformal field theory, sharp corners in the worldline, i.e. cusps, host dynamical degrees of freedom characterized in part by a spectrum of scaling dimensions, called cusp anomalous dimensions. We present various general bounds on cusp anomalous dimensions following from unitarity and cutting-and-gluing consistency of different defect geometries. We first establish, for cusps involving conjugate defects, that level crossings upon varying the cusp angle are forbidden between the lightest singlet cusp and any non-singlet cusp, proving that singlet cusps are the lightest. Then, we study line defects arranged in a rectangular geometry, which are subject to bootstrap constraints reminiscent of the spinless modular bootstrap. We find an analytic ``magic" functional that produces an optimal and universal lower bound on the dimension of a right angle bare cusp in terms of the universal defect Casimir energy between the corresponding defect and its conjugate in flat space.
articles.abstract_zh: 线缺陷动力学的一个重要探针，是其世界线的整体几何形状。对于共形场论中的共形线缺陷，世界线上的尖角，即尖点，会承载由一组标度维数刻画的动力学自由度，这些标度维数部分体现为尖点反常维数。本文利用幺正性以及不同缺陷几何之间的切割与拼接一致性，推导了尖点反常维数的一般界限，并证明单态尖点是最轻的。作者还构造出一种解析的“神奇”泛函，为直角裸尖点的维数给出关于缺陷卡西米尔能的最优且普适的下界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 线缺陷动力学的一个富有启发性的探针，是其世界线的整体几何形状。对于共形场论中的共形线缺陷，世界线上的尖锐角，即尖点，会承载动力学自由度；这些自由度的部分特征由一组称为尖点反常维数的标度维数谱描述。我们根据幺正性以及不同缺陷几何之间的切割与拼接一致性，给出了尖点反常维数的若干一般界限。首先，对于涉及共轭缺陷的尖点，我们证明，随着尖点角度变化，最轻单态尖点与任何非单态尖点之间都不允许发生能级交叉，从而证明单态尖点是最轻的。随后，我们研究排列成矩形几何的线缺陷；这些缺陷受到类似无自旋模自洽性引导的约束。我们发现了一个解析的“神奇”泛函，它能够根据平直空间中相应缺陷与其共轭缺陷之间的普适缺陷卡西米尔能，为直角裸尖点的维数给出一个最优且普适的下界。

articles.title: Quantum thermalization achieves optimal approximate quantum error correction
articles.title_zh: 量子热化实现最优的近似量子纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04121v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum thermalization explains how an isolated many-body system naturally evolves towards a thermal state, rendering information about the initial conditions inaccessible to local measurements. This is precisely the mechanism utilized in quantum error correction, where information is protected by design through a nonlocal encoding. In this work, we leverage this connection to port the rigorous framework of (approximate) quantum error correction to the study of quantum thermalization. Treating typical late-time states as codewords, we characterize the error-correcting properties of generic thermalizing dynamics. We numerically uncover a universal relationship between the encoding rate, distance, and thermal entropy density of the emergent code. At infinite temperature, this universal curve saturates the quantum Singleton bound, achieving the same optimal limit as Haar-random codes. At finite temperature, we introduce a code family based on the Scrooge ensemble, the natural thermal analogue of the Haar ensemble, and prove it saturates the entropic quantum Singleton bound, establishing this family as optimal within entropic constraints. Our extracted universal curve independently saturates this same bound, revealing that finite-temperature thermalization is itself optimal. Finally, we show how conserved quantities limit the error-correcting behavior of thermalization: codewords with differing energies, or other conserved charges, leak only classical information, and correctability persists until the difference reaches the scale of thermal fluctuations. Our results reveal a universal optimal coding structure in thermalizing dynamics, while introducing new optimal codes that achieve fundamental limits of approximate quantum error correction.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子热化说明孤立多体系统如何自然演化到热态，使初始条件的信息无法通过局域测量获得，而这正是量子纠错中通过非局域编码保护信息的机制。本文将近似量子纠错的严格理论框架用于研究量子热化，把典型晚期态视为编码字，并揭示热化动力学中涌现编码的编码率、距离和热熵密度之间的普适关系。在无限温度下，该关系饱和量子Singleton界；在有限温度下，基于Scrooge系综的编码族饱和熵形式量子Singleton界，表明热化本身达到了近似量子纠错的最优极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子热化解释了一个孤立的多体系统如何自然地演化到热态，从而使关于初始条件的信息无法通过局域测量获得。这正是量子纠错所利用的机制：通过非局域编码来保护信息。在这项工作中，我们利用这一联系，将近似量子纠错的严格理论框架引入量子热化研究。我们把典型的晚期态视为编码字，并刻画了一般热化动力学的纠错性质。我们通过数值计算发现了涌现编码的编码率、距离和热熵密度之间的普适关系。在无限温度下，这条普适曲线饱和了量子Singleton界，达到与Haar随机编码相同的最优极限。在有限温度下，我们引入了基于Scrooge系综的编码族；Scrooge系综是Haar系综的自然热对应物，并证明该编码族饱和了熵形式的量子Singleton界，从而确立了其在熵约束下的最优性。我们提取出的普适曲线也独立地饱和了同一个界限，揭示有限温度热化本身是最优的。最后，我们展示了守恒量如何限制热化的纠错行为：具有不同能量或其他守恒荷的编码字只会泄漏经典信息，并且在差异达到热涨落尺度之前，纠错能力仍然保持。我们的结果揭示了热化动力学中普适的最优编码结构，同时引入了能够达到近似量子纠错基本极限的新的最优编码。

articles.title: Exact mapping from short-ranged harmonic elastic models of spin crossover materials to Ising models with interactions at all length scales
articles.title_zh: 从自旋交叉材料的短程谐和弹性模型到具有全尺度相互作用的伊辛模型的精确映射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2008.08738v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin crossover (SCO) materials are reversible molecular switches found in a wide range of transition metal complexes and metal organic frameworks (MOFs). They exhibit diverse spin state orderings and transitions between them. Here we present an exact mapping from harmonic elastic models to Ising-like models with both a short-range Ising interaction that decays with a power law at large distances and a long-range (infinite-range) Husimi-Temperley interaction that is independent of distance. We apply this mapping to a simple model of SCO frameworks. This provides a microscopic justification for an Ising-Husimi-Temperley model description, which has previously only been justified on phenomenological grounds. Elastic frustration is required for non-zero Ising interactions, but whether or not the short-range interactions in the Ising model are geometrically frustrated depends on the ratio of the bulk and shear moduli, or equivalently Poisson's ratio. The long-range interaction has two origins: (i) a self-interaction on the average spin state, mediated through the coupling between the average spin state and the unit cell parameters; and (ii) an infrared divergence in the spin state-spin state coupling mediated by displacements of metals and ligands within the unit cell. %In the absence of elastic frustration these terms are equal and opposite so there is no long-range interaction. However, in general they do not cancel and there is a long-range Ising interaction. The long-range interaction is independent of the distance between metal centers, nevertheless it leads to an extensive contribution to the (free) energy. In this model the Husimi-Temperley interaction dominates transitions of spin states, whereas multistep transitions and intermediate order are observed if only the pure (power-law) Ising interaction are retained, only single-step transitions are found in the full model.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋交叉材料是过渡金属配合物和金属有机框架中广泛存在的可逆分子开关，能够表现出多种自旋态有序结构及其转变。本文给出了从谐和弹性模型到类伊辛模型的精确映射，该模型同时包含大距离下按幂律衰减的短程伊辛相互作用，以及与距离无关的长程Husimi-Temperley相互作用。映射表明，弹性挫折是产生非零伊辛相互作用的必要条件，而体模量与剪切模量之比决定短程相互作用是否具有几何挫折。模型中长程相互作用主导自旋态转变，而仅保留幂律伊辛相互作用时则可出现多步转变和中间有序态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋交叉材料是可逆分子开关，存在于广泛的过渡金属配合物和金属有机框架（MOF）中。它们表现出多种自旋态有序结构以及不同自旋态之间的转变。在此，我们给出了从谐和弹性模型到类伊辛模型的精确映射；所得模型同时包含一种短程伊辛相互作用，该相互作用在大距离下按幂律衰减，以及一种与距离无关的长程（无限程）Husimi-Temperley相互作用。我们将这一映射应用于自旋交叉框架的简单模型。这为采用伊辛-Husimi-Temperley模型描述提供了微观依据，而此前这种描述仅在现象学层面得到论证。弹性挫折是产生非零伊辛相互作用的必要条件；但是，伊辛模型中的短程相互作用是否具有几何挫折，取决于体模量与剪切模量之比，或者等价地取决于泊松比。长程相互作用有两个来源：（i）平均自旋态上的自相互作用，该作用通过平均自旋态与晶胞参数之间的耦合产生；（ii）由晶胞内金属和配体的位移介导的自旋态-自旋态耦合中的红外发散。在没有弹性挫折时，这些项大小相等、符号相反，因此不存在长程相互作用。然而，一般而言它们不会相互抵消，从而产生长程伊辛相互作用。尽管长程相互作用与金属中心之间的距离无关，但它仍会对能量（自由能）产生广延贡献。在该模型中，Husimi-Temperley相互作用主导自旋态转变；而如果仅保留纯粹的（幂律）伊辛相互作用，则会观察到多步转变和中间有序态，在完整模型中则只会出现单步转变。

articles.title: Near-Unity Charge Readout in a Nonlinear Resonator without Matching
articles.title_zh: 无需阻抗匹配的非线性谐振器中的近单位电荷读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.17709v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dissipative sensors typically use linear resonators with impedance matching to achieve maximal signal and fast operation. The impedance matching, however, sets an upper limit to the bandwidth of the readout. In this paper, we present a nonlinear resonator performing the readout of a double quantum dot charge state via a charge-sensing quantum dot. We show that by driving the resonator in the nonlinear regime, we achieve a near-unity signal for a dissipative sensor. This despite not satisfying the sensor impedance matching requirements necessary for such large signals in the linear regime. Our experiments, supported by numerical calculations, demonstrate that the signal increase stems from the sensor dissipation shifting the onset of the nonlinear resonator response. By lifting the matching requirement, we open up an avenue to ultrafast charge detectors as the resonator input-output coupling - setting the detector bandwidth - does not have to match to the typically much slower sensor dissipation rate.
articles.abstract_zh: 耗散型传感器通常采用带阻抗匹配的线性谐振器，以获得最大信号和快速运行，但阻抗匹配会限制读出带宽。本文利用非线性谐振器，通过电荷传感量子点读出双量子点的电荷状态，并证明在非线性驱动区域可以实现近单位的耗散传感信号，即使不满足线性区域获得大信号所需的阻抗匹配条件。实验和数值计算表明，信号增强源于传感器耗散改变了非线性谐振器响应的起始位置，从而为超快电荷探测器提供了途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 耗散型传感器通常使用带阻抗匹配的线性谐振器，以实现最大信号和快速运行。然而，阻抗匹配会为读出带宽设定上限。在本文中，我们提出了一种非线性谐振器，通过电荷传感量子点实现对双量子点电荷状态的读出。我们证明，通过在非线性区域驱动谐振器，可以使耗散型传感器获得近单位信号，尽管其并不满足在线性区域实现如此大信号所必需的传感器阻抗匹配要求。实验结果以及数值计算表明，信号增强源于传感器耗散使非线性谐振器响应的起始位置发生移动。通过取消匹配要求，我们为超快电荷探测器开辟了一条途径，因为谐振器的输入-输出耦合决定探测器带宽，不必与通常慢得多的传感器耗散速率相匹配。

articles.title: Critical photoinduced reflectivity relaxation dynamics in single-layer Bi-based cuprates near the pseudogap end point
articles.title_zh: 赝能隙终点附近单层铋基铜酸盐中的临界光致反射率弛豫动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.21298v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A comprehensive study of photoinduced transient reflectivity dynamics in heavily overdoped single-layer cuprate (Bi,Pb)₂Sr₂CuO₆₊δ (Pb-Bi-2201) across the end points of the pseudogap and superconducting phases was conducted using optical ultrafast time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy. In the Pb-Bi-2201 near the proposed pseudogap end-point doping, the transient reflectivity dynamics above Tᵣₘ c resemble the pseudogap response observed in the optimally doped La-Bi-2201. With decreasing temperature, however, the relaxation time exhibits a power-law divergence, τsim10hbar/kBT, consistent with quantum critical behavior near the proposed pseudogap end-point doping. A similar power-law increase in relaxation time is also observed at a slightly more overdoped composition, though it is less pronounced.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用光学超快时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱，对重度过掺杂单层铜酸盐Pb-Bi-2201在赝能隙相和超导相终点附近的光致瞬态反射率动力学进行了系统研究。在接近所提出的赝能隙终点掺杂浓度时，高于超导转变温度的瞬态反射率动力学类似于最佳掺杂La-Bi-2201中的赝能隙响应。随着温度降低，弛豫时间呈幂律发散，约为10ℏ/(kBT)，与该掺杂区域附近的量子临界行为一致；略高过掺杂样品中也观察到类似增长，但不太明显。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用光学超快时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱，对重度过掺杂单层铜酸盐（Bi,Pb）₂Sr₂CuO₆₊δ（Pb-Bi-2201）跨越赝能隙相和超导相终点的光致瞬态反射率动力学进行了全面研究。在接近所提出的赝能隙终点掺杂浓度的Pb-Bi-2201中，高于超导转变温度的瞬态反射率动力学类似于最佳掺杂La-Bi-2201中观察到的赝能隙响应。然而，随着温度降低，弛豫时间呈现幂律发散，τ约为10ℏ/(kBT)，这与所提出的赝能隙终点掺杂附近的量子临界行为一致。在略高的过掺杂组分中也观察到弛豫时间类似的幂律增长，但其表现得不那么显著。

articles.title: Proximity effect in gap-asymmetric superconducting bilayers and regularization of transition rates
articles.title_zh: 能隙不对称超导双层中的近邻效应与跃迁速率的正则化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17765v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The standard mean-field treatment of low-temperature superconductors leads to a square-root divergent density of states at the gap value. This feature can lead to unphysical logarithmic divergences in various quantities, such as currents and qubit transition rates. We revisit their possible regularization based on the proximity effect between two superconducting films with different gaps. We derive analytical approximations for the density of states in each superconducting film. We find that the smearing of the density of states grows with the gap asymmetry. As a concrete example, we discuss the regularization of transition rates in qubits with frequency close to resonance with the gap asymmetry between the two films, and the consequent smoothening of the jump discontinuity in the qubit frequency shift. Our results could also aid the development of superconducting detectors and related devices based on superconducting bilayers.
articles.abstract_zh: 标准的低温超导体平均场处理会导致态密度在能隙值处呈平方根发散，并可能使电流和量子比特跃迁速率等物理量出现非物理的对数发散。本文重新研究了具有不同能隙的两层超导薄膜之间的近邻效应对这种发散的正则化，并推导了各超导薄膜中态密度的解析近似。结果表明，能隙不对称性越强，态密度的展宽越明显；对于接近共振条件的量子比特，跃迁速率的发散得到正则化，量子比特频移中的跳跃不连续性也随之变得平滑。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 标准的低温超导体平均场处理会导致态密度在能隙值处呈平方根发散。这一特征可能导致各种物理量出现非物理的对数发散，例如电流和量子比特跃迁速率。我们重新研究了如何利用具有不同能隙的两层超导薄膜之间的近邻效应对这种发散进行正则化。我们推导了每一层超导薄膜中态密度的解析近似。我们发现，态密度的展宽会随着能隙不对称性的增加而增大。作为具体例子，我们讨论了跃迁频率接近共振于两层薄膜能隙不对称性的量子比特中的跃迁速率正则化，以及由此导致的量子比特频移中跳跃不连续性的平滑化。我们的结果还可能有助于开发基于超导双层的超导探测器及相关器件。

articles.title: Bright yet dark: how strong coupling quenches exciton-polariton radiation
articles.title_zh: 明亮却黑暗：强耦合如何淬灭激子-极化激元辐射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.21247v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding the radiative decay of exciton-polaritons is essential for achieving long-lived polaritons - a key prerequisite for enhancing nonlinear and quantum polaritonic effects. However, conventional wisdom - the coupled oscillator model - often oversimplifies polariton radiation as independent emissions from uncoupled excitonic and photonic resonances, overlooking the role of strong exciton-photon coupling in reshaping their radiative behavior. In this work, we present a theoretical framework that goes beyond the conventional coupled oscillator model by fully accounting for the collective and coherent nature of exciton-photon interactions. We demonstrate that these interactions can strongly suppress polariton radiation via destructive interference - both within the excitonic ensemble and between excitonic and photonic radiation channels - giving rise to polaritonic bound states in the continuum with infinitely long radiative lifetimes. Our approach offers a unified description of polariton radiative decay and establishes new design principles for engineering long-lived exciton-polaritons with tailored radiation properties, opening new avenues for nonlinear, topological, and quantum polaritonic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解激子-极化激元的辐射衰减，是实现长寿命极化激元的关键，而长寿命极化激元对于增强非线性和量子极化激元效应至关重要。本文提出超越传统耦合振子模型的理论框架，完整考虑激子-光子相互作用的集体相干性质。研究表明，激子系综内部以及激子与光子辐射通道之间的破坏性干涉可以强烈抑制极化激元辐射，形成具有无限长辐射寿命的连续谱中的极化激元束缚态，并为设计长寿命、可调辐射性质的激子-极化激元提供了原则。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解激子-极化激元的辐射衰减，对于实现长寿命极化激元至关重要；而长寿命极化激元是增强非线性和量子极化激元效应的关键前提。然而，传统观念，即耦合振子模型，往往将极化激元辐射过度简化为未耦合的激子和光学共振分别独立发射，忽略了强激子-光子耦合在重塑其辐射行为中的作用。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个超越传统耦合振子模型的理论框架，完整考虑激子-光子相互作用的集体性和相干性。我们证明，这些相互作用能够通过破坏性干涉强烈抑制极化激元辐射；这种干涉既发生在激子系综内部，也发生在激子与光子辐射通道之间，从而产生连续谱中的极化激元束缚态，其辐射寿命可以无限长。我们的方法为极化激元辐射衰减提供了统一描述，并建立了设计具有定制辐射性质的长寿命激子-极化激元的新原则，为非线性、拓扑和量子极化激元应用开辟了新途径。

articles.title: Bloch sphere picture and restoration of the quantum Mpemba effect beyond the weak coupling regime in the spin boson model
articles.title_zh: 自旋-玻色子模型中的布洛赫球图像与弱耦合区之外量子Mpemba效应的恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.17565v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding relaxation dynamics in open quantum systems is a central problem in nonequilibrium quantum physics. Here we investigate the quantum Mpemba effect in the spin boson model. In the weak coupling Markovian regime we show that the occurrence of the effect strongly depends on the choice of distance measure at low temperature: while it appears in the trace distance, it can disappear in the quantum relative entropy. Going beyond the weak-coupling approximation, numerically exact simulations of the full system bath dynamics reveal that increasing coupling enhances the effect in the trace distance and restores it in the quantum relative entropy. We uncover a simple Bloch sphere picture of the effect: within the excited-state hemisphere, pairs of states related by rotations and having the same Bloch-vector modulus generically exhibit an inversion of their relaxation ordering. This behavior is robust across sub Ohmic, Ohmic, and super Ohmic bath spectra. In the Ohmic and sub Ohmic regimes, the crossing time becomes strongly suppressed upon approaching the critical region, whereas in the super Ohmic regime the effect remains enhanced despite the absence of a finite-coupling localization transition. These results highlight the interplay between geometry, distance measures, system--environment coupling, and bath spectral properties in anomalous quantum relaxation.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了自旋-玻色子模型中的量子Mpemba效应，发现该效应在弱耦合马尔可夫区域的表现强烈依赖于距离度量：低温下它可以出现在迹距离中，却在量子相对熵中消失。对完整系统-浴动力学进行数值精确模拟表明，增强耦合会强化迹距离中的效应，并使其在量子相对熵中恢复。作者进一步给出一个简单的布洛赫球图像，指出在激发态半球内，具有相同布洛赫矢量模长且通过旋转相关的状态对通常会出现弛豫顺序反转；该行为对不同浴谱具有稳健性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解开放量子系统中的弛豫动力学，是非平衡量子物理中的核心问题。在此，我们研究了自旋-玻色子模型中的量子Mpemba效应。在弱耦合马尔可夫区域，我们表明，该效应的出现强烈依赖于所选择的距离度量：在低温下，它会出现在迹距离中，却可能在量子相对熵中消失。超越弱耦合近似后，对完整系统-浴动力学进行数值精确模拟显示，增大耦合会增强迹距离中的效应，并使其在量子相对熵中恢复。我们揭示了该效应的一个简单布洛赫球图像：在激发态半球内，通过旋转相互关联且具有相同布洛赫矢量模长的状态对，通常会表现出弛豫顺序的反转。这一行为对于次欧姆、欧姆和超欧姆浴谱都具有稳健性。在欧姆和次欧姆区域，随着接近临界区域，交叉时间受到强烈抑制；而在超欧姆区域，尽管不存在有限耦合局域化转变，该效应仍然得到增强。这些结果突出了几何结构、距离度量、系统-环境耦合以及浴谱性质在反常量子弛豫中的相互作用。

articles.title: Signatures of an Entangled Graviton Duet
articles.title_zh: 纠缠引力子二重态的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the detection of the Higgs boson, the standard model is an almost complete theory. Missing from the model is a massless spin-two boson, the graviton. We might reasonably expect that detection of gravitational radiation would include the observation of the graviton as the quanta of the radiation. However, the connection between gravitational radiation observations and the theoretical graviton has yet to be realized due to the physical limitations on single-graviton detections. A more promising approach to the demonstration of the non-classical nature of gravitational radiation is to look at quantum entanglement in bipartite detections.
articles.abstract_zh: 标准模型几乎构成了一个完整理论，但其中缺少无质量自旋二玻色子，即引力子。由于单引力子探测存在物理限制，直接通过引力辐射观测确认引力子的方案尚未实现；更有希望的途径，是在双体探测中寻找引力辐射的量子纠缠和非经典特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着希格斯玻色子的探测，标准模型已经成为一个几乎完整的理论。该模型中缺少的是一种无质量的自旋二玻色子，即引力子。我们可以合理地期待，引力辐射的探测应当包括对作为辐射量子的引力子的观测。然而，由于单引力子探测受到物理限制，引力辐射观测与理论上的引力子之间的联系尚未实现。展示引力辐射非经典性质的一种更有希望的方法，是在双体探测中寻找量子纠缠。

articles.title: Time-of-flight fuzziness from deformed relativistic symmetries
articles.title_zh: 形变相对论对称性导致的飞行时间模糊
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A general expectation in quantum gravity is that quantum properties of spacetime manifest themselves as fuzziness, causing an irreducible uncertainty in the measurement of spacetime-related observables. In this work, we derive the time-of-flight fuzziness for free particles within a noncommutative spacetime model with κ-Poincaré deformed relativistic symmetries. To retain the full quantum structure of the theory we work in the corresponding noncommutative space of worldlines. This provides a convenient framework for constructing quantum states and deriving the probability distributions for the parameters characterizing particle trajectories, allowing us to obtain the probability distribution of particle times of flight. Our results reproduce the well-known systematic time-of-flight correction, leading to energy-dependent departures from the special-relativistic expectation, and simultaneously predict a novel stochastic contribution to the time of flight. While the systematic contribution scales with the ratio between the particle energy and the quantum-gravity energy scale and is amplified by the propagation distance, the stochastic contribution scales as the square root of the product of the quantum-gravity length scale and the travel time, multiplied by a prefactor which depends on the particle velocity.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子引力通常预期时空的量子性质会表现为模糊性，从而给时空相关可观测量的测量带来不可消除的不确定性。本文在具有κ-庞加莱形变相对论对称性的非对易时空模型中，推导了自由粒子的飞行时间模糊，并在相应的非对易世界线空间中保留理论的完整量子结构。结果既重现了随粒子能量和传播距离变化的系统性飞行时间修正，也预言了新的随机贡献；该随机项与量子引力长度尺度和传播时间乘积的平方根成正比，并受到粒子速度相关前因子的调制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子引力中的一个普遍预期是，时空的量子性质会表现为模糊性，从而导致时空相关可观测量的测量存在不可消除的不确定性。在这项工作中，我们在具有κ-庞加莱形变相对论对称性的非对易时空模型中，推导了自由粒子的飞行时间模糊。为了保留理论的完整量子结构，我们在相应的非对易世界线空间中开展研究。这一框架便于构造量子态，并推导刻画粒子轨迹的参数所对应的概率分布，从而获得粒子飞行时间的概率分布。我们的结果重现了广为人知的系统性飞行时间修正，该修正导致随能量变化的偏离狭义相对论预期的效应；同时，结果还预言了飞行时间中一种新的随机贡献。系统性贡献与粒子能量和量子引力能标之比成正比，并会被传播距离放大；随机贡献则与量子引力长度尺度和飞行时间乘积的平方根成正比，并乘以一个取决于粒子速度的前因子。

articles.title: Three Chiral Families from a Monopole Product over S²timesCP²
articles.title_zh: 来自 S²×CP² 上单极子乘积的三个手性家族
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02907v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the chiral zero-mode spectrum of the compact six-manifold X₆=S²× CP² in a ten-dimensional Kaluza-Klein setting. We review the monopole Dirac index on S² and the Spinc index analysis, showing that CP² admits a minimal unit-index chiral sector. Dolan and Nash established the Spin^c index mechanism on complex projective spaces and showed that CP² can supply a one-family chiral building block with Standard-Model-like quantum numbers. The step taken here is to place the CP² sector on the six-dimensional product S²timesCP² and use an independently quantized monopole sector on S² to control the multiplicity. Unlike Calabi--Yau model-building constructions, where the family number is tied to vector-bundle and quotient data, this homogeneous product gives the three-family count through the factorized Dirac-index formula:  Nᵣₘ fₐₘ = rm index DS^₂ × CP^₂=bigl(rm index DS^₂,ₘbigr) ,bigl(rm index DCP^₂,ₙbigr)=m,fracn²-18. The canonical complex Spinc structure on CP² has n=3 and unit index. We show that this index is saturated by exactly one chiral zero mode and no opposite-chirality vectorlike partner. Thus, two flux sectors produce exactly three chiral internal zero modes: (m,n)=(3,3) and (m,n)=(1,5). Saturation is proved for all odd n≥ 3. This homogeneous product isolates the family number in an elementary geometric formula. For a 10D Weyl fermion valued in a visible 16 of Spin(10)_G, Lorentz branching shows these internal zero modes yield three left-handed 4D 16_G multiplets. The analysis is restricted to the spectral and index-theoretic problem; moduli stabilization and phenomenological dynamics are deferred to a companion paper.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在十维卡鲁扎–克莱因框架下研究六维复流形 S²×CP² 上的手性零模谱，并通过单极子与 Spin^c 指数机制实现三代手性费米子结构。作者强调该结果来自一个可分解的几何指数公式，具体模型细节与物理延伸需参见原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在十维卡鲁扎–克莱因框架下，六维紧致流形 X₆=S²×CP² 的手性零模谱。我们回顾了 S² 上的单极子狄拉克指标以及 Spin^c 指标分析，说明 CP² 可以提供一个最小单位指标的手性扇区。Dolan 和 Nash 已经建立了复射影空间上的 Spin^c 指标机制，并表明 CP² 可以提供一个具有类似标准模型量子数的单家族手性构件。本文进一步将 CP² 扇区放在六维乘积空间 S²×CP² 上，并使用在 S² 上独立量子化的单极子扇区来控制简并度。与 Calabi--Yau 模型构造不同，在那类构造中，家族数与向量丛及商空间数据相关，这里的同质乘积通过可分解的狄拉克指标公式给出三代数：N_fam = index DS^₂×CP^₂ = (index DS^₂,ₘ)(index DCP^₂,ₙ) = m,(n²-1)/8。CP² 上的标准复 Spin^c 结构取 n=3 时具有单位指标。我们证明这一指标恰好由一个手性零模饱和，而没有相反手性的矢量样伴随态。于是，两个磁通扇区恰好产生三个手性内部零模：(m,n)=(3,3) 和 (m,n)=(1,5)。对于所有奇数 n≥3，都可以证明这种饱和成立。这个同质乘积用一个基础的几何公式将家族数分离出来。对于一个取可见 Spin(10)_G 的 16 表示的十维 Weyl 费米子，洛伦兹分解表明这些内部零模会产生三个左手的四维 16_G 多重态。本文仅限于谱与指标理论问题；模稳定和现象学动力学留待配套论文讨论。

articles.title: Growth-of-Structure Constraints on the Variable Chaplygin Gas Model
articles.title_zh: 变 Chaplygin 气模型的结构形成约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02914v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A unified description of dark matter and the late-time acceleration of the Universe offers an attractive framework for explaining the dark sector. Among such models, the Variable Chaplygin Gas (VCG) model provides a unified description but faces challenges, particularly in the evolution of cosmological perturbations. We investigate the evolution of linear density perturbations in the VCG model assuming adiabatic perturbations and constrain its parameters using recent fσ₈ growth measurements within a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) framework. Gaussian priors are adopted from our previous analysis of background observations, including Type Ia supernovae (Pantheon), baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO), Hubble parameter H(z) measurements, fast radio bursts (FRB), and gamma-ray bursts (GRB). We find that growth data favour a markedly different region of the parameter space than the background observations. In particular, the growth analysis prefers a substantially larger value of the model parameter n (n simeq 2.3) compared with the background constraint (n sim 1). This tension indicates that parameter values providing an excellent fit to the background expansion fail to simultaneously reproduce the observed growth of cosmic structures. Our results demonstrate that growth-of-structure observations provide a stringent and independent test of unified dark sector models and underscore the importance of combining background and perturbation data when assessing the cosmological viability of the Variable Chaplygin Gas model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用近期 fσ₈ 增长率观测，对变 Chaplygin 气模型的线性密度扰动演化进行约束。结果表明，结构增长数据偏好的参数区域与背景宇宙学观测存在明显张力，说明该模型需要同时结合背景与扰动数据检验其宇宙学可行性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 统一描述暗物质与宇宙晚期加速为解释暗宇宙部门提供了一个有吸引力的框架。在这类模型中，变 Chaplygin 气（VCG）模型提供了一种统一描述，但在宇宙学微扰演化方面面临挑战。我们在假设绝热扰动的条件下，研究 VCG 模型中线性密度扰动的演化，并在马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）框架下，利用近期的 fσ₈ 增长率观测对其参数进行约束。我们采用来自前期背景观测分析的高斯先验，包括 Ia 型超新星（Pantheon）、重子声学振荡（BAO）、哈勃参数 H(z) 测量、快速射电暴（FRB）和伽马射线暴（GRB）。我们发现，增长数据所偏好的参数空间与背景观测所偏好的参数空间显著不同。特别是，增长分析更偏好模型参数 n 的一个明显更大的取值（n 约为 2.3），而背景约束则给出较小的值（n 约为 1）。这种张力表明，能够很好拟合背景膨胀的参数值，无法同时重现观测到的宇宙结构增长。我们的结果表明，结构增长观测为统一暗部门模型提供了严格而独立的检验，并强调在评估变 Chaplygin 气模型的宇宙学可行性时，结合背景数据与微扰数据的重要性。

articles.title: Molecular Transferability of a Noble-Gas Coordinate for Electronegativity Equalization
articles.title_zh: 用于电负性均等化的稀有气体坐标的分子可迁移性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02930v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge-equilibration models predict how electrons redistribute over a molecule more cheaply than quantum chemistry, and each begins from a table of atomic electronegativities and hardnesses. A recent table replaces ionization energies and electron affinities with one geometric quantity: each main-group atom's fractional distance to the noble gas closing its row. Holding geometries, electrostatic damping and the molecule list fixed, we compare it with spectroscopic values, with its own kernel refitted, and with a quadratic control, over a primary set of fifty-two molecules and ions at the B3LYP/def2-TZVP level. Two structural consequences follow from the table construction rather than the equalization solver. Atoms at equal fractional distance receive identical electronegativities, so the dipole moments of chlorine monofluoride, iodine monobromide and sulfur dioxide vanish exactly, and the measured 0.72 debye HF/HCl gap is lost. Because the first period is excluded, hydrogen retains its spectroscopic electronegativity above every geometric value, reversing mathrmO-H, mathrmN-H and hydrogen-halide polarity. Fitted alike, geometric and quadratic kernels agree to 0.0022 electron per atom, so predictions are set by the fitted energy scales, not the kernel shape. Resolving the electronegativity scale period by period restores correct polarity in all five polyatomic heavy-atom-hydrogen tests.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文考察一种基于主族原子到其所在周期末端稀有气体的分数距离的几何电负性标度在分子中的可迁移性。研究显示，该标度在某些结构上会导致偶极矩和极性预测偏差，但按周期分层处理后可恢复更合理的极性描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电荷均等化模型比量子化学更廉价地预测电子如何在分子中重新分布，而每一种模型都从一张原子电负性与硬度表开始。近期的一种表用一个几何量取代电离能和电子亲和能：即每个主族原子到其所在周期闭壳层对应稀有气体的分数距离。在保持几何构型、电静阻尼和分子列表固定的条件下，我们将该表与光谱值、其自身重新拟合的核函数以及一个二次型对照进行了比较，样本包括 52 个分子和离子，计算水平为 B3LYP/def2-TZVP。由该表构造本身而非电荷均等化求解器带来两个结构性后果。处于相同分数距离的原子被赋予相同电负性，因此氯一氟化物、碘一溴化物和二氧化硫的偶极矩会严格为零，而实验测得的 0.72 德拜 HF/HCl 差异也会丢失。由于第一周期被排除，氢保留了高于所有几何值的光谱电负性，从而颠倒了 O-H、N-H 和氢卤键的极性。若以相同方式拟合，几何核与二次核在每个原子 0.0022 个电子以内达成一致，因此预测主要由拟合能量尺度决定，而不是由核函数形状决定。按周期逐层地解析电负性标度，可在所有五个含重原子-氢的多原子测试中恢复正确极性。

articles.title: A Langmuir-Like Adsorption Model for MoS2 Gas Sensors: Bridging Theory and Experiment
articles.title_zh: MoS2 气体传感器的类 Langmuir 吸附模型：连接理论与实验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gas sensors based on layered TMDCs (transition-metal dichalcogenides) such as MoS2 have attracted considerable attention recently and are considered as a promising alternative to the conventional metal-oxide-based gas sensing devices. Recent studies on TMDC gas sensors have mainly addressed either the theoretical description of adsorption mechanisms or the fabrication of test devices and the investigation of their gas sensing performance. However, a suitable approach for modeling the gas sensing behavior of TMDC devices and for establishing a reliable connection between theoretical results and the response of experimental devices when exposed to gases remains absent. To bridge this gap, in the present work a new Langmuir-based adsorption model, capable of calculating both the sensor sensitivity and selectivity, is developed and applied to MoS2-based gas sensors. It is shown that by using appropriate published data for the adsorption energy and the charge transfer as input data, the reported experimental sensitivities of MoS2 gas sensors can be well reproduced by the model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于 Langmuir 吸附的 MoS2 气体传感模型，用于同时计算传感器灵敏度与选择性，并尝试将理论吸附结果与实验器件响应联系起来。研究表明，借助已发表的吸附能和电荷转移数据，该模型能够较好再现实验灵敏度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于层状 TMDC（过渡金属硫族化物）的气体传感器，如 MoS2 传感器，近年来受到广泛关注，并被视为传统金属氧化物气敏器件的有前景替代方案。近期关于 TMDC 气体传感器的研究，主要集中于对吸附机理的理论描述，或器件制备与气敏性能测试。然而，目前仍缺乏一种合适的方法来建模 TMDC 器件的气敏行为，并建立理论结果与实验器件在接触气体时响应之间的可靠联系。为弥补这一空白，本文提出一种新的基于 Langmuir 的吸附模型，可同时计算传感器灵敏度与选择性，并将其应用于基于 MoS2 的气体传感器。结果表明，只要将已发表的吸附能与电荷转移数据作为输入，该模型就能很好地再现实验报道的 MoS2 气体传感器灵敏度。

articles.title: Stochastic Tensor Contraction for Efficient MP2 Exchange
articles.title_zh: 用于高效 MP2 交换项的随机张量收缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Second-order Moller--Plesset perturbation theory (MP2) is one of the simplest correlated wave-function methods, but its conventional O(N⁵) cost limits its application to large systems. Stochastic tensor contraction (STC) has recently appeared as a general technique to evaluate high-order tensor contractions in quantum chemistry. Here, we apply STC to the exchange contribution of Laplace-transformed MP2, which is the source of O(N⁵) scaling in the formulation. The resulting STC exchange algorithm has an O(N³) deterministic setup cost and an O(N²) stochastic cost at fixed absolute error. The estimator is unbiased and provides a way to specify the target stochastic error by estimating the number of required samples before the full calculation. We implement the algorithm using a hybrid deterministic--stochastic evaluation strategy, with grouped index sampling, to reduce the computational prefactor. Over a range of benchmark molecules containing up to sim 7000 basis functions, the stochastic exchange evaluation takes as little as 1/270 of the time of a complete DF-MP2 calculation on the same system. Within the Laplace-transformed formulation, the O(N⁴) scaling direct contribution is thus the only significant cost. Our results further substantiate the power of STC to serve as a general tensor-contraction engine for quantum chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将随机张量收缩方法应用于拉普拉斯变换 MP2 的交换项，以降低传统二阶 Møller–Plesset 微扰理论的计算代价。作者给出一种无偏估计器和混合确定性-随机算法，在固定误差下可将交换项计算显著加速。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二阶 Møller--Plesset 微扰理论（MP2）是最简单的相关波函数方法之一，但其传统 O(N⁵) 代价限制了在大体系中的应用。随机张量收缩（STC）近年来被提出，作为评估量子化学中高阶张量收缩的一般技术。本文将 STC 应用于拉普拉斯变换 MP2 的交换贡献，而该项正是该形式中 O(N⁵) 标度的来源。得到的 STC 交换算法在确定性预处理阶段具有 O(N³) 代价，而在固定绝对误差下具有 O(N²) 的随机代价。该估计器是无偏的，并且提供了一种通过在完整计算前估计所需样本数来指定目标随机误差的方法。我们使用带分组索引采样的混合确定性—随机评估策略实现了该算法，以降低计算前因子。在一系列最多包含约 7000 个基函数的基准分子上，随机交换项的计算时间低至完整 DF-MP2 计算时间的 1/270。于是，在拉普拉斯变换框架内，O(N⁴) 标度的直接贡献成为唯一显著代价。我们的结果进一步证明，STC 可作为量子化学中通用张量收缩引擎的强大潜力。

articles.title: Grammar-based topology search for reconfigurable integrated photonic spectrometers
articles.title_zh: 用于可重构集成光子光谱仪的基于文法的拓扑搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reconfigurable integrated photonic spectrometers can generate exponentially increasing measurement states from a small number of switching elements, making them a promising design class for high-performance portable spectroscopy. However, selecting a circuit architecture remains largely intuition driven. We introduce a grammar-based topology optimization framework that composes standard photonic building blocks, canonicalizes and physically prunes candidate circuits, and jointly searches topology and component parameters using a coherent scattering-matrix model. Designs are screened by a decoder-independent architecture objective that combines absolute singular-value noise gain with multi-line conditioning, thereby accounting for response diversity and optical throughput. Direct held-out spectrum reconstruction confirms that this surrogate is a strong predictor of reconstruction quality at high incident signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Across the nonresonant and resonator-augmented design spaces examined, dFT and its variants offer the best balanced performance; increased component loss favors a shallower dFT variant in which one differential-delay stage is replaced by an analog optical phase shifter. Passive and active rings provide no robust advantage attributable to resonant amplitude coding. The results identify balanced complementary interferometric responses, efficient terminal collection, and limited lossy circuit depth as central design rules, and establish a systematic route for selecting task-optimized photonic circuit topologies under technology-specific constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于文法的拓扑优化框架，用于自动搜索可重构集成光子光谱仪的电路结构及器件参数。研究表明，平衡的互补干涉响应、有效的末端收集以及较短的有损电路深度，是高性能设计的重要原则。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可重构集成光子光谱仪可由少量开关元件产生呈指数增长的测量状态，因此是一类很有前景的高性能便携光谱设计方案。然而，电路架构的选择在很大程度上仍依赖经验直觉。我们提出一种基于文法的拓扑优化框架，它组合标准光子学基本模块，对候选电路进行规范化和物理裁剪，并利用相干散射矩阵模型联合搜索拓扑结构与器件参数。设计通过一个与解码器无关的架构目标函数进行筛选，该函数结合了绝对奇异值噪声增益与多谱线条件数，从而同时考虑响应多样性和光学吞吐量。对留出谱重构的直接验证表明，在高入射信噪比（SNR）下，这一替代指标能够强力预测重构质量。在所考察的非谐振和加入谐振器的设计空间中，dFT 及其变体表现出最佳的综合性能；当器件损耗增大时，一种更浅的 dFT 变体更有优势，其中一个差分延迟级被模拟光学相位移器取代。被动和主动环结构并未显示出可归因于谐振幅度编码的稳健优势。结果识别出平衡的互补干涉响应、高效的末端收集以及有限的有损电路深度，是核心设计规则，并建立了一种在特定技术约束下选择任务优化光子电路拓扑的系统化途径。

articles.title: A Silicon-Compatible Uncooled Compact Broadband Infrared Spectrometer
articles.title_zh: 一种硅兼容的无需制冷紧凑型宽带红外光谱仪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03284v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Infrared spectroscopy is a widely used technique for molecular identification, yet its widespread deployment remains constrained by bulky instrumentation, cryogenic cooling requirements, and limited portability. Here we demonstrate broadband near- to short-wave infrared spectroscopy enabled by a silicon-compatible GeSn photodetector integrated into a compact digital micromirror device-based single-pixel architecture. By combining detector design with targeted optical reconfiguration and wavelength recalibration, we extend the operational range up to 2.4 micrometers while maintaining room-temperature, zero-bias photovoltaic operation. System-level benchmarking quantifies the intrinsic trade-off between spectral extension and detectivity in narrow-bandgap photodetection, yielding a specific detectivity of 1.12 × 10¹⁰ cm Hz¹/² W⁻¹ at 1.55 micrometers with an extended wavelength cut-off. We validate the capabilities of the obtained spectrometer through selective identification of representative commodity plastics, demonstrating a lightweight, low-power, and mechanically robust platform for portable and autonomous deployment. Despite the expected increase in generation-limited noise, access to strong polymer combination bands beyond 1.7 micrometers allows enhanced material discrimination. This work establishes a pathway toward scalable distributed molecular sensing and broadens access to infrared spectroscopy for environmental monitoring, industrial process control, and community-level chemical detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种基于硅兼容 GeSn 光探测器与数字微镜单像素架构的紧凑型宽带红外光谱系统，可在室温零偏压下工作并扩展到更长波段。该平台兼具轻量、低功耗和机械稳健等优点，并可用于塑料等样品的选择性识别。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 红外光谱是分子识别中广泛使用的技术，但其大规模部署仍受制于体积庞大的仪器、低温制冷需求以及便携性不足。本文展示了一种宽带近红外到短波红外光谱技术，它由集成在紧凑型数字微镜器件单像素架构中的硅兼容 GeSn 光探测器实现。通过结合探测器设计、针对性的光学重构以及波长重新校准，我们将工作波段扩展至 2.4 微米，同时保持室温、零偏压的光伏工作模式。系统层面的基准测试定量表征了窄带隙光探测中光谱扩展与探测率之间的内在权衡，在扩展截止波长条件下，于 1.55 微米处获得 1.12 × 10¹⁰ cm Hz¹/² W⁻¹ 的比探测率。我们通过对代表性商品塑料的选择性识别验证了所获光谱仪的能力，证明其是一个轻量、低功耗且机械稳健的平台，适合便携式和自主式部署。尽管预期会出现更高的生成受限噪声，但访问 1.7 微米以上强聚合物组合带可增强材料区分能力。这项工作为可扩展的分布式分子传感开辟了道路，并拓宽了红外光谱在环境监测、工业过程控制以及社区级化学检测中的应用范围。

articles.title: Finite-source filtering and Doppler modulation of infragravity waves generated by breakpoint forcing
articles.title_zh: 由破碎点强迫产生的内重力波的有限源滤波与多普勒调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03300v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Infragravity waves generated in the surf zone contribute substantially to nearshore water-level variability, with group-scale variations in wave breaking generating free long waves through breakpoint forcing. Existing interpretations of this mechanism rely largely on an idealised moving-breakpoint picture in which breaking is tied to a local saturation relation, leaving unresolved how the finite extent and evolution of a realistic breaking region control the radiated waves. We first derive a local decomposition of the wave-induced forcing into breakpoint and bound wave forcing, separating the two contributions within the same evolving short-wave field. We then describe the breakpoint-forcing field as a finite, evolving source through its integrated strength, centroid, cross-shore width, and shape. This representation shows that finite source extent produces spatial interference, as phase differences between contributions emitted from different positions attenuate the high-frequency part of the infragravity response and shift this attenuation toward lower frequencies as the source widens. Source migration produces a directional Doppler shift by modifying the arrival times of successive emissions, with shoreward motion compressing arrivals at a shoreward observer and stretching them at a seaward observer. Breaking depth controls both the conversion of this forcing into surface elevation and the celerities governing these propagation-time effects. Controlled numerical experiments across a range of plane-beach slopes reproduce the predicted signatures: broader source footprints strengthen upper-band attenuation on both branches. The diagnosed migration history, with breaking strongest during shoreward motion, partly offsets that attenuation shoreward and reinforces it seaward.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究近岸破碎区生成的内重力波如何受到有限尺度、可演化源的影响，并分析其源过滤与多普勒调制特征。作者从理论和数值实验两方面表明，源的宽度、迁移和破碎深度会共同改变辐射出的长波响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由破碎点强迫在近岸破碎区生成的内重力波，会显著影响近岸水位变化，而波破碎的群尺度变化会通过破碎点强迫产生自由长波。现有对这一机制的解释主要依赖理想化的移动破碎点图景，即将破碎与局部饱和关系联系起来，这使得现实中破碎区域的有限范围及其演化如何控制辐射波仍未明确。我们首先从波致强迫出发，推导出对破碎点强迫和束缚波强迫的局部分解，在同一演化的短波场中将二者区分开来。随后，我们通过积分强度、质心、横岸宽度和形状，将破碎点强迫场描述为一个有限且不断演化的源。该表示表明，有限源范围会产生空间干涉，因为从不同位置发出的贡献之间存在相位差，会削弱内重力响应的高频部分，并且随着源宽度增大，这种削弱会向更低频率移动。源的迁移则通过改变连续发射的到达时间产生方向性的多普勒频移：向岸运动会压缩岸侧观测者接收到的到达间隔，而在离岸侧观测者处则会拉伸这些间隔。破碎深度同时控制着这种强迫向表面位移转换的过程，以及支配这些传播时间效应的相速度。跨越一系列平坦海滩坡度的受控数值实验再现了上述预测特征：更宽的源足迹会加强上下频带的衰减。诊断得到的迁移历史显示，破碎在向岸运动期间最强，这一过程部分抵消了岸侧的衰减，并在离岸侧进一步增强了衰减。

articles.title: PSDWII: Physical-Structure-Driven Waveform Inversion Imaging
articles.title_zh: PSDWII：物理结构驱动的波形反演成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03380v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper proposes a Physical-Structure-Driven Waveform Inversion Imaging framework (PSDWII), grounded in the recognition that surface-recorded seismic data are directly related to subsurface virtual sources rather than to the model parameters themselves. Based on this recognition, we decompose seismic wave propagation into a three-step physical process: source excitation and incident wave propagation; interaction of the incident wave with heterogeneities, which generates virtual sources with distinct radiation patterns and excites secondary waves; and propagation and reception of the secondary waves. The adjoint of the propagation operator (reverse-time extrapolation) is then used to formulate a linear inversion projection for the virtual sources. By distinguishing different virtual-source expressions and their underlying physical mechanisms, we establish a unified mathematical representation for three inversion tasks: Full Waveform Inversion(FWI), stratigraphic physical properties imaging, and stratigraphic structures imaging. Deconvolution and linear inversion are respectively adopted to achieve multi-parameter decoupling in FWI and in angle-domain common-image gather inversion for stratigraphic physical properties imaging. The PSDWII framework shifts the conventional ``mathematical optimization driven'' paradigm of waveform inversion to a ``physical-structure-driven'' one. It neither constructs objective functions nor computes their gradients or Hessian inverses. Within this framework, we develop three specific methods: physical-structure-driven FWI (PSDFWI), physical-structure-driven stratigraphic physical properties imaging with angle-domain common-image gather inversion (PSDSI), and physical-structure-driven stratigraphic structures imaging (PSDMig).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种物理结构驱动的波形反演成像框架，强调地表地震数据与地下虚拟源之间的直接物理关联，而非与模型参数的直接对应。作者据此建立了统一的数学表述，可用于全波形反演、地层物性成像和地层结构成像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出一种物理结构驱动的波形反演成像框架（PSDWII），其基础认识是：地表记录的地震数据与地下虚拟源直接相关，而不是与模型参数本身直接相关。基于这一认识，我们将地震波传播分解为三个物理步骤：源激发与入射波传播；入射波与非均匀体相互作用，生成具有不同辐射模式的虚拟源并激发次级波；以及次级波的传播与接收。随后，利用传播算子的伴随算子（逆时外推）来建立针对虚拟源的线性反演投影。通过区分不同虚拟源表达式及其背后的物理机制，我们建立了一个统一的数学表述，用于三类反演任务：全波形反演（FWI）、地层物性成像和地层结构成像。我们分别采用反褶积和线性反演，实现 FWI 中的多参数解耦，以及用于地层物性成像的角度域公共成像道集反演中的多参数解耦。PSDWII 框架将传统“数学优化驱动”的波形反演范式转变为“物理结构驱动”的范式。它既不构造目标函数，也不计算其梯度或 Hessian 逆矩阵。在该框架下，我们发展了三种具体方法：物理结构驱动的 FWI（PSDFWI）、基于角度域公共成像道集反演的物理结构驱动地层物性成像（PSDSI），以及物理结构驱动地层结构成像（PSDMig）。

articles.title: Cascade coalescence dynamically sustains bubble retention near gas-evolving surfaces
articles.title_zh: 级联并合动态维持气体析出表面的气泡滞留
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bubble detachment from solid surfaces governs heat, mass, and charge transport across technologies vital to clean energy, including high-current-density water electrolysis and boiling thermal management. At high gas fluxes, however, bubbles remain trapped at active surfaces despite immense buoyancy, severely restricting mass transfer and increasing energy losses. Here, we show that this unexpected surface retention originates from cascade coalescence between unequal-sized bubbles. High-speed observations around microelectrodes demonstrate that when a rising bubble merges with a smaller surface-attached successor, its trajectory abruptly reverses, accelerating toward the substrate at nearly two orders of magnitude above its rising speed. Direct numerical simulations and scaling analysis reveal that asymmetric interfacial retraction during merging generates non-canceling viscous stresses, producing a net downward impulse toward the smaller bubble. Repeated cascade coalescence events accumulate these transient impulses into a steady, time-averaged retaining force capable of opposing buoyancy three to four orders of magnitude beyond quasistatic limits. Our findings establish bubble coalescence as a previously unrecognized mechanism that dynamically sustains bubble retention under high gas flux.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了高气体通量下气泡会因级联并合而持续滞留于固体表面的新机制。研究表明，不同尺寸气泡并合产生的非对称界面回缩会带来向下脉冲，多个事件累积后可形成足以对抗浮力的平均保持力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 气泡从固体表面脱离决定了许多关键清洁能源技术中的热、质和电荷传递，包括大电流密度水电解和沸腾热管理。然而，在高气体通量下，尽管浮力极大，气泡仍会滞留在活性表面上，严重限制传质并增加能量损失。本文表明，这种出乎意料的表面滞留源于不同尺寸气泡之间的级联并合。围绕微电极的高速观测显示，当一个上升气泡与一个更小的、附着于表面的后续气泡合并时，其轨迹会突然反转，并以接近其上升速度近两个数量级的速度加速朝向基底。直接数值模拟和尺度分析揭示，并合过程中的非对称界面回缩会产生无法相互抵消的黏性应力，从而对较小气泡产生一个净向下冲量。反复发生的级联并合事件会将这些瞬态冲量累积为一个稳态的、时间平均的保持力，其能力可比准静态极限强三到四个数量级，从而足以对抗浮力。我们的研究确立了气泡并合作为一种此前未被认识到的机制，可在高气体通量下动态维持气泡滞留。

articles.title: Interface-resolved simulations of boiling heat transfer
articles.title_zh: 沸腾传热的界面分辨模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03396v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Boiling heat transfer underpins many applications where large heat fluxes must be dissipated. Boiling is characterized by a wide range of coupled multiscale transport phenomena, making its accurate numerical prediction a long-standing challenge. In this context, interface-resolved simulation approaches - where the liquid-vapor interface is either explicitly or implicitly described - have undergone significant advancements, driven by improved numerical formulations, more complete thermodynamic and compressibility modeling, and the growing availability of computational resources. Here, we provide a comprehensive overview of the state of the art in interface-resolved simulations of boiling flows. We examine the different formulations governing the flow and temperature field, strategies for coupling heat and mass transfer at the interface, and current modeling approaches for small-scale physics such as nucleation, microlayer evaporation, and contact-line dynamics. By analyzing insights from recent high-fidelity simulations, a central observation is that interface-resolved simulations of boiling are hydrodynamically resolved but microscopically modeled: their predictive accuracy depends on the sub-grid closures for nucleation, microlayer, and contact-line physics no less than on the fidelity of the hydrodynamic solver. We discuss the strengths and limitations of available methods on this basis, together with the open challenges in the accurate description of boiling heat transfer.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述概述了沸腾流界面分辨模拟的研究进展，讨论了流动与温度场的建模、界面热质传递耦合，以及成核、微层蒸发和接触线动力学等小尺度物理的处理方式。作者指出，此类方法在流体动力学上虽可解析，但在微观尺度上仍依赖模型闭合，其预测能力很大程度取决于亚网格模型的准确性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 沸腾传热支撑着许多需要消散大热流密度的应用。沸腾具有多尺度耦合传输现象范围广的特点，因此其精确数值预测长期以来一直是一个挑战。在这一背景下，界面分辨模拟方法——即显式或隐式地描述液-汽界面——近年来取得了显著进展，这得益于更完善的数值格式、更完整的热力学与可压缩性建模，以及计算资源的不断增长。本文对沸腾流界面分辨模拟的研究现状进行了全面综述。我们考察了支配流动和温度场的不同方程形式、界面热质传递耦合策略，以及针对成核、微层蒸发和接触线动力学等小尺度物理的当前建模方法。通过分析近期高保真模拟所提供的认识，一个核心结论是：界面分辨模拟在流体动力学上是可解析的，但在微观上仍依赖模型；其预测精度对成核、微层和接触线物理的亚网格闭合的依赖，并不亚于对流体动力学求解器保真度的依赖。我们据此讨论了现有方法的优点与局限，并总结了准确描述沸腾传热所面临的开放挑战。

articles.title: A conservative coupling method of sharp-interface and multi-species model for compressible reacting gas-liquid flows with phase change
articles.title_zh: 一种用于含相变可压缩反应气-液流的锐界面与多组分模型保守耦合方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, a conservative sharp-interface and diffuse-interface coupling method is developed for compressible two-phase multi-species flows with phase change and chemical reactions. The liquid--gas interface is represented by a sharp-interface model, whereas a diffuse-interface model treats the transport and chemical reactions of gas-phase species. Conservation is enforced by coupling the two phases through interfacial fluxes obtained from a multi-species phase-change Riemann problem. The original single-species four-wave Riemann solver is extended to multi-species gas mixtures by modifying the interfacial energy jump condition. Interfacial mass transfer is restricted to the condensable vapor species. Accordingly, both the interfacial energy jump condition and the gas-mixture energy-exchange flux are constructed using the internal energy of the phase-changing vapor species rather than the mixture internal energy. With this species-selective energy coupling, an approximate multi-species Riemann solver is constructed that retains the four-wave structure while avoiding the multidimensional nonlinear root-finding required by the exact solution. A series of numerical tests, including impulsive evaporation and condensation, reacting aluminum vaporization, shock-droplet interaction, and detonation-droplet interaction, are performed to assess the accuracy and robustness of the method. The numerical results agree well with reference solutions and benchmark data, demonstrating that the present method resolves the effects of phase change and chemical reactions in compressible multi-species multiphase flows while preserving conservative interfacial coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于含相变和化学反应的可压缩两相多组分流动的保守锐界面—弥散界面耦合方法。该方法通过多组分相变黎曼问题获得界面通量，并将能量耦合限定在可凝结蒸气组分上，以保持守恒并避免高维非线性求根。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文针对含相变和化学反应的可压缩两相多组分流动，提出一种保守的锐界面与弥散界面耦合方法。液-气界面采用锐界面模型表示，而气相组分的输运与化学反应则由弥散界面模型处理。通过从一个多组分相变黎曼问题中获得的界面通量，在两相之间实施守恒耦合。原始的单组分四波黎曼求解器通过修改界面能量跃迁条件，被扩展到多组分气体混合物。界面质量传递被限制为可凝结蒸气组分。因此，界面能量跃迁条件以及气体混合物的能量交换通量，均使用发生相变的蒸气组分的内能来构建，而不是使用混合物内能。借助这种特定于组分的能量耦合，构造出一个近似的多组分黎曼求解器，它保留了四波结构，同时避免了精确解所需的多维非线性求根。我们通过一系列数值测试来评估该方法的准确性和鲁棒性，包括脉冲蒸发与凝结、反应性铝蒸发、激波-液滴相互作用以及爆轰-液滴相互作用。数值结果与参考解和基准数据吻合良好，表明该方法在保持界面保守耦合的同时，能够解析可压缩多组分多相流中相变与化学反应的影响。

articles.title: Radiative and Dynamical Controls on the Land-Ocean Warming Contrast in Climate Models
articles.title_zh: 气候模型中陆海增暖差异的辐射与动力控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03658v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface air over land warms substantially more than over the ocean under greenhouse forcing, a phenomenon known as the land-ocean warming contrast. Current explanations for this contrast are commonly expressed either in terms of energetic constraints, from top-of-atmosphere and surface energy balance, or dynamical constraints, from large-scale atmospheric dynamics. We show that these perspectives are complementary when viewed through the lens of atmospheric moist static energy (MSE) transport, and that connecting them yields new insight into the controls of the warming contrast and the spread in climate models. We use this framework to construct an interpretable emulator that reproduces the land-ocean warming response across 22 models from the latest Coupled Model Intercomparison Project (CMIP6). We find that the strength of the land-ocean warming contrast emerges from the interplay between a model-dependent radiative baseline and a robust dynamical restoring mechanism that favors greater warming over land. This interplay leads to two broad model regimes that align with climate sensitivity. In low-climate-sensitivity models, more stabilizing radiative feedbacks over the ocean directly favor greater land warming. In high-climate-sensitivity models, radiative feedbacks alone would instead favor greater ocean warming, but a strong MSE-transport feedback (approximately 0.2 PW/K) more than compensates for this tendency. The intermodel spread in the land-ocean warming contrast is closely related to the ratio of radiative feedbacks over land and ocean, highlighting a broader connection between climate sensitivity and the land-ocean warming contrast.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究解释温室气体强迫下陆地增暖强于海洋的机制，并将能量约束与大尺度动力约束统一到大气湿静能输送框架中。作者基于22个CMIP6模型构建可解释模拟器，发现陆海增暖差异由模型依赖的辐射基线与稳健的动力恢复机制共同控制。模型间差异与陆地和海洋辐射反馈比值密切相关，并与气候敏感度存在更广泛联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03658v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：在温室气体强迫下，陆地上方的近地面空气增暖幅度显著大于海洋上方，这一现象被称为陆海增暖差异。目前对这种差异的解释通常要么从大气顶和地表能量平衡出发，以能量约束来表述；要么从大尺度大气动力学出发，以动力约束来表述。我们表明，当通过大气湿静能（MSE）输送的视角来看待时，这两种观点是互补的，而将二者联系起来能够为增暖差异及气候模型离散性的控制因素提供新的认识。我们利用这一框架构建了一个可解释的模拟器，能够再现最新耦合模式比较计划（CMIP6）中22个模型的陆海增暖响应。我们发现，陆海增暖差异的强度源自模型依赖的辐射基线与一种稳健的动力恢复机制之间的相互作用，而该机制倾向于使陆地增暖更强。这种相互作用产生了两类大致的模型状态，并与气候敏感度相对应。在低气候敏感度模型中，海洋上更具稳定作用的辐射反馈会直接有利于更强的陆地增暖。在高气候敏感度模型中，仅辐射反馈本身反而会有利于更强的海洋增暖，但强烈的MSE输送反馈（约0.2 PW/K）足以抵消并超过这一倾向。陆海增暖差异的模型间离散性与陆地和海洋辐射反馈的比值密切相关，凸显了气候敏感度与陆海增暖差异之间更广泛的联系。

articles.title: Cold Extremes during Dansgaard-Oeschger Oscillations
articles.title_zh: 丹斯高—奥施格振荡期间的极端寒冷事件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03664v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper studies the statistics of extreme cold air surface temperatures in a climate that experiences abrupt changes. We employ a CCSM4 simulation of Last Glacial Maximum conditions that exhibits rapid switching between stadial and interstadial states as data. Non-stationary linear Generalized Extreme Value (GEV) distributions are fitted to find the regions that show the most prominent changes and associate them with physical processes. The results are then compared with a non-linear model, which gives a more detailed picture of how the parameters change as a function of the AMOC strength. While different regions of the world show different extremal behaviours, many regions show an approximately linear relationship between the parameters of the GEV distributions and the strength of the AMOC within the stadial and interstadial states, with some non-linear oscillation or jump where the transition between them takes place. Physical processes such as the expansion and retreat of the sea ice and the relative changes in the strength of the currents are shown to impact the magnitude and variability of the extremes, with significant changes observed in the three parameters of the GEV. They also create teleconnections that are compared whenever possible with various proxies for the temperature of the air and the water. We show how mapping the parameters of the GEV distributions into the AMOC strength gives a way to compare results between different climate models and different climate states. Comparisons, however, need to pay heed to the dynamical characteristics of the state and the location to be meaningful.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究在经历突变的气候中极端低温近地面气温的统计特征。作者使用末次盛冰期条件下的CCSM4模拟，并用非平稳线性广义极值分布识别极端冷事件变化显著的区域及其物理机制。结果显示，海冰进退、洋流强度变化及AMOC强度会影响极端事件的幅度和变率，并提示不同模型和气候状态之间的比较需考虑动力特征和地理位置。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03664v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：本文研究在经历突变的气候中，极端寒冷近地面气温的统计特征。我们采用一个末次盛冰期条件下的CCSM4模拟作为数据，该模拟表现出冷阶状态与暖阶状态之间的快速切换。通过拟合非平稳线性广义极值（GEV）分布，我们寻找变化最显著的区域，并将这些变化与物理过程联系起来。随后将这些结果与一个非线性模型进行比较，该模型能够更详细地呈现各参数如何随AMOC强度而变化。尽管世界不同区域表现出不同的极端行为，但许多区域显示出GEV分布参数与冷阶和暖阶状态内AMOC强度之间近似线性的关系，并且在二者转变发生的位置出现某种非线性振荡或跃变。研究表明，海冰的扩张与退缩以及洋流强度的相对变化等物理过程，会影响极端事件的幅度和变率，并使GEV的三个参数均出现显著变化。这些过程还产生了遥相关，我们在可能的情况下将其与多种空气温度和水体温度代用指标进行比较。我们展示了如何将GEV分布参数映射到AMOC强度，从而为不同气候模型和不同气候状态之间的结果比较提供一种方法。然而，要使比较具有意义，必须注意相应状态和地点的动力学特征。

articles.title: Diabatic Seam Space Sampling for Hydrogen Tunneling Systems with Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Theory
articles.title_zh: 基于核—电子轨道理论的氢隧穿体系糖尿病缝合空间采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrogen tunneling is central to many chemical and biological processes. Herein, we introduce the vibronic-SHAKE (V-SHAKE) approach to comprehensively sample energy-conserving molecular configurations enabling hydrogen tunneling. A constrained form of nuclear-electronic orbital multistate density functional theory (NEO-MSDFT) dynamics, where the tunneling hydrogen nucleus is quantized, is used to sample geometries in the diabatic seam space corresponding to the intersection of the reactant and product NEO-DFT diabatic vibronic surfaces. V-SHAKE is applied to hydrogen and deuterium tunneling in 4-cyanobutanolate and Z-4-hydroxybut-3-en-2-one. The vibronic coupling is found to vary significantly in the diabatic seam space, mainly due to changes in the donor-acceptor distance. The reaction coordinate and gradient of the vibronic coupling at the minimum energy crossing point are nearly orthogonal and are dominated by motions stabilizing the product relative to the reactant or decreasing the donor-acceptor distance, respectively. V-SHAKE provides fundamental insights and validation for assumptions underlying rate theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出vibronic-SHAKE（V-SHAKE）方法，用于全面采样能够发生氢隧穿且能量守恒的分子构型。作者将约束形式的核—电子轨道多态密度泛函理论动力学用于二面体缝合空间采样，其中隧穿氢核被量子化处理。结果表明，振电子耦合在缝合空间中显著变化，主要受供体—受体距离改变控制，并为相关速率理论假设提供了机理见解和验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03942v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：氢隧穿在许多化学和生物过程中居于核心地位。本文引入振电子-SHAKE（V-SHAKE）方法，用于全面采样能够实现氢隧穿的能量守恒分子构型。我们采用一种约束形式的核—电子轨道多态密度泛函理论（NEO-MSDFT）动力学，其中隧穿的氢核被量子化处理，以采样二面体缝合空间中的几何构型；该空间对应于反应物与产物NEO-DFT二面体振电子势能面的交叉。V-SHAKE被应用于4-氰基丁醇盐和Z-4-羟基丁-3-烯-2-酮中的氢和氘隧穿。研究发现，振电子耦合在二面体缝合空间中变化显著，主要原因是供体—受体距离的变化。在最低能量交叉点处，反应坐标与振电子耦合梯度几乎正交，并分别主要由相对于反应物稳定产物的运动以及缩短供体—受体距离的运动所主导。V-SHAKE为速率理论所依据的假设提供了基础性认识和验证。

articles.title: How do flapping avian wing exhibit superior aerodynamic performance?
articles.title_zh: 扑翼鸟类翅膀如何表现出优越的气动性能？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03957v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work investigates the unsteady aerodynamic performance and vortex dynamics of avian-inspired flapping wings using our in-house sharp-interface immersed-boundary solver, VorteXdyn. A falcon-inspired body-wing model based on NACA 4312 profile is employed to examine aerodynamic force generation and vortex evolution during steady forward flapping flight at Reynolds numbers of 2,500, 5000, and 10000 and Strouhal numbers of 0.18, 0.225, and 0.27. The influence of physiologies is examined using three wing configurations: a simplified wing without distinct feather structures, a wing incorporating feather-like structures (serrations) along the trailing edge, and a geometrically detailed wing incorporating multiple feather layers consisting of primary, secondary, and median feathers over its span. The aerodynamic performance of these configurations is quantified using the temporal profiles and time-averaged characteristics of the lift and drag coefficients and the lift-to-drag ratio. The associated vortex dynamics are characterized through the formation and evolution of multiple leading-edge vortices (LEVs), their spanwise coherence, circulation, characteristic size, and persistence over the wings' surfaces. Particular emphasis is placed on the spanwise development of the LEVs from the root to the wingtip, their interactions with the tip vortices, and the resulting wake evolution during the downstroke. Our results demonstrate that increasing geometric fidelity modifies aerodynamic force production, the formation and evolution of multiple LEV structures, vortex-vortex and votex-wing interactions, and wake topology. These findings provide insight into the aerodynamic role of feather morphology in three-dimensional flapping flight for the aerodynamic design of efficient bio-inspired flapping-wing micro air vehicles.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用自研锐界面浸没边界求解器VorteXdyn，分析仿鸟扑翼的非定常气动性能和涡动力学。作者比较了无羽毛结构、带后缘羽状锯齿以及包含多层羽毛的三种翼型构型，评估升力、阻力、升阻比及前缘涡演化。结果表明，提高几何细节会改变气动力生成、涡结构、涡—涡与涡—翼相互作用及尾迹拓扑，对仿生微型扑翼飞行器设计具有启示意义。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03957v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：本研究使用我们自研的锐界面浸没边界求解器VorteXdyn，考察仿鸟扑翼的非定常气动性能和涡动力学。研究采用一个基于NACA 4312翼型的仿隼体—翼模型，在雷诺数为2,500、5000和10000以及斯特劳哈尔数为0.18、0.225和0.27的稳态向前扑翼飞行条件下，考察气动力生成和涡演化。通过三种翼构型考察生理形态的影响：一种是不含明显羽毛结构的简化翼；一种是在后缘加入类羽毛结构（锯齿）的翼；另一种是在展向上包含由初级羽、次级羽和中间羽组成的多层羽毛的几何细节化翼。通过升力系数、阻力系数和升阻比的时间变化曲线及时间平均特征，对这些构型的气动性能进行量化。相关涡动力学则通过多个前缘涡（LEV）的形成与演化、其展向相干性、环量、特征尺度以及在翼表面的持续存在来表征。研究特别强调前缘涡从翼根到翼尖的展向发展、它们与翼尖涡的相互作用，以及下扑过程中由此产生的尾迹演化。我们的结果表明，提高几何保真度会改变气动力产生、多重LEV结构的形成和演化、涡—涡与涡—翼相互作用以及尾迹拓扑。这些发现为三维扑翼飞行中羽毛形态的气动作用提供了认识，并有助于高效仿生扑翼微型飞行器的气动设计。

articles.title: Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy at Benchmark-Level Sub-Permille Accuracy Enabled by a System-Level Detection Transfer Function
articles.title_zh: 系统级检测传递函数实现基准级亚千分之一精度的腔衰荡光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS) is widely used for sensitive optical absorption measurements, but its quantitative accuracy can be limited at the few-percent level by systematic distortions originating in the CRDS detection system, particularly at short ring-down times. These limitations can restrict demanding spectroscopic applications requiring sub-permille accuracy, including atmospheric sensing, tests of ab initio theory and fundamental physics, and quantum-based optical gas standards. Here we develop a methodology based on a system-level detection transfer function describing the complete CRDS detection-system response, including detector, electronics, and digitization stages, and use it to correct previously unaccounted-for instrumental distortions in retrieved absorption. We demonstrate the method on a CO absorption line measured down to very short ring-down times using multiple independent CRDS detection configurations, initially exhibiting line-area biases of up to 14%. After applying the transfer-function correction, all systems converge to a common value, with the bias relative to the most accurate ab initio-validated reference data reaching the sub-permille level and the accuracy improving by a factor of 41--87. The proposed framework brings well-established CRDS to the level of the most accurate reference methods without requiring specialized measurement schemes or external calibration standards, making benchmark-quality measurements more widely accessible.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对腔衰荡光谱中由检测系统导致的系统性畸变，提出系统级检测传递函数校正方法。作者在CO吸收线的多种CRDS检测配置上验证该方法，将原先最高达14%的线面积偏差校正到相对于高精度从头算验证参考数据的亚千分之一水平。该框架无需专门测量方案或外部校准标准，即可提升CRDS的定量准确度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.04027v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：腔衰荡光谱（CRDS）被广泛用于灵敏的光学吸收测量，但其定量准确度可能会受到源自CRDS检测系统的系统性畸变限制，尤其是在短衰荡时间下，这种限制可达到百分之几的水平。这些限制可能制约要求亚千分之一精度的高要求光谱应用，包括大气探测、从头算理论和基础物理检验，以及基于量子的光学气体标准。本文发展了一种基于系统级检测传递函数的方法，该函数描述完整CRDS检测系统响应，包括探测器、电子学和数字化阶段，并用其校正此前未被考虑的仪器畸变对反演吸收的影响。我们在一条CO吸收线上展示了该方法，该吸收线在非常短的衰荡时间下由多个独立CRDS检测配置测得，初始结果显示线面积偏差最高可达14%。应用传递函数校正后，所有系统均收敛到一个共同值，相对于最精确的从头算验证参考数据的偏差达到亚千分之一水平，准确度提高了41到87倍。所提出的框架使成熟的CRDS达到最精确参考方法的水平，而无需专门的测量方案或外部校准标准，从而使基准质量的测量更容易获得。

articles.title: Testbeam characterization of a 3D silicon sensor read out by Timepix4
articles.title_zh: Timepix4读出的三维硅传感器的测试束表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04042v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Testbeam results from a 300,mum-thick 3D silicon sensor bump-bonded to a Timepix4 ASIC, are presented. The hit detection efficiency, spatial resolution, and timing performance of the 3D sensor are studied for several track angles, bias voltages and charge thresholds. The time measurements are corrected for Timepix4 clock-frequency variations and timewalk, while for the spatial studies, nonlinear charge-sharing corrections are determined. At perpendicular incidence, the time resolution of the 3D detector is equal to 245,ps with a 97% hit detection efficiency. An optimal angle of 8^circ with respect to the beam direction of the 3D detector was found, in which the time resolution improves by 6% compared to normal incidence, while the hit detection efficiency reaches above 99% and the spatial resolution is approximately 7,mum. Intrapixel studies show that a time resolution of 153,ps at the most probable value of the signal charge can be achieved for hits between the electrodes at normal incidence, while the timing performance of these best-performing regions deteriorate upon sensor rotation. The timing properties at different depths of the 3D sensor have been investigated with tracks at grazing-angle incidence, revealing a dependence of the time resolution along the sensor depth.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文报告了厚度300微米、与Timepix4 ASIC凸点键合的三维硅传感器的测试束结果。作者在不同入射角、偏置电压和电荷阈值下研究命中探测效率、空间分辨率和时间性能，并进行了时钟频率变化、时间游走和非线性电荷共享校正。结果显示，在8度入射角下性能最优，探测效率超过99%，空间分辨率约7微米，且时间分辨率随像素内位置和传感器深度变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.04042v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：本文展示了一种厚度为300微米、凸点键合到Timepix4 ASIC的三维硅传感器的测试束结果。研究在若干轨迹角、偏置电压和电荷阈值下考察了该三维传感器的命中探测效率、空间分辨率和时间性能。时间测量经过Timepix4时钟频率变化和时间游走校正，而在空间研究中则确定了非线性电荷共享校正。在垂直入射时，三维探测器的时间分辨率为245皮秒，命中探测效率为97%。研究发现，相对于三维探测器束流方向8度的角度为最佳角度，在该角度下，与法向入射相比，时间分辨率提高6%，命中探测效率达到99%以上，空间分辨率约为7微米。像素内研究显示，在法向入射时，对于电极之间且信号电荷处于最概然值的命中，可实现153皮秒的时间分辨率，而这些表现最佳区域的时间性能在传感器旋转后会变差。研究还利用掠入射角轨迹考察了三维传感器不同深度处的时间特性，揭示出时间分辨率沿传感器深度存在依赖关系。

articles.title: Monitoring antiproton numbers with a CMOS detector in a dense-track environment
articles.title_zh: 在高密度径迹环境中利用CMOS探测器监测反质子数量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The production of antihydrogen by the GBAR experiment at AD/ELENA requires good knowledge of the number of incident keV antiprotons, which can be problematic. We have used a commercial CMOS digital camera mounted around the experimental vacuum chamber to determine antiproton numbers from ionising particles created in the annihilation process on the surface of microchannel plate detectors which are used for beam imaging. We show that the multiplicity of emerging charged particles is as expected for individual annihilations of antiprotons with nucleons at rest, taking into account the surrounding material budget. Most of those particles are in the minimal ionising regime, but can be detected with nearly 100% efficiency in the CMOS pixel detector, while due to the thin depletion layer the device is insensitive to background gammas. Thanks to the high granularity and small pixel size millions of antiproton annihilations can be reconstructed in a dense tracking environment over a large dynamic range with good resolution. From cluster length studies of non perpendicular tracks the thickness of the depletion zone and effective detection area was estimated. The cluster length also allows for a monitoring of track angles. Antiproton numbers are determined from the number of reconstructed clusters in the CMOS sensor by means of the covered solid angle relative to a calibration measurements with well known beam intensities at the most upstream location of the GBAR apparatus.
