For teleportation through a systematic gate miscalibration, the network learns to invert the miscalibration and raises mean state fidelity from about 0.93 to 0.99, with the gain increasing as additional shots reduce tomographic noise. A control experiment replacing the systematic miscalibration with a fully random per-qubit rotation yields no benefit, the expected outcome when noise carries no recurring structure. The findings indicate that lightweight learned post-processing is worthwhile specifically in the low-shot, structured-noise regime, and offers nothing when noise is structureless.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一个仅作为经典后处理层的小型神经网络，能否利用真实接收者可获得的信息来缓解量子隐形传态和超密编码中的信道缺陷。结果显示，在低测量次数和具有结构的噪声条件下，学习型后处理能够改善性能：对于带偏置泡利信道和非对称读出误差的超密编码，其准确率在五次测量时比多数投票基线高约五个百分点；对于系统性门校准误差下的隐形传态，平均态保真度可由约 0.93 提升至 0.99。面对每个量子比特均随机变化、缺乏重复结构的噪声时，该方法没有带来收益。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子隐形传态和超密编码是量子通信的基础协议，但二者都会因信道缺陷而性能下降。本文考察了这样一个问题：当一个小型神经网络仅作为经典后处理层，并且只接收真实接收者能够收集的信息时，它是否能够缓解这些缺陷。两个协议均使用复数值量子比特振幅上的张量运算精确实现，从而复现理想的无噪声行为。随后引入现实中的缺陷，并在有限测量次数条件下评估学习型缓解方法；在这种条件下，网络观测到的是有限数量的离散测量结果，而非精确概率，并且从未获得噪声参数。结果明确表明了学习方法何时有效的边界。对于经过带偏置泡利信道和非对称读出误差的超密编码，在低测量次数范围内，学习型解码器超过了多数投票基线；在五次测量时，其优势约为五个百分点，随着测量次数增加，两种方法的准确率都趋近于完美。对于存在系统性门校准误差的量子隐形传态，网络学会了反演该校准误差，并将平均态保真度从约 0.93 提高到 0.99；随着更多测量次数降低层析噪声，这一提升幅度还会增加。将系统性校准误差替换为每个量子比特均完全随机的旋转后，作为对照实验，网络没有带来任何收益；当噪声不具有重复结构时，这是预期结果。研究结果表明，轻量级的学习型后处理仅在低测量次数、具有结构化噪声的条件下值得采用，而面对无结构噪声时不会带来收益。

articles.title: Quantum control algorithm looks to explain how birds migrate
articles.title_zh: 量子控制算法试图解释鸟类如何迁徙
articles.abstract: The hidden world of quantum mechanics exists at scales many orders of magnitude smaller than living organisms, yet scientists have long theorized that quantum effects play an important role in biology. Birds' ability to sense magnetic fields during migration is one of the best-known mysteries in this field, with leading theories suggesting that this sensing could be achieved by exploiting quantum entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子力学的隐秘世界存在于比生物体小许多数量级的尺度上，但科学家长期以来一直认为量子效应可能在生物学中发挥重要作用。鸟类在迁徙过程中感知磁场的能力，是这一领域最著名的谜题之一。主流理论认为，鸟类可能通过利用量子纠缠实现这种磁场感知。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子力学的隐秘世界存在于比生物体小许多数量级的尺度上，但科学家长期以来一直在推测，量子效应可能在生物学中发挥重要作用。鸟类在迁徙过程中感知磁场的能力，是这一领域最著名的谜题之一；主流理论认为，这种感知可能通过利用量子纠缠来实现。

articles.title: Evolution from Kitaev to XXZ spin chains via distortion: Application to BaCo₂V₂O₈
articles.title_zh: 通过畸变实现从 Kitaev 到 XXZ 自旋链的演化：BaCo₂V₂O₈ 的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: BaCo₂V₂O₈ is a prototypical spin-orbit-coupled Ising-chain antiferromagnet that provides a unique platform for studying field-induced quantum magnetism. Under a transverse magnetic field, it exhibits unusual magnetic properties, including an anomalous staggered magnetization and a pronounced anisotropy of the critical field with respect to the in-plane field direction. While these phenomena have been attributed phenomenologically to a site-dependent anisotropic g-tensor, a recent microscopic theory has shown that spin-orbit coupling naturally generates bond-dependent Heisenberg, Kitaev, and Γ exchange interactions. Here, we unify these two pictures by extending the microscopic theory to incorporate distortions of the CoO₆ octahedra. We show that the distortions not only generate the site-dependent anisotropic g-tensor but also renormalize the staggered exchange interactions through a distortion-induced contribution that partially compensates the Kitaev-derived staggered term. Using point-charge calculations to estimate the g-tensor of BaCo₂V₂O₈, we demonstrate that the strong anisotropy of the critical field originates from the combined effects of the modified exchange interactions and the anisotropic g-tensor. Our work provides a unified microscopic framework for understanding the magnetic anisotropy of spin-orbit-coupled Ising-chain materials.
articles.abstract_zh: BaCo₂V₂O₈ 是一种典型的自旋轨道耦合伊辛链反铁磁体，为研究场诱导量子磁性提供了独特平台。本文将具有位置依赖各向异性 g 张量的现象学图像与包含键依赖海森堡、Kitaev 和 Γ 交换相互作用的微观理论统一起来，并将 CoO₆ 八面体畸变纳入分析。研究表明，畸变不仅产生位置依赖的各向异性 g 张量，还会重整化交错交换相互作用，并部分抵消由 Kitaev 相互作用产生的交错项；临界场的强各向异性源于修正后的交换相互作用与各向异性 g 张量的共同作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: BaCo₂V₂O₈ 是一种典型的自旋轨道耦合伊辛链反铁磁体，为研究场诱导量子磁性提供了独特平台。在横向磁场下，它表现出不同寻常的磁性，包括反常的交错磁化，以及临界场相对于面内磁场方向所呈现的显著各向异性。尽管这些现象在现象学上被归因于位置依赖的各向异性 g 张量，但近期的微观理论表明，自旋轨道耦合会自然地产生键依赖的海森堡、Kitaev 和 Γ 交换相互作用。在本文中，我们扩展微观理论，将 CoO₆ 八面体的畸变纳入其中，从而统一这两种图像。我们表明，畸变不仅会产生位置依赖的各向异性 g 张量，还会通过畸变诱导的贡献重整化交错交换相互作用；该贡献会部分抵消由 Kitaev 相互作用产生的交错项。我们利用点电荷计算估算 BaCo₂V₂O₈ 的 g 张量，并证明其临界场的强各向异性源于修正后的交换相互作用和各向异性 g 张量的共同作用。我们的工作为理解自旋轨道耦合伊辛链材料中的磁各向异性提供了统一的微观框架。

articles.title: Symmetry-selective nonrelativistic spin splitting in antiferromagnets driven by coherent phonons
articles.title_zh: 相干声子驱动反铁磁体中的对称性选择性非相对论自旋劈裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) in antiferromagnets (AFMs) enables magnetization-free spin polarization for ultrafast spintronics. Here, we demonstrate that coherent phonons can dynamically induce and control NRSS in collinear AFMs. Excitation of Γ-point infrared-active phonons lifts the spin degeneracy of the ground state, while the residual sublattice-connecting symmetries determine the momentum-space form of the induced splitting. Because the relevant infrared modes couple to orthogonal in-plane light polarizations, distinct spin-split phases can be selectively activated by the polarization of the driving field. Using first-principles calculations for MnPS₃, we show that a mode that breaks all sublattice-connecting symmetries induces an s-wave spin-split state with Δ(Γ)≠0, whereas a symmetry-distinct mode that preserves a sublattice-connecting mirror symmetry generates a d-wave altermagnetic state with Δ(Γ)=0. In both cases, the spin splitting grows linearly with the phonon amplitude and reverses the induced spin polarization when the displacement is reversed. Our results establish coherent lattice driving as a direct, polarization- and mode-selective route to dynamically induce distinct NRSS phases in AFMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，相干声子能够在共线反铁磁体中动态诱导并控制非相对论自旋劈裂，从而实现无需净磁化的超快自旋极化。Γ 点红外活性声子的激发会解除基态自旋简并，而保留下来的连接子晶格对称性决定动量空间中劈裂的形式。以 MnPS₃ 的第一性原理计算为例，不同的红外模式可分别通过光偏振选择性地激活 s 波自旋劈裂态和 d 波交替磁态；劈裂随声子振幅线性增加，并在位移反向时使诱导自旋极化反向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体中的非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS）能够在没有磁化的情况下实现自旋极化，为超快自旋电子学提供可能。本文证明，相干声子可以在共线反铁磁体中动态诱导并控制 NRSS。激发 Γ 点红外活性声子会解除基态的自旋简并，而剩余的连接子晶格对称性则决定所诱导劈裂在动量空间中的形式。由于相关红外模式与相互正交的面内光偏振相耦合，因此可以通过驱动光的偏振选择性地激活不同的自旋劈裂相。我们利用 MnPS₃ 的第一性原理计算表明，一种破坏所有连接子晶格对称性的模式会诱导出 Δ(Γ)≠0 的 s 波自旋劈裂态，而另一种在对称性上不同、保留连接子晶格镜面对称性的模式则会产生 Δ(Γ)=0 的 d 波交替磁态。在这两种情况下，自旋劈裂都会随声子振幅线性增加，并且当位移反向时，诱导的自旋极化也会反向。我们的结果确立了相干晶格驱动这一直接的、具有偏振选择性和模式选择性的途径，可用于在反铁磁体中动态诱导不同的非相对论自旋劈裂相。

articles.title: Magnons in Metallic Altermagnetic KV₂Se₂O
articles.title_zh: 金属交替磁体 KV₂Se₂O 中的磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the spin excitation in altermagnetic vanadium oxyselenides, focusing on the metallic quasi-two-dimensional compound KV₂Se₂O. Using a fermionic Hamiltonian derived from ab initio calculations, we compute the transverse spin susceptibilities within the random phase approximation and extract the magnon dispersion relation. We show that the altermagnetic symmetry leads to characteristic degeneracies and directional splittings in both the electronic bands and the magnon spectra along high-symmetry paths of the Brillouin zone. The metallic KV₂Se₂O exhibits finite magnon linewidths arising from the coupling to the particle-hole continuum. Furthermore, by fixing the magnitude of the wave vector and varying its in-plane direction, we uncover a pronounced angular dependence of the magnon energies and lifetimes, with complementary damping behavior between the two magnon branches. Upon including spin-orbit coupling, the system exhibits an out-of-plane easy c-axis anisotropy, which opens a magnon gap of approximately 6 meV at the Γ-point, possibly rendering the magnetic order stable at room temperature. Our results demonstrate that altermagnetism controls not only the dispersion but also the anisotropic decay of spin excitations, highlighting altermagnetic metals as promising platforms for directionally selective magnon transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究交替磁性钒氧硒化物中的自旋激发，重点考察金属准二维化合物 KV₂Se₂O，并利用由第一性原理计算导出的费米子哈密顿量计算横向自旋磁化率和磁振子色散。交替磁对称性导致电子能带和磁振子谱在布里渊区高对称路径上出现特征简并与方向性劈裂；由于与粒子-空穴连续谱耦合，金属体系中的磁振子具有有限线宽。自旋轨道耦合产生面外易磁化 c 轴各向异性，在 Γ 点打开约 6 meV 的磁振子能隙，并可能使磁有序在室温下保持稳定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究交替磁性钒氧硒化物中的自旋激发，重点关注金属准二维化合物 KV₂Se₂O。我们使用由第一性原理计算导出的费米子哈密顿量，在随机相位近似下计算横向自旋磁化率，并提取磁振子色散关系。我们表明，交替磁对称性会在布里渊区的高对称路径上，使电子能带和磁振子谱同时呈现特征性的简并与方向性劈裂。金属 KV₂Se₂O 中的磁振子由于与粒子-空穴连续谱耦合而具有有限的线宽。此外，通过固定波矢的大小并改变其面内方向，我们发现磁振子能量和寿命具有显著的角度依赖性，并且两个磁振支之间表现出互补的阻尼行为。加入自旋轨道耦合后，体系呈现面外易磁化 c 轴各向异性，并在 Γ 点打开约 6 meV 的磁振子能隙，这可能使磁有序在室温下保持稳定。我们的结果表明，交替磁性不仅控制自旋激发的色散，还控制其各向异性的衰减特性，凸显了交替磁金属作为方向选择性磁振子输运平台的潜力。

articles.title: Machine Learning Local Potentials for Accelerated Electron-Phonon Interactions Calculations within the Projector Augmented-Wave Framework
articles.title_zh: 在投影缀加波框架内利用机器学习局域势加速电子-声子相互作用计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron-phonon interactions govern carrier dynamics, transport, and many optical and quantum phenomena in solids, but finite-displacement calculations within the projector augmented-wave (PAW) framework require up to 6N self-consistent supercell calculations for an N-atom system, making them costly for large, low-symmetry, and disordered materials. We introduce MLLocP, a machine learning strategy that learns the self-consistent local potential on real-space grids and supplies its displacement derivatives to the evaluation of all-electron PAW electron-phonon matrix elements. Analysis of the PAW decomposition identifies the local-potential contribution as a natural target for machine learning, while the remaining PAW quantities are retained within the established VASP/PHELEL framework. Using targeted grid-point sampling and feature-diversity selection for efficient model training, we validate MLLocP for elemental Cu, polar BAs, and chemically disordered Cu3Au. The learned potentials and their resulting displacement derivatives closely reproduce direct density functional theory calculations, yielding transport coefficients within approximately 3.5% for BAs mobility, 8% for Cu conductivity, and 11% for Cu3Au conductivity. For the 32-atom Cu3Au special quasirandom structure, using 40 sampled configurations reduces the number of self-consistent calculations by about fivefold relative to the 192 displaced structures required directly; using 20 or 10 configurations increases the acceleration to approximately 10- and 20-fold, with conductivity errors of 14.3% and 18.6%, respectively. MLLocP thus provides a scalable route to PAW electron-phonon calculations in complex materials while preserving the underlying all-electron formalism.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子-声子相互作用控制固体中的载流子动力学、输运以及许多光学和量子现象，但投影缀加波（PAW）框架下的有限位移计算对含 N 个原子的体系最多需要 6N 次自洽超胞计算。本文提出 MLLocP，在实空间网格上学习自洽局域势，并将其位移导数用于计算全电子 PAW 电子-声子矩阵元，同时保留现有 VASP/PHELEL 框架中的其他 PAW 量。该方法在 Cu、极性 BAs 和化学无序 Cu₃Au 中得到验证，可在保持全电子形式的同时显著减少自洽计算，并将输运系数的误差控制在约 3.5% 至 11% 的范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子-声子相互作用支配固体中的载流子动力学、输运以及许多光学和量子现象，但在投影缀加波（PAW）框架内进行有限位移计算时，对于含有 N 个原子的体系，最多需要进行 6N 次自洽超胞计算，因此对于大型、低对称性和无序材料而言成本高昂。我们提出 MLLocP，一种在实空间网格上学习自洽局域势的机器学习策略，并将该局域势的位移导数用于计算全电子 PAW 电子-声子矩阵元。对 PAW 分解的分析表明，局域势贡献是机器学习的自然目标，而其余 PAW 量则保留在已有的 VASP/PHELEL 框架中。通过针对性网格点采样和特征多样性选择实现高效模型训练后，我们在元素 Cu、极性 BAs 以及化学无序 Cu₃Au 中验证了 MLLocP。学习得到的势及其位移导数能够较好地复现实空间泛函理论的直接计算结果，并使输运系数分别达到约 3.5% 的 BAs 迁移率误差、8% 的 Cu 电导率误差和 11% 的 Cu₃Au 电导率误差。对于 32 原子的 Cu₃Au 特殊准随机结构，使用 40 个采样构型可将自洽计算次数相对于直接计算所需的 192 个位移结构减少约五倍；使用 20 个或 10 个构型时，加速倍数分别提高到约 10 倍和 20 倍，而电导率误差分别为 14.3% 和 18.6%。因此，MLLocP 为复杂材料中的 PAW 电子-声子计算提供了一条可扩展的路径，同时保留了底层全电子形式。
articles.focus_summary: 论文提出机器学习局域势方法，通过学习实空间网格上的自洽局域势及其位移导数，加速PAW框架下的电子-声子相互作用计算。该方法在铜、极性BAs和无序Cu3Au中得到验证，并能较好复现密度泛函理论结果和输运系数。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量、电子-声子耦合、载流子输运和无序材料模拟高度直接相关。其将机器学习用于局域电子势和电子-声子矩阵元计算的策略，对大超胞、低对称性及化学无序体系尤其具有借鉴价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步评估该方法在二维半导体、卤化物钙钛矿、缺陷半导体和界面体系中的精度，并结合非绝热分子动力学研究载流子弛豫与非辐射复合。还可探索等变神经网络或机器学习哈密顿量对势函数导数和电子结构的统一预测。

articles.title: Interaction effects on Andreev states from an electromagnetic environment
articles.title_zh: 电磁环境对安德烈夫态的相互作用效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Here we present a detailed theoretical investigation of the environment-induced interaction correction to the ground states and addition energies in a short superconducting junction. We derive general formulas for these corrections linking them to the frequency-dependent admittance of the junction and the environment impedance. We specify two environmental models: that of an external impedance and the Mattis-Bardeen model. In both cases we assume G_Q Z ll 1, where G_Q is the conductance quantum and Z the typical environmental resistance. While an expectation is that the typical scale of the relative correction is of the order G_Q Z, we have found that in many cases the dimensionless scale L G_Q Δ provides a better estimation, where Δ is the superconducting energy gap and L an external inductance. We discuss the logarithmic renormalizations of the energies by low- and high-frequency phase fluctuations and single out a non-superconducting contribution related to the renormalization of transmission eigenvalues. We investigate in detail the peculiarities of the corrections at: i. small phases, where the interaction causes a current jump, ii. Andreev bound state energies close to the gap edge, iii. Andreev bound state energies close to Fermi level. In all these cases the correction may become comparable with the unperturbed energy, even for G_Q Z ll 1, and we briefly sketch non-perturbative models relevant for the situations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了电磁环境对短超导结基态和加电子能量所产生的环境诱导相互作用修正，并推导出将这些修正与结的频率依赖导纳及环境阻抗联系起来的一般公式。研究了外部阻抗和Mattis-Bardeen两种环境模型，发现修正的典型尺度在许多情况下更适合由L G_Q Δ估计，而非通常预期的G_Q Z。作者还分析了低频和高频相位涨落引起的对数重整化，以及小相位、接近能隙边缘和接近费米能级时安德烈夫束缚态能量修正的特殊行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文对电磁环境对短超导结基态和加电子能量所产生的环境诱导相互作用修正进行了详细的理论研究。我们推导了这些修正的一般公式，并将其与结的频率依赖导纳和环境阻抗联系起来。我们具体研究了两种环境模型：外部阻抗模型和Mattis-Bardeen模型。在两种模型中，我们都假设G_Q Z远小于1，其中G_Q为电导量子，Z为典型环境电阻。虽然通常预期相对修正的典型尺度约为G_Q Z，但我们发现，在许多情况下，无量纲尺度L G_Q Δ能够提供更好的估计，其中Δ为超导能隙，L为外部电感。我们讨论了低频和高频相位涨落对能量产生的对数重整化，并特别指出了一种与透射本征值重整化有关的非超导贡献。我们详细研究了以下情况下修正的特殊性质：i. 小相位，此时相互作用会导致电流跳变；ii. 安德烈夫束缚态能量接近能隙边缘；iii. 安德烈夫束缚态能量接近费米能级。在所有这些情况下，即使G_Q Z远小于1，修正也可能与未扰动能量相当；我们还简要勾勒了与这些情形相关的非微扰模型。

articles.title: Non-Additivity of Microwave-Shielded Interactions between Dipolar Molecules
articles.title_zh: 微波屏蔽偶极分子相互作用的非加和性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01940v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Theoretical models of the effective interactions between microwave-shielded polar molecules typically rely on the assumption of pairwise additivity. In this work, we test the validity of this pairwise approximation by evaluating the exact many-body potential energy for configurations of three and four molecules. We demonstrate that this approximation fails for molecule configurations in the plane of the circularly polarized microwave field. In these planar geometries, many-body effects significantly increase the depth of the attractive potential well and shift the position of the repulsive barrier. Although out-of-plane interactions in three-dimensional arrangements weaken this non-additivity, the effective interactions between microwave-shielded dipoles are not a simple sum of pair interactions. In particular, their attractive well, crucial for self-bound clusters, can only be described by the full many-body potential energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 微波屏蔽极性分子之间的有效相互作用理论通常假设相互作用具有成对可加性。本文通过计算三个和四个分子构型的精确多体势能，检验了这一近似的有效性。结果表明，在圆偏振微波场平面内的分子构型中，成对近似失效，多体效应会显著加深吸引势阱并改变排斥势垒位置；因此，对于形成自束缚团簇至关重要的吸引势阱，必须采用完整的多体势能描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微波屏蔽极性分子之间有效相互作用的理论模型通常依赖于成对可加性的假设。在本工作中，我们通过计算三个和四个分子构型的精确多体势能，检验了这种成对近似的有效性。我们证明，当分子构型位于圆偏振微波场的平面内时，该近似会失效。在这些平面几何构型中，多体效应会显著加深吸引势阱，并使排斥势垒的位置发生偏移。尽管在三维排列中，平面外相互作用会削弱这种非加和性，但微波屏蔽偶极分子之间的有效相互作用并不是成对相互作用的简单求和。尤其是，对于自束缚团簇而言至关重要的吸引势阱，只有通过完整的多体势能才能加以描述。

articles.title: Observation of g-wave altermagnetic multipole
articles.title_zh: g波交替磁性多极矩的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over the past few years, altermagnets have emerged as a new class of collinear magnets with broken time-reversal symmetry, offering novel opportunities for spintronics beyond conventional magnets. Rather than from net magnetization, as in ferromagnets, the unconventional time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets originates from antiferroic magnetic dipoles locked to higher-order multipoles. Here we report the direct visualization of a g-wave altermagnetic multipole in the canonical altermagnet CrSb. Combining high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction with valence electron density (VED) analysis, we uncover a pronounced directional anisotropy of the VED distribution alternating between Cr sublattices. This evidences the antiferroic order of electric hexadecapoles predicted in g-wave altermagnets. Its coexistence with antiferroic magnetic dipoles induces ferroic magnetic multipoles, as probed by polarized neutron diffraction. We further identify a microscopic model of altermagnetism that directly relates the g-wave multipole and the g-wave spin splitting. Through direct observation and quantification of multipoles, this study provides a real-space fingerprint of altermagnetism and establishes a general probe of hidden multipole order in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 交替磁体是近年来出现的一类具有破缺时间反演对称性的共线磁体，其时间反演对称性破缺源于与高阶多极矩锁定的反铁磁型磁偶极矩，而非铁磁体中的净磁化。本文结合高能同步辐射X射线衍射和价电子密度分析，在典型交替磁体CrSb中直接观测到g波交替磁性多极矩。研究发现，Cr子晶格之间交替出现显著的价电子密度方向各向异性，并通过偏振中子衍射探测到与之共存的铁磁型磁多极矩，从而为交替磁性及隐藏多极有序提供了实空间证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在过去几年中，交替磁体作为一类具有破缺时间反演对称性的共线磁体逐渐受到关注，为超越传统磁体的自旋电子学提供了新的机会。与铁磁体中的净磁化不同，交替磁体中非常规的时间反演对称性破缺源于锁定于高阶多极矩的反铁磁型磁偶极矩。本文报告了在典型交替磁体CrSb中对g波交替磁性多极矩的直接可视化观测。通过结合高能同步辐射X射线衍射与价电子密度（VED）分析，我们揭示了价电子密度分布的显著方向各向异性，并且这种各向异性在不同Cr子晶格之间交替出现。这一结果证明了g波交替磁体中所预测的电十六极矩反铁磁型有序。该有序与反铁磁型磁偶极矩共存，并诱导出铁磁型磁多极矩，这一点通过偏振中子衍射得到了探测。我们进一步确定了交替磁性的微观模型，该模型直接联系了g波多极矩与g波自旋劈裂。通过直接观测和量化多极矩，本研究提供了交替磁性的实空间指纹，并建立了一种探测量子材料中隐藏多极有序的通用方法。

articles.title: Machine-learning screening and first-principles lattice dynamics resolve the most stable structure of NaCa(BH₄)₃ from a data-driven candidate search
articles.title_zh: 机器学习筛选与第一性原理晶格动力学从数据驱动候选搜索中确定NaCa(BH4)3的最稳定结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equimolar NaCa(BH₄)₃ offers a theoretical hydrogen capacity of 11.24 wt.% and a decomposition enthalpy expected to fall between those of NaBH₄ and Ca(BH₄)₂, but it has never been prepared and no crystal structure has been reported. Predictions for it have so far been built within the perovskite family that its heavier homologues adopt. Here that assumption is removed. Six candidate frameworks were assembled from three independent sources --- experimentally determined ABX₃ borohydrides, a distorted perovskite from data-driven structure prediction, and an unbiased search over a structural database in which all 2238 generated candidates were relaxed with none excluded --- and at fixed charge-neutral composition the cation arrangement of every framework was enumerated exhaustively, 420 decorations reducing to 118 symmetry-inequivalent configurations, screened with a machine-learning potential and settled from first principles. The most stable structure is not a perovskite. It is a monoclinic framework of space group Cm, reached only by the unrestricted search, at -4.185640 eV/atom, 7.67 meV/atom below the best framework available beforehand; two chemically unrelated donor prototypes converge on it to 0.076 meV/atom, and its ordered cation arrangement is the ground state of its own series. Its phonon spectrum carries no imaginary mode at any wavevector the supercell resolves exactly and its relaxed-ion elastic tensor is positive definite, whereas the orthorhombic perovskite candidate is unstable to -2.401 THz. That contrast supplies a physical reason for the reported failure to obtain this composition in perovskite form, and the simulated diffraction pattern reported here identifies the predicted framework by seven reflections that neither parent phase nor the competing framework produces.
articles.abstract_zh: NaCa(BH4)3具有11.24 wt.%的理论储氢容量，但此前从未制备成功，也没有报道其晶体结构。本文从多个来源构建候选结构，对所有电荷中性的阳离子排列进行穷举，并结合机器学习势与第一性原理计算进行筛选和确认。结果表明，最稳定结构不是钙钛矿，而是仅由无约束搜索发现的单斜Cm框架；其声子谱和弹性张量均显示稳定性，而正交钙钛矿候选结构存在虚频，这为该组成难以形成钙钛矿结构提供了物理解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 等摩尔比NaCa(BH4)3的理论储氢容量为11.24 wt.%，其分解焓预计介于NaBH4和Ca(BH4)2之间，但该化合物从未被制备出来，也没有报道其晶体结构。此前对它的预测一直建立在钙钛矿家族结构之上，因为其较重的同系物采用了这类结构。本文取消了这一假设。研究从三个相互独立的来源构建了六种候选框架：实验确定的ABX3硼氢化物、数据驱动结构预测得到的畸变钙钛矿，以及对结构数据库进行无偏搜索得到的结构；在后者中，生成的全部2238个候选结构均进行了弛豫，没有排除任何候选。在固定电荷中性的组成下，对每个框架的阳离子排列进行了穷举，共得到420种排列，并进一步归并为118种对称性不等价构型；这些构型先由机器学习势进行筛选，最终通过第一性原理计算确定。最稳定的结构不是钙钛矿，而是空间群为Cm的单斜框架；它仅通过无约束搜索被发现，其能量为−4.185640 eV/atom，比此前可获得的最佳框架低7.67 meV/atom。两个化学上无关的供体原型最终都收敛到该结构，能量差仅为0.076 meV/atom，并且其有序阳离子排列是该结构系列自身的基态。其声子谱在超胞能够精确解析的所有波矢处均不含虚频，弛豫离子弹性张量为正定；相比之下，正交钙钛矿候选结构不稳定，存在−2.401 THz的虚频。这一对比为该组成以钙钛矿形式制备失败的报道提供了物理原因。本文还给出了模拟衍射图谱，其中的七条衍射峰能够识别所预测的框架，而母相和竞争框架均不会产生这些衍射峰。

articles.title: EuIn2Sb2: epitaxially stabilized axion insulator candidate with strong spin-orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: EuIn2Sb2：外延稳定的强自旋轨道耦合轴子绝缘体候选材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02114v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Eu triangular lattice layer compounds described by the general formula EuA2X2 have attracted growing attention due to a wide range of layered crystal structures and corresponding magnetic topological phases, arising from the coexistence of large Eu magnetic moments and energetically inverted A and X bands. Among the EuA2X2 family, EuIn2Sb2 has been predicted to host robust axion insulator and higher-order topological insulator states by stronger spin-orbit coupling but has not been experimentally realized, including the structural identification. Here we report the epitaxial stabilization of EuIn2Sb2 by adopting the molecular beam epitaxy technique. Structural characterization reveals that EuIn2Sb2 films are based on a unique In-on-In stacking, forming a new trilayer structure distinct from previously predicted structures in the EuA2X2 family. In addition to the in-plane antiferromagnetic ordering at TN=10.5K, the stronger spin-orbit coupling and enhanced In-In hybridization in EuIn2Sb2 make it an ideal candidate of axion insulator and higher-order topological insulator phases. These results establish EuIn2Sb2 as a new member of the EuA2X2 family and offer an advanced platform for exploring these magnetic topological phases.
articles.abstract_zh: EuA2X2类三角晶格层状化合物因其多样的层状晶体结构和磁性拓扑相而受到关注，这些性质源于较大的Eu磁矩以及A、X能带的能量反转。本文利用分子束外延技术实现了EuIn2Sb2的外延稳定，并发现其具有不同于此前预测结构的独特In-on-In堆垛三层结构。该材料在TN=10.5 K时呈现面内反铁磁有序，较强的自旋轨道耦合和增强的In-In杂化使其成为轴子绝缘体和高阶拓扑绝缘体相的理想候选平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由通式EuA2X2表示的Eu三角晶格层状化合物因其广泛的层状晶体结构及相应的磁性拓扑相而日益受到关注，这些性质源于较大的Eu磁矩与A、X能带在能量上的反转。在EuA2X2家族中，理论预测EuIn2Sb2由于具有更强的自旋轨道耦合，能够承载稳健的轴子绝缘体态和高阶拓扑绝缘体态，但此前尚未在实验上实现，也未完成其结构鉴定。本文报道了采用分子束外延技术实现EuIn2Sb2的外延稳定。结构表征显示，EuIn2Sb2薄膜具有独特的In-on-In堆垛，形成了一种不同于此前EuA2X2家族预测结构的新型三层结构。除在TN=10.5 K时出现面内反铁磁有序外，EuIn2Sb2中更强的自旋轨道耦合和增强的In-In杂化还使其成为轴子绝缘体相和高阶拓扑绝缘体相的理想候选材料。这些结果确立了EuIn2Sb2作为EuA2X2家族的新成员，并为探索这些磁性拓扑相提供了先进平台。

articles.title: The Locality Cost of Fully Flat Hopf Insulators
articles.title_zh: 完全平坦霍普夫绝缘体的局域性代价
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hopf topology permits a strictly finite-range Hamiltonian with one exactly flat topological band. We prove, however, that extending flatness to the complete two-band spectrum necessarily sacrifices strict locality or the gap: any gapped, Hermitian, translationally invariant two-band Hamiltonian with strictly finite-range hopping and two exactly flat bands has vanishing Hopf invariant. Equivalently, within this two-band setting, a Hopf band admits no compactly supported, translation-covariant, orthonormal Wannier generator. For factorized one-flat-band Hopf parents, the unavoidable partner dispersion equals the Gram symbol of translated compact localized states and encodes their nonorthogonality. Full flattening converts this dispersion into exponentially decaying but infinitely supported hopping. Model-independent bounds provide a sufficient criterion for finite-range approximants to retain the Hopf phase. An explicit model yields the axial decay length ξ_z/a=1/ln 2, parameter-free hopping tails, and residual bandwidths testable in circuit and photonic lattices. Hopf topology therefore does not prohibit a flat band but forces the locality--flatness cost to appear as either partner-band dispersion or nonlocal hopping.
articles.abstract_zh: 霍普夫拓扑允许存在具有严格有限程哈密顿量和一个完全平坦拓扑能带的系统，但将平坦性扩展到完整的双能带谱必然牺牲严格局域性或能隙。本文证明，任何具有严格有限程跃迁、平移不变性、厄米性和能隙的双能带哈密顿量，只要两条能带都完全平坦，其霍普夫不变量就必为零。对于因子化的单平坦带霍普夫母模型，不可避免的伴随能带色散体现了紧致局域态的非正交性；完全平坦化则会转化为指数衰减但具有无限支撑的跃迁。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 霍普夫拓扑允许严格有限程哈密顿量具有一条完全平坦的拓扑能带。然而，我们证明，将平坦性扩展到完整的双能带谱，必然要牺牲严格局域性或能隙：任何具有严格有限程跃迁、能隙、厄米性和平移不变性的双能带哈密顿量，只要具有两条完全平坦的能带，其霍普夫不变量就必为零。等价地，在这一双能带体系中，霍普夫能带不可能拥有紧支撑、平移协变且正交归一的Wannier生成元。对于因子化的单平坦带霍普夫母模型，不可避免的伴随能带色散等于平移后的紧致局域态的Gram符号，并编码了这些态之间的非正交性。完全平坦化会将这种色散转化为指数衰减但具有无限支撑的跃迁。与模型无关的界给出了一个充分条件，用于判断有限程近似是否能够保持霍普夫相。一个显式模型给出了轴向衰减长度ξ_z/a=1/ln 2、无参数的跃迁尾部以及可在电路和光子晶格中检验的剩余带宽。因此，霍普夫拓扑并不禁止平坦能带存在，但会迫使局域性与平坦性之间的代价以伴随能带色散或非局域跃迁的形式出现。

articles.title: Linker Functionalization and pH Tuning Enhance Solar-Driven Catalytic CO₂ Reduction in MOF-5
articles.title_zh: 连接体功能化与pH调控增强MOF-5中的太阳能驱动催化二氧化碳还原
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The wide band gap of metal-organic framework (MOF) 5 constrains its use in photocatalytic carbon dioxide (CO₂) reduction despite its high porosity and favorable mass-transport properties. Adopting a state-of-the-art first-principles approach, we systematically investigate the effects of volumetric strain, metal-node substitution, linker functionalization, and pH control as knobs to improve the CO₂ photocatalytic ability of MOF-5. Strain and metal-node substitution negligibly affect the gap, whereas linker functionalization narrows it into the visible range via in-gap states while preserving reduction-side alignment at pH = 0. The resulting reduction energetics are strongly sensitive to both linker functionalization and pH. Halogenated and hydroxylated frameworks provide access primarily to HCOOH, CO, and HCHO under alkaline conditions, principally with the Mg and Zn nodes, whereas COOH functionalization offers the broadest thermodynamic accessibility across the full CO₂ reduction sequence. NH₂ retains thermodynamic feasibility for all target reduction pathways but with larger overpotentials, while NO₂ generally yields unfavorable reduction energetics. Crucially, within the COOH series, the choice of the metal node tunes the fundamental gap by over 1 eV with only minor changes in the reduction overpotentials, placing Sr- and Ba-based architectures as the most favorable ones for broad product selectivity with visible-light excitation. Linker functionalization substantially reduces the spatial overlap of the frontier states, promoting photoinduced charge separation. Taken together, these results establish linker functionalization and solution pH as complementary design levers for independently tuning light absorption and CO₂-reduction energetics in MOF-5, establishing a rational and viable route for designing efficient MOF-based photocatalysts.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属有机框架MOF-5具有较宽的带隙，限制了其在光催化二氧化碳还原中的应用，尽管其孔隙率高且有利于传质。本文采用先进的第一性原理方法，系统研究体积应变、金属节点替换、连接体功能化和pH调控对MOF-5光催化能力的影响。结果表明，连接体功能化可通过引入带隙内态将带隙缩小至可见光范围，同时保持还原侧能带对齐；在COOH功能化体系中，金属节点可使带隙调节超过1 eV，而对还原过电位影响很小，Sr和Ba结构因此最有利于可见光驱动下的广泛产物选择性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属有机框架（MOF）5具有较宽的带隙，这限制了其在光催化二氧化碳（CO2）还原中的应用，尽管它具有较高的孔隙率和有利于传质的性质。本文采用先进的第一性原理方法，系统研究了体积应变、金属节点替换、连接体功能化和pH调控等因素作为改善MOF-5光催化能力的调控手段。应变和金属节点替换对带隙的影响可以忽略不计，而连接体功能化能够通过引入带隙内态将带隙缩小到可见光范围，同时在pH=0时保持还原侧能带对齐。由此产生的还原热力学对连接体功能化和pH均高度敏感。在碱性条件下，卤代和羟基化框架主要能够生成甲酸（HCOOH）、一氧化碳（CO）和甲醛（HCHO），其中以Mg和Zn为节点的框架尤为突出；而COOH功能化在整个CO2还原序列中提供了最广泛的热力学可达性。NH2功能化对所有目标还原路径都保持热力学可行性，但需要更大的过电位；NO2功能化通常会导致不利的还原热力学。尤其是在COOH系列中，金属节点的选择能够在还原过电位仅发生轻微变化的情况下，使基本带隙调节超过1 eV，因此，以Sr和Ba为基础的结构在可见光激发下最有利于实现广泛的产物选择性。连接体功能化会显著降低前沿态的空间重叠，从而促进光生电荷分离。总体而言，这些结果表明，连接体功能化和溶液pH是两种互补的设计手段，可以分别调控MOF-5的光吸收和CO2还原热力学，并为设计高效的MOF基光催化剂建立了一条合理且可行的路径。

articles.title: Anomalous Superfluid Response in Altermagnetic Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 交替磁超导体中的异常超流响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on the emergence of the anomalous (paramagnetic) superfluid response in altermagnetic superconductors at arbitrary impurity concentrations. Due to anisotropic gapless superconductivity, altermagnetic superconductors with an out-of-plane Zeeman field display an anisotropic paramagnetic Meissner effect. The effect is strongest for parallel altermagnetic and Zeeman exchange field vectors and in the clean sample. The presence of nonmagnetic impurities leads to isotropisation and, consequently, weakens the effect; however, the paramagnetic response sustains intermediate amounts of impurities in the system. As demonstrated in recent experiments, microwave superfluid stiffness measurements can serve as a sensitive probe of gapless superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了交替磁超导体中异常的顺磁性超流响应，并指出该效应在任意杂质浓度下都可出现。研究表明，取向关系与杂质无序会影响该响应强度，微波超流刚度测量可作为探测无能隙超导的重要手段。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报道了交替磁超导体在任意杂质浓度下出现异常的（顺磁性）超流响应。由于各向异性的无能隙超导，具有面外塞曼场的交替磁超导体表现出各向异性的顺磁性迈斯纳效应。该效应在交替磁交换场矢量与塞曼交换场矢量平行且样品处于洁净极限时最强。非磁性杂质的存在会导致各向同性化，从而削弱该效应；不过，在体系中等量杂质存在时，顺磁响应仍可维持。正如近期实验所示，微波超流刚度测量可以作为探测无能隙超导的灵敏手段。

articles.title: Vitrification-Devitrification Enables Tunable Photonic and Gas Sorption Properties of Zeolitic Imidazolate Frameworks
articles.title_zh: 淬玻璃化-脱玻璃化使沸石咪唑骨架具有可调光子与气体吸附性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Zeolitic imidazolate framework (ZIF) glasses represent an emerging family of melt-quenched glasses, which exhibit immense potential for applications in gas separation, energy storage, and optics. However, their intrinsic porosity remains elusive due to the inherent challenges in resolving their disordered atomistic structures. Here, we systematically investigate the porosity of ZIF-4 and ZIF-62 crystals and their corresponding glasses. CO2 sorption at 195 K enables quantitative assessment of microporosity in both crystalline and glassy states, allowing the accessible micropore volume of the ZIF glasses to be determined. Moreover, establishing a direct relationship between photonic properties and structural porosity in Zn-based ZIF glasses remains challenging. Here we demonstrate striking broadband blue-light emission from ZIF-4 glass annealed under optimized conditions. A pronounced red shift is observed when increasing the annealing temperature above the glass transition temperature. By correlating the evolution of photoluminescence with structural porosity, we reveal the interplay between the photonic and gas sorption properties of ZIF glasses. These findings provide new insights into the structure-property relationships of ZIF glasses and offer a pathway toward the rational design of multifunctional MOF glasses.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了 ZIF-4 和 ZIF-62 晶体及其对应玻璃的孔隙性，并揭示了热退火条件对光致发光和气体吸附性质的影响。结果表明，通过调控淬玻璃与脱玻璃过程，可实现沸石咪唑骨架玻璃的光学和吸附性能调节。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 沸石咪唑骨架（ZIF）玻璃是一个新兴的熔融淬冷玻璃家族，在气体分离、储能和光学方面展现出巨大应用潜力。然而，由于其无序原子结构难以解析，其本征孔隙性一直不清楚。本文系统研究了 ZIF-4 和 ZIF-62 晶体及其对应玻璃的孔隙性。195 K 下的 CO2 吸附可对晶态和玻璃态中的微孔性进行定量评估，从而确定 ZIF 玻璃的可达微孔体积。此外，要建立 Zn 基 ZIF 玻璃的光学性质与结构孔隙性之间的直接关系仍具挑战。本文展示了在优化条件下退火后的 ZIF-4 玻璃所发出的显著宽带蓝光发射。当退火温度升高到玻璃转变温度以上时，观察到明显的红移。通过将光致发光演化与结构孔隙性相关联，作者揭示了 ZIF 玻璃中光子性质与气体吸附性质之间的相互作用。这些发现为理解 ZIF 玻璃的结构—性能关系提供了新认识，并为多功能 MOF 玻璃的理性设计提供了途径。

articles.title: Ferroelastic domain switching by ultrafast photoinduced strain
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The crystal lattice underpins the fundamental properties of condensed matter, with ferroic order emerging sensitively from atomic coordination. Manipulating the lattic therefore promises a direct way to switch ferroics between their states. Infrared excitation provides an efficient pathway to drive lattice motion and generate transient crystal deformations and strains. Ferroelastics constitute a uniquely direct platform for such control, their order parameter being strain itself. However, whether ultrafast laser-induced lattice distortions can switch ferroelastic order remains unknown. Here we use ultrafast pump-probe microscopy to demonstrate that a single high-amplitude infrared pulse induces strain within the first nanosecond, followed by ferroelastic domain switching several nanoseconds later. The spatial distribution follows that expected from the photoinduced strain field, while their temporal evolution is closely coupled to the strain dynamics. Our observations identify transient strain as the driving field for ferroelastic switching and suggest a general lattice-mediated pathway for controlling ferroic order using infrared light.

articles.title: In silico design of magnonic lasing in constricted waveguides
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Analogue black-hole systems have been proposed in various physical platforms, including magnetic materials, offering rich physics and promising applications such as wave lasing. However, their practical realization and characterization remain largely unexplored. Here, we present an in silico study of magnonic black-hole phenomena in constricted ferromagnetic waveguides driven by spin-polarized currents. Using micromagnetic simulations with a two-dimensional Poisson solver to obtain realistic current-density profiles, we demonstrate the formation of a double-hole cavity bounded by analogue event horizons, enabling resonant spin-wave amplification. We characterize the resonances as a function of magnetic and geometric parameters and identify the corresponding spin-wave modes. We further show that gradual tapers enhance transmission by suppressing spin-wave reflections, while interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction can mimic the current-induced Doppler shift, substantially reducing the critical current density required for applications and, consequently, Joule heating. Finally, we demonstrate a spin-wave laser in which thermally excited spin waves undergo selective amplification and coherent emission at well-defined resonance frequencies. These results provide design principles for magnonic analogues of gravitational systems and point toward their potential for advanced spintronic applications.

articles.title: Room-temperature local strain control of moiré excitons in MoS₂/WSe₂ heterobilayers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré superlattices in heterobilayers of atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a versatile platform for exploring quantum many-body physics as they can trap excitons, leading to the formation of quantized moiré exciton states. However, such moiré excitons have been predominantly studied at cryogenic temperatures, which severely limits their practical applications. Here, we demonstrate room-temperature activation and control of moiré excitons in MoS₂/WSe₂ heterobilayers using local strain engineering. Applying mechanical strain with a modified atomic force microscopy tip, we observe a series of resonances attributed to interlayer exciton states confined in the moiré potential. Power-dependent photoluminescence measurements elucidate the population dynamics of the moiré exciton states, while controlled local strain enables continuous tuning of their emission wavelength to the center of the second telecom window. We provide a theoretical model that captures all experimentally observed features, including the unconventional spectral shape of the moiré exciton emission. Our findings establish local tip-induced strain as a powerful tool for the on-demand manipulation of moiré excitons, paving the way for room-temperature quantum excitonic devices.

articles.title: Collective Cell Fluidity Controls Active Prestress Transmission in Cell-Extracellular-Matrix Tissues
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02360v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tissues are active composites in which multicellular collectives and extracellular matrices mechanically reorganize one another. We develop a three-dimensional micromechanical model that couples deformable, rearranging cell clusters to a disordered network of semiflexible fibers through a dynamic, force-generating interface. Cell clusters are represented as solid-like or fluid-like vertex-model spheroids and coupled to the matrix by passive or contractile linkers renewed as the cluster boundary reorganizes. Matched intact, voided, and passive-linker controls separate cavity formation, interfacial tethering, and active loading. At small strain, passive tethering provides modest reinforcement, whereas active contraction prestresses and strongly stiffens the matrix. Solid-like clusters preserve coherent force transmission and exhibit an excess modulus scaling approximately as |σ|¹.⁴ across changes in activity, cluster size, and cluster number. Fluid-like clusters undergo greater interfacial renewal, producing weaker and nonmonotonic coupling between prestress and stiffness. Increasing cluster number produces collective stiffening when prestressed regions become connected through sufficiently persistent interfaces. At large strain, both solid-like and fluid-like systems approach the corresponding voided-network response as the residual fiber backbone becomes mechanically dominant. Thus, cell-generated prestress controls macroscopic stiffness only together with the organization and persistence of its transmission across the cell-matrix interface.

articles.title: Magneto-Structural Coupling Enables Cryogenic Cation Redistribution in a Spinel Oxide
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ionic transport in oxides is generally frozen at cryogenic temperatures, where thermal energy lies far below typical cation-migration barriers. Neutron powder diffraction reveals progressive Fe/Mg redistribution between tetrahedral (A) and octahedral (B) sites in the spinel Mg0.5Fe0.5TiFeO4 upon cooling from 200 K to 5 K. A-site Fe occupancy increases toward near completion at 5 K within Rietveld resolution, while Ti remains on the B site. This exchange coincides with complex magnetic correlations rather than a classical thermally activated window. Low-temperature magnetostrictive volume changes indicate strong spin-lattice coupling, but do not identify magnetostriction as the sole thermodynamic driver. Room-temperature high-pressure X-ray diffraction produces the opposite occupancy trend, showing that volume contraction alone cannot explain the cryogenic site exchange. These results point to magneto-structural free-energy minimization as a plausible mechanism for unlocking cryogenic cation mobility in a correlated spinel oxide.

articles.title: Molecular-dynamics-based modal analysis of heat transport in quasi-one-dimensional systems from a symmetry-adapted perspective
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02397v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detailed analysis of thermal conductivity results obtained from molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories conventionally relies on knowledge of the harmonic vibrational modes of the system. Such is the case in methods like Green--Kubo modal analysis (GKMA) and homogeneous nonequilibrium modal analysis (HNEMA). This approach faces several shortcomings that become especially important when dealing with nanostructures. Chief among them is scalability, followed by the ambiguity associated to the degeneracy of the large vibrational subspaces defined by a common translational wave number k. We propose an alternative for quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) systems: we construct the modal basis for the decomposition of the thermal conductivity from line-group projection operators, so that every projected component carries well-defined symmetry labels (including rotational information and parities) and the decomposition is unique at the level of irreducible representations (irreps). Applying the idea to a (10,0)-(20,0) WS2-MoS2 double-walled nanotube (DWNT) described by a neuroevolution potential (NEP), we find that at 300 K both HNEMA and GKMA yield statistically consistent total conductivities and allow the identification of several prominent symmetry-adapted conduction channels. The GKMA pair matrix shows that within-block and same-channel cross-k terms account for 75.6% of the total conductivity, while cross-channel correlations contribute 24.4%.

articles.title: Rank-Selective Optical Tomography of Higher-Wave Altermagnetism
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02429v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying the spatial rank of higher-wave altermagnetic order optically is challenging because local electric-dipole response does not uniquely resolve distinct continuum harmonics. We show that finite photon momentum turns one-photon spin-resolved absorption into a rank-selective tomography. For the planar |m|=ell sector of an even-parity ell-wave component, a joint Fourier projection in polarization and momentum angle isolates mathcal T_ellproptoη_ell qell⁻², yielding the hierarchy d:q⁰, g:q², and i:q⁴; phase changes track rotations of the selected magnetic harmonic. A Ward-consistent finite-q microscopic calculation reproduces these powers without imposing them. Although discrete crystal symmetry can generate lower-order local aliases, they are orthogonal to the selected momentum harmonic and cannot contaminate it below qell⁻². In MnTe, whose nonrelativistic parent order is three-dimensional g wave while spin--orbit coupling lowers the exact relativistic spin-momentum-locking symmetry, first-principles calculations show that more than 99.9% of the Fourier power of the Néel-projected A-region spin-energy contrast remains in the parent g-wave-derived m=3 harmonic. Structured near fields place the required momentum window within experimental reach.
articles.focus_summary: 本文提出利用有限光子动量和自旋分辨吸收实现高阶交替磁序的空间秩选择性光学层析，并推导了不同磁性谐波对应的动量幂次关系。以MnTe为例，第一性原理计算表明其自旋能量对比信号主要集中于预期的高阶磁性谐波分量。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的交替磁性、磁性拓扑性质、自旋轨道耦合、光学响应、第一性原理计算和对称性分析方向直接相关。该工作可为识别高阶交替磁序、建立磁性结构与光学信号之间的联系提供新的理论和计算思路。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步研究不同晶体对称性、应变和自旋轨道耦合对高阶交替磁光学响应的影响。可结合Wannier模型、非线性光学计算和实验可观测量分析，筛选具有强秩选择性信号的交替磁材料。

articles.title: Thermodynamic Electric Toroidal Dipole and Intrinsic Longitudinal Spin Transport
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02443v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric toroidal dipoles (ETDs) characterize ferroaxial order, yet their bulk definition in periodic crystals has remained elusive because conventional multipole operators involve the ill-defined position operator. Here we formulate a thermodynamic ETD by coupling a spatially varying electric field to the relativistic spin-induced electric polarization. The resulting expression is gauge invariant and provides a bulk order parameter for ferroaxial phases. We further establish a direct relation between the chemical-potential derivative of the ETD and the intrinsic longitudinal spin conductivity in insulating systems. To demonstrate the formulation, we construct a minimal ferroaxial extension of the Kane--Mele model. The ETD becomes finite exclusively in the ferroaxial phase and is strongly enhanced near a small band gap, accompanied by a sizable longitudinal spin current. Our results establish a thermodynamic theory of ETDs in crystalline solids and identify the longitudinal spin conductivity as a direct transport manifestation of ferroaxial order.

articles.title: Spin wave freezing in Re/Co/Pt multilayers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The phenomenon of spin wave (SW) freezing occurs in the Damon-Eshbach mode in thin film magnetic systems, when SW phase and group velocities both go to zero, and the wave ceases to oscillate and move, preserving its shape as a domain structure pattern. This effect is related to the spin reorientation transition, where the magnetization configuration changes between the homogeneous in-plane state and domain structure with the out-of-plane magnetization component state. Here, we study the SW freezing effect in [Re/Co/Pt]₂₀ magnetic multilayers, induced by varying the in-plane external magnetic field. The studies were performed on nanostructures with the quality factor Q (ratio of uniaxial anisotropy to demagnetization energies) greater and smaller than one. Domain structures with an out-of-plane magnetization component were observed in these multilayers. The critical field, visible as the saturation field Hₛ|| in the parallel static magnetization curve measured by superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID), is also manifested in the field-dependent vector-network-analyzer ferromagnetic resonance (VNA-FMR) experiment, which measures the homogeneous magnetization oscillations. Brillouin Light Scattering (BLS) spectra, recorded for several values of wave vectors and several field values, probed the field-evolution of the dispersion relation. Micromagnetic simulations allow one to obtain a full dispersion, in good agreement with VNA-FMR and BLS results. Around Hₛ|| the simulated dispersion relations approach the conditions for SW freezing. Below Hₛ|| low and high frequency VNA-FMR modes are related to magnetization oscillations inside domain walls and within domains, respectively. The experimental results of static and dynamic behavior, together with micromagnetic simulations, create an overall consistent picture of the investigated multilayers.

articles.title: Disorder-driven competing magnetic interactions and glassy magnetic behavior in quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this combined experimental and theoretical study, we investigate the role of disorder in governing the magnetic ground state of the quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe. In the FeRuMnZ (Z = Ga, Si) series, chemical substitution modifies atomic ordering and electronic structure, resulting in distinct magnetic ground states. Motivated by this, we extend the series to FeRuMnGe. X-ray diffraction reveals B2-type antisite disorder, where Fe--Ru and Mn--Ge intermix. Theoretical calculations show that such disorder modifies exchange interactions, leading to competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic couplings, and drives the system from half-metallic to metallic. Magnetic measurements reveal competing interactions, giving rise to a cluster-glass state coexisting with long-range magnetic order. The absence of a thermodynamic signature at T_f, together with ac susceptibility and relaxation measurements, supports the presence of short-range magnetic interactions and a glassy magnetic state. The compound exhibits an enhanced magnetic response below sim 161 K and a maximum magnetization of sim 1.64~μ_B/f.u. at 5 T. Overall, this work establishes a direct correlation between antisite disorder, competing exchange interactions, and glassy magnetism in quaternary Heusler alloys. Combined experimental results and theoretical calculations reveal that disorder drives the system from an AFM-dominated state in FeRuMnSi to an FM-dominated state in FeRuMnGe, providing deeper insight into the role of the extent of disorder in governing the magnetic properties of QHAs.

articles.title: A Wannier-first approach for extended chiral systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02524v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a real-space formulation of DFT for extended systems in which localized Wannier-like functions are constructed directly from localized Gaussian basis functions without explicitly computing canonical Bloch-like states during the self-consistent cycle. Building on the formalism of Pederson and Lin [Phys. Rev. B 35, 2273 (1987)], a variational set of Wannier-like functions is generated self-consistently within a finite Wannier domain and used to construct the charge density, electrostatic potential, and per cell total energy of the extended system. The occupied space can be determined entirely from the Wannier-like functions. Electronic band structures can be recovered in a post-processing step by solving the full Hamiltonian in a Bloch-like basis constructed from Gaussian orbitals. A key feature of the method is that it can incorporate combined translation--rotation, or screw, symmetries, enabling efficient simulations of chiral and helical systems with finite twist angles at essentially the same computational cost as systems described by pure translational symmetry. The approach is validated through calculations on linear and twisted mathrm-CequivC- and mathrm-Li-F- chains, as well as graphene, where total energies and band structures show excellent agreement with reference periodic calculations. To illustrate the ability of the method to treat three-dimensional systems, it is further applied to AA graphite, in which carbon atoms in adjacent graphene layers are aligned directly above one another, as well as helically stacked AA graphite structures. The Wannier-first framework provides a practical route for treating extended systems with nontrivial translational, rotational, and screw symmetries, and provides a natural foundation for the implementation of orbital-dependent functionals such as the Perdew--Zunger self-interaction correction.

articles.title: Magnetic-Field-Calibration-Free Determination of the Hyperfine Constant A in Ultracold Fermi gases of ⁴⁰K
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02572v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hyperfine constant A is a key parameter of the hyperfine structure and underpins precision spectroscopy and metrology. In this Letter, we develop a magnetic-field-calibration-free method for determining the ground-state hyperfine constant A in an ultracold ⁴⁰K Fermi gas by utilizing a pair of magnetically insensitive ("clock") transitions. This overcomes the stringent magnetic-field calibration requirements of conventional methods. We measure the transition frequency between these two magnetically insensitive transitions with Hz-level resolution over a range of magnetic fields, and obtain the ground-state hyperfine constant A = -h× 285.730536(2),MHz, corresponding to an absolute uncertainty of about 2,Hz. Our value reduces the uncertainty by nearly three orders of magnitude compared with previous determinations, providing a substantially improved reference for high-precision spectroscopy and metrology with ⁴⁰K.

articles.title: Multivariate hyperdensity functional theory for inhomogeneous equilibrium fluids: From first principles to simulation-based machine learning
articles.title_zh: 用于非均匀平衡流体的多变量超密度泛函理论：从第一性原理到基于模拟的机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02594v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hyperdensity functional theory facilitates the investigation of the equilibrium behavior of a general order parameter or statistical mechanical observable in spatially inhomogeneous classical many-body systems. The approach is based on applying the exact Mermin-Evans classical density functional mapping to an extended ensemble. Here we present the multivariate generalization for investigating simultaneously the properties and interrelations of several different hyperobservables of choice. The resulting framework gives rise to a systematic characterization and prediction scheme for general many-body phenomena. All pertinent equilibrium averages, variances, and covariances constitute universal density functionals, as we demonstrate explicitly. Associated one-body hyperfluctuation profiles quantify the degree of correlation of the local density with first- and second-order combinations of hyperobservables. These multivariate hyperfluctuation profiles are accessible in many-body simulations and they satisfy exact hyper-Ornstein-Zernike equations, which we derive from the minimization principle in the extended multivariate ensemble. The formal structure of the theory integrates naturally with supervised machine learning, which renders all hyperdensity functionals accessible in practice via training of neural networks on simulation data. We demonstrate all salient techniques using the illustrative case of clustering in confined hard rod fluids, thereby choosing the total number of particles and the largest cluster size as the representative hyperobservables of interest. Our numerical methodology enables the efficient and successful prediction of all statistical quantities induced by the chosen hyperobservables, which we verify via comparison to test data and which we attribute to the tight interplay of first-principles and machine-learning concepts that our general approach combines.
articles.abstract_zh: 超密度泛函理论为研究空间非均匀经典多体系统中一般序参量或统计力学可观测量的平衡行为提供了框架。本文将该理论推广到多变量情形，可同时研究多个超可观测量及其相互关系，并给出其平均值、方差与协方差作为普适密度泛函的系统表征。作者还推导了相应的超 Ornstein-Zernike 方程，并展示了该框架如何与监督式机器学习自然结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超密度泛函理论为研究空间非均匀经典多体系统中一般序参量或统计力学可观测量的平衡行为提供了便利。该方法基于将精确的 Mermin-Evans 经典密度泛函映射应用于扩展系综。这里我们给出其多变量推广，用于同时考察若干不同超可观测量的性质及其相互关系。由此得到的框架为一般多体现象的系统表征与预测提供了途径。正如我们明确展示的那样，所有相关的平衡平均值、方差和协方差都构成普适的密度泛函。与之对应的一体超涨落剖面量化了局域密度与超可观测量的一阶和二阶组合之间的相关程度。这些多变量超涨落剖面可由多体模拟获得，并满足精确的超 Ornstein-Zernike 方程；我们从扩展多变量系综中的极小化原理推导出了这些方程。该理论的形式结构与监督式机器学习自然契合，这使得所有超密度泛函在实践中都可通过对模拟数据训练神经网络来获得。我们以受限硬棒流体中的聚类这一示例系统展示了所有关键技术，并将粒子总数与最大团簇尺寸选作所关注的代表性超可观测量。我们的数值方法能够高效且成功地预测由所选超可观测量诱导出的全部统计量；我们通过与测试数据比较验证了这一点，并将其归因于第一性原理思想与机器学习概念在我们的一般方法中的紧密结合。

articles.title: Pure FENE Bond Potential for Soft Matter and Biological Simulations: Theory, HOOMD-blue Implementation, and Applications to Polymer, Colloidal, and Membrane Systems
articles.title_zh: 用于软物质与生物模拟的纯 FENE 键势：理论、HOOMD-blue 实现及其在聚合物、胶体和膜体系中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The finitely extensible nonlinear elastic (FENE) potential is widely used as a bonded interaction in coarse-grained simulations of polymers, soft matter, colloids, and biological systems. In the classical Kremer--Grest framework, FENE bonding is combined with a short-range Weeks--Chandler--Andersen (WCA) interaction to provide finite bond extensibility together with excluded-volume repulsion. Although this combination is highly successful, it intrinsically couples bonded elasticity to the nonbonded interaction, limiting the ability to independently control these two contributions. Here, we introduce a standalone FENE bond potential in HOOMD-blue in which finite bond extensibility is implemented independently of the choice of nonbonded interaction. This formulation allows the same FENE bond potential to be combined with WCA, Lennard--Jones, or other pair interactions without modifying the bonded interaction itself. We demonstrate the utility of the standalone formulation in coarse-grained polymer chains, colloidal networks, and mesh-based biological membrane models. Across these systems, Pure FENE bonding without short-range excluded-volume stabilization produces pronounced structural contraction, whereas the addition of WCA repulsion suppresses this collapse and preserves finite, spatially extended structures. These results demonstrate that separating finite bond extensibility from steric interactions provides independent control over local bond mechanics and collective structural organization. The standalone FENE formulation therefore provides a modular framework for coarse-grained simulations in which molecular connectivity and nonbonded interactions represent distinct physical mechanisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限可伸长非线性弹性（FENE）势是粗粒化模拟中常用的键合相互作用，尤其适用于聚合物、软物质、胶体和生物体系。本文在 HOOMD-blue 中提出了一种独立的纯 FENE 键势，使有限键伸长能够与非键合相互作用分离控制。作者展示了其与 WCA、Lennard-Jones 等相互作用组合时的行为，并说明是否加入短程排斥会显著影响结构稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有限可伸长非线性弹性（FENE）势被广泛用作聚合物、软物质、胶体和生物系统粗粒化模拟中的键合相互作用。在经典的 Kremer-Grest 框架中，FENE 键合与短程 Weeks-Chandler-Andersen（WCA）相互作用结合，以同时提供有限的键可伸长性和排除体积排斥。尽管这种组合非常成功，但它在本质上将键合弹性与非键合相互作用耦合在一起，限制了对这两部分贡献进行独立控制的能力。这里，我们在 HOOMD-blue 中引入一种独立的纯 FENE 键势，其中有限键伸长的实现与非键合相互作用的选择彼此独立。该形式允许同一种 FENE 键势与 WCA、Lennard-Jones 或其他成对相互作用结合，而无需修改键合相互作用本身。我们在粗粒化聚合物链、胶体网络和基于网格的生物膜模型中展示了这种独立形式的实用性。对于这些体系而言，不加短程排除体积稳定化的纯 FENE 键合会导致显著的结构收缩，而加入 WCA 排斥则会抑制这种塌缩并保持有限、空间上延展的结构。这些结果表明，将有限键伸长与空间位阻相互作用分离，能够对局域键力学和整体结构组织实现独立控制。因此，这种独立的 FENE 形式为粗粒化模拟提供了一个模块化框架，其中分子连通性和非键合相互作用代表不同的物理机制。

articles.title: Nonreciprocal Magnon Hanle Effect in Antiferromagnetic α-Fe₂O₃
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁 α-Fe₂O₃ 中的非互易磁振子汉勒效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The precession of the magnon pseudospin about the equilibrium pseudofield, the latter capturing the nature of magnonic eigenexcitations in an antiferromagnet, gives rise to the magnon Hanle effect. Its realization via electrically injected and detected spin transport in an antiferromagnetic insulator demonstrates its high potential for devices and as a convenient probe for magnon eigenmodes and the underlying spin interactions in the antiferromagnet. Here, we observe a non-reciprocity in the Hanle signal measured in alpha-Fe2O3 using two spatially separated Pt electrodes as spin injector and detector. Interchanging their roles alters the detected magnon spin signal. The recorded difference depends on the applied magnetic field and reverses sign when the signal passes its nominal maximum at the so-called compensation field. Our findings unlock the high potential of antiferromagnetic magnonics towards the realization of electronics-inspired phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在反铁磁 α-Fe₂O₃ 中观测到磁振子汉勒信号的非互易性。利用两个空间分离的 Pt 电极分别作为自旋注入与探测端，交换它们的角色会改变检测到的磁振子自旋信号。该差异随外加磁场变化，并在补偿场附近穿越信号最大值时变号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁振子赝自旋绕平衡赝场的进动——后者刻画了反铁磁体中磁振子本征激发的性质——产生了磁振子汉勒效应。其通过在反铁磁绝缘体中进行电注入和电探测的自旋输运得以实现，显示出其在器件中的巨大潜力，也可作为研究磁振子本征模及反铁磁体中底层自旋相互作用的便捷探针。在这里，我们在 α-Fe2O3 中使用两个空间分离的 Pt 电极作为自旋注入器和探测器，观测到了汉勒信号的非互易性。交换它们的角色会改变所探测到的磁振子自旋信号。所记录到的差异依赖于所施加的磁场，并且在信号穿过其名义最大值、即所谓补偿场时会反转符号。我们的发现释放了反铁磁磁振子学在实现类电子学现象方面的巨大潜力。

articles.title: Spin Hall Magnetoresistance in Antiferromagnetic Insulators
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁绝缘体中的自旋霍尔磁阻
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnetic materials promise improved performance for spintronic applications, as they are robust against external magnetic field perturbations and allow for faster magnetization dynamics compared to ferromagnets. The direct observation of the antiferromagnetic state, however, is challenging due to the absence of a macroscopic magnetization. We show that the spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) is a versatile tool to probe the antiferromagnetic spin structure via simple electrical transport experiments by investigating the easy-plane antiferromagnetic insulators alpha-Fe2O3 (hematite) and NiO in bilayer heterostructures with a Pt heavy-metal top electrode. While rotating an external magnetic field in three orthogonal planes, we record the longitudinal and the transverse resistivities of Pt and observe characteristic resistivity modulations consistent with the SMR effect. We analyze both their amplitude and phase and compare the data to the results from a prototypical collinear ferrimagnetic Y3Fe5O12/Pt bilayer. The observed magnetic field dependence is explained in a comprehensive model, based on two magnetic sublattices and taking into account magnetic field-induced modifications of the domain structure. Our results show that the SMR effect allows to readout the spin configuration and to investigate magnetoelastic effects in antiferromagnetic multi-domain materials. We demonstrate that the SMR amplitude scales with the sum of the absolute sublattice magnetizations in ferrimagnetic and antiferromagnetic materials. In alpha-Fe2O3/Pt bilayers, we find an unexpectedly large SMR amplitude of 2.5E-3, twice as high as for prototype Y3Fe5O12/Pt bilayers, making the system particularly interesting for room-temperature antiferromagnetic spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁材料具有抗外部磁场扰动和更快磁化动力学等优势，但由于缺乏宏观磁化强度，其反铁磁态难以直接观测。本文通过研究覆盖Pt重金属电极的赤铁矿和NiO双层异质结构，证明自旋霍尔磁阻可通过简单的电输运实验探测反铁磁自旋结构。结果表明，α-Fe2O3/Pt中的自旋霍尔磁阻振幅达到2.5×10⁻³，是Y3Fe5O12/Pt的两倍，显示出其在室温反铁磁自旋电子学中的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁材料有望提升自旋电子学应用的性能，因为它们能够抵抗外部磁场扰动，并且与铁磁体相比可以实现更快的磁化动力学。然而，由于不存在宏观磁化强度，反铁磁态的直接观测具有挑战性。我们通过研究在具有重金属Pt顶电极的双层异质结构中的易面反铁磁绝缘体α-Fe2O3（赤铁矿）和NiO，表明自旋霍尔磁阻（SMR）是一种多功能工具，可以通过简单的电输运实验探测反铁磁自旋结构。当在三个相互正交的平面内旋转外部磁场时，我们记录Pt的纵向和横向电阻率，并观测到与SMR效应相符的特征性电阻率调制。我们分析了这些调制的振幅和相位，并将数据与原型共线亚铁磁性Y3Fe5O12/Pt双层结构的结果进行了比较。观测到的磁场依赖性可以由一个综合模型解释，该模型基于两个磁性子晶格，并考虑了磁场诱导的畴结构变化。我们的结果表明，SMR效应能够读出自旋构型，并研究反铁磁多畴材料中的磁弹性效应。我们证明，在亚铁磁和反铁磁材料中，SMR振幅与子晶格磁化强度绝对值之和成正比。在α-Fe2O3/Pt双层结构中，我们发现了意外的大SMR振幅2.5×10⁻³，是原型Y3Fe5O12/Pt双层结构的两倍，这使该体系对于室温反铁磁自旋电子学应用尤其具有吸引力。

articles.title: XPCS-Echo and broad relaxation measurements using a bunch-mode data acquisition scheme
articles.title_zh: 利用束团模式数据采集方案进行XPCS回波与宽范围弛豫测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Echoes observed in the intensity-intensity autocorrelation functions [g₂(q, τ)] is a powerful method for probing nonaffine deformations and yielding behavior of soft viscoelastic materials subjected to an oscillatory shear. Multispeckle X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) measurements of large number of echoes with high time resolution impose severe constraints in terms of the computational hardware and potential degradation of the sample. These issues are alleviated by implementing a bunch-mode data acquisition scheme in which the highest resolution frames or bunches centered at the echo peaks. In addition, by placing the bunches in an aperiodic Fibonacci sequence, g₂(q, τ) over a long time span can be measured with orders of magnitude lesser number of frames. The performance of these XPCS acquisition schemes is demonstrated using slowly relaxing model colloidal suspensions. Furthermore, an analytical expression is provided for the quantitative description of full g₂(q, τ).
articles.abstract_zh: 强度-强度自相关函数g₂(q,τ)中的回波可用于探测振荡剪切作用下软黏弹性材料的非仿射形变和屈服行为。本文提出束团模式数据采集方案，仅在回波峰附近以最高分辨率采集帧，从而降低计算硬件负担和样品损伤风险。进一步采用非周期性的斐波那契序列排列束团，可用数量少几个数量级的帧测量长时间范围内的g₂(q,τ)，并给出了完整g₂(q,τ)的定量解析表达式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在强度-强度自相关函数[g₂(q,τ)]中观测到的回波，是探测受到振荡剪切的软黏弹性材料中的非仿射形变和屈服行为的一种有力方法。对大量回波进行具有高时间分辨率的多散斑X射线光子相关谱（XPCS）测量，会对计算硬件提出严苛要求，并可能加剧样品退化。通过实施束团模式数据采集方案，可以缓解这些问题；在该方案中，以最高分辨率采集的帧或束团集中分布在回波峰附近。此外，将束团按照非周期性的斐波那契序列排列，可以用数量少几个数量级的帧测量长时间范围内的g₂(q,τ)。我们利用缓慢弛豫的模型胶体悬浮液展示了这些XPCS采集方案的性能。此外，我们还给出了用于定量描述完整g₂(q,τ)的解析表达式。

articles.title: Liquid-liquid phase transitions in dipolar liquids. Insights into Supercooled Water
articles.title_zh: 偶极液体中的液-液相变：对过冷水的认识
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dipolar liquids combine two coupled degrees of freedom, translational and dipolar. Intriguingly, these two sectors can reside in distinct thermodynamic states, with the state of one sector possibly favoring a specific state of the other. The onset of ferroelectric order in dipolar liquids is an example of this mutual stabilization. Since this coupling is often encoded in interaction potentials, projecting out one sector to derive an effective interaction for the other can uncover the microscopic mechanism underlying this phenomenon. A coarse-grained theory in which the distance between nearest-neighbor particles depends on their dipolar interaction through a density-dependent mechanical compliance shows that a ferroelectric transition can trigger a liquid-liquid transition. It also predicts a first-order liquid-liquid transition in the paraelectric phase that can in turn induce ferroelectric ordering. The anisotropic dipolar-dependent soft-core interaction is shown to lead to an effective Jagla-like isotropic two-length-scale interaction, known to support liquid-liquid phase transitions. Here, however, the two-length-scale pattern depends on density and dipolar configuration, becoming sensitive to dipolar order. Analysis of supercooled TIP4P/Ice water numerical simulations shows that first-coordination-shell features of pair correlation functions are sensitive to dipolar interaction, supporting the coarse-grained theory foundations. Comparison of low- and high-density liquid water reveals enhanced spatial anisotropy of the first coordination shell in the low-density liquid, with increased effective excluded volume, showing that the liquid-liquid transition involves structural changes within the first shell, beyond reorganization of the interstitial region and tetrahedral order. These findings point to a role for dipolar interactions in supercooled water liquid-liquid phase transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 偶极液体包含相互耦合的平移和偶极两个自由度，这两个部分可能处于不同的热力学状态并相互稳定。本文的粗粒化理论表明，铁电有序化可以触发液-液相变，而顺电相中的一级液-液相变也可能反过来诱导铁电有序。对过冷TIP4P/Ice水模拟的分析支持了偶极相互作用对第一配位壳层结构的影响，说明过冷水的液-液相变涉及第一壳层内部的结构变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 偶极液体结合了两个相互耦合的自由度，即平移自由度和偶极自由度。引人关注的是，这两个部分可以处于不同的热力学状态，其中一个部分的状态可能有利于另一个部分采取特定状态。偶极液体中铁电有序的出现就是这种相互稳定的一个例子。由于这种耦合通常编码在相互作用势中，对其中一个部分进行投影以推导另一个部分的有效相互作用，可以揭示这一现象背后的微观机制。一种粗粒化理论表明，当最近邻粒子之间的距离通过与密度有关的机械柔顺性依赖于它们的偶极相互作用时，铁电相变可以触发液-液相变。该理论还预测，在顺电相中存在一级液-液相变，而这一相变反过来可以诱导铁电有序。研究表明，各向异性的、依赖偶极的软核相互作用会导出一种类似Jagla势的各向同性双长度尺度相互作用，而众所周知，这类相互作用能够支持液-液相变。然而，在本研究中，双长度尺度结构依赖于密度和偶极构型，并因此对偶极有序十分敏感。对过冷TIP4P/Ice水数值模拟的分析显示，成对关联函数的第一配位壳层特征对偶极相互作用敏感，从而支持了该粗粒化理论的基础。对低密度和高密度液态水的比较表明，低密度液体的第一配位壳层具有增强的空间各向异性，并表现出增大的有效排斥体积，这说明液-液相变涉及第一壳层内部的结构变化，而不仅仅是间隙区域的重组和四面体有序的变化。这些发现表明，偶极相互作用可能在过冷水的液-液相变中发挥作用。

articles.title: Electronic Structure and Superconductivity in La₁.₅₅Sr₀.₄₅CuO₄/La₂CuO₄ Artificial High-T_c Superlattices Probed by Hard and Soft X-ray Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: La₁.₅₅Sr₀.₄₅CuO₄/La₂CuO₄人工高温超导超晶格中的电子结构与超导性：硬X射线和软X射线谱学研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02668v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In La₁.₅₅Sr₀.₄₅CuO₄/La₂CuO₄ (LSCO/LCO) artificial high-T_c superlattices (AHTS), grown by quantum material design, the superconducting dome can be tuned by varying the geometric ratio L/d, where L is the LCO layer thickness and d is the superlattice nanoscale period. Here, we combine hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (HAXPES) and polarization-dependent soft X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) to probe how the electronic structure evolves across the L/d-tuned superconducting dome. We observe systematic chemical-potential evolution across the series, together with enhanced spectral weight near the Fermi level, enhanced local and non-local screening signatures, and increased in-plane orbital polarization near the top of the dome. Together, these spectroscopic signatures provide insight into the emergence of Fano-Feshbach resonant superconductivity in the LSCO/LCO AHTS series.
articles.abstract_zh: 在通过量子材料设计制备的La₁.₅₅Sr₀.₄₅CuO₄/La₂CuO₄人工高温超导超晶格中，可通过改变几何比L/d调控超导穹顶，其中L为LCO层厚度，d为超晶格纳米尺度周期。本文结合硬X射线光电子能谱和偏振依赖软X射线吸收谱，研究L/d调控的超导穹顶中电子结构的演化。结果显示，化学势、费米能级附近的谱权重、局域和非局域屏蔽特征以及面内轨道极化均呈系统性增强，为LSCO/LCO超晶格中Fano-Feshbach共振超导性的出现提供了线索。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在La₁.₅₅Sr₀.₄₅CuO₄/La₂CuO₄（LSCO/LCO）人工高温超导超晶格（AHTS）中，这些超晶格通过量子材料设计生长，其超导穹顶可以通过改变几何比L/d进行调控，其中L是LCO层厚度，d是超晶格的纳米尺度周期。在本文中，我们结合硬X射线光电子能谱（HAXPES）和偏振依赖的软X射线吸收谱（XAS），探测电子结构如何跨越由L/d调控的超导穹顶发生演化。我们观测到整个系列中化学势的系统性演化，同时还发现费米能级附近的谱权重增强、局域和非局域屏蔽信号增强，以及穹顶顶部附近面内轨道极化增强。总体而言，这些谱学特征为理解LSCO/LCO人工高温超导超晶格系列中Fano-Feshbach共振超导性的出现提供了洞见。
articles.focus_summary: 本文利用硬X射线光电子能谱和偏振依赖软X射线吸收谱，研究LSCO/LCO人工高温超导超晶格中电子结构随层厚比变化的演化。结果显示化学势、费米能级附近谱重、屏蔽效应和面内轨道极化均发生系统变化，并与超导穹顶及共振超导机制相关。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队关注的超导、人工超晶格、电子结构和量子功能材料相关，但本文主要采用实验光谱手段，缺少团队常用的第一性原理、有效哈密顿量或输运模拟。其对超晶格轨道重构和界面电子态的分析可为理论建模提供验证依据。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可基于第一性原理和Wannier方法构建LSCO/LCO超晶格低能有效模型，分析界面电荷转移、轨道极化和层厚比对费米面及配对相互作用的影响。也可进一步结合电子-声子耦合或强关联模型研究超导穹顶的微观起源。

articles.title: QArray+: A physics-informed GPU-accelerated simulator for quantum dot arrays
articles.title_zh: QArray+：物理信息驱动的GPU加速量子点阵列模拟器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02736v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor quantum-dot arrays are a compelling platform for scalable quantum technologies, yet their practical operation is hindered by the complexity of tuning large-scale devices. Existing automation tools rely on simplified physical models---such as constant-capacitance approximations and equilibrium Hubbard models---which assume instantaneous relaxation to a steady state. These frameworks fail in experimentally critical regimes where measurement rates exceed tunneling dynamics, necessitating more sophisticated non-equilibrium control strategies. To bridge this gap, we introduce QArray+, an extension of the QArray framework that incorporates gate-dependent tunnel coupling and a quantum open-system description of dissipative processes. This approach enables the unified simulation of coherent interdot charge-state hybridization and the non-equilibrium latching dynamics essential for training robust machine-learning models for automated device operation. Implemented in JAX with GPU acceleration, QArray+ scales across GPUs and multi-node systems. For example, a charge stability diagram for a 100X100 grid of gate voltages over 64 dots can be computed in sim0.17,s on multiple GPUs. Since interdot interactions are short-ranged and the corresponding tuning corrections are local, simulations at these scales capture the physics relevant to even larger devices. These capabilities support high-throughput dataset generation for automated device tuning.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体量子点阵列是可扩展量子技术的重要平台，但大规模器件的调谐受到复杂性的限制。本文提出QArray+，在QArray框架中引入栅极依赖的隧穿耦合以及量子开放系统对耗散过程的描述，从而统一模拟相干的点间电荷态杂化和非平衡锁存动力学。该工具基于JAX并支持GPU加速，可用于大规模高吞吐数据集生成；例如，在多GPU上可在约0.17秒内计算64个量子点、100×100栅极电压网格的电荷稳定性图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 半导体量子点阵列是实现可扩展量子技术的一个有吸引力的平台，但大规模器件的实际运行受到调谐复杂性的阻碍。现有自动化工具依赖简化的物理模型，例如定电容近似和平衡Hubbard模型，这些模型假设体系会瞬时弛豫到稳态。在测量速率超过隧穿动力学速率的实验关键状态下，这些框架失效，因此需要更复杂的非平衡控制策略。为弥合这一差距，我们提出QArray+，这是QArray框架的扩展版本，引入了栅极依赖的隧穿耦合以及量子开放系统对耗散过程的描述。该方法能够统一模拟相干的点间电荷态杂化和对训练稳健机器学习模型进行自动化器件运行至关重要的非平衡锁存动力学。QArray+使用JAX实现并采用GPU加速，可以在多个GPU和多节点系统之间扩展。例如，在多GPU上，可以在约0.17秒内计算包含64个量子点、由100×100栅极电压网格组成的电荷稳定性图。由于点间相互作用是短程的，相应的调谐修正也是局域的，因此这一规模的模拟能够捕捉对更大器件同样相关的物理。上述能力支持为自动化器件调谐高吞吐量地生成数据集。

articles.title: Understanding Graphene-Perovskite Interactions: From Flake Chemistry to Crystallisation and Solar Cell Performance
articles.title_zh: 理解石墨烯-钙钛矿相互作用：从片层化学到结晶与太阳能电池性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphene-derivatives are widely employed materials to improve bulk and interface properties of metal-halide perovskite devices. Yet the implications of their flake chemistry and interactions with the perovskite precursors remain unclear. Here, we show that pristine graphene flakes (GF) and more conventional graphene oxide flakes (GOF) are not interchangeable. Density functional theory calculations reveal that GOF interacts more strongly with the perovskite lattice but induces larger structural distortions, stronger interfacial polarisation, and localised gap states. In contrast, GF forms comparatively non-disruptive contacts, a response retained across a wide compositional range. Machine-learning atomistic simulations further show that GF contacts both Pb- and I-containing regions of solvated perovskite nanocrystals, with a strong solvent dependency. Solution spectroscopic characterization indicates that GF additives serve as scaffold for preorganised Pb/I-containing precursors, favouring film crystallisation. In this sense, GF enhances solar cell performance across perovskite compositions, but particularly those facing a more challenging crystallisation. In mixed Sn-Pb perovskite solar cells, GF raises the champion power-conversion efficiency from 21.5% to 23.7% with improved storage stability. These results establish pristine GF as a chemically defined additive and connect its atomic-scale interactions with precursor organisation, crystallisation, device performance, and stability.
articles.abstract_zh: 石墨烯衍生物常被用于改善金属卤化物钙钛矿器件的体相和界面性质，但其片层化学以及与钙钛矿前驱体的相互作用仍不清楚。本文表明，原始石墨烯片层和石墨烯氧化物片层并不可互换：前者形成扰动较小的接触并促进前驱体预组织，后者虽与钙钛矿晶格作用更强，却会引起更大的结构畸变和局域带隙态。原始石墨烯可改善不同组分钙钛矿太阳能电池的性能，在混合Sn-Pb钙钛矿中将最高功率转换效率从21.5%提高到23.7%，并改善储存稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 石墨烯衍生物被广泛用作改善金属卤化物钙钛矿器件体相性质和界面性质的材料。然而，它们的片层化学以及与钙钛矿前驱体之间相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，原始石墨烯片层（GF）与更为常用的氧化石墨烯片层（GOF）并不可互换。密度泛函理论计算显示，GOF与钙钛矿晶格的相互作用更强，但会诱导更大的结构畸变、更强的界面极化以及局域化的带隙态。相比之下，GF形成的接触具有相对较小的扰动，并且在很宽的组分范围内都能保持这一响应。机器学习原子模拟进一步表明，GF会接触溶剂化钙钛矿纳米晶中含Pb和含I的区域，而且这种接触强烈依赖于溶剂。溶液光谱表征表明，GF添加剂可以作为预先组织的含Pb/I前驱体的支架，从而有利于薄膜结晶。从这一意义上说，GF能够提升不同钙钛矿组分的太阳能电池性能，尤其适用于面临更大结晶挑战的组分。在混合Sn-Pb钙钛矿太阳能电池中，GF将最高功率转换效率从21.5%提高到23.7%，并改善了储存稳定性。这些结果确立了原始GF作为一种化学组成明确的添加剂的地位，并将其原子尺度相互作用与前驱体组织、结晶、器件性能和稳定性联系起来。
articles.focus_summary: 本文研究石墨烯及氧化石墨烯片层与金属卤化物钙钛矿之间的相互作用，结合密度泛函理论、机器学习原子模拟和实验表征分析其对结构、界面极化、局域能隙态及结晶过程的影响。结果表明，氧化石墨烯相互作用更强但引起更大结构畸变，而原始石墨烯接触扰动较小，并可促进钙钛矿薄膜结晶和太阳能电池性能提升。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的卤化物钙钛矿、二维材料、异质结构界面、机器学习原子模拟、界面电荷转移和太阳能电池方向高度相关。其关于石墨烯化学性质、溶剂依赖界面作用和结晶调控的结果，可为钙钛矿界面工程及缺陷钝化设计提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步计算不同石墨烯官能团、缺陷和应变条件下的界面电荷转移、缺陷形成能及载流子复合过程。结合非绝热分子动力学或GW-BSE方法，可研究石墨烯调控下的热载流子弛豫、激子解离和非辐射复合。

articles.title: Magnetoelectric Phase Transition and Axion Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 磁电相变与轴子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02759v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetoelectric phase transitions have been experimentally studied, but no macroscopic theory has been proposed to explain their dynamical origin. In this work, we assume that the axion quasiparticle with frequency undergoes a condensation like process. We show that these magnetoelectric phase transitions can be described within a Ginzbur Landau framework by introducing a coupled dynamic parameter, the axion angle, which is proportional to the magnetoelectric coeffcient. We derive relations between the static axion angle, the axion frequency, and the phase transition temperature for different magnetoelectric materials, respectively, and compare these calculations with existing experimental results. We also connect the artificially designed Dzyaloshinskii Moriya interaction with the axion condensate like process, so that the relation between the static axion angle and the experimentally measured frequency shift can be obtained.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁电相变虽然已得到实验研究，但其动力学起源尚缺乏宏观理论解释。本文假设轴子准粒子经历类似凝聚的过程，并在引入与磁电系数成正比的耦合动力学参数轴子角后，利用金兹堡-朗道框架描述磁电相变。作者推导了不同磁电材料中静态轴子角、轴子频率和相变温度之间的关系，并将计算结果与已有实验结果进行比较，同时讨论了人工设计的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与类轴子凝聚过程之间的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁电相变已经得到实验研究，但尚未提出解释其动力学起源的宏观理论。在这项工作中，我们假设频率为某值的轴子准粒子经历类似凝聚的过程。我们表明，通过引入一个耦合的动力学参数，即与磁电系数成正比的轴子角，可以在金兹堡-朗道框架内描述这些磁电相变。对于不同的磁电材料，我们分别推导出静态轴子角、轴子频率和相变温度之间的关系，并将这些计算结果与已有实验结果进行比较。我们还将人工设计的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与类轴子凝聚过程联系起来，从而可以得到静态轴子角与实验测得的频移之间的关系。

articles.title: Systematic display of the spin splitting in band structures of representative altermagnetic crystals
articles.title_zh: 系统展示代表性交错磁晶体能带结构中的自旋劈裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we demonstrate a novel approach to exhibit the unique spin splitting that is typical of collinear altermagnets. This approach is to plot band structures on Brillouin zone paths that sample general k-points to show a representative picture that corresponds to Brillouin zone averages. This is in contrast to conventional band structure plotting which plots band structures on the highest-symmetry points and lines, and thus in many cases can fail to show any altermagnetic spin splitting at all. Our investigation compares the new approach with the band structures of collinear altermagnets using conventional band structure plotting. We report the band structure and symmetry analysis for MnTe, CrSb, SmFeO3, ScCrO3, LaMnO3, TlCrO3, HoFeO3, InCrO3 and DyFeO3. This result clearly demonstrates the advantage of this novel method for displaying the spin splitting of collinear altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种展示共线交错磁体特有自旋劈裂的新方法：在能够采样一般k点的布里渊区路径上绘制能带结构，以获得代表布里渊区平均特征的图像。该方法区别于只经过高对称点和高对称线的传统能带绘制方式，后者在许多情况下会完全隐藏交错磁自旋劈裂。通过对MnTe、CrSb、SmFeO3、ScCrO3、LaMnO3、TlCrO3、HoFeO3、InCrO3和DyFeO3等材料进行能带和对称性分析，本文明确展示了新方法的优势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们展示了一种呈现共线交错磁体所特有自旋劈裂的新方法。该方法是在能够采样一般k点的布里渊区路径上绘制能带结构，从而展示与布里渊区平均相对应的代表性图像。这不同于传统的能带绘制方式，后者沿高对称点和高对称线绘制能带，因此在许多情况下可能完全无法显示任何交错磁自旋劈裂。我们的研究将这种新方法与采用传统能带绘制方式得到的共线交错磁体能带结构进行了比较。我们报告了MnTe、CrSb、SmFeO3、ScCrO3、LaMnO3、TlCrO3、HoFeO3、InCrO3和DyFeO3的能带结构及对称性分析。结果清楚地展示了这种用于显示共线交错磁体自旋劈裂的新方法的优势。

articles.title: Emergence of the magnetic octupole Rashba-Edelstein effect from spin-orbit entanglement
articles.title_zh: 自旋-轨道纠缠诱导的磁八极Rashba-Edelstein效应的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic multipoles have attracted growing interest as order parameters and dynamical degrees of freedom in unconventional magnets, yet it remains unclear how broadly they can emerge as active electronic degrees of freedom. Here, we show that spin-orbit-entangled multiorbital states can host magnetic octupole (MO) degrees of freedom. In Rashba systems, this gives rise to an MO Rashba texture accompanying the J-Rashba texture. Remarkably, spin-orbital entanglement can realize a pure-MO limit in which the spin and orbital-angular-momentum textures vanish while the MO texture remains finite. An applied electric field converts this texture into a nonequilibrium MO polarization through an MO Rashba-Edelstein effect. Around the pure-MO regime, the MO Edelstein response dominates over the conventional spin response, showing that multipolar responses need not be small corrections to dipolar spin physics. Our results establish an interface-based route for electrically generating nonequilibrium multipolar magnetic polarization in spin-orbit-coupled systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁多极矩作为非常规磁体中的序参量和动力学自由度日益受到关注，但其作为活性电子自由度的普适性仍不清楚。本文表明，自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道态能够承载磁八极矩自由度，并在Rashba体系中形成伴随J-Rashba纹理的磁八极Rashba纹理。电场可将该纹理转换为非平衡磁八极极化；在纯磁八极区域附近，其Edelstein响应可超过传统自旋响应，为电生成非平衡多极磁极化提供了界面途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁多极矩作为非常规磁体中的序参量和动力学自由度，已经引起越来越多的关注，但目前仍不清楚它们能否广泛地作为活性电子自由度出现。在这里，我们表明，自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道态能够承载磁八极矩（MO）自由度。在Rashba体系中，这会产生一种MO Rashba纹理，并伴随J-Rashba纹理。值得注意的是，自旋-轨道纠缠可以实现纯MO极限，在这一极限下，自旋纹理和轨道角动量纹理均消失，而MO纹理仍保持有限。施加电场可以通过MO Rashba-Edelstein效应将这一纹理转化为非平衡MO极化。在纯MO区域附近，MO Edelstein响应超过传统自旋响应，这表明多极响应不一定只是偶极自旋物理的小修正。我们的结果确立了一条基于界面的途径，可在自旋-轨道耦合体系中电学生成非平衡多极磁极化。

articles.title: AlterSeeK-Path: Systematic construction of generalized band-structure paths for displaying altermagnetic spin splitting
articles.title_zh: AlterSeeK-Path：用于展示交错磁自旋劈裂的广义能带结构路径的系统构建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetic materials exhibit spin splitting in their electronic band structures while maintaining zero net magnetization. However, conventional high-symmetry k-paths generally hide this splitting because they follow symmetry lines that in most cases enforce spin degeneracy. We present AlterSeeK-Path, an open-source Python tool that systematically constructs generalized band-structure paths for collinear altermagnets. The method selects the centroid of the conventional irreducible wedge used in routine band-structure calculations as the representative general k-point, maps it to a spin-flip-related partner, and inserts paired segments through these points into the standard high-symmetry path; these segments systematically sample the interior of the irreducible wedge. We demonstrate the construction for all 54 three-dimensional combinations of extended Bravais lattice type and spin Laue group across the six crystal systems that support collinear altermagnetism, and for the 12 two-dimensional cases spanning the four compatible two-dimensional Bravais lattices. Representative band structures are shown for the distinct lattice/path cases. With AlterSeeK-Path, these band structures can be constructed with essentially the same effort as conventional band structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 交错磁材料在保持零净磁化强度的同时，其电子能带结构中存在自旋劈裂，但传统高对称性k路径通常会将这种劈裂隐藏。本文提出开源Python工具AlterSeeK-Path，用于系统构建共线交错磁体的广义能带路径。该方法选取常规能带计算所用不可约楔形区的质心作为代表性一般k点，将其映射到自旋翻转相关的伙伴点，并把成对线段插入标准高对称路径。作者展示了其对三维和二维所有支持共线交错磁性的晶格与自旋劳厄群组合的适用性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交错磁材料在保持零净磁化强度的同时，其电子能带结构表现出自旋劈裂。然而，传统的高对称性k路径通常会隐藏这种劈裂，因为这些路径沿着在多数情况下强制自旋简并的对称线。我们提出AlterSeeK-Path，这是一种开源Python工具，用于系统构建共线交错磁体的广义能带结构路径。该方法选取常规能带结构计算中使用的不可约楔形区的质心作为代表性一般k点，将其映射到一个与自旋翻转相关的伙伴点，并将经过这些点的成对线段插入标准高对称路径；这些线段能够系统地采样不可约楔形区的内部。我们针对支持共线交错磁性的六种晶系，展示了扩展布拉菲晶格类型与自旋劳厄群的全部54种三维组合的路径构建；同时也展示了覆盖四种兼容二维布拉菲晶格的12种二维情形。我们给出了不同晶格和路径情形的代表性能带结构。利用AlterSeeK-Path，可以用与构建传统能带结构基本相同的工作量构建这些能带结构。
