By applying pressures up to 80 GPa, despite partial suppression of insulating behavior and the DW order, but superconductivity is not observed in our present study. Density functional theory calculations suggest that the 3dz^₂ and 3dₓ^₂₋y^₂ are separated from other t₂g orbitals and make a primary contribution to the Fermi surface. The newly synthesized trilayer nickelate Sm₄Ni₃O₁₀₋δ offers a unique platform for probing the fundamental physics of RP nickelates.

articles.title: Bond-number-controlled durability of cohesive granular materials under repeated vibration
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00587v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cohesive granular materials derive their mechanical stability not only from the strength of individual interparticle bonds but also from the number of bonds forming the load-bearing network. However, these two effects are difficult to separate experimentally because conventional control parameters, such as liquid content, generally alter both simultaneously. Here, we use a mixed granular system composed of cohesive and noncohesive grains to control the cohesive bond number while keeping the bond strength approximately unchanged. We investigate the failure lifetime under repeated vibration and find that the number of cycles to failure, N_f, depends strongly on the mixing ratio α. The data are well collapsed by ln N_f propto α²/G, where α² represents the fraction of cohesive contacts and G is a peak acceleration normalized by gravitational acceleration. Remarkably, although the Young's modulus is nearly independent of α above the rigidity threshold, the lifetime continues to increase strongly with α. This demonstrates that mechanical rigidity and durability against repeated perturbations exhibit distinct dependences on the cohesive network. These results identify bond number as a key control parameter for the durability of cohesive granular materials.

articles.title: GW and Bethe-Salpeter Theory for Molecular Polaritons, Quasiparticles, and Excitons
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00594v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electron self-energy is central to quasiparticle theory, yet how an optical cavity enters it remains unclear. We address this question for a molecule in a single-mode cavity using the dipole-gauge Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian and a coherent-state QED Hartree-Fock reference. The cavity enters through three channels: the static dipole self-energy (DSE) shift of reference orbital energies, direct DSE augmentation of the screened interaction, and the polariton pole carrying the bilinear electron-photon coupling. We benchmark QED-GW ionization potentials (IPs) and electron affinities (EAs) against a cavity Δ-method ladder from QED-HF to correlated wave-function methods, whose cavity-induced shifts agree within 1 meV where directly comparable. For closed-shell molecules with unbound anions, GW systematically overestimates cavity-induced IP redshifts, whereas EA shifts are reproduced nearly quantitatively, although this does not imply comparable accuracy for absolute EAs. For ionic molecules with bound anions, this ordering reverses, consistent with published QED coupled-cluster results. Coupling and detuning scans show that the error is predominantly quadratic in λ and DSE-driven rather than resonant. The spectral function develops a polariton-replica photoemission sideband with weight scaling as λ². In the static screened interaction used in the Bethe-Salpeter equation, bare-photon exchange cancels the matching DSE contribution to the direct interaction, while exchange and polariton-screening corrections remain. Their net effect on the lowest excitation is appreciable only for ammonia in the molecules studied. Exciton-binding energies involving unbound anions are strongly basis-dependent and should therefore be viewed as diagnostics of electron-hole interactions rather than basis-converged molecular quantities.

articles.title: Feedback-Enhanced Quantum Metrology and Clock Precision under Thermodynamic Uncertainty
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Feedback can convert continuously monitored quantum jumps into a thermodynamic resource. We formulate full counting statistics for open quantum systems under unital jump feedback by incorporating the feedback maps into the tilted generator. The resulting trajectory ensemble determines both current fluctuations and the Fisher information of the measurement record. We show that feedback can enhance reservoir-parameter estimation and clock precision without necessarily changing average thermodynamic currents. This enhanced precision is not bounded by reservoir entropy production alone. By embedding the reduced dynamics in an enlarged measurement-feedback process, we derive a feedback-modified thermodynamic uncertainty relation in which the information entropy production of the feedback apparatus supplies the missing cost. A charge-monitored double quantum dot illustrates the framework: jump-conditioned feedback improves thermometry and chemical-potential sensing, and stabilizes a quantum clock defined by output-current ticks.

articles.title: Overcoming the Efficiency-Stability Trade-off in Spin-Orbit Torque Devices with Thermally Robust BCC NiW Alloys
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The development of high-performance spin-orbit torque (SOT) magnetic memories is fundamentally constrained by a persistent trade-off between spin Hall efficiency, thermal structural stability, and perpendicular magnetic anisotropy in conventional heavy metals. Here, we overcome this limitation by engineering body-centered-cubic (BCC) Ni-doped W alloys as highly efficient and thermally robust spin-current sources. Ni₃₀W₇₀/CoFeB heterostructures achieve deterministic out-of-plane magnetization switching at an ultra-low critical current density of 1.78 MA/cm², nearly threefold lower than that of β-W, while maintaining a high anisotropy field of 8,500 Oe and a thermal stability factor of 57.9. The BCC Ni₃₀W₇₀ alloy preserves its structural integrity and the perpendicular magnetic anisotropy of the adjacent CoFeB layer after annealing at 450 ^circC, demonstrating robustness under the stringent thermal processing conditions relevant to back-end-of-line integration. Harmonic Hall and ferromagnetic resonance measurements reveal a large spin Hall angle of -0.39 and a high interfacial spin transparency of 0.75, demonstrating efficient spin-current generation and interfacial transmission. First-principles calculations further reveal enhanced intrinsic spin Hall conductivity in W-rich BCC NiW alloys, associated with the Fermi level lying within a spin-orbit-coupling-induced band gap. These findings establish BCC NiW alloys as a scalable and thermally resilient material platform for energy-efficient SOT-MRAM.

articles.title: Floquet scattering and Fano resonances in nodal-ring and multi-Weyl semimetals: Role of propagating and evanescent modes
articles.title_zh: 节点环与多重Weyl半金属中的Floquet散射与Fano共振：传播模与倏逝模的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a comprehensive Floquet scattering theory for quantum transport in periodically driven nodal-ring semimetals (NRSs) and multi-Weyl semimetals (mWSMs), extending our earlier study reported in Annalen der Physik 535, 2200460 (2023), in which evanescent modes were neglected, to a complete formalism that includes both propagating and evanescent channels. By solving the full boundary-value problem, we obtain the complete set of scattering states and show that, although evanescent modes are indispensable for satisfying the matching conditions at the potential interfaces, they carry zero net probability current and do not contribute to any observable transport quantity. We identify a previously unexplored transport regime in NRSs in which two propagating channels coexist and participate in coherent scattering, producing multi-channel quantum interference and Floquet-induced Fano resonances. The transmission, reflection, pumped shot noise, and the associated Fano resonance features are determined entirely by the propagating channels, and the resonance energies coincide with those of the corresponding quasi-bound states of the static potential well. Our results establish a unified framework for Floquet transport in anisotropic topological semimetals, and confirm that the approximation of neglecting evanescent modes in our earlier work is justified for all measurable transport properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了周期驱动节点环半金属和多重Weyl半金属中量子输运的完整Floquet散射理论，将传播通道与倏逝通道统一纳入边值问题。研究表明，倏逝模虽对势垒界面的匹配条件不可或缺，但不携带净概率流，也不影响可观测输运量。节点环半金属中两个传播通道的共存可产生多通道量子干涉和Floquet诱导的Fano共振，且共振能量与静态势阱准束缚态的能量一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了周期驱动节点环半金属（NRS）和多重Weyl半金属（mWSM）中量子输运的综合Floquet散射理论，将我们此前发表于《Annalen der Physik》535, 2200460（2023）的研究加以扩展；在此前研究中，倏逝模被忽略，而现在的完整形式主义同时包含传播通道和倏逝通道。通过求解完整的边值问题，我们获得了完整的散射态集合，并表明，尽管倏逝模对于满足势界面处的匹配条件不可或缺，但它们携带的净概率流为零，因此不会对任何可观测的输运量作出贡献。我们在节点环半金属中发现了一个此前未被探索的输运区域，其中两个传播通道共存并参与相干散射，从而产生多通道量子干涉和Floquet诱导的Fano共振。透射、反射、泵浦散粒噪声以及相关的Fano共振特征完全由传播通道决定，并且共振能量与相应静态势阱的准束缚态能量相一致。我们的结果为各向异性拓扑半金属中的Floquet输运建立了统一框架，并确认，在所有可测输运性质方面，忽略倏逝模的近似对于我们此前的工作是合理的。

articles.title: Correlation-Driven Nonlinear Magnetoelectric Response in an Altermagnet: A Dynamical Mean-Field Study
articles.title_zh: 交互作用驱动的交错磁体非线性磁电响应：动力学平均场研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the optical nonlinear magnetoelectric effect (NMEE) in a strongly correlated altermagnet using dynamical mean-field theory. Unlike effective band descriptions with an imposed spin splitting, our approach determines the altermagnetic order, electronic spectrum, and optical nonlinear response self-consistently. We find that the NMEE is finite in the altermagnetic phase and vanishes in the paramagnetic phase. Its frequency dependence reflects the spin-resolved spectral structure and provides an estimate of the characteristic altermagnetic spin-splitting scale. Interaction and temperature tuning produce qualitatively different behavior: at low temperature, reducing the interaction strength toward the interaction-driven magnetic phase boundary enhances the response, whereas increasing the temperature suppresses it and drives it to zero above the critical temperature. These results establish the optical NMEE as a probe of correlated altermagnetic order and suggest that tuning parameters such as pressure, strain, or chemical substitution toward an interaction-driven phase boundary may provide a promising route to maximizing the response.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用动力学平均场理论研究强关联交错磁体中的光学非线性磁电效应。结果表明，非线性磁电效应在交错磁相中有限，而在顺磁相中消失，其频率依赖反映了自旋分辨的谱结构。降低温度或调节交互作用会导致不同的响应变化，接近交互作用驱动的磁相边界时，低温响应增强，而升温会抑制响应并使其在临界温度以上消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用动力学平均场理论研究强关联交错磁体中的光学非线性磁电效应（NMEE）。不同于施加自旋劈裂的有效能带描述，我们的方法能够自洽地确定交错磁序、电子谱以及光学非线性响应。我们发现，NMEE在交错磁相中是有限的，而在顺磁相中消失。其频率依赖性反映了自旋分辨的谱结构，并为交错磁自旋劈裂的特征尺度提供了估计。交互作用和温度调控会产生定性不同的行为：在低温下，将交互作用强度降低至交互作用驱动的磁相边界附近会增强响应；而升高温度则会抑制响应，并使其在临界温度以上趋于零。这些结果表明，光学NMEE可作为探测关联交错磁序的手段，并提示，将压力、应变或化学取代等调控参数调节至交互作用驱动的相边界附近，可能是最大化响应的一条有前景的途径。

articles.title: Phase Switchable Photocatalytic Water Splitting via a Paraelectric-Ferroelectric Transition in Zr2Ge2S6 Monolayer: A Comprehensive Theoretical Insights
articles.title_zh: 通过Zr2Ge2S6单层中的顺电-铁电相变实现可切换相的光催化分解水：综合理论研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00724v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photocatalytic water splitting (PWS) is a promising technology for addressing the global energy crisis and producing renewable and clean hydrogen fuel. Although numerous 2D materials have recently been proposed as potential photocatalysts, effective strategies for regulating photocatalytic reactions and improving energy conversion efficiency remain limited due to performance regulation challenges. Here, using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the photocatalytic activity and energy conversion efficiency of a Zr2Ge2S6 monolayer can be effectively tuned through a paraelectric-ferroelectric phase transition. The Zr2Ge2S6 monolayer exhibits excellent structural stability, favorable mechanical properties, a suitable band gap, optimal band edge positions, and broad-spectrum light absorption. Moreover, the Zr2Ge2S6 monolayer exhibits a higher oxidation potential and a stronger driving force for photogenerated holes to promote oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in the ferroelectric phase. In contrast, the paraelectric phase provides photogenerated electrons with a greater reduction potential and driving force for hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). The solar-to-hydrogen conversion efficiency is also strongly influenced by the phase transition, increasing from 7.71% in the paraelectric phase to 15.31% in the ferroelectric phase because of the improved carrier utilization. Our theoretical investigation not only highlights the crucial role of ferroelectric polarization in photocatalytic water splitting but also provides an effective strategy for tuning the photocatalytic properties of 2D ferroelectric materials through ferroelectric switching.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于第一性原理计算表明，Zr2Ge2S6单层的光催化活性和能量转换效率可通过顺电-铁电相变有效调控。该材料具有良好的结构稳定性、力学性质、合适的带隙、适宜的能带边位置及宽光谱吸收特性。顺电相更有利于析氢反应，而铁电相具有更强的析氧驱动力，并使太阳能制氢效率由7.71%提高至15.31%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光催化分解水（PWS）是应对全球能源危机并生产可再生清洁氢燃料的一项有前景的技术。尽管近年来已有大量二维材料被提出作为潜在光催化剂，但由于性能调控方面的挑战，调节光催化反应和提高能量转换效率的有效策略仍然有限。在此，我们利用第一性原理计算证明，Zr2Ge2S6单层的光催化活性和能量转换效率可以通过顺电-铁电相变得到有效调控。Zr2Ge2S6单层具有优异的结构稳定性、良好的力学性质、合适的带隙、适宜的能带边位置以及宽光谱光吸收能力。此外，在铁电相中，Zr2Ge2S6单层表现出更高的氧化电势和更强的光生空穴驱动力，可促进析氧反应（OER）。相比之下，顺电相能够为光生电子提供更高的还原电势和更强的析氢反应（HER）驱动力。太阳能制氢转换效率也受到相变的显著影响，由于载流子利用率得到提高，该效率从顺电相中的7.71%增加到铁电相中的15.31%。我们的理论研究不仅突出了铁电极化在光催化分解水中的关键作用，也为通过铁电开关调节二维铁电材料的光催化性质提供了有效策略。

articles.title: Magnetic quantum defects in a uniaxial antiferromagnetic insulator
articles.title_zh: 单轴反铁磁绝缘体中的磁性量子缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00801v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Point defects have been successfully utilized in various quantum technologies, serving as quantum qubits for quantum computation, single-photon emitters for quantum communication, and nanoscale sensors for quantum metrology. However, their further development faces key challenges, particularly in discovering and exploring suitable defect-host systems that meet the necessary criteria for quantum applications. Here, using polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy and terahertz absorption spectroscopy, we discover three distinct chromium-vacancy-induced excitations in the uniaxial antiferromagnetic insulator, Cr₂O₃. These vacancy-induced excitations have an energy scale of a few tens of millielectronvolts and are twofold degenerate, and the lowest one at 64 cm⁻¹ is sharp and sensitive to the external magnetic field along the easy-axis direction, particularly close to the spin-flop regime around 6T, where the mode softens from 64 to 27cm⁻¹. Based on the defect supercell first-principles calculations, we interpret the mode at 64 cm⁻¹ as a local magnetic excitation of the local moment within the chromium vacancy state. Our results establish that the magnetic defect states in Cr₂O₃ have potential for quantum applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过偏振分辨拉曼光谱和太赫兹吸收光谱，在单轴反铁磁绝缘体Cr2O3中发现了三种由铬空位诱导的激发。相关激发能标为数十毫电子伏，并具有二重简并性；其中64 cm⁻¹的最低能模对沿易轴方向的外磁场敏感，在约6 T的自旋翻转区域软化至27 cm⁻¹。第一性原理缺陷超胞计算表明，该模式源于铬空位态局域磁矩的局域磁激发，显示其具有量子应用潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 点缺陷已成功应用于多种量子技术，包括用作量子计算中的量子比特、量子通信中的单光子发射器以及量子计量学中的纳米尺度传感器。然而，它们的进一步发展面临着关键挑战，尤其是发现和探索能够满足量子应用所需条件的合适缺陷-宿主体系。本文利用偏振分辨拉曼光谱和太赫兹吸收光谱，在单轴反铁磁绝缘体Cr₂O₃中发现了三种不同的铬空位诱导激发。这些空位诱导激发的能量尺度为数十毫电子伏，并且具有二重简并性；其中最低能量的激发位于64 cm⁻¹，表现得很尖锐，并且对沿易轴方向施加的外部磁场敏感，尤其是在约6 T的自旋翻转区域附近，该模式从64 cm⁻¹软化到27 cm⁻¹。基于缺陷超胞第一性原理计算，我们将64 cm⁻¹处的模式解释为铬空位态中局域磁矩的局域磁激发。我们的结果表明，Cr₂O₃中的磁性缺陷态具有应用于量子技术的潜力。

articles.title: Independent Tuning of Surface Acoustic-Waves and Spin-Waves via Buffer-Layer Engineering in Co2FeGe Heusler Thin Films
articles.title_zh: 通过Co2FeGe霍斯勒薄膜中的缓冲层工程独立调控表面声波与自旋波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding and controlling acoustic and spin-wave excitations in magnetic thin films is critical for the development of magnonic and spin-acoustic devices. We report on the use of Cr and W buffer layers to independently modify the acoustic and magnetic excitations in Co2FeGe full-Heusler thin films grown on MgO(001). Using Brillouin light scattering (BLS) spectroscopy and ferromagnetic resonance (FMR), we probed Rayleigh and Sezawa surface acoustic waves (SAWs) alongside Damon-Eshbach and perpendicular standing spin-wave (PSSW) modes. Our results show that acoustic dispersion depends strongly on the buffer material; W-buffered films exhibit a pronounced 16% reduction in Rayleigh SAW frequency compared to buffer-free films, primarily due to mass loading and acoustic impedance shifts. While the buffer layers significantly shift acoustic frequencies, they simultaneously modify the dynamic magnetic response (increasing spin-wave group velocity by ~34%) through different physical mechanisms. Finite-element simulations show excellent agreement with the experimental acoustic data. These findings demonstrate that buffer-layer engineering is an effective strategy for the independent tailoring of elastic and magnetic excitations, providing a versatile platform for hybrid spin-acoustic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了Cr和W缓冲层对生长于MgO(001)衬底上的Co2FeGe全霍斯勒薄膜中声学和磁性激发的独立调控作用。实验表明，W缓冲薄膜的瑞利表面声波频率相较无缓冲层薄膜降低16%，而缓冲层还可通过不同机制使自旋波群速度提高约34%。结果说明，缓冲层工程能够分别调节弹性激发和磁性激发，为混合自旋-声学器件提供平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解和控制磁性薄膜中的声学激发与自旋波激发，对于发展磁振子学和自旋-声学器件至关重要。我们报道了利用Cr和W缓冲层，独立改变生长于MgO(001)衬底上的Co2FeGe全霍斯勒薄膜中的声学和磁性激发。我们采用布里渊光散射（BLS）光谱和铁磁共振（FMR），探测了瑞利型和Sezawa型表面声波（SAW），以及Damon-Eshbach型和垂直驻立自旋波（PSSW）模式。结果显示，声学色散强烈依赖于缓冲材料；与无缓冲层薄膜相比，W缓冲薄膜的瑞利SAW频率显著降低了16%，其主要原因是质量加载和声阻抗变化。虽然缓冲层显著改变了声学频率，但它们也通过不同的物理机制改变了动态磁响应，使自旋波群速度提高约34%。有限元模拟与实验声学数据表现出良好的一致性。这些发现表明，缓冲层工程是独立调节弹性激发和磁性激发的有效策略，并为混合自旋-声学技术提供了通用平台。

articles.title: Large Exchange Magnetostriction in a Kagome Antiferromagnet at Room Temperature
articles.title_zh: 室温下笼目反铁磁体中的巨大交换磁致伸缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00887v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pursuit of high-performance magnetostrictive materials is crucial for advancing technologies in sensing, actuation, and microelectromechanical systems. Although pronounced magnetostrictive effects have been observed in a few ferromagnets, a systematic exploration of magnetostriction across a broader range of antiferromagnets remains limited. Here, we report the observation of large magnetostriction in the kagome antiferromagnet YMn6Sn6. Under a magnetic field, the system undergoes a field-induced evolution from a helical magnetic ground state toward a collinear field-polarized state, accompanied by a large anisotropic lattice strain and a substantial volume magnetostriction exceeding 400 ppm at room temperature. Remarkably, the magnetostrictive response remains nearly fully reversible up to 9 T with nearly hysteresis-free behavior, effectively minimizing the energy dissipation commonly associated with domain-wall pinning. Combined experimental measurements and theoretical calculations reveal that the large, nearly hysteresis-free magnetostriction originates from the competition between intralayer ferromagnetic and interlayer exchange interactions. This exchange-driven magnetoelastic coupling further gives rise to a strongly direction-dependent lattice distortion pathway. This work establishes kagome helimagnets as a tunable platform for low-dissipation magnetoelastic functionalities and responsive magnetomechanical applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在笼目反铁磁体YMn6Sn6中观察到巨大的磁致伸缩效应。外磁场使体系从螺旋磁基态演化为共线场极化态，并伴随显著的各向异性晶格应变，在室温下体积磁致伸缩超过400 ppm。该响应在最高9 T范围内几乎完全可逆且基本无磁滞，其起源是层内铁磁交换与层间交换相互作用之间的竞争。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 探索高性能磁致伸缩材料对于推进传感、驱动和微机电系统等技术至关重要。尽管在少数铁磁体中已观察到显著的磁致伸缩效应，但对于更广泛反铁磁体中磁致伸缩行为的系统探索仍然有限。本文报道了在笼目反铁磁体YMn6Sn6中观察到的巨大磁致伸缩。在磁场作用下，该体系经历了从螺旋磁基态向共线场极化态的场诱导演化，并伴随显著的各向异性晶格应变；在室温下，其体积磁致伸缩超过400 ppm。值得注意的是，在最高9 T的磁场下，该磁致伸缩响应仍几乎完全可逆，并表现出近乎无磁滞的行为，从而有效减小了通常与畴壁钉扎相关的能量耗散。结合实验测量和理论计算，我们发现，这种巨大且近乎无磁滞的磁致伸缩源于层内铁磁交换相互作用与层间交换相互作用之间的竞争。这种由交换作用驱动的磁弹耦合还导致了强烈依赖方向的晶格畸变路径。该工作确立了笼目螺旋磁体作为低耗散磁弹功能和响应式磁机械应用的可调平台。

articles.title: Fourier Neural Operators for Composition-Driven Crystal Structure Discovery
articles.title_zh: 用于成分驱动晶体结构发现的傅里叶神经算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystalline materials discovery is essential for energy, electronics, and catalysis, but the vast chemical and structural space makes exhaustive screening infeasible. Existing voxel-based methods are limited by the local receptive fields of three-dimensional convolutional neural networks and the posterior collapse of high-dimensional variational autoencoders. Here, we develop a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO)-based crystal-field solver that maps a prescribed chemical formula and lattice parameters to periodic number-density and electron-density fields. By operating on global Fourier modes, the solver captures long-range correlations in periodic crystal fields beyond conventional local convolutions. Building on this solver, we construct a coupled generation-solving framework in which a conditional variational autoencoder generates diverse candidate lattice parameters in a low-dimensional basis-coefficient space, followed by density-field prediction and atomic reconstruction through peak detection, position optimization, and weight optimization. The reconstructed structures are further screened using voxel-level filtering, machine-learning interatomic-potential relaxation, and first-principle calculations. The framework generates novel structures across 104 chemical formulas with competitive reconstruction accuracy, demonstrating high generative diversity and structural validity. By extending Fourier neural operators to periodic crystal fields and coupling them with composition-conditioned lattice generation, our approach provides a scalable route to crystal structure discovery from prescribed chemical compositions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种基于傅里叶神经算子的晶体场求解器，可将给定化学式和晶格参数映射为周期性数密度场与电子密度场，从而捕捉传统局部卷积难以描述的长程关联。研究者进一步结合条件变分自编码器生成候选晶格参数，并通过峰值检测、位置优化和权重优化重构原子结构。该框架在104种化学式上生成了具有较高多样性和结构有效性的候选结构，为按指定化学组成发现晶体结构提供了可扩展方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体材料发现对于能源、电子和催化领域至关重要，但巨大的化学空间和结构空间使穷举筛选难以实现。现有基于体素的方法受到三维卷积神经网络局部感受野以及高维变分自编码器后验坍缩问题的限制。在此，我们开发了一种基于傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的晶体场求解器，将给定的化学式和晶格参数映射为周期性数密度场和电子密度场。该求解器通过作用于全局傅里叶模，能够捕捉周期性晶体场中的长程关联，超越传统局部卷积的能力。在此求解器基础上，我们构建了生成-求解耦合框架：条件变分自编码器首先在低维基底系数空间中生成多样化的候选晶格参数，随后通过密度场预测以及峰值检测、位置优化和权重优化完成原子重构。重构得到的结构还会经过体素级筛选、机器学习原子间势弛豫和第一性原理计算进行进一步筛选。该框架在104种化学式上生成了新颖结构，并取得了具有竞争力的重构精度，展现出较高的生成多样性和结构有效性。通过将傅里叶神经算子扩展到周期性晶体场，并将其与成分条件化的晶格生成相结合，我们的方法为从指定化学组成出发发现晶体结构提供了一条可扩展路径。

articles.title: Element priors and target support shape chemical transfer in materials graph networks
articles.title_zh: 元素先验与目标支持塑造材料图网络中的化学迁移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00915v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials graph neural networks must often transfer to chemical regions weakly represented in training data. Such transfer can rely on predefined relations among elements or supervised evidence from target-containing structures, but these pathways are usually entangled. Here, held-out-element splits and incremental target support separate their roles. Without target-containing training structures, formation-energy errors depend strongly on the element representation, particularly for H, O and F. Matched perturbations show that representation-induced sharing matters beyond input dimension or numerical form, while a label-free similarity-graph prior reduces selected zero-shot errors. Adding a few target-containing structures sharply lowers errors and contracts differences among one-hot, k-hot and continuous inputs across ALIGNN and CGCNN. Calibration explains only part of this recovery, and freezing the initial element projection preserves most gains in five of six ALIGNN splits. Target support therefore shifts chemical transfer from reliance on static element relations toward learning from target-containing environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究材料图神经网络向训练数据中代表性不足的化学区域迁移时，元素预定义关系与目标结构监督证据各自发挥的作用。结果表明，在没有含目标元素的训练结构时，元素表示对形成能误差影响显著，而加入少量目标结构后，不同输入表示之间的差异明显缩小。研究说明，目标支持会使化学迁移从依赖静态元素关系转向学习目标元素所处的环境。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料图神经网络常常必须迁移到训练数据中代表性不足的化学区域。这种迁移可以依赖元素之间预先定义的关系，也可以依赖包含目标元素结构所提供的监督证据，但通常难以将这两条路径分离。本文采用留出元素划分和递增式目标支持来区分它们的作用。在没有含目标元素的训练结构时，形成能误差强烈依赖于元素表示，尤其对于H、O和F。匹配的扰动实验表明，表示所诱导的共享作用超出了输入维度或数值形式本身的影响，而一种无标签相似性图先验可以降低部分零样本误差。加入少量含目标元素的结构后，ALIGNN和CGCNN中的误差显著降低，并且one-hot、k-hot和连续输入之间的差异收窄。校准只能解释这种恢复的一部分；在六个ALIGNN划分中的五个划分里，冻结初始元素投影仍能保留大部分增益。因此，目标支持会使化学迁移从依赖静态元素关系转向从含目标元素的环境中学习。

articles.title: Cavity-control of Majorana bound states in superconductor-semiconductor heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 超导体-半导体异质结构中马约拉纳束缚态的腔体调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically study a hybrid superconductor-semiconductor platform hosting Majorana bound states coupled to a single mode photonic cavity. Starting with a one-dimensional wire coupled to a bulk s-wave superconductor embedded in a photonic cavity, we derive an effective light-matter Hamiltonian for such a platform. Assuming that the photonic vector potential is aligned along the tunneling between a wire and a superconductor, we find that the cavity coupling enters only in the effective superconducting pairing term. By solving the coupled electron-photon Hamiltonian using different approaches, such as exact diagonalization in case of zero or large number of photons, high-frequency expansion, and mean-field decoupling, we find that the phase boundary between the topological trivial phases is shifted to smaller values of the Zeeman energy compared to the uncoupled case. Cavity embedding has the strongest effect on the phase diagram in the semiclassical regime, corresponding to a large number of photons. In all cases, we find that at large values of the light-matter coupling strength the effective superconducting pairing is suppressed, driving the system into the gapless phase. We demonstrate that even small light-matter coupling strength allows for entering the topological phase at values of the Zeeman energy compared to the uncoupled platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究与单模光子腔耦合、能够承载马约拉纳束缚态的超导体-半导体混合平台。研究发现，腔体耦合通过有效超导配对项改变拓扑相边界；在半经典的大光子数区域影响最强。较强的光-物质耦合会抑制有效配对并将系统推入无能隙相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究一种承载马约拉纳束缚态并与单模光子腔耦合的超导体-半导体混合平台。我们从嵌入光子腔中的一维导线与体s波超导体耦合的体系出发，推导该平台的有效光-物质哈密顿量。假设光子矢势沿导线与超导体之间的隧穿方向排列，我们发现腔体耦合只进入有效超导配对项。通过采用多种方法求解耦合的电子-光子哈密顿量，包括光子数为零或很大时的精确对角化、高频展开以及平均场解耦，我们发现，与无耦合情形相比，拓扑平庸相之间的相边界移向更小的塞曼能。腔体嵌入对相图的影响在对应于大光子数的半经典区域最强。在所有情形下，当光-物质耦合强度较大时，有效超导配对会受到抑制，从而将系统驱入无能隙相。我们证明，即使光-物质耦合强度很小，也能使系统在相较于无耦合平台更低的塞曼能下进入拓扑相。

articles.title: Weisfeiler-Lehman subtree encoding for Bayesian optimization of atomic configurations
articles.title_zh: 用于原子构型贝叶斯优化的魏斯费勒-莱曼子树编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The efficiency of Bayesian optimization (BO) of atomic configurations depends strongly on how configurations are encoded. We introduce the Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) subtree kernel, which views configurations as element-labeled graphs and measures their similarity by how many local structural patterns they share, into Bayesian-optimization-based configuration search. Because this kernel is reproduced as the plain inner product of explicit features (L²-normalized histograms of local topological patterns), introducing it reduces to introducing the corresponding features: the encoding enters existing BO frameworks as an ordinary descriptor. In a benchmark ground-state configuration search of cubic BC₂N evaluated with a universal machine-learning interatomic potential, the WL encoding reached the ground state almost immediately after a shared random initialization of 100 samples in every one of five independent rounds (108±5 evaluations on average), whereas the one-hot baseline required 280±122 evaluations; the WL-driven sampler first exhausted the degenerate ground-state group and then discovered the metastable degenerate groups from the bottom up, in order of increasing energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将魏斯费勒-莱曼子树核引入基于贝叶斯优化的原子构型搜索，把构型视为元素标记图，并依据共享的局部结构模式衡量相似性。由于该核可表示为显式局部拓扑模式特征的普通内积，它能够直接作为现有贝叶斯优化框架中的描述符。在立方BC₂N基态搜索基准中，该编码比one-hot基线更快找到基态，并按能量递增顺序发现亚稳简并基态群。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子构型贝叶斯优化（BO）的效率很大程度上取决于构型的编码方式。我们将魏斯费勒-莱曼（WL）子树核引入基于贝叶斯优化的构型搜索；该核把构型看作元素标记图，并通过构型间共享的局部结构模式数量来衡量其相似性。由于这一核可以表示为显式特征的普通内积，其中显式特征是局部拓扑模式的L²归一化直方图，因此引入该核等价于引入相应特征：这种编码可以作为普通描述符进入现有的BO框架。在使用通用机器学习原子间势评估的立方BC₂N基态构型搜索基准中，在共享100个样本的随机初始化后，WL编码在五轮相互独立的实验中均几乎立即达到基态，平均需要108±5次评估；而one-hot基线需要280±122次评估。WL驱动的采样器首先耗尽简并基态群，随后自下而上地发现亚稳简并基态群，其顺序对应能量逐渐升高。

articles.title: Topological charges and parity selection at Floquet quasienergy degeneracies
articles.title_zh: Floquet准能简并处的拓扑荷与宇称选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quasienergy spectrum of a strongly driven two-level system as a function of the driving parameters exhibits conical intersections, which are enabled by hidden time-nonlocal symmetries. We show that each such crossing carries a quantized topological charge: the Floquet--Berry phase acquired along an adiabatic loop around a cone is equal to a Z₂-valued charge. We further identify a second family of degeneracies that occurs at vanishing driving amplitude, when the level splitting matches m energy quanta of the field. Along the Stark-shifted resonance line, the minimum quasienergy gap opens as |A|^m, and the charge is nontrivial only for odd m. We analytically derive both results from a perturbative reduction to a spin-1/2 in an effective two-dimensional magnetic field and confirm them numerically through the Bargmann invariant. Moreover, we propose a chirality-based protocol that cancels the dynamical phase to isolate the geometric one, and an ancilla-based Ramsey readout that renders the topological charge directly observable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究强驱动二能级系统准能谱中的锥形交叉及其拓扑性质。每个交叉携带取值于Z₂的量子化拓扑荷，而在驱动幅度为零且能级劈裂匹配场的m个能量量子时，还会出现另一类简并。研究表明，共振线上的最小准能隙按|A|^m开启，且仅当m为奇数时拓扑荷非平凡，并提出了可直接观测该拓扑荷的实验协议。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强驱动二能级系统的准能谱作为驱动参数的函数呈现锥形交叉，而隐藏的时间非局域对称性使这些交叉得以存在。我们表明，每个这样的交叉都携带一个量子化拓扑荷：沿锥体周围绝热回路获得的Floquet-Berry相位等于一个取值为Z₂的荷。我们进一步确定了第二类简并，它发生在驱动幅度为零且能级劈裂与场的m个能量量子相匹配时。在Stark位移后的共振线上，最小准能隙按|A|^m开启，并且只有当m为奇数时拓扑荷才是非平凡的。我们通过将问题微扰约化为有效二维磁场中的自旋1/2，解析地推导出这两个结果，并通过Bargmann不变量进行数值验证。此外，我们提出一种基于手性的协议，用于抵消动力学相位以分离出几何相位；还提出一种基于辅助量子比特的Ramsey读出方案，使拓扑荷能够被直接观测。

articles.title: Mass-conserving growth percolation in polymer gelation
articles.title_zh: 聚合物凝胶化中的守恒质量生长渗流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01044v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polymer gelation involves the emergence of a system-spanning network from growing polymer-rich domains, yet conventional percolation models typically prescribe particle size independently of material consumption. We formulate gelation as a locally mass-conserving growth-percolation process in which Voronoi capture zones define finite material reservoirs for individual nuclei. Local depletion determines the evolving supersaturation and limiting particle size, while particle contacts generate a dynamic network whose first spanning cluster defines the gel point. Three mechanisms, namely, interface-, diffusion-, and polymer-blob-controlled growth produce distinct gelation kinetics while sharing the same accessible final state. Spatial fluctuations in nucleation further generate a distribution of gelation times. The framework separates gelation from saturation and naturally captures post-gel aging as continued growth and topological maturation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将聚合物凝胶化表述为局部质量守恒的生长-渗流过程，其中Voronoi捕获区为各个晶核提供有限材料储库。局部耗尽决定过饱和度演化和颗粒尺寸上限，颗粒接触形成动态网络，其首个贯穿团簇定义凝胶点。界面控制、扩散控制和聚合物团簇控制的生长机制会产生不同的凝胶化动力学，同时该框架还能描述成核涨落导致的凝胶时间分布以及凝胶后的持续老化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚合物凝胶化涉及由不断生长的富聚合物区域形成贯穿整个体系的网络，然而传统渗流模型通常将颗粒尺寸规定为独立于材料消耗的量。我们提出一种局部质量守恒的生长-渗流过程来描述凝胶化，其中Voronoi捕获区为各个晶核定义有限的材料储库。局部耗尽决定不断演化的过饱和度和颗粒尺寸上限，而颗粒接触生成动态网络，其首个贯穿体系的团簇定义凝胶点。三种机制，即界面控制、扩散控制和聚合物团簇控制的生长，会产生不同的凝胶化动力学，但具有相同的可达最终状态。成核过程中的空间涨落还会产生凝胶时间的分布。该框架将凝胶化与饱和过程分离开来，并自然地描述凝胶后的老化，即持续生长和拓扑成熟。

articles.title: First-Principles Electronic Structure Calculation of Crystals in Laboratory Magnetic Fields
articles.title_zh: 实验室磁场中晶体的第一性原理电子结构计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01053v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: External magnetic fields can qualitatively reshape the electronic structure of crystals, underpinning quantum Hall physics, Landau-level spectra and field-induced topological phases. Their first-principles treatment at laboratory-scale fields is, however, hindered by magnetic-flux quantization, which requires magnetic unit cells with areas inversely proportional to the applied field. Such cells contain a large number of chemical unit cells, rendering real-space and plane-wave calculations prohibitively expensive. Here we, for the first time, construct a magnetic Bloch basis built from linear combinations of gauge-including Gaussian-type atomic orbitals, which incorporate the magnetic-field phase factors required by magnetic translation symmetry. The framework requires far fewer basis functions than real-space or plane-wave representations of the same magnetic supercell and retains the sparsity of an atom-centred basis, together substantially reducing computational cost. We validate the framework by reproducing Landau-level spectrum of graphene from first principles. This approach provides a practical route to simulations of crystalline materials under experimentally accessible magnetic fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 实验室尺度磁场会显著重塑晶体的电子结构，但磁通量量子化要求磁性晶胞面积与外加磁场成反比，使实空间和赝势平面波计算的代价难以承受。本文构造了由包含磁场相位因子的规范相关高斯型原子轨道线性组合形成的磁性布洛赫基组，从而大幅减少表示同一磁性超胞所需的基函数数量，并保留原子中心基组的稀疏性。该方法通过第一性原理重现石墨烯的朗道能级谱，为模拟实验可及磁场下的晶体材料提供了实用路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 外部磁场可以定性地重塑晶体的电子结构，并支撑量子霍尔物理、朗道能级谱和场诱导拓扑相。然而，在实验室尺度磁场下进行第一性原理处理受到磁通量量子化的阻碍，因为磁通量量子化要求磁性晶胞的面积与所施加磁场成反比。这类晶胞包含大量化学晶胞，使实空间计算和平面波计算的成本高得难以承受。在此，我们首次构造了一种磁性布洛赫基组，它由规范相关高斯型原子轨道的线性组合构成，并包含磁性平移对称性所要求的磁场相位因子。与同一磁性超胞的实空间或平面波表示相比，该框架所需的基函数数量大幅减少，同时保留原子中心基组的稀疏性，二者共同显著降低了计算成本。我们通过从第一性原理重现石墨烯的朗道能级谱来验证该框架。这一方法为模拟处于实验可及磁场中的晶体材料提供了实用途径。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文提出一种适用于实验室尺度磁场下晶体第一性原理电子结构计算的磁性布洛赫基组方法。该方法结合含规范相位的高斯型原子轨道和磁平移对称性，在降低磁性超胞计算成本的同时复现了石墨烯的朗道能级谱。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的第一性原理电子结构计算、拓扑材料、磁性体系和量子功能材料研究相关，但其核心贡献是磁场下的计算方法开发，与团队主要关注的缺陷、磁性相互作用和材料设计方向的直接联系较弱。该方法对研究外场诱导拓扑相变和磁输运具有潜在借鉴价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议关注该方法在二维磁体、交替磁性材料和磁性拓扑材料中的适用性与数值尺度。后续可将其与 Wannier 哈密顿量、量子输运及强磁场下的光学响应计算结合。

articles.title: Exchange striction determines how fast antiferromagnetic insulators demagnetize
articles.title_zh: 交换伸缩决定反铁磁绝缘体退磁的快慢
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnets combine terahertz spin dynamics with insensitivity to stray fields, and how quickly their order can be manipulated sets the speed limit on device operation. Femtosecond optical pulses demagnetize antiferromagnetic insulators on timescales that span picoseconds to nanoseconds across compounds, and no material parameter is known that accounts for the spread or predicts where a new compound will fall. In a compensated antiferromagnet, no angular momentum needs to leave the spin system, so the rate is set by energy flow from the lattice into the spins. Time-resolved second-harmonic generation experiments show that Cr2O3 demagnetizes within 2 ps once the lattice is driven above the Neel temperature, two orders of magnitude faster than the structurally similar FeBO3. First-principles calculations trace the disparity to exchange striction: short Cr-Cr contacts make the exchange coupling tenfold more sensitive to atomic displacements and widen the phase space for phonon decay into magnon pairs. Spin-lattice simulations with ab initio parameters reproduce the order of magnitude of the measured ratio. The derivative of the exchange coupling with respect to the ionic displacement thus emerges as a computable parameter that predicts how fast an insulating antiferromagnet can be demagnetized. The results advance our understanding of ultrafast control in insulating antiferromagnets, and suggest a practical pathway to screen candidate materials for thermally assisted antiferromagnetic memory before synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究反铁磁绝缘体在飞秒光脉冲作用下退磁速率的材料依赖性，并将其归因于交换伸缩。时间分辨二次谐波产生实验显示，晶格温度超过奈尔温度后，Cr₂O₃可在2 ps内退磁，比结构相近的FeBO₃快两个数量级。第一性原理和自旋-晶格模拟表明，交换耦合对离子位移的导数是可计算的预测参数，可用于合成前筛选适合热辅助反铁磁存储的材料。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体兼具太赫兹自旋动力学和对杂散场不敏感的特性，而其有序态能够被操控的速度决定了器件运行的速度上限。飞秒光脉冲会在从皮秒到纳秒不等的时间尺度上使反铁磁绝缘体退磁，不同化合物之间的时间尺度差异很大，但目前没有已知的材料参数能够解释这种差异或预测新化合物的表现。在补偿型反铁磁体中，自旋系统无需带走角动量，因此退磁速率由晶格向自旋的能量流动决定。时间分辨二次谐波产生实验表明，一旦晶格被驱动到奈尔温度以上，Cr₂O₃可在2 ps内退磁，比结构相似的FeBO₃快两个数量级。第一性原理计算将这种差异追溯到交换伸缩：较短的Cr-Cr接触使交换耦合对原子位移的敏感性提高十倍，并扩大了声子衰变为磁振子对的相空间。采用从头算参数的自旋-晶格模拟重现了测得比值的数量级。由此，交换耦合对离子位移的导数成为一个可计算的参数，能够预测绝缘反铁磁体退磁的速度。研究结果推进了我们对绝缘反铁磁体超快调控的认识，并为在合成前筛选热辅助反铁磁存储候选材料提供了实用途径。

articles.title: Trap Dynamics and Conductivity Changes in AlGaN/GaN Heterostructures Under Ultrasonic Loading
articles.title_zh: 超声加载下AlGaN/GaN异质结构中的陷阱动力学与电导变化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AlGaN/GaN heterostructures are critical for high-power electronic devices but suffer from electron trapping at defects, limiting reliability. We investigate how ultrasonic vibrations affect electron transport in MOCVD-grown AlGaN/GaN heterostructures by combining temperature-dependent Hall effect and high-resolution X-ray diffraction measurements. Here we demonstrate that ultrasonic loading induces persistent acoustoconductivity and lattice parameter changes, attributed to acoustically driven rearrangement of metastable DX centers. This leads to increased carrier concentration and decreased mobility, reflecting defect state modulation by acoustic strain. These findings provide new insights into trap dynamics under dynamic deformation and suggest ultrasonic treatment as a potential approach to mitigate trapping effects, thereby enhancing the performance and reliability of GaN-based devices.
articles.abstract_zh: AlGaN/GaN异质结构是高功率电子器件的关键材料，但缺陷导致的电子俘获会限制其可靠性。本文结合温度依赖的霍尔效应和高分辨率X射线衍射，研究超声振动对MOCVD生长异质结构电子输运的影响。结果表明，超声加载通过声学应变驱动亚稳态DX中心重排，引起持久的声电导效应和晶格参数变化，表现为载流子浓度升高、迁移率下降。
articles.abstract_zh_full: AlGaN/GaN异质结构是高功率电子器件的关键组成部分，但会受到缺陷处电子俘获的影响，从而限制可靠性。我们结合温度依赖的霍尔效应测量和高分辨率X射线衍射测量，研究超声振动如何影响MOCVD生长的AlGaN/GaN异质结构中的电子输运。我们证明，超声加载会诱导持久的声电导效应和晶格参数变化，这归因于由声波驱动的亚稳态DX中心重排。这一过程导致载流子浓度增加而迁移率降低，反映出缺陷态受到声学应变调制。这些发现为动态形变条件下的陷阱动力学提供了新的认识，并表明超声处理可能成为减弱俘获效应、提升氮化镓基器件性能和可靠性的潜在方法。

articles.title: Pressure-regulated mechanochemistry at lithium metal-sulfide electrolyte interfaces
articles.title_zh: 锂金属-硫化物电解质界面处的压力调控机械化学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stack pressure is commonly treated as a means of maintaining physical contact in all-solid-state lithium-metal batteries, but it can also alter the chemistry of reactive solid-solid interfaces. Here, using pressure-aware, charge-resolved machine-learning molecular dynamics validated against DFT, we determine how pressure magnitude and loading geometry regulate interphase formation at Li||Li6PS5Cl interfaces. The response is nonmonotonic: compression at 1 kbar accelerates PS4 decomposition and Li2S-like ordering, whereas 10-100 kbar compression restricts structural rearrangement and long-range crystallization. Charge-resolved dynamics further identify sulfur-centered, lithium-rich early-interphase environments associated with subsequent Li2S-like ordering. Uniaxial loading accelerates interfacial reaction relative to isostatic loading at the same nominal pressure. Pressure also changes void closure and dead-lithium spreading in a defect-location-dependent manner. These results establish applied pressure as a mechanochemical process variable coupling interphase chemistry, ion transport and defect evolution, providing a mechanistic framework for interpreting pressure effects in sulfide solid-state batteries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用经DFT验证的压力感知电荷分辨机器学习分子动力学，研究压力大小和加载几何对Li||Li₆PS₅Cl界面相形成的影响。压力响应呈非单调性：1 kbar压缩会加速PS₄分解和类Li₂S有序化，而10至100 kbar会限制结构重排和长程结晶。单轴加载比相同名义压力下的等静压更能加速界面反应，压力还会以依赖缺陷位置的方式影响空洞闭合和死锂扩展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 堆叠压力通常被视为维持全固态锂金属电池中物理接触的一种手段，但它也可能改变反应性固-固界面的化学性质。在此，我们利用经DFT验证的压力感知、电荷分辨机器学习分子动力学，确定压力大小和加载几何如何调控Li||Li₆PS₅Cl界面的相形成。该响应呈非单调性：1 kbar的压缩会加速PS₄分解和类Li₂S有序化，而10至100 kbar的压缩会限制结构重排和长程结晶。电荷分辨动力学进一步识别出富锂的硫中心早期界面环境，这些环境与随后发生的类Li₂S有序化有关。在相同名义压力下，单轴加载相较于等静压会加速界面反应。压力还会以依赖缺陷位置的方式改变空洞闭合和死锂扩展。这些结果确立了外加压力作为一种机械化学过程变量，它将界面相化学、离子输运和缺陷演化联系起来，并为理解硫化物固态电池中的压力效应提供了机制框架。

articles.title: Interfacial orbital torques excite nanoscale terahertz magnons
articles.title_zh: 界面轨道力矩激发纳米尺度太赫兹磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01118v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exchange-dominated magnons in nanometer-thick ferromagnets extend to the terahertz regime through thickness quantization of perpendicular standing spin-wave (PSSW) modes. While interfacial spin-orbit torques (SOTs) have been shown to enable the excitation of such modes, the microscopic origin of the interfacial driving torque remains unclear. In particular, the coexistence of spin and orbital currents complicates the understanding. Here, we develop and use an atomistic framework that explicitly resolves interfacial symmetries and separates spin and orbital torque contributions. Exploiting a trilayer geometry for a thin ferromagnet sandwiched between non-magnetic layers, where the symmetry-controlled polarity of the interfacial torque produces mode-selective magnon excitation as observed in the recent experiment of Salikhov et al. Nature Phys. 19, 529 (2023), we disentangle the different interfacial torque contributions. By decomposing the torque into magnetization-even (field-like) and magnetization-odd components, we identify the field-like torque as the dominant contribution responsible for the excitation. Crucially, isolating orbital and spin contributions reveals that the interfacial orbital torque provides the primary channel for the efficient excitation of exchange-dominated THz magnons in thin ferromagnets. Our results establish a microscopic basis for symmetry-engineered control of confined terahertz spin dynamics in magnetic multilayers.
articles.abstract_zh: 纳米厚铁磁体中的交换主导磁振子可通过厚度量子化的垂直驻波自旋波模式延伸至太赫兹频段，但界面自旋轨道力矩的微观驱动来源仍不清楚。本文通过显式解析界面对称性并分离自旋与轨道力矩，发现类场力矩是主要激发贡献，而界面轨道力矩是高效激发交换主导太赫兹磁振子的主要通道。研究为通过对称性工程控制磁性多层膜中的受限太赫兹自旋动力学提供了微观基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纳米米厚铁磁体中的交换主导磁振子可以通过垂直驻波自旋波（PSSW）模式的厚度量子化延伸至太赫兹频段。尽管已有研究表明界面自旋轨道力矩（SOT）能够激发这类模式，但界面驱动力矩的微观起源仍不清楚。特别是自旋流与轨道流共存，使得相关机制更加复杂。在此，我们建立并使用一种原子级框架，显式解析界面对称性并分离自旋力矩和轨道力矩的贡献。我们利用一种三层结构，其中薄铁磁层夹在非磁性层之间；在该结构中，由对称性控制的界面力矩极性会产生具有模式选择性的磁振子激发，正如Salikhov等人在近期实验中观察到的那样（Nature Phys. 19, 529（2023）），由此我们分辨出不同的界面力矩贡献。通过将力矩分解为磁化偶对称的（类场）分量和磁化奇对称分量，我们确定类场力矩是负责激发的主要贡献。关键的是，分离轨道和自旋贡献后发现，界面轨道力矩为薄铁磁体中交换主导太赫兹磁振子的高效激发提供了主要通道。我们的结果为通过对称性工程控制磁性多层膜中受限的太赫兹自旋动力学建立了微观基础。

articles.title: Quantum antidipolar systems in two-dimensional geometries
articles.title_zh: 二维几何中的量子反偶极系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01137v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Particles with magnetic moment can be polarized, and rapidly rotated, employing a magnetic field such that the dipolar interaction among them changes sign, becoming antidipolar and thus isotropically attractive in a plane. Polar molecules can also be manipulated using microwave dressing fields to invert the sign of the dipole-dipole interaction. In this work, we study a two-dimensional system of antidipolar particles by calculating its equation of state and structural properties. The system behaves as a liquid even for scattering lengths significantly greater than the dipolar length. For large enough densities, the system transitions to a solid with one particle per lattice site via a first-order phase transition at a significantly smaller density than its dipolar counterpart. Moreover, motivated by the recent realization of a strongly axially trapped, bilayer geometry [Science 384, 546-551 (2024)], we study the properties of the bilayer liquid phase as the inter-layer distance is tuned, and provide the range of parameters where one layer can influence the properties of the other.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过磁场使磁矩快速旋转，或利用微波缀饰极性分子，可以反转偶极-偶极相互作用的符号，使二维平面内的相互作用成为各向同性吸引的反偶极作用。本文计算二维反偶极粒子体系的状态方程和结构性质，发现该体系在较大散射长度下仍可保持液态，并在足够高密度时经一级相变形成固体。研究还考察了双层液体相随层间距变化的性质及层间相互影响的参数范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有磁矩的粒子可以在磁场作用下被极化并快速旋转，使它们之间的偶极相互作用改变符号，进而在二维平面内变成各向同性吸引的反偶极相互作用。极性分子也可以利用微波缀饰场操控，以反转偶极-偶极相互作用的符号。在本文中，我们通过计算二维反偶极粒子体系的状态方程和结构性质，研究这一体系。即使散射长度显著大于偶极长度，该体系仍表现为液体。在足够高的密度下，该体系转变为每个晶格位置包含一个粒子的固体，并通过一级相变发生；其转变密度显著低于对应的偶极体系。此外，受近期强轴向囚禁双层几何实现的启发（Science 384, 546-551（2024）），我们研究了层间距离调节时双层液体相的性质，并给出一层能够影响另一层性质的参数范围。

articles.title: Layer-selective and magnetic-field-enhanced transport of topological kink states in rhombohedral multilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱方多层石墨烯中层选择性且受磁场增强的拓扑扭结态输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological valley kink states (VKSs), which are quantum valley Hall states emerging at the interfaces between adjacent domains with opposite valley Chern numbers, have attracted considerable interest in graphene-based systems. In this work, we investigate the quantum transport of VKSs in ABC-stacked rhombohedral multilayer graphene in the presence of Anderson disorder and a perpendicular magnetic field. Two prominent transport characteristics are revealed. First, in the absence of a magnetic field, the kink states exhibit strong layer polarization, with their wave functions predominantly localized and equally distributed on the outermost top and bottom layers. As a result, their transport properties are highly sensitive to the layer-selective disorder distribution. Second, under a perpendicular magnetic field, the layer-symmetric spatial distribution of VKSs is broken, leading to a significant reduction in the wave-function overlap between counter-propagating VKSs from opposite valleys. Consequently, intervalley scattering is suppressed, and the transmission of VKSs through disordered regions is substantially enhanced. Our results provide new insights into multichannel topological valley transport in rhombohedral multilayer graphene and demonstrates disorder-engineering and magnetic fields as effective approaches for manipulating the propagation of VKSs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究存在Anderson无序和垂直磁场时，ABC堆垛菱方多层石墨烯中拓扑谷扭结态的量子输运。无磁场时，扭结态强烈层极化，主要分布在最外层，因此对层选择性无序十分敏感。垂直磁场会破坏这种层对称空间分布，降低相反传播的不同谷扭结态之间的波函数重叠，从而抑制谷间散射并显著增强无序区域中的透射。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑谷扭结态（VKS）是在具有相反谷陈数的相邻畴之间界面处出现的量子谷霍尔态，近年来在石墨烯基体系中受到广泛关注。在本文中，我们研究了存在Anderson无序和垂直磁场时，ABC堆垛菱方多层石墨烯中VKS的量子输运。我们揭示出两种显著的输运特征。第一，在没有磁场时，扭结态表现出强烈的层极化，其波函数主要局域在最外侧的顶层和底层，并在两者之间等量分布。因此，它们的输运性质对层选择性无序分布高度敏感。第二，在垂直磁场下，VKS的层对称空间分布被破坏，导致来自相反谷、反向传播的VKS之间波函数重叠显著降低。因而谷间散射受到抑制，VKS穿过无序区域的透射得到大幅增强。我们的结果为菱方多层石墨烯中的多通道拓扑谷输运提供了新的认识，并表明无序工程和磁场是操控VKS传播的有效手段。

articles.title: Geometry-Controlled Magnetic and Electronic Landscapes in Anisotropic van der Waals Materials
articles.title_zh: 各向异性范德华材料中几何调控的磁性与电子景观
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01223v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic structure in van der Waals materials is commonly engineered through composition, strain, electrostatic gating and heterostructure assembly. Here we introduce geometronics, a concept in which substrate geometry locally reorients an anisotropic crystal, transforming homogeneous external perturbation into programmable magnetic and electronic landscapes. We demonstrate this concept using a bilayer of the antiferromagnetic semiconductor CrSBr transferred onto an inverted pyramidal nanoindentation, where the local crystal orientation with respect to the external magnetic field drives the coexistence of antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic phases within a single continuous crystal. The resulting magnetic landscape creates a switchable excitonic potential well of up to 10--12 meV, directly visualised by spatially resolved spectroscopy. More generally, geometronics provides a universal route for deterministically programmed electronic and magnetic landscapes without modifying the material itself. It therefore establishes substrate topography as a new design principle that exploits the intrinsic anisotropy of layered van der Waals materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德华材料的电子结构通常通过成分、应变、静电栅控和异质结构组装进行调控。本文提出“几何电子学”概念：利用衬底几何形貌局域地重定向各向异性晶体，将均匀外部扰动转化为可编程的磁性和电子景观。在双层反铁磁半导体 CrSBr 中，局域晶体取向使反铁磁相与铁磁相在同一连续晶体内共存，并形成可切换、深度达 10--12 meV 的激子势阱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德华材料中的电子结构通常通过成分、应变、静电栅控和异质结构组装进行工程化调控。本文提出几何电子学这一概念：衬底几何形貌可局域地重定向各向异性晶体，从而将均匀的外部扰动转化为可编程的磁性与电子景观。我们利用转移至倒置金字塔形纳米压痕上的反铁磁半导体 CrSBr 双层，展示了这一概念；相对于外部磁场的局域晶体取向驱动反铁磁相和铁磁相在单个连续晶体中共存。由此形成的磁性景观产生了深度最高为 10--12 meV 的可切换激子势阱，并通过空间分辨光谱得到了直接观测。更一般地说，几何电子学为确定性地编程电子和磁性景观提供了一条通用途径，而无需改变材料本身。因此，它将衬底表面形貌确立为一种新的设计原则，可利用层状范德华材料的内禀各向异性。

articles.title: Interferometry reveals spin-singlet fractional quantum Hall edges in graphene
articles.title_zh: 干涉测量揭示石墨烯中的自旋单态分数量子霍尔边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The edge modes of spin-singlet fractional quantum Hall (FQH) phases are manifestations of multicomponent topological order and SU(2) spin symmetry. An archetype is the spin-unpolarized state at ν=2/3, whose edge is expected to host spatially coexisting yet counter-propagating charge and neutral spin modes. Despite efforts, its edge properties, including spin coherence and spin-charge separation, have remained elusive owing to the difficulty of resolving spins in FQH edge transport. Here, we develop a spin-sensitive probe of graphene FQH edges by using a p-n junction to interface a target FQH state with a probe integer quantum Hall (QH) state of opposite polarity. An Aharonov-Bohm (AB) interferometer forms along the interface, when the target and probe edge channels carry the same spin. We identify the spin-unpolarized and polarized edges of the ν=2/3 states at lower and higher magnetic fields, respectively, through spin-dependent interference. A novel multiparticle AB interference between two electrons of opposite spin emerges from spin-charge separation and recombination on the unpolarized edge, featuring a spin swap. Our results establish edge transport as a probe of spin-singlet topological orders, with implications for parafermion platforms in graphene-superconductor hybrids.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋单态分数量子霍尔相的边缘模式体现了多组分拓扑序和 SU(2) 自旋对称性，但其自旋相干性及自旋-电荷分离一直难以探测。本文以 p-n 结连接目标分数量子霍尔态与反极性的整数量子霍尔探测态，建立了自旋敏感的石墨烯边缘态干涉探针。研究通过自旋依赖干涉识别了 ν=2/3 态在低场下的非自旋极化边缘和高场下的自旋极化边缘，并发现了涉及相反自旋电子、自旋交换的多粒子阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆干涉。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋单态分数量子霍尔（FQH）相的边缘模式是多组分拓扑序和 SU(2) 自旋对称性的体现。一个典型例子是填充因子 ν=2/3 下的非自旋极化态，其边缘预期承载空间上共存但传播方向相反的电荷模式和中性自旋模式。尽管已有诸多努力，由于在 FQH 边缘输运中分辨自旋十分困难，其边缘性质，包括自旋相干性和自旋-电荷分离，仍然难以捉摸。本文通过利用 p-n 结将目标 FQH 态与具有相反极性的探测整数量子霍尔（QH）态连接，开发出一种针对石墨烯 FQH 边缘的自旋敏感探针。当目标态与探测态的边缘通道携带相同自旋时，沿界面形成阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆（AB）干涉仪。我们通过自旋依赖的干涉，识别出 ν=2/3 态在较低和较高磁场下分别具有非自旋极化边缘和自旋极化边缘。源于非自旋极化边缘上的自旋-电荷分离与重新结合、并具有自旋交换特征的一种新型相反自旋双电子多粒子 AB 干涉随之出现。我们的结果确立了将边缘输运作为探测自旋单态拓扑序的手段，并对石墨烯-超导体杂化结构中的副费米子平台具有意义。

articles.title: Multiple chiral Majorana states in proximitized magnetic topological insulator heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 超导近邻磁性拓扑绝缘体异质结构中的多个手性马约拉纳态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01243v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving robust topological superconductivity with multiple Majorana channels is a key step for scalable topological quantum computing. To this end, we investigate magnetically doped three-dimensional topological insulator heterostructures proximitized by an s-wave superconductor within a fully three-dimensional extended Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang framework that explicitly accounts for vertical confinement. We show that magnetic exchange coupling, orbital mixing, and bulk band inversion cooperate to generate effective equal-spin p-wave pairing channels supporting multiple chiral Majorana modes. The number of Majorana channels is determined by the confined modes in the vertical direction and the high-Chern-number phases of the normal state, which allows us to derive an analytical criterion for the emergence of the multiple-Majorana topological superconducting phases. The chiral Majorana modes remain robust against strong disorder and moderate symmetry-breaking perturbations. We also demonstrate that a superconducting phase difference defining a vertical Josephson junction acts as a tunable parameter that controls the hybridization, minigap, and effective multiplicity of the low energy Majorana channels. Our results establish magnetic three-dimensional topological- insulator heterostructures as a promising platform for engineering multiple chiral Majorana modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现具有多个马约拉纳通道的稳健拓扑超导性，是可扩展拓扑量子计算的重要一步。本文在显式考虑垂直限域的三维扩展 Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang 框架下，研究 s 波超导体近邻诱导的磁掺杂三维拓扑绝缘体异质结构。结果表明，磁交换耦合、轨道混合和体能带反转可产生支持多个手性马约拉纳模的有效等自旋 p 波配对通道，且这些模式对强无序和中等对称性破缺具有稳健性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实现具有多个马约拉纳通道的稳健拓扑超导性，是迈向可扩展拓扑量子计算的关键一步。为此，我们在一个完全三维的扩展 Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang 框架内，研究由 s 波超导体近邻诱导的磁掺杂三维拓扑绝缘体异质结构；该框架显式考虑了垂直限域。我们表明，磁交换耦合、轨道混合和体能带反转协同作用，可产生支持多个手性马约拉纳模的有效等自旋 p 波配对通道。马约拉纳通道的数目由垂直方向的受限模式和正常态的高陈数相决定，这使我们能够导出多个马约拉纳拓扑超导相出现的解析判据。手性马约拉纳模在强无序和中等程度的对称性破缺扰动下仍保持稳健。我们还证明，定义垂直约瑟夫森结的超导相位差可作为一个可调参数，控制低能马约拉纳通道的杂化、小能隙及有效数目。我们的结果表明，磁性三维拓扑绝缘体异质结构是构筑多个手性马约拉纳模的有前景平台。

articles.title: Antiresonances of Wannier-Stark ladders in Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattices
articles.title_zh: Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 晶格中 Wannier-Stark 阶梯的反共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01363v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that Wannier-Stark ladders (WSLs) in one-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains manifest as antiresonance signatures in the electron transmission. We study the quantum transport in the SSH chain in the presence of a periodic potential profile plus a uniform electric field. By employing the global matrix method with non-trivial matching conditions, we find that these WSL antiresonances correspond to states that are exponentially localized at the potential's incident boundary. These findings provide a robust, unified framework for identifying WSLs across diverse scales, ranging from electronic transport in trans-polyacetylene to classical-wave analogs in phononic crystals and surface water waves.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，一维 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 链中的 Wannier-Stark 阶梯可在电子透射中表现为反共振特征。对于具有周期势剖面和均匀电场的 SSH 链，全球矩阵法显示这些反共振对应于在势能入射边界处指数局域的态。该结果为跨越电子输运及经典波类比系统识别 Wannier-Stark 阶梯提供了统一框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，一维 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链中的 Wannier-Stark 阶梯（WSL）会在电子透射中表现为反共振特征。我们研究了存在周期性势能剖面和均匀电场时 SSH 链中的量子输运。通过采用具有非平凡匹配条件的全局矩阵方法，我们发现这些 WSL 反共振对应于在势能入射边界处指数局域的态。这些发现为在各种尺度上识别 WSL 提供了一个稳健且统一的框架，范围从反式聚乙炔中的电子输运，到声子晶体和表面水波中的经典波类比体系。

articles.title: Polar nanoregions and reentrant-like ferroelectric behavior in SrTiO₃
articles.title_zh: SrTiO₃ 中的极性纳米区域与类再入铁电行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent real-space imaging in quantum paraelectric SrTiO₃ [Nature 656, 54 (2026)] reveals that local polar textures do not continuously grow upon cooling, but reach a maximum intensity at intermediate temperatures around 60-65~K and weaken again toward the quantum paraelectric ground state. Such a reentrant-like weakening of local polar textures challenges the conventional paradigm in which ordering tendencies generally strengthen as thermal fluctuations are suppressed. Here we employ a self-consistent phase-field theory showing that this anomalous behavior naturally arises from the interplay between intrinsic polar and antiferrodistortiv (AFD) fluctuations. We demonstrate that flexoelectric-like coupling strongly hybridizes the polar and AFD modes. As the uncoupled polar and AFD modes cross near 52~K, their hybridization is maximized, driving the lower hybridized branch to develop a minimum on a finite-wave-vector shell. This finite-q softening triggers a Brazovskii-type instability, strongly enhancing polarization correlations and producing nanoscale polar textures. Away from the crossing temperature, the two modes become increasingly detuned, weakening their hybridization and the associated finite-q softening. These results reaveal the origin of the formation of polar nanoregions in SrTiO₃, naturally explaining the unexpected confinement to an intermediate-temperature window and providing a mechanism beyond the quantum-fluctuation-based interpretation suggested by experiment. Furthermore, we predict an unconventional reentrant-like sequence in weakly strained SrTiO₃, evolving from ferroelectric to paraelectric, polar-nanoregion, and eventually paraelectric regimes upon heating from zero temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期实空间成像发现，量子顺电体 SrTiO₃ 的局域极性纹理在约 60--65 K 的中间温度达到最大，继续降温时反而减弱。本文利用自洽相场理论指出，这一类再入行为源于内禀极性涨落与反铁畸变涨落的耦合和杂化；在约 52 K 两种未耦合模式交叉时，有限波矢软化触发 Brazovskii 型不稳定性并增强极化关联。研究还预测弱应变 SrTiO₃ 升温时会依次经历铁电、顺电、极性纳米区域和顺电区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子顺电体 SrTiO₃ 的最新实空间成像研究［Nature 656, 54 (2026)］表明，局域极性纹理并不会随冷却持续增长，而是在约 60--65 K 的中间温度达到最大强度，并在趋向量子顺电基态时再次减弱。局域极性纹理这种类再入式减弱，挑战了如下传统范式：随着热涨落受到抑制，有序化趋势通常会增强。本文采用自洽相场理论，表明这种异常行为自然地源于内禀极性涨落与反铁畸变（AFD）涨落之间的相互作用。我们证明，类挠电耦合使极性模式和 AFD 模式发生强烈杂化。当未耦合的极性模式和 AFD 模式在约 52 K 处交叉时，它们的杂化达到最大，驱动较低的杂化分支在一个有限波矢壳层上形成极小值。这种有限 q 软化触发 Brazovskii 型不稳定性，显著增强极化关联并产生纳米尺度极性纹理。偏离交叉温度后，两种模式逐渐失谐，削弱了其杂化以及相关的有限 q 软化。这些结果揭示了 SrTiO₃ 中极性纳米区域形成的起源，自然解释了其出人意料地局限于中间温度窗口的现象，并提供了一种不同于实验所提出的基于量子涨落解释的机制。此外，我们预测弱应变 SrTiO₃ 存在一种非常规的类再入序列：从零温开始升温时，体系依次从铁电区演化至顺电区、极性纳米区域，最终进入顺电区。

articles.title: Accelerating dynamic simulations of photoexcited materials and their evolution by electron-informed machine learning
articles.title_zh: 利用电子信息机器学习加速光激发材料及其演化的动力学模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonadiabatic coupled electron-nuclear dynamics upon electronic excitation underpin the microscopic mechanism and rational modulation of diverse photoinduced functional phenomena in materials, yet their direct first-principles simulations remain computationally demanding. Here we develop a framework for nonadiabatic excited-state machine-learning molecular dynamics (EMLMD) simulations, where the nonequilibrium electronic information upon photoexcitation such as electron temperature is rigorously calibrated from high-precision real-time time-dependent density functional theory (rt-TDDFT) benchmark simulations, enabling accurate reconstruction of excited-state potential energy surfaces (PES). This framework natively incorporates the excited-state electron-phonon couplings and intrinsically captures photoinduced phonon anharmonicity, both of which are missing in standard machine learning molecular dynamics, thus delivering first-principles-level accuracy for excited-state atomic evolutions. Large-scale EMLMD simulations resolve time- and momentum-resolved phonon dynamics in photoexcited materials, directly uncovering the competition between photogenerated coherent phonons and thermal phonons during photoinduced phase transition of bismuth. It also simultaneously resolves elusive atomic-scale microscopic dynamics and global structural rearrangement for selenium photoamorphization. Balancing high accuracy and efficiency, EMLMD offers a versatile paradigm to tackle key challenges in the study of complex excited-state molecular dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子激发后的非绝热电子-原子核耦合动力学决定了多种光致材料现象的微观机制，但直接第一性原理模拟成本高昂。本文提出非绝热激发态机器学习分子动力学（EMLMD）框架，以高精度实时含时密度泛函理论校准光激发后的电子温度等非平衡电子信息，从而重建激发态势能面。该方法可纳入激发态电子-声子耦合和光致声子非谐性，并揭示铋光致相变及硒光致非晶化中的多尺度原子动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子激发后的非绝热电子-原子核耦合动力学支撑着材料中多种光致功能现象的微观机制及其理性调控，然而，对这类动力学进行直接第一性原理模拟在计算上仍然要求极高。本文开发了一种用于非绝热激发态机器学习分子动力学（EMLMD）模拟的框架，其中，光激发后的非平衡电子信息，例如电子温度，均由高精度实时含时密度泛函理论（rt-TDDFT）基准模拟严格校准，从而能够准确重建激发态势能面（PES）。该框架能够原生纳入激发态电子-声子耦合，并内禀地捕捉光致声子非谐性；这两项因素均是标准机器学习分子动力学所缺失的，因此该框架可为激发态原子演化提供第一性原理水平的精度。大尺度 EMLMD 模拟解析了光激发材料中时间分辨和动量分辨的声子动力学，直接揭示了铋光致相变过程中光生相干声子与热声子之间的竞争。它还同时解析了硒光致非晶化中难以观测的原子尺度微观动力学和整体结构重排。在兼顾高精度与高效率的同时，EMLMD 为解决复杂激发态分子动力学研究中的关键挑战提供了一种通用范式。
articles.focus_summary: 论文发展了面向光激发材料的非绝热机器学习分子动力学方法，以实时含时密度泛函理论为基准校准光激发后的电子信息和电子温度，并重构激发态势能面。该方法显式包含激发态电子-声子耦合和光生声子非简谐性，可用于大尺度解析光激发材料中的时间和动量分辨声子动力学。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的非绝热分子动力学、机器学习势、电子-声子耦合、热载流子弛豫、载流子复合和光电材料模拟高度直接相关。该框架尤其适合扩展现有第一性原理激发态动力学的时间和空间尺度，并研究光激发下的结构演化。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议将该方法应用于卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、异质结和光催化界面，研究热载流子冷却、极化子形成、界面电荷转移及非辐射复合。还可结合GW-BSE、Wannier插值和主动学习，提升激发态电子结构及长时间动力学的精度。

articles.title: No source-free exchange-correlation magnetic fields in non-collinear spin DFT
articles.title_zh: 非共线自旋 DFT 中不存在无源交换-相关磁场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that the Maxwellian equation nablacdotBₓc=0, where Bₓc is the exchange-correlation (xc) magnetic field, is not an exact condition of non-collinear spin density functional theory: it violates global spin-rotation symmetry, the operation which turns the electron spins. How much does this matter in practice? To find out we impose the condition anyway, in the best way we can: we modify any parent xc functional so that the Kohn-Sham procedure yields a divergence-free Bₓc that is a functional derivative, stays exact for the homogeneous gas, and exerts the local torques a locally collinear functional cannot. Any non-physical result from the calculation must be due to the spurious condition, not the implementation. On Mn₂ with LSDA as parent, the source-free (SoF) construction and locally collinear (LoC) LSDA both give too short a bond and too large a bond energy, but differ on the magnetic exchange coupling and on the state itself: SoF finds the experimentally observed ¹Σ^+_g antiferromagnet, with a coupling of the right sign and roughly the right size, while LoC finds a high-spin ¹¹Πᵤ ferromagnet and the wrong sign. Despite this seeming success, breaking the symmetry has serious consequences: a rigid spin rotation of the magnetization changes Eₓc by about 1 eV (it should not change at all), and the magnetization induced by a weak uniform field points perpendicular to the field (it should be antiparallel to it).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，在非共线自旋密度泛函理论中，对交换-相关磁场施加散度为零的 Maxwell 型条件并非精确要求，因为它破坏全局自旋旋转对称性。作者构建了满足该附加条件的无源交换-相关泛函，以区分条件本身带来的非物理后果。以 Mn₂ 为例，尽管该构造得到实验观察到的反铁磁基态，却导致刚性自旋旋转时约 1 eV 的交换-相关能变化，并使弱均匀磁场诱导的磁化方向错误。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，Maxwell 型方程 ∇·Bₓc=0，其中 Bₓc 为交换-相关（xc）磁场，并不是非共线自旋密度泛函理论的精确条件：它违反了全局自旋旋转对称性，即旋转电子自旋的操作。这在实际中有多大影响？为探究这一问题，我们仍以尽可能好的方式施加该条件：我们修改任意母体 xc 泛函，使 Kohn-Sham 过程产生一个无散度的 Bₓc；该磁场是一个泛函导数，对均匀电子气仍保持精确，并且能够施加局域共线泛函无法施加的局域力矩。计算中任何非物理结果都必然来自这一虚假的条件，而非实现方法。以 LSDA 为母体泛函时，对于 Mn₂，无源（SoF）构造和局域共线（LoC）LSDA 都给出过短的键长和过大的键能，但二者在磁交换耦合和基态本身上有所不同：SoF 找到了实验观测到的 ¹Σ⁺g 反铁磁态，耦合的符号正确且量级大致正确；而 LoC 找到了高自旋 ¹¹Πᵤ 铁磁态，并给出错误的耦合符号。尽管这一结果看似成功，破坏该对称性会产生严重后果：对磁化进行刚性自旋旋转会使 Eₓc 改变约 1 eV（它本应完全不变），而弱均匀磁场诱导的磁化方向垂直于该磁场（它本应与磁场反平行）。

articles.title: Singular Weak-Field Thermodynamics of 2D Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 二维超导体的奇异弱场热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01602v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a bulk 3D type-II superconductor, the lower critical field at which an isolated vortex becomes thermodynamically favorable is a size-independent material property. We show that the situation is different in 2D superconductors: the larger the superconductor, the weaker the field needed to create its first vortex. The lower critical field in 2D is always size-dependent. For a disk of area mathcal A, the lower critical field Bᵥ(mathcal A) scales as mathcal A⁻¹ln(mathcal A/mathcal A₀) in the weak-screening regime and as mathcal A⁻¹/² in the strong-screening regime. We derive these results from an analytically tractable microscopic model that admits many-body wavefunctions for both the uniform and singly quantized vortex states in a magnetic field, and incorporate screening by coupling their long-distance 2D supercurrents to 3D Maxwell equations. These results motivate organizing the weak-field ground-state of a 2D superconductor in the (1/mathcal A,B) plane. The origin represents the zero-field thermodynamic limit and it is singular. Approaching the origin along the B axis leads to an increasingly dilute vortex lattice, whereas approaching along the 1/mathcal A axis yields the uniform vortex-free state. Our theory shows that every trajectory carrying fixed finite flux ultimately approaches the vortex-free state in the thermodynamic limit and provides a firm microscopic foundation for the weak-field thermodynamics of 2D superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 不同于三维第二类超导体，二维超导体中首个涡旋在热力学上变得有利所需的下临界场总是依赖于样品尺寸，且样品越大，所需磁场越弱。本文导出圆盘二维超导体在弱屏蔽和强屏蔽区间的面积标度关系，并结合二维超电流与三维 Maxwell 方程处理屏蔽效应。研究表明，二维超导体在零场热力学极限附近具有奇异性，而携带固定有限磁通的任意路径最终均趋于无涡旋态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在体三维第二类超导体中，一个孤立涡旋在热力学上变得有利时对应的下临界场，是与尺寸无关的材料性质。我们表明，二维超导体中的情形不同：超导体越大，产生其第一个涡旋所需的磁场越弱。二维中的下临界场总是依赖于尺寸。对于面积为 𝒜 的圆盘，在弱屏蔽区间，下临界场 Bᵥ(𝒜) 标度为 𝒜⁻¹ln(𝒜/𝒜₀)，而在强屏蔽区间标度为 𝒜⁻¹/²。我们从一个可解析处理的微观模型中导出这些结果；该模型允许得到磁场中均匀态和单量子化涡旋态的多体波函数，并通过将其长程二维超电流耦合至三维 Maxwell 方程来纳入屏蔽效应。这些结果促使我们在 (1/𝒜, B) 平面中组织二维超导体的弱场基态。原点代表零场热力学极限，并且是奇异的。沿 B 轴趋近原点会导致越来越稀疏的涡旋晶格，而沿 1/𝒜 轴趋近原点则得到均匀无涡旋态。我们的理论表明，所有携带固定有限磁通的路径在热力学极限下最终都会趋近无涡旋态，并为二维超导体的弱场热力学提供了坚实的微观基础。

articles.title: Generative artificial intelligence for reliable mechanistic reasoning for corrosion
articles.title_zh: 用于可靠腐蚀机理推理的生成式人工智能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00099v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Corrosion accounts for approximately 4% of global GDP, and reliable prediction is essential for timely mitigation. Machine learning effectively predicts corrosion rates from composition, microstructure, and environmental variables, but cannot explain the underlying mechanisms. A reliable approach in safety-critical materials engineering requires not only accurate retrieval but also mechanistically defensible reasoning, a capability that existing factuality metrics cannot assess. This work presents a domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation framework for corrosion knowledge synthesis, demonstrated on magnesium alloy corrosion. Three open-weight language models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) are fine-tuned on 3,309 expert-verified question-answer pairs from 840 peer-reviewed papers and integrated with a hybrid dense-lexical retrieval pipeline. Retrieval augmentation produces Token F1 gains of 143-194%, with system faithfulness of 0.964 and context recall of 0.988. Blind external validation on newly published literature and in-house electrochemical data confirms trend-level generalisation. Reason Map, a proposition-graph framework, is further introduced; it independently constructs directed evidence graphs from generated answers and retrieved literature, enabling systematic detection of causal direction inversions and unsupported inferential leaps that flat factuality metrics cannot expose. The modular architecture can be applied across domains, offering a generalizable blueprint for trustworthy AI-assisted knowledge synthesis to circumvent corrosion, which can also be applied to other engineering domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 腐蚀造成的经济损失约占全球 GDP 的 4%，而仅预测腐蚀速率的机器学习方法难以解释其机制。本文提出面向腐蚀知识综合的领域自适应检索增强生成框架，并以镁合金腐蚀为例，对三种开源权重语言模型进行微调并结合稠密-词法混合检索。该框架显著提高检索与忠实性指标，并通过“推理图”命题图方法识别因果方向颠倒和缺乏依据的推理跳跃。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 腐蚀约占全球 GDP 的 4%，因此，可靠预测对于及时缓解腐蚀至关重要。机器学习能够根据成分、微观结构和环境变量有效预测腐蚀速率，但无法解释其背后的机制。在安全关键型材料工程中，可靠的方法不仅需要准确检索，还需要在机制上站得住脚的推理，而现有事实性指标无法评估这种能力。本文提出了一种用于腐蚀知识综合的领域自适应检索增强生成框架，并以镁合金腐蚀为例进行了展示。三种开源权重语言模型，即 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B 和 Mistral-7B，基于来自 840 篇同行评审论文的 3,309 个经专家验证的问答对进行微调，并与稠密检索和词法检索相结合的混合检索流程集成。检索增强使 Token F1 提升了 143--194%，系统忠实度达到 0.964，上下文召回率达到 0.988。对新近发表文献和内部电化学数据进行的盲法外部验证，确认了其在趋势层面的泛化能力。本文进一步引入“推理图”这一命题图框架；该框架从生成回答和检索文献中独立构建有向证据图，能够系统识别扁平事实性指标无法揭示的因果方向反转和缺乏支持的推理跳跃。该模块化架构可应用于多个领域，为可信赖的人工智能辅助知识综合提供了一种可泛化蓝图，以规避腐蚀问题，也可应用于其他工程领域。

articles.title: Guiding center quantization of a quantum Hall analog of Hawking radiation
articles.title_zh: 量子霍尔霍金辐射类比中的导引中心量子化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00158v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We revisit the quantum Hall analog of Hawking radiation in which a Fermi sea of electrons occupying half of a plane, subjected to a quadrupolar electric potential, gives rise to analog Hawking radiation of chiral edge modes. We show that the phenomenon is accurately captured by quantization of the classical guiding center theory, where the gyroscopic motion of the electrons is coarse grained and only the drift motion is resolved. The quantum dynamics takes place on a non-commutative plane, which requires an electron localized in the half-plane to be supported everywhere along the edge direction. This kinematical constraint on the quantum state leads directly to the radiation, which propagates in both directions away from the origin along the edge. The radiation is thermal with respect to laboratory time, which is equal (up to a constant factor) to the boost angle in the analog Minkowski spacetime in which the chiral edge modes propagate, so in fact it corresponds to analog Unruh radiation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新考察量子霍尔体系中的霍金辐射类比：在四极电势下，占据半个平面的电子费米海可产生手性边缘模式的类霍金辐射。作者表明，该现象可由经典导引中心理论的量子化准确描述，其中电子回旋运动被粗粒化，只保留漂移运动。非交换平面的量子运动学约束直接导致沿边缘向原点两侧传播的热辐射；相对于实验室时间而言，它实际上对应类 Unruh 辐射。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们重新考察了量子霍尔霍金辐射类比：在该体系中，受到四极电势作用并占据半个平面的电子费米海，会产生手性边缘模式的类霍金辐射。我们表明，这一现象可由经典导引中心理论的量子化准确捕捉；在该理论中，电子的回旋运动被粗粒化，只有漂移运动得到分辨。量子动力学发生在一个非交换平面上，这要求局域于半平面内的电子在整个边缘方向上均具有支撑。量子态的这一运动学约束直接导致辐射产生，该辐射沿边缘从原点向两个方向传播。相对于实验室时间，该辐射是热性的；实验室时间与手性边缘模式传播所在的类闵可夫斯基时空中的推进角相等，至多相差一个常数因子，因此它实际上对应于类 Unruh 辐射。

articles.title: Smoothed truncated Coulomb potential for periodic Gaussian-basis Hartree--Fock exchange
articles.title_zh: 用于周期性高斯基组 Hartree--Fock 交换的平滑截断库仑势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00203v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Truncated Coulomb (TC) potentials reduce finite-size errors and accelerate thermodynamic-limit convergence in periodic Hartree--Fock (HF) calculations, but their use with Gaussian basis sets is complicated by the evaluation of electron repulsion integrals (ERIs), particularly for nonspherical truncation domains and all-electron calculations. We introduce the smoothed truncated Coulomb (sTC) potential as a systematically improvable approximation to a parent TC potential. A real-space Gaussian convolution smooths the sharp truncation boundary, and a single dimensionless parameter, η, controls the width of the smoothing window, which can be tightened to systematically approach the TC reference. The smoothing by sTC enables a dual-space algorithm for evaluating periodic Gaussian-basis ERIs that requires neither a large plane-wave basis nor new molecular integral kernels and is applicable to both pseudopotential and all-electron calculations, including the important Wigner--Seitz-cell truncation boundaries. Benchmarks spanning insulating, semiconducting, layered, metallic, and molecular-crystal systems show that sTC-based HF closely reproduces TC results in pseudopotential calculations and extends TC-quality calculations to all-electron settings. Across these systems, sTC substantially improves thermodynamic-limit convergence relative to the probe-charge Ewald method while remaining practical for all-electron calculations in which direct TC-based calculations are computationally challenging.
articles.abstract_zh: 截断库仑势可降低周期性 Hartree--Fock 计算中的有限尺寸误差，但在高斯基组、非球形截断区域和全电子计算中，其电子排斥积分计算较为困难。本文提出平滑截断库仑势，以一个无量纲参数控制截断边界的高斯平滑，并通过对偶空间算法计算周期性高斯基组电子排斥积分。基准结果表明，该方法能在赝势计算中紧密再现截断库仑结果，并将相近精度扩展至全电子体系，同时改善热力学极限收敛。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 截断库仑（TC）势可减小周期性 Hartree--Fock（HF）计算中的有限尺寸误差，并加速向热力学极限的收敛；但其与高斯基组联合使用时，电子排斥积分（ERI）的计算较为复杂，尤其对于非球形截断区域和全电子计算。我们将平滑截断库仑（sTC）势引入为母体 TC 势的一种可系统改进的近似。实空间高斯卷积可平滑尖锐的截断边界，而单一无量纲参数 η 控制平滑窗口的宽度；收紧该窗口可使结果系统地逼近 TC 参考结果。sTC 所提供的平滑性使得能够采用一种对偶空间算法计算周期性高斯基组 ERI，该算法既不需要大规模平面波基组，也不需要新的分子积分核，并可应用于赝势和全电子计算，包括重要的 Wigner--Seitz 晶胞截断边界。涵盖绝缘体、半导体、层状材料、金属和分子晶体体系的基准测试表明，在赝势计算中，基于 sTC 的 HF 结果能够紧密再现 TC 结果，并将 TC 质量的计算扩展到全电子情形。在这些体系中，相比探测电荷 Ewald 方法，sTC 显著改善了向热力学极限的收敛，同时对于直接基于 TC 的计算在计算上具有挑战性的全电子计算仍保持实用性。

articles.title: Mixture of Polyconvex Neural Potentials for Parametric Hyperelasticity: Towards Foundation Material Models
articles.title_zh: 用于参数化超弹性的多重多凸神经网络势：迈向基础材料模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00359v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hyperelastic constitutive models enable modeling large deformations in elastic solids. In common practice, a strain energy density function is prescribed in advance and model-specific parameters are calibrated from experiments. However, many applications require constitutive models for a family of related materials whose mechanical behavior varies with composition. A fixed constitutive model-form may not capture the full range of behavior across the family, while fitting separate forms does not provide a direct way to predict the response of new compositions. Recent work has developed data-driven constitutive models that learn flexible strain energy functions while incorporating key physical constraints. In this work, we propose using mixtures of convex neural potentials based on input convex neural networks as a modular and data efficient approach to modeling material families. Each potential is convex and monotonic with respect to polyconvex strain invariants, while a conditioning network maps material descriptors to mixture weights. We compare the approach with a monolithic partially input-convex neural network using experimental data from PolyJet 3D-printed materials and a synthetic Gent-type benchmark. Across both benchmarks, the mixture architecture generalized better to material descriptors not seen during training. In the PolyJet experimental benchmark, we showed that the mixture architecture is less sensitive to model hyperparameters, while in the Gent-type benchmark it generalized more reliably with sparse data in the material-descriptor space. These results suggest that representing a material family through a small set of shared convex neural potentials provides a useful structural prior for learning descriptor-dependent constitutive behavior from limited data.
articles.abstract_zh: 超弹性本构模型用于描述弹性固体的大变形，但固定模型形式难以覆盖成分变化材料族的全部力学行为。本文提出由输入凸神经网络构成的凸神经势混合模型：各势函数对多凸应变不变量保持凸性和单调性，条件网络则将材料描述符映射为混合权重。在 PolyJet 3D 打印材料实验数据和 Gent 型合成基准上，该混合架构对未见材料描述符和稀疏数据表现出更好的泛化能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超弹性本构模型能够用于模拟弹性固体中的大变形。在常见实践中，预先规定应变能密度函数，并利用实验数据校准模型特定参数。然而，许多应用需要针对一类相关材料建立本构模型，其力学行为随成分而变化。固定的本构模型形式可能无法捕捉该材料族内的全部行为范围，而分别拟合不同形式则无法直接预测新成分的响应。近期研究已发展出数据驱动的本构模型，可在纳入关键物理约束的同时学习灵活的应变能函数。本文提出，使用基于输入凸神经网络的凸神经势混合模型，作为一种模块化且数据高效的方法来建模材料族。每个势函数相对于多凸应变不变量均为凸且单调，而一个条件网络将材料描述符映射为混合权重。我们利用 PolyJet 3D 打印材料的实验数据和一个合成 Gent 型基准，将该方法与单体式部分输入凸神经网络进行比较。在两个基准上，该混合架构对训练期间未见的材料描述符均表现出更好的泛化能力。在 PolyJet 实验基准中，我们表明混合架构对模型超参数不那么敏感；而在 Gent 型基准中，当材料描述符空间中的数据稀疏时，它的泛化更加可靠。这些结果表明，通过一小组共享的凸神经势来表征材料族，为从有限数据中学习依赖描述符的本构行为提供了有用的结构先验。

articles.title: Strong suppression of the photonic density of states in three-dimensional disordered silicon networks
articles.title_zh: 三维无序硅网络中光子态密度的强烈抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00432v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Photonic bandgaps can open not only in crystalline dielectric materials but also in amorphous structures. Self-uniform amorphous gyroid networks have been proposed as promising disordered photonic architectures. Motivated by numerical studies, we combine direct laser-writing lithography with advanced materials processing to fabricate these structures from high-refractive-index silicon. Spectroscopic measurements at mid-infrared wavelengths reveal pronounced transmission minima. To investigate the formation of photonic band gaps in amorphous structures, we develop polarization-resolved transmission spectroscopy that separates ballistic and multiply scattered contributions, enabling direct identification of the underlying transport regimes. We observe a strong suppression of diffuse transmission, providing direct experimental evidence for a breakdown of conventional diffuse transport associated with a strongly reduced photonic density of states. Together with large-scale numerical simulations, our results establish the presence of a deep photonic pseudogap in an amorphous three-dimensional dielectric material and open new opportunities for observing disorder-induced localization phenomena, including Anderson localization of light.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子带隙不仅能够在晶态介电材料中形成，也可以出现在非晶结构中。本文利用直接激光写入光刻和先进材料加工技术，以高折射率硅制备自均匀非晶陀螺网络，并在中红外波段观察到显著的透射极小值。偏振分辨透射光谱将弹道透射与多重散射贡献分离，结果显示漫射透射被强烈抑制，证明非晶三维介电材料中存在深度光子赝带隙，并为研究安德森光局域等无序诱导局域化现象提供了可能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光子带隙不仅能够在晶态介电材料中打开，也可以在非晶结构中形成。自均匀非晶陀螺网络已被提出作为有前景的无序光子结构。受数值研究启发，我们结合直接激光写入光刻与先进材料加工技术，利用高折射率硅制备了这些结构。光谱测量在中红外波长范围内揭示出明显的透射极小值。为了研究非晶结构中光子带隙的形成，我们开发了偏振分辨透射光谱技术，将弹道透射贡献与多重散射贡献分离，从而能够直接识别其背后的输运机制。我们观察到漫射透射受到强烈抑制，这为与光子态密度显著降低相关的传统漫射输运失效提供了直接实验证据。结合大规模数值模拟，我们的结果确立了非晶三维介电材料中深度光子赝带隙的存在，并为观察无序诱导的局域化现象，包括光的安德森局域化，开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: Spatio-temporal coherent molding and retrieval of pulsed signals in optical waveguides
articles.title_zh: 光波导中脉冲信号的时空相干整形与恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00856v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Optical waveguides are key elements for high fidelity, long distance optical communications. Coupled waveguide arrays allow for higher information density, steerting the propagation direction, and for encoding information. However, due to the mixing of relative phases for short pulses containing multiple waveguide-mode frequencies, a process for retrieving an encoded input state once these signals undergo coherent propagation remains elusive. A concept is presented to extract with high fidelity the phase-encrypted input signal from spatio-temporal propagated states. As a realization, an array of coupled waveguides is suggested with the retrieval mechanism being realized by local phase shifts that comply with the identified retrieval concept. Three dimensional full-wave electromagnetic simulations for broadband optical signals in coupled dielectric waveguides confirm the validity of the scheme and the high fidelity of information retrieval pointing to potential applications, for instance in ultrafast coherent coding and decoding of information imprinted on pulse sequences.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种从时空传播态中高保真提取相位加密输入信号的方法，以解决多波导模频率短脉冲在相干传播过程中相对相位混合导致的恢复困难。该方案通过局域相位移实现，并以耦合波导阵列为具体实现平台。三维全波电磁模拟表明，该方法能够高保真恢复宽带光信号中的信息，具有用于超快相干编码与解码的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光波导是实现高保真、长距离光通信的关键元件。耦合波导阵列能够提高信息密度、引导传播方向并实现信息编码。然而，对于包含多个波导模频率的短脉冲而言，由于相对相位发生混合，一旦这些信号经历相干传播，如何恢复编码后的输入态仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。本文提出了一种概念，用于从时空传播态中高保真地提取经过相位加密的输入信号。作为一种实现方案，我们提出采用耦合波导阵列，并通过满足所确定恢复概念的局域相位移来实现恢复机制。针对耦合介质波导中宽带光信号开展的三维全波电磁模拟证实了该方案的有效性以及信息恢复的高保真度，表明其可能应用于脉冲序列所承载信息的超快相干编码和解码等领域。

articles.title: Information geometry of non-equilibrium quantum states: Mixed metric structures on an extended information manifold
articles.title_zh: 非平衡量子态的信息几何：扩展信息流形上的混合度量结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00977v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We discuss an information-geometric framework for characterizing quantum states in non-equilibrium dynamics. Using the transverse-field Ising chain model as a laboratory, we investigate the quantum Fisher information metric with particular emphasis on the mixed metric component gₕₜ and related geometric observables, where h is a controllable post-quench Hamiltonian parameter and t is real time. The framework treats h and t as coordinates of an extended information manifold (h,t). The geometric observables characterize the speed of evolution on the manifold and the alignment between the temporal and parameter-deformation directions. Correlations between these geometric quantities and two widely used measures of non-equilibrium dynamics, the entanglement entropy and the Loschmidt echo, are analyzed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个用于刻画非平衡动力学中量子态的信息几何框架，并以横场伊辛链为研究模型。研究重点是量子费舍尔信息度量中的混合度量分量g_ht及相关几何观测量，其中h为淬火后哈密顿量的可控参数，t为实时间。通过将h和t视为扩展信息流形的坐标，文章分析了几何量与纠缠熵、Loschmidt回波等非平衡动力学指标之间的关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们讨论了一个用于刻画非平衡动力学中量子态的信息几何框架。我们以横场伊辛链模型为研究对象，重点考察量子费舍尔信息度量，尤其关注混合度量分量gₕₜ及相关几何观测量，其中h是一个可控的淬火后哈密顿量参数，t是真实时间。该框架将h和t视为扩展信息流形（h,t）的坐标。几何观测量刻画了流形上的演化速度，以及时间方向与参数形变方向之间的对齐程度。我们分析了这些几何量与两种广泛使用的非平衡动力学度量，即纠缠熵和Loschmidt回波之间的关联。

articles.title: Tangent fermions can restore vacuum stability of discrete-time Dirac models
articles.title_zh: 切线费米子能够恢复离散时间狄拉克模型的真空稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01029v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Dirac quantum walk (a 1+1 dimensional space-time discretization of the Dirac equation) has a 2μ mass gap both at the center and at the corner of the quasi-energy-momentum Brillouin zone. Gupta and Short recently noted [Quantum 9, 1845 (2025)] that the Dirac vacuum can create a particle-hole pair at the zone corner with the release of an energy 2μ to the environment. They removed this vacuum instability at the expense of fermion doubling, the appearance of a second low-energy Dirac cone.
